### [137] [The Code of Theseus: Can Agents Rebuild Software from Recovered Design Documents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20068)
*Cezar Sas,Sandra Mitrović,Fabio Barth,Georg Rehm,Matteo Salani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，从代码的紧凑表示（静态依赖图和关键上下文文件）中恢复对齐的利益相关者意图、需求和架构文档，并发布了一个包含10,764个Java、Python、C/C++和C#仓库的数据集。通过"软件忒修斯之船"实验，让编码代理从这些恢复的文档重建29个Commit0库，结果显示文档显著改善了重建模块的结构相似性（F1从0.54提升到0.63），但对功能正确性（通过率）影响不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地在实现前进行系统设计，但训练和评估数据集中实现和测试占主导（61%和12%），而需求（5%）和设计（3%）数据稀缺。需求和设计文档往往缺失、过时或私密，而源代码却极其丰富。现有的架构恢复方法将完整源码喂给LLM会导致上下文饱和，无法扩展到大量仓库，且只产生单一工件而非对齐的多个工件。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 种子数据集构建——使用Arcan静态分析工具从31,438个候选仓库中筛选14,525个（近5年有提交且至少50星），最终保留10,764个（依赖图节点数在12-1493之间）；(2) 仓库表示——将依赖图与上下文文件（pom.xml、README等）编码为文本形式，相比原始源码节省90%以上的token；(3) 工件生成——使用三个开源LLM（Gemma4-31B、Qwen3.5-122B、GPT-OSS-120B）以零样本提示独立生成三种对齐工件：利益相关者意图、功能/非功能需求、C4架构文档。评估方法：LLM-as-a-judge在7个质量维度上对1,000个仓库的工件评分；编码代理重建29个Commit0库（仅给接口契约和30%可见测试），对比Intent与Full两种条件。

Result: RQ1（工件质量）：三个生成器的产物在清晰度和内部一致性上评分较高（3.6-4.3），但在正确性和抽象层次上评分较低（2.1-3.0）。GEMA（最简洁的）总体质量最高（Q=3.48），QW35次之（3.02），GPTO最差（2.84）。RQ2（功能性）：Full条件相比Intent条件，保留测试通过率仅从33.7%略升至35.8%（Δ=+2.1pp, p=0.160），不显著。RQ3（结构相似性）：非契约模块的F1从0.54显著提升至0.63（Δ=+0.09, p=0.005），召回率从0.51提升至0.63（Δ=+0.12, p=0.001）。两种生成器均产生显著增益，且简洁的GEMA工件与冗长的QW35工件效果无显著差异。契约覆盖率、构件覆盖率和长度均不能预测增益大小。

Conclusion: 恢复的设计文档传达了测试无法捕获的设计信息，能够在不依赖人工参考的情况下，通过"往返"（代码→设计→代码）评估架构恢复的保真度。该数据集为训练"先设计后实现"的LLM智能体提供了可扩展的设计级数据来源。未来工作包括：在对齐工件和代码上微调模型；将工件用作多智能体框架中角色间的交接物；在没有可运行测试的系统中进行重建（工件作为唯一规范）；利用无需人工参考的结构相似性作为训练生成器的奖励信号。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly design a system before implementing it, yet the data to train and evaluate them centres on implementation and testing: requirements and design artefacts are often missing, outdated or private. Source code, in contrast, is abundant. Prior work recovers architecture documentation by feeding LLMs the source code or letting agents explore it, which saturates the context, does not scale to many repositories, and yields a single artefact rather than aligned ones. We present a framework that recovers aligned stakeholder intent, requirements and architecture from a compact repository representation, a static dependency graph and key contextual files, and release the artefacts of 10,764 Java, Python, C/C++ and C# repositories as a dataset. An LLM judge rates the artefacts of three generators as clear and internally consistent, but less reliably correct and at the right level of abstraction. To test whether the artefacts carry the design, we pose a software Ship of Theseus: a coding agent rebuilds 29 Commit0 libraries from the intent alone or with the recovered requirements and architecture, given only an interface contract and part of the tests. The artefacts do not significantly change the held-out pass rate (33.7% vs. 35.8%), but bring the rebuilt module structure significantly closer to the original (module F1 from 0.54 to 0.63), with either generator and even with concise artefacts. Recovered artefacts thus convey design that tests do not capture, offering a scalable source of design-level data for agents that design before they implement, and the round trip measures this without human references.

</details>


### [138] [LintEval: Benchmarking LLMs on Linter-Guided File Refactoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20027)
*Tongwei Deng,Jinyu Zhu,Yue Cao,Chenxu Wang,Yanzhen Zou,Bing Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LintEval是一个针对LLM的多语言基准测试，用于评估在保持功能正确性的前提下进行linter引导的文件重构能力，覆盖C++、Python和Java三种语言，包含13061个程序和171662条lint告警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码基准未能联合评估功能保持、lint告警减少、新告警避免和编辑最小性这四个维度，而linter引导的文件重构与开发者实际工作流紧密相关却缺乏系统评估。

Method: 基于CodeContests+构建功能正确的初始程序，使用clang-tidy、Pylint和PMD提取lint告警并归一化为统一分类法（Error-prone/Performance/Refactor/Style/Other），定义四个条件化评估指标（Reduction@P、New@P、ΔLine@P、LinePerFix@P），并对闭源商业模型与开源模型进行系统评估及SFT对照实验。

Result: 实验揭示持续存在的权衡：闭源商业模型Reduction@P高达90.4%但Pass@1仅67.1%-68.3%，开源小模型出现低或负的Reduction@P；重构导向SFT使Qwen2.5-Coder-7B的Reduction@P从24.7%提升至76.0%，证明监督格式而非仅接触干净代码是关键。

Conclusion: 没有任何方法能同时优化功能保持、告警减少、新告警避免和编辑最小性四个维度，联合优化这些目标仍是自动化代码维护的开放挑战。

Abstract: Linters are widely used in code maintenance and real-time IDE editing to surface lint alerts related to performance, style, error-prone, and other patterns in source files. However, existing code benchmarks do not explicitly evaluate linter-guided file refactoring, where models must reduce lint alerts in source files with correct initial functionality while satisfying functionality preservation. We introduce LintEval, a multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring across C++, Python, and Java, comprising 13,061 programs with correct initial functionality and 171,662 lint alerts extracted using language-specific linters. LintEval jointly evaluates functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality. Experiments reveal a persistent trade-off: closed-source commercial models reach up to 90.4% Reduction@P but achieve only 67.1%-68.3% Pass@1, while several open-source small models show low or negative Reduction@P. A controlled fine-tuning study further shows that supervision format matters: refactoring-oriented SFT raises Qwen2.5-Coder-7B Reduction@P from 24.7% to 76.0%. LintEval enables controlled evaluation of models that improve source files under functionality preservation.

</details>


### [139] [Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning for Code Comprehension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19970)
*Alex Wolf,Pooja Rani,Harald C. Gall*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为TAFT（Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning）的新型适应方法，用于解决代码库随时间演变时大型语言模型的知识错位问题。TAFT通过从代码库转换中生成时间相关的QA数据，采用偏好优化配对新旧知识，并通过重放转换条件的留存样本来保留仍然有效的知识。在扩展的时间SWE-bench数据集（包含255,295个QA条目）上，TAFT在更新知识、抑制过时答案、留存有效知识以及相邻知识稳定性四个维度上均优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着代码库不断演变，专门针对代码库微调的大型语言模型容易出现知识错位问题，包括未获取新知识、未抑制过时知识、遗忘仍然有效的知识，以及破坏语义相关知识。现有的检索、微调和模型编辑方法只能解决其中部分问题，缺少一个系统性的解决方案来处理代码库演变过程中的知识对齐问题。

Method: TAFT（Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning）是一种新颖的代码库适应方法，将代码库版本转换作为监督信号。具体包括三个核心机制：(1) 从代码库转换中派生出时间基础的QA数据；(2) 通过偏好优化（preference optimization）将新有效知识与过时知识进行配对；(3) 重放转换条件的留存示例以保留仍然有效的知识。此外，TAFT-KANT变体在直接提供知识锚点（knowledge anchors）时进一步提升性能。

Result: 在包含255,295个QA条目、跨10个时间切片的扩展时间SWE-bench数据集上的实验结果表明：TAFT在所有评估维度上均优于延迟基线（Baseline）和逐切片重训基线（Baseline-Batched）。具体而言：更新/抑制知识准确率平均相对提升18%，留存准确率翻倍，相邻知识准确率约为基线的1.5倍。当直接提供知识锚点时，TAFT-KANT在更新/抑制、留存和相邻准确率上分别比TAFT提高3.55%、8.35%和13.00%。

Conclusion: TAFT有效解决了代码库演变过程中大型语言模型的知识对齐问题，在更新知识获取、过时知识抑制、有效知识留存和相邻知识稳定性四个方面均取得实质性提升。该方法证明了将代码库转换作为监督信号进行时间自适应微调的可行性，能够使代码理解QA与代码库的持续演化保持一致。

Abstract: Repository-level code comprehension question answering (QA) supports developer reasoning over functionality and usage distributed across codebases. However, repository-specialized large language models (LLMs) can become misaligned as code evolves. We study this challenge as temporal repository adaptation: acquiring new knowledge, suppressing obsolete, retaining still-valid, and preserving semantically neighboring knowledge. Existing retrieval, fine-tuning, and model-editing methods address only parts of this problem. We propose Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning (TAFT), a novel adaptation approach that treats repository transitions as supervision. TAFT derives temporally grounded QA data from repository transitions, pairs newly valid with obsolete knowledge through preference optimization, and replays transition-conditioned retention examples to preserve still-valid knowledge. We evaluate TAFT on an augmented temporal SWE-bench dataset comprising 255,295 QA entries across ten temporal slices, comparing deferred (Baseline), per-slice retrained (Baseline-Batched), and variants with knowledge anchors along four dimensions: updated knowledge, obsolete-answer suppression, retention, and neighbor stability. TAFT consistently outperforms both the deferred and batched baselines, with an average relative improvement of 18% in updated/suppressed knowledge accuracy, doubled retention accuracy, and roughly 1.5 times the neighbor accuracy. With directly supplied knowledge anchors, TAFT-KANT further improves mean updated/suppressed, retention, and neighbor accuracy over TAFT by 3.55%, 8.35%, and 13.00%, respectively. Overall, TAFT demonstrates its effectiveness across all evaluated areas, effectively enabling code comprehension QA alignment with repository evolution.

</details>


### [140] [Taming the Online Software Engineering Tongue: Detecting and Reducing Offensive Language in Software Communities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19961)
*Jithin Cheriyan,Bastin Tony Roy Savarimuthu,Stephen Cranefield*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对Stack Overflow、GitHub、Gitter和Slack四大在线软件工程(SE)社区中普遍存在的攻击性语言问题，构建了一个名为OLRS-SE的四阶段系统，包含检测、分类、解释与改写功能，并基于BERT与传统ML模型进行了全面的实验验证与用户评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Stack Overflow等在线SE社区逐渐变得不友好和充满敌意，攻击性评论损害了参与者的心理健康并导致用户流失（尤其是女性和少数族裔等边缘化群体）。然而现有研究缺乏针对SE领域的细粒度攻击性语言检测与减少系统，因此需要深入调查其普遍性与性质，并开发能够帮助发布者在源头减少攻击性内容的工具。

Method: 方法包括：1) 基于WOAH-2020提供的SO数据集构建三层分类法（Level-1区分RO/UN，Level-2识别攻击目标，Level-3区分种族/辱骂）；2) 开发72个ML模型（每类任务12个，含BERT、RF和SVM，特征组合涵盖TF-IDF、情感与礼貌度）；3) 四阶段OLRS-SE流水线（检测-分类-解释-改写），结合Regex、PAPI与LIME解释器；4) 采用改进的GPS管道（基于RoBERTa）与seq2seq BART模型进行改写，使用J分数过滤；5) 通过30名参与者的用户研究和Cohen's Kappa一致性检验进行评估。

Result: 最佳模型的F1分数在0.56到0.94之间，平均为0.85；BERT在RO检测任务上表现最佳（F1=0.92），SVM在UN检测任务上最优；统计检验表明深度学习模型显著优于传统ML，且礼貌度特征对传统模型至关重要；改写模块平均J分数为0.8；用户评估中97%的参与者对系统性能满意，98%认为该工具有助于减少SE社区的攻击性语言；跨平台测试显示在GitHub、Gitter、Slack上的准确率为57%-100%；IRR验证平均Kappa分数为0.76。

Conclusion: OLRS-SE是首个针对SE社区的综合性攻击性语言减少系统，成功集成了检测、细粒度分类、解释和改写四项功能；系统在SO数据集上表现优异，并具备跨平台应用的潜力；未来工作将探索大语言模型（如GPT、Claude）的集成，以及将系统开发为浏览器插件以扩展应用场景，并研究攻击性语言对软件生产力和多样性的下游影响。

Abstract: Online Software Engineering (SE) communities such as Stack Overflow have become unwelcoming and hostile spaces, as evidenced by the presence of rude and offensive comments that are detrimental to the emotional wellbeing of participants. The main objective of this work is to investigate the prevalence and nature of offensive language in online SE communities, and develop approaches to classify them with the ultimate goal of reducing offensive language by proposing an Offensive Language Reduction System (OLRSSE) that has the ability to detect, classify, and explain to the poster why a comment is offensive and also propose non-offensive alternative suggestions. Using data from 130,000 user comments on discussions held in four prominent SE platforms: Stack Overflow, GitHub, Gitter and Slack, we developed six sets of twelve (72 in total) different machine learning models (both traditional and deep learning). The F1-Score of the best performing models in the system ranges from 0.56 to 0.94, with an average F1-Score of 0.85, predominantly using BERT as the primary model for various classification tasks. Also, two language-based models were developed for paraphrasing offensive to non-offensive comments. The overall utility of the OLRS-SE was evaluated using user studies with 30 participants, which showed that the developed system is easy to use and also effective in reducing offensive language. Investigating the capabilities of different large language models for offensive language reduction is a promising avenue for future research.

</details>


### [141] [Systematic Detection of Energy Regressions in Software Version Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19895)
*Jérôme Maquoi,François Bechet,Luís Cruz,Benoît Vanderose,Xavier Devroey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了EnergyTrackr，一种用于检测多次提交中能耗回归（energy regression）的方法，并在5个Java项目的1,932次提交上进行了实证评估。研究比较了线性扫描与二分搜索两种算法，发现二分搜索在保证结果准确性的同时显著降低了资源消耗和处理时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着信息技术能耗问题日益突出，绿色软件工程受到关注。但在持续开发过程中，如何自动且高效地在提交级别（commit level）检测能耗回归仍缺乏有效手段，现有方法在识别统计显著的能耗变化方面投入不足。

Method: 提出EnergyTrackr方法，用于跨多次提交检测能耗回归。实验在5个Java项目的1,932次提交上进行评估，比较两种算法：(1) 线性算法——分析完整提交历史；(2) 二分搜索算法——更高效地定位能耗变化。两种方法均用于识别具有统计显著性的能耗变化。

Result: 实验结果表明，EnergyTrackr能有效识别跨提交的显著能耗变化。二分搜索算法在发现整体软件能耗趋势方面与线性方法效果相当，但显著减少了资源消耗和处理时间。

Conclusion: EnergyTrackr能够帮助开发者准确监控项目中的能耗回归与改进情况，从而优化源代码以降低软件能耗，有望成为持续开发环境中绿色软件工程的有效工具。

Abstract: Context: Green software engineering is emerging as a crucial response to the rising energy impact of information technology, especially in continuous development. However, challenges remain in devising automated methods to efficiently identify energy regressions across commits. In particular, little effort has been put into automatically detecting regressions at the commit level by identifying statistically significant changes in energy consumption. Objectives: This paper presents EnergyTrackr, an approach for detecting energy regressions across multiple commits. Methods: We empirically evaluated EnergyTrackr on 1,932 commits from five Java projects, assessing its ability to identify significant energy changes. We also compared a straightforward linear algorithm that analyzes the entire commit history with a more efficient dichotomous search algorithm. Results: The evaluation demonstrates the effectiveness of EnergyTrackr in identifying significant energy changes across commits. Our findings highlight the efficiency of the dichotomous algorithm in uncovering overall software energy trends, achieving results comparable to the linear approach while reducing resource consumption and processing time. Conclusion: We expect EnergyTrackr to help developers accurately monitor energy regressions and improvements in their projects and optimize their source code to reduce software energy consumption.

</details>


### [142] [When Does the Dependency Graph Help Code-to-Architecture Mapping?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19769)
*Rakhshanda Jabeen,Morgan Ericsson,Jonas Nordqvist,Anna Wingkvist*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究代码到架构（C2A）映射问题，将其形式化为有向多关系依赖图上的半监督节点分类任务。比较了GCN、GAT和MLP三种编码器在10个开源Java和C/C++系统上的表现，发现所有神经模型均优于朴素贝叶斯基线，GAT在Chrome（18,343个文件的大型系统）上显著优于MLP，但依赖图的优势受系统连通性、同质性等因素影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码到架构映射是软件架构一致性检查（SACC）的前提，但现有方法依赖手工维护映射或不充分的监督学习。随着LLM生成代码的兴起，架构侵蚀问题愈发重要，需要自动化方法从少量标记文件扩展到整个系统。

Method: 将C2A映射形式化为半监督节点分类：以文件为节点、类型化依赖为边、代码标识符和目录路径为特征构建多关系有向图。通过迭代自训练从5%标记集扩展到完整映射。比较GCN、GAT和图无关MLP三种编码器，使用相同的自训练流程和特征表示，以隔离依赖图的贡献。

Result: 1) 三种神经模型在所有10个系统上均优于朴素贝叶斯；2) GAT在系统级中位数宏F1（83.5）和微F1（92.2）平均最高；3) 在Chrome上GAT和GCN分别超出MLP 22和19个宏F1点；4) 多关系聚合在所有系统上优于单一合并边类型；5) 连通性和同质性与消息传递帮助相关，但训练种子影响部分小幅度排名差异。

Conclusion: 依赖图在大规模、高连通性系统中贡献显著（特别是Chrome），但优势并非普遍存在。GAT在低同质性系统上比GCN更具竞争力。设计选择（深度、方向）具有系统依赖性，没有统一最优配置。多关系聚合虽有效，但可能部分归因于增加的模型容量。Chrome上GAT相对MLP的优势是最稳健的结果。

Abstract: Architectural technical debt arises when a system's implementation drifts from its inten ded modular decomposition, while the mapping between source files and architectural modu les is missing, incomplete, or costly to maintain manually. We formulate code-to-archite cture mapping as semi-supervised node classification over a directed multi-relational de pendency graph, with files as nodes, typed dependencies as edges, and lexical features d erived from code identifiers and directory layout. Starting from a small labeled sample, an iterative self-training procedure expands the mapping to the remaining files. We com pare a graph convolutional network (GCN), a graph attention network (GAT), and a graph-f ree multi-layer perceptron (MLP), using identical features and training procedures for t he learned models, against a Naive Bayes reference. Across 100 runs on ten open-source J ava and C/C++ systems, all three neural models outperform the reference on both F1 metri cs. GAT achieves the highest averages of system-level median macro and micro F1, at 83.5 and 92.2, respectively, whereas MLP remains competitive or superior on several systems. On Chrome, the largest system with 18,343 files, GAT and GCN exceed MLP by 22 and 19 ma cro-F1 points, respectively, and have substantially fewer persistently misclassified fil es. Connectivity and homophily are associated with where neural message passing helps, w hile multi-relational aggregation outperforms a single merged edge type on every system for both GCN and GAT. A follow-up study finds that several model rankings depend on the training seed, qualifying smaller advantages without removing the large graph benefit ob served on Chrome.

</details>


### [143] [BenchChecker: Assessing the Credibility of Bug-Fixing Benchmarks for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19447)
*Di Wu,Xu He,Shu Wang,Kun Sun*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出BenchChecker框架，通过取证式两阶段检测（仓库存在测试+补丁存在测试），仅依赖模型文本输出即可检测LLM Bug修复基准中的数据污染问题，实验表明该方法在6个基准上AUC约0.9，去污后中难度任务解决率下降超20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在自动程序修复（APR）领域表现突出，但现有Bug修复基准存在严重数据污染问题，导致评估结果虚高。现有基于logit的成员推断方法不适用于仅提供文本输出的闭源模型，且LLM通常不公开训练集。需要一种兼容开源与闭源模型的污染检测框架，以实现更可信的基准评估。

Method: BenchChecker采用取证式两阶段框架：（1）**仓库存在测试**：通过Bernoulli假设检验，以代码前缀查询-后缀目标对探测模型，选取满足"重复性、独特性、上下文独立性"三条件的签名代码片段，计算p值判定仓库是否在训练集中。（2）**补丁存在测试**：预处理补丁代码块，通过AST对齐在截止快照中定位补丁块，利用代码嵌入模型进行相似度判定，不确定时回退到测试套件验证。实现采用NiCad检测代码克隆、SimHash检测文本重复、PrefixSpan挖掘词共现模式，使用Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B作为参考模型计算熵，使用GumTree进行AST匹配，jina-code-embeddings-0.5B进行嵌入相似度计算。

Result: 在The Stack v2训练的StarCoder-15B、StarCoder2-15B和CodeGen2-16B上评估6个基准（SWE-bench Verified、BugsInPy、BugSwarm、Multi-SWE-bench、Defects4J、GrowingBugs），BenchChecker的AUC约0.9，FPR低于0.1，显著优于Loss、Zlib、Min-K%、Reference四个logit基线（这些基线效果接近随机猜测）。应用到SWE-bench Verified和Multi-SWE-bench排行榜后，中等难度任务（1-4h/Medium）的解决率下降超20%（Multi-SWE-bench Medium平均下降约40%）。污染影响随时间减弱：2023年模型下降40%，2025年仅下降5%，表明新模型泛化能力提升。消融实验验证了三个签名片段准则和补丁预处理的必要性。

Conclusion: BenchChecker是首个针对LLM Bug修复基准数据污染的检测框架，仅依赖文本输出即可同时支持开源与闭源模型，有效揭示了当前排行榜上的结果虚高问题。该工具可帮助基准维护者自动过滤污染样本，提升评估可信度。研究发现：(1)Bug难度越高，模型越依赖记忆；(2)不同基准受污染影响程度不同；(3)同一底层模型的代理框架间结果一致；(4)模型泛化能力随时间提升。研究还分析了SOTA模型的失败模式，发现Bug定位失败是见过补丁却仍修复失败的主要原因，多文件修改是模型的主要挑战。局限性：Stage I在词法层面评估独特性；Stage II假设补丁在截止快照中仍可观测；未覆盖issue描述等非代码形式的污染。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for Automatic Program Repair (APR), existing benchmarks suffer from data contamination, in which test samples appear in training sets, artificially inflating performance. To address this, we propose BenchChecker, a framework compatible with both open-source and closed-source models that supports more credible evaluation by detecting such contamination. Grounded in the observation that persistent patches likely remain in recent repository snapshots used for training, BenchChecker employs a forensics-based two-stage detection process using only textual model outputs together with public repository history. The first stage conducts a repository presence test by probing the model with code prefixes to infer training inclusion; the second stage performs a patch presence test to verify patch persistence via similarity alignment and test-suite verification. Evaluations using StarCoder-15B, StarCoder2-15B, and CodeGen2-16B trained on The Stack v2 demonstrate that BenchChecker achieves robust detection with AUC scores around 0.9 across six benchmarks. Furthermore, applying BenchChecker to SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench reveals that filtering contaminated samples reduces the reported resolution rates of most LLMs by more than 20% relative to the original rates on medium-difficulty tasks.

</details>


### [144] [OS-Bench: Evaluating SWE Agents on Cross-OS Code Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19368)
*Qirui Jin,Kenan Li,Liao Zhu,Lingching Tung,Yikai Zhang,Yijia Wu,Zijian Jin,Pengfei Gao,Yu Kang,Qingwei Lin,Wenke Lee*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: OS-Bench 是一个面向跨操作系统代码迁移的可执行基准测试，包含 140 个来自 111 个真实开源仓库的任务，覆盖 Linux↔Windows 两个方向和 5 种编程语言；通过差分执行覆盖率自动识别平台特定代码并构造任务，评测结果显示当前主流 SWE 智能体在跨平台迁移上表现很差（Linux 目标 26.4%，Windows 目标 20.4%），且源平台回归测试会显著降低报告成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SWE 基准（如 SWE-bench 系列）大多基于 GitHub issue/PR，任务在单一操作系统环境中评测，无法衡量智能体在跨平台迁移中的能力——即在目标平台实现缺失功能的同时保持源平台行为不变。这种能力对实际多平台软件维护至关重要，但缺乏专门的可执行测试平台。

Method: 提出基于差分执行覆盖率（differential coverage）的任务构建流水线：(1) 在 Linux 和 Windows 原生环境分别构建并运行同一仓库测试，收集覆盖轨迹并归一化路径；(2) 用 LM 验证器对单边覆盖区域按六类标签（平台条件、平台 API、平台路径、平台编码、其他兼容特征、假阳性）进行分类，人工复核后保留前五类；(3) 用 LM masker 将目标平台实现替换为占位符构造"不完整仓库"，记录 fail-to-pass 与 pass-to-pass 测试集；(4) 评估时将同一补丁分别在目标平台与源平台原生环境运行，要求目标测试通过且源平台回归测试不退化。同时为 Windows 任务引入 Win-agent 框架（PowerShell 原生工具集）。

Result: 基准含 140 个任务（91 Win→Linux，49 Linux→Win），跨 C/C++/C#/Go/Rust 五种语言，平均每任务涉及 7 个文件、271 行迁移代码，难度分布为 44 易/38 中/58 难。评测 6 个模型 × 4 种 harness：Linux 端最强配置 Claude-Opus-4.8 + OpenHands 达 26.4%；Windows 端最强配置 GPT-5.6-Sol + Win-agent 仅 20.4%。加入源平台回归测试后成功率显著下降（如 GPT-5.6-Sol + Claude Code 由 54.9% 降至 24.2%）。失败原因主要为部分修复（51.4%）与验证遗漏（54.3%），且无任何 Linux 配置解决 C/C++ 任务。不同 harness 对同一模型可造成 6–11 个任务的差距。

Conclusion: OS-Bench 揭示当前 SWE 智能体在跨 OS 代码迁移这一真实且未被充分探索的能力上存在显著短板；可靠的迁移需要智能体识别完整迁移范围、跨文件恢复平台特定行为，并在双系统上验证。OS-Bench 可作为推动平台感知型 SWE 智能体研究的测试平台，未来需改进任务执行跟踪、跨平台验证以及利用提交历史发现跨平台抽象代码。

Abstract: Language-model (LM) agents are increasingly evaluated on repository-level software engineering (SWE) benchmarks derived from GitHub issues and pull requests. Although these benchmarks cover a broad range of development tasks, they provide limited insight into a common yet technically distinct challenge: migrating an existing implementation from one operating system (OS) to another while preserving behavior on both. We introduce OS-Bench, an executable benchmark for cross-OS code migration between Linux and Windows. Motivated by case studies showing that cross-platform features are frequently implemented on one OS before support is added for another, OS-Bench identifies migration opportunities by comparing execution coverage collected from the same repository on both systems. Platform-specific regions are then verified, organized into five migration scenarios, and transformed into repository-level tasks with target-platform tests and source-platform regression tests. The resulting benchmark contains 140 validated tasks from 111 repositories across C, C++, C#, Go, and Rust, comprising 91 Windows-to-Linux and 49 Linux-to-Windows migrations. We evaluate six models with SWE-agent, Claude Code, OpenHands, and Win-agent. The best configurations achieve only 26.4% success on Linux-target tasks and 20.4% on Windows-target tasks while preserving correctness across both systems. These results indicate that cross-OS migration is a challenging and underexplored capability, and OS-Bench is a testbed for improving platform-aware SWE agents.

</details>


### [145] [Beyond Functional Correctness: Static Code Quality Profiling of LLM-Generated Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19167)
*Jue Huang,Tarek Mahmud,Meiru Che,Guowei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM生成代码的静态质量（非功能性属性）进行大规模系统化分析。研究使用LiveCodeBench中73个LLM生成的65,663个Python程序，借助Pylint、Radon和SonarQube三种主流静态分析工具，从可维护性、可靠性、安全性三个维度构建多维静态质量剖面（profile），弥补了现有评估仅依赖基准测试通过率（功能性正确性）的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码生成评估主要关注功能正确性（是否通过基准测试如HumanEval、MBPP、DS-1000等），但这仅提供了有限的质量视图：基准测试通常不完整，通过测试并不保证代码可维护、可靠或结构良好。先前研究表明LLM生成的代码可能存在可维护性和结构性问题，但缺乏大规模、跨模型的静态质量系统化评估。

Method: 1. 数据集：使用LiveCodeBench，73个LLM在最多1055个提示上生成的程序，每提示取第1个样本，过滤后得到65,663个Python程序样本；保留Easy/Medium/Hard难度划分。2. 分析工具与指标：Pylint（Convention、Refactor、Warning、Error四类）、Radon（圈复杂度、Maintainability Index、LOC、SLOC、LLOC、注释行、空行、函数数等）、SonarQube（Maintainability/Reliability/Security三类）。3. 长度归一化：基于每100 SLOC的密度指标，消除代码量对原始计数的干扰。4. 两类子集分析：all-code全集 vs correct-only仅含通过基准测试的子集。5. 两个RQ：RQ1关注跨LLM、跨难度的静态质量变化；RQ2关注功能正确性与静态质量之间的权衡。6. 补充泛化性分析：在HumanEval上以29个LLM重复实验。

Result: RQ1：（1）不同LLM即使功能正确性相近，静态质量剖面也存在系统性差异；（2）可维护性相关和结构指标是最强的差异化维度，可靠性差异较温和，安全性发现普遍稀疏（因LiveCodeBench任务以短函数级竞赛题为主，缺乏安全相关操作）；（3）随任务难度增加，程序普遍变长、圈复杂度升高、Maintainability Index下降、Pylint/SonarQube问题数增加；但归一化后发现，部分问题密度随难度反而稳定或下降，说明原始计数增长部分源于代码量增加。RQ2：（1）正确性与更大、更显式结构化的代码相关联，正确代码通常具有更高的SLOC/LOC/LLOC、更多注释和空行、更高的圈复杂度；（2）正确代码在样本级别具有更高的Maintainability Index和更少的SonarQube Maintainability问题；（3）功能正确性与静态质量相关但不等同，更高正确性并不一致地对应更低复杂度或更少静态分析发现。HumanEval补充分析：主要趋势一致，但LiveCodeBench中正确性与代码扩展、结构复杂度关联更强，而HumanEval中更高正确性更常与更少静态分析发现、更高可维护性相关联，表明静态质量剖面对基准特性敏感。

Conclusion: LLM生成代码的功能正确性与静态代码质量是互补但不可互换的评价维度。应使用多维静态质量剖面（涵盖代码量、复杂度、可维护性、可靠性、编码规范、安全性等）来补充通过率评估。基准设计者应结合正确性条件化和长度归一化的静态质量指标；模型开发者可将这些剖面作为功能性能相近时的次级评估信号；实际开发工作流中，通过测试的生成代码仍应在集成前进行静态分析和质量检查。本研究局限于函数级Python基准，未来工作应扩展到项目级、多文件、多语言的代码生成场景。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet most evaluations still focus on whether generated code passes benchmark test suites. Functional correctness alone, however, provides only a limited view of quality: benchmark tests are often incomplete, and passing them does not guarantee that code is maintainable, reliable, or well-structured. This paper {presents a large-scale static quality profiling of} LLM-generated Python code, with a focus on maintainability and reliability. Using 65{,}663 programs from 73 models in LiveCodeBench, we evaluate generated code with established static analysis tools, including Pylint, Radon, and SonarQube. Our results show systematic differences across models that are not captured by correctness alone, with maintainability emerging as the clearest source of variation. We further find that correctness often comes with structural trade-offs rather than uniformly simpler solutions. Overall, our findings motivate evaluation frameworks that assess LLM-generated code beyond pass rates alone.

</details>


### [146] [DivAlgo: A systematic evaluation of algorithmic diversity for code generation models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19157)
*Anubhav Jangra,Smaranda Muresan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了DivAlgo基准测试，系统评估24个代码生成大语言模型在生成算法多样化解决方案方面的能力。研究发现LLM生成的代码在算法多样性上显著低于人类解决方案（无控制采样仅达人类多样性的31%，最佳多样化生成策略仅达70%），且模型倾向于收敛到更流行的人类解法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM生成的代码在软件开发和计算机科学教育中的广泛使用，用户过度依赖模型输出的现象日益严重。现有的代码生成研究主要关注功能正确性（通过RLVR等后训练技术优化），但忽视了模型生成解决方案的算法多样性。这会导致：(1) 模型反复生成相似的实现，限制了用户接触到的"算法词汇"；(2) 解决方案同质化带来工程成本，因为多样化实现是N版本容错的基础。因此，系统评估LLM生成代码的算法多样性成为迫切需求。

Method: 论文提出三阶段方法：(1) 构建DivAlgo基准——基于CodeContests+数据集，通过程序依赖图(PDG)、CodeXEmbed嵌入模型和6个专有LLM法官的两阶段级联过滤，构建包含15,246个C++解决方案的高质量数据集，标注三层本体（13种范式/64种技术/22种数据结构）；(2) 开发轻量级相似度度量——通过对CodeXEmbed模型进行监督微调（CodeX-SFT，AUC从0.686提升到0.727），并采用Vendi Score衡量群体多样性；(3) 系统评估——在24个LLM（涵盖专有和开源模型）上测试三种策略（无控制i.i.d.采样、温度变化、口头化采样、迭代约束生成），并提出AlgoCov指标衡量对两种代表性人类解法的覆盖度。

Result: 三个核心发现：(1) RQ1（单模型多样性）：无控制采样生成的代码多样性远低于人类——最佳模型Gemini-3.8-flash仅达人类Vendi分数的约31%（4.84/14.27）；即使采用最佳多样化生成策略（Gemma-4-31b + 迭代约束生成），在匹配样本量下也只能达到人类多样性的70.5%；温度提升收益递减且会降低弱模型的正确率。(2) RQ2（模型间收敛）：LLM倾向于生成与更流行人类解法对齐的解决方案（Pearson r=+0.695）；多模型集成（24模型i.i.d.采样）能将多样性从4.32提升至6.69，但仍低于单模型的迭代约束生成策略（8.83），说明异构模型共享难以通过集成克服的算法先验。(3) RQ3（策略可控性）：迭代生成策略在两种粒度上达到了steer(A+B)上界水平，表明算法策略是潜在的而非缺失的；但被引导生成非默认策略时，Paradigm重叠率仅从15.4%升至34.7%，而默认策略达到93.8%，说明模型对冷门策略的表达能力有限；人类在弱粒度（数据结构差异）上的覆盖率达79.6%，远超最佳模型的23.3%，表明细粒度的数据结构选择多样性最难激发。

Conclusion: 算法多样性是当前LLM的一种潜在属性但表达受限。无控制采样无法恢复人类解决方案池中的算法多样性，且模型会向更流行的人类解法收敛。提示模型生成多样化解决方案可以缩小部分差距，但异构模型集成的增益微乎其微。虽然引导特定策略可以提高模型覆盖率，但在所有三个粒度上仍低于人类上限。过度依赖模型生成代码会收窄程序员的算法词汇，代码生成模型在获取人类算法多样性方面存在根本局限。论文贡献包括：(1) 首个大规模细粒度算法多样性基准DivAlgo；(2) 经过LLM集成标注验证的蒸馏轻量级评估指标；(3) 对24个LLM和多种生成策略的系统性研究。

Abstract: Code generation models are actively being used in professional and educational settings. However, the competence of large language models (LLMs) to generate algorithmically diverse code remains largely unknown. We propose the DivAlgo benchmark, a large-scale dataset constituting algorithmically diverse solutions to programming problems. We also introduce a lightweight similarity metric to enable large-scale evaluation. Our experiments across 24 modern code generation models found that uncontrolled model-generated code is significantly less diverse than human solutions (capturing ~31% of human diversity), and even the best diverse code generation strategy could achieve only ~70% of human diversity. Moreover, while it was possible to steer the models to generate solutions based on human strategies, they were unable to reproduce the diversity of the human solutions. These findings indicate the limitations of code generation models in capturing the algorithmic diversity humans exhibit, and that overexposure to model-generated code can narrow programmers' algorithmic vocabulary.

</details>


### [147] [A Systematic Study of Deprecated Android API Usage Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19150)
*Tarek Mahmud,Meiru Che,Guowei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 系统研究Android弃用API的迁移，基于1,000个API与4,336个GitHub示例归纳出6类迁移场景与5种更新模式，将模式注入LLM提示后在156个任务上将正确数从139提升至147。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化API迁移技术受限于API变更的多样性与上下文复杂性，缺乏对开发者实际迁移策略的系统性理解，难以泛化到非简单语法替换的场景。

Method: 1) 从Android开发者文档提取1,000个弃用API及其推荐替换API（通过正则匹配弃用消息，准确率100%、召回率99.6%）；2) 从GitHub收集最多5个/API的迁移实例共4,336个；3) 两位作者手动分析，按签名差异分为3种映射关系（1-to-0/1/多）与6类迁移场景，并归纳出带代码模板的使用更新模式；4) 将类别与模式注入GUPPY zero-shot提示进行适用性评估。

Result: 六类迁移分布为：相同返回类型与参数(33.12%)、相同返回类型不同参数(22.68%)、字段同数据类型(16.28%)、不同返回类型与参数(15.32%)、不同API类型(9.98%)、字段不同数据类型(2.62%)。在GUPPY 156任务上，原提示139正确、模式引导提示147正确；Cat1-5均提升，仅Cat6(19→18)略降，因单一模式仅覆盖该类76%的真实更新。

Conclusion: 实证提炼的迁移模式能为LLM驱动的API更新提供有效领域指导，但异质性强的类别（如Cat6）需多个专门模式或更丰富的程序上下文；为自动化迁移工具与Android开发者维护提供了可复用的分类与模式基础。

Abstract: Android Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) continuously evolve, causing existing APIs to become deprecated and requiring developers to migrate their usages to recommended replacements. Although prior studies have proposed automated migration techniques, their effectiveness is often limited by the diversity and contextual complexity of API changes. This paper presents a systematic study of deprecated Android APIs, their recommended replacements, and real-world usage updates performed by developers. Based on an analysis of 1,000 deprecated APIs and 4,336 migration examples collected from GitHub, we identify six migration categories and derive recurring usage-update patterns involving Android-version checks, parameter adaptation, object initialization, data-type conversion, and changes in API interaction mechanisms. To assess their applicability, we augment the zero-shot GUPPY benchmark prompts with the migration category and corresponding usage-update pattern. On 156 benchmark tasks, the pattern-guided prompt improves correct updates from 139 to 147 and performs better in five of the six categories.

</details>

### [148] [JetStream: Generating Verified Query Accelerators for Existing Database Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20527)
*Akhilesh Balasingam,Amadou Ngom,Geoffrey X. Yu,Tim Kraska*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: JetStream是一个利用LLM代理自动生成数据库查询加速器的系统，它扩展现有的DBMS（而非替换），支持ad-hoc查询并能在持续更新下保持加速效果。系统可生成两种加速器：经差异测试验证的测试型加速器，以及使用Verus进行机器可检查正确性证明的验证型加速器。在TPC-H SF=20上，相比DuckDB实现315×（验证型93×）的读加速，在10K行/秒更新流下仍保持120×加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成的数据库系统（如GenDB、Bespoke OLAP）替换了DBMS的原生存储并假设数据静态，导致用户必须迁移数据、放弃ad-hoc查询、且在数据变化后失去加速效果。本文旨在解决这些实用性问题，让加速器能够扩展现有DBMS而非替换，同时支持写入和ad-hoc查询。

Method: 1) 分阶段agentic合成工作流（分析→实现→优化→审计），外部orchestrator拥有正确性和性能评估以避免reward hacking；2) 引擎中立的substrate抽象层隔离加速器与DBMS特定集成；3) 基于版本化的辅助状态存储支持事务一致性读取；4) 成本模型在增量应用/部分重建/全部重建/延迟重建间动态选择维护策略；5) QSem将SQL自动翻译为Verus规格，agent生成的加速器附带机器检查的正确性证明；6) 分区机制定位维护操作；7) 多worker并发合成各自查询的加速器。

Result: 在TPC-H SF=20：stateful加速器相对DuckDB达到315×读加速（相对PostgreSQL 2001×），相对GenDB的34×和Bespoke OLAP的12×均有提升；verified加速器达到93×。在每秒10K行更新的TPC-H refresh流下，仍保持120×综合加速（verified为40.5×）。在SEC-EDGAR未见工作负载上达到744×（vs DuckDB）和3508×（vs PostgreSQL）。生成所有22个TPC-H状态加速器成本$41.63，验证型成本$334.65。

Conclusion: JetStream证明LLM驱动的数据库特化无需合成完整的替代引擎或假设静态数据。生产级DBMS可继续负责规范存储、事务、恢复和通用SQL，生成组件仅特化工作负载中已知的昂贵部分。这种分离提供了一条实用的路径，能够在不牺牲成熟DBMS的功能和可靠性的前提下，实现日益激进的、工作负载特定的优化。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that LLMs can synthesize highly specialized database systems for fixed workloads, but these systems replace the DBMS's native storage and assume static data: users must migrate their data, often give up ad-hoc queries, and lose acceleration once the data changes. We present JetStream, which instead generates query-specific accelerators that extend an existing DBMS. Given a set of parametrized query templates, a staged agentic workflow synthesizes accelerators that run directly over the DBMS's native tables and may maintain custom auxiliary state, while the DBMS remains responsible for storage, transactions, recovery, and all other queries. A fixed, engine-neutral substrate handles engine-specific hooks and keeps auxiliary state transactionally consistent under writes. JetStream generates two kinds of accelerators: tested accelerators, which may use any optimization and are validated by differential testing, and verified accelerators which trade some performance for a machine-checked proof that every answer satisfies a trusted specification derived from the SQL. On TPC-H at SF=20, JetStream achieves a $315 \times$ geomean read speedup over DuckDB ($93 \times$ verified) and retains $120 \times$ under a continuous update stream of 10,000 modified rows per second.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [149] [Scaling LLM Inference via Parallelism: Throughput-Latency Trade-off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19405)
*Javad Mirzaei,Jeebak Mitra*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM推理服务中的并行配置选择问题，构建了一个融合延迟权衡、SLO感知服务与长上下文可扩展性的统一分析框架，揭示张量并行（TP）与流水线并行（PP）的最优配置随工作负载组成、延迟要求和上下文长度的变化规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式LLM推理系统中，TP、PP及其混合配置的选择高度依赖工作负载特性与延迟需求，但缺乏在变化条件下的系统性选型理论。同时，仅用单一延迟或吞吐指标无法全面表征推理服务性能，需引入TTFT-ITL双维度及goodput等SLO导向指标来刻画并行配置的最优运行区域。

Method: 1) 提出并行运行区域概念：构建TTFT-ITL可行集与Pareto前沿，刻画配置间的延迟权衡；2) 形式化SLO感知选型：通过goodput = 吞吐量 × SLO达成率，在TTFT SLO约束下求解最优并行配置；3) 长上下文扩展分析：固定输出长度，仅增大输入长度，考察goodput与SLO达成率随序列长度的退化行为；4) 基于Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct + vLLM v0.15.0 + 8×H200实验平台，在TP8/TP4PP2/TP2PP4/PP8四种配置下进行实证。

Result: 实验表明：1) Pareto最优工作点随工作负载由decode-heavy向prefill-heavy系统性迁移，从TP主导过渡到PP主导；2) OSL延长主要改善ITL（TP受益最显著），TTFT几乎不变；3) 在紧TTFT SLO下，PP8凭借更高SLO达成率获得最高goodput；SLO放宽后，最优配置逐步向hybrid及TP8迁移；4) 序列长度增大时，PP主导配置的SLO达成率退化更平缓，在长上下文场景下（尤其是紧SLO下）最终超越TP主导配置。

Conclusion: TP、PP及其组合在TTFT-ITL设计空间中各占据不同运行点，并不存在全局最优配置；最优并行配置是工作负载组成（prefill/decode比例）、SLO严格度及上下文长度的联合函数。未来应将并行视为动态可调的运行决策，而非静态部署选择，本文提出的运行区域框架为自适应推理服务系统的并行动态选择奠定了基础。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) serving systems must balance latency and throughput while efficiently utilizing distributed GPU resources. This challenge arises because inference consists of two fundamentally different phases: prefill, which determines time-to-first-token (TTFT), and decode, which determines inter-token latency (ITL). The use of tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), and hybrid configurations exposes different trade-offs between these latency dimensions, making the optimal parallelism configuration highly dependent on workload characteristics, latency requirements, and context length. Moreover, despite the widespread adoption of distributed inference, there is still limited understanding of how parallelism configurations should be selected under varying workload conditions and service-level objectives (SLO). In this paper, we develop a systematic framework for characterizing LLM inference parallelism via throughput-latency trade-offs, SLO-aware serving, and long-context scalability. We introduce the notion of parallelism operating regions by constructing TTFT-ITL feasible sets and Pareto frontiers across different workload compositions, thereby revealing a systematic transition from TP-dominant to PP-dominant configurations as workloads become increasingly prefill-heavy. We further formulate SLO-aware parallelism selection using goodput, showing that stringent TTFT requirements favor PP-dominated configurations, whereas relaxed latency constraints progressively shift the optimality toward TP-dominated configurations with higher serving capacity. Finally, we demonstrate that increasing context length fundamentally changes the relative advantages of parallelism configurations, with PP-dominant configurations exhibiting more favorable scalability and SLO attainment in the long-context regime.

</details>


### [150] [Understanding NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell Unified Memory Through Placement-Controlled Microbenchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20354)
*Nathan Graddon,Aaron Jarmusch,Sunita Chandrasekaran*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对 NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell（GB200）平台的 CUDA 统一内存（Unified Memory, UM），提出了一套"placement-controlled"的微基准测试方法，系统性地分离并量化了多种内存路径与运行时机制的性能差异，指出"统一地址"并不等于"统一性能"。核心结论是：UM 的实际带宽强烈依赖于数据放置位置（本地 HBM / 主机系统内存）、访问历史（冷首次访问 / 预取 / 复用）、访问模式（流式 / 跨步 / 随机 / 稀疏）、以及容量压力（是否超出 GPU 可见内存）。文章还构建了一个测量校准的分析模型，将执行时间分解为计算、本地访问、远程访问、页管理、迁移、淘汰、同步/交接等成本，并用 CPU-GPU 交接实验对该模型进行了验证（平均绝对百分比误差约 0.40%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell（GB200）等紧耦合 CPU-GPU 异构平台通过 NVLink-C2C 实现硬件级一致性访存，CUDA 统一内存（UM）的编程接口进一步简化。然而，"统一寻址（unified addressability）"掩盖了不同硬件路径与运行时机制之间的性能差异：同一个 cudaMallocManaged 分配在 GB200 上可能来自本地 HBM、经主机/系统内存访问、按需迁移、预取、复用、或被淘汰后重载。一个单一的"UM 带宽"数字会误导开发者。已有工作要么针对早期独立 GPU 与 PCIe 系统，要么只关注本地 GPU 微架构，或仅研究前一代 Grace-Hopper。因此，Grace-Blackwell 时代下 UM 的系统级、placement-controlled 特性研究存在空白。

Method: 方法核心是"placement-controlled 微基准测试"，将 UM 行为拆解为独立可控的维度：
（1）内存路径分离：分别测量本地 HBM、host-mapped 系统内存访问、显式 host↔device 拷贝、managed prefetch 等基线路径；
（2）放置策略对比：explicit HBM (cudaMalloc) vs. managed first touch (CPU 初始化后 GPU 首次访问) vs. managed prefetch (cudaMemPrefetchAsync) vs. managed reuse (先前 GPU 访问后复用) vs. cudaMemAdvise 各种 hint；
（3）访问模式扫描：streaming、strided (1~1024)、random（带 shuffled index array）、page-touch（4 KiB / 64 KiB / 2 MiB 间隔）；
（4）容量压力扫描：在 25%~125% CUDA-visible memory 区间对 prefetched/reused managed memory 做流式、跨步、随机访问扫描；
（5）CPU-GPU 交接基准：对比 managed、prefetched managed、host-mapped、explicit copy 四种策略下，1~32 次 GPU 复用的交替执行时间。
实验平台包括 GB200（主目标，2×B200，189 GiB HBM/GPU）、GH200（Grace-Hopper 基线）、GB10/DGX Spark（仅作工作流验证）。每配置 25~30 次试验，使用中位数带宽，5 次 warm-up，并用 Nsight Systems 做 API/UM 事件校验。
分析模型：将执行时间分解为 T_total = T_compute + T_access + T_management，其中 T_access = B_HBM/BW_HBM + B_CPU/BW_CPU，T_management = T_fault + T_migration + T_eviction + T_sync。交接实验用一个仿射模型 T̂_p(B,R) = F_p(B) + R·G_p(B) 描述固定交接成本与每次 GPU pass 的边际成本。

Result: 主要定量结果（GB200，1 GiB STREAM-style triad）：
- 本地 HBM：3963 GB/s（GH200 为 3165 GB/s，约 1.25×）；
- Host-mapped 系统内存：304 GB/s（约为 HBM 的 7.7%；GH200 为 345 GB/s）；
- 显式 H→D 拷贝：211 GB/s；D→H 拷贝：193 GB/s（GH200 分别为 130、67 GB/s）；
- Managed prefetch CPU→GPU：115 GB/s；GPU→CPU：75 GB/s（GH200 为 42、18 GB/s）。

256 MiB 流式 kernel 的放置敏感性：
- Explicit HBM：4582 GB/s；
- Cold managed first touch：14.1 GB/s（仅 0.3% 基线）；
- Managed prefetch：4606 GB/s；
- Managed reuse：4504 GB/s。
GH200 上同样规律，绝对值低一档（3128 / 9.9 / 3121 / 3105 GB/s）。
GB10 上各模式均在 ~80–83% 区间，差异不显著（因 CPU/GPU 共享 LPDDR5X 池）。

访问模式：跨步 1 时 explicit HBM ≈ 4585 GB/s，跨步 1024 跌至 67.7 GB/s；cold managed 跨步 1 仅 8.6 GB/s，跨步 1024 跌至 0.01 GB/s。Page-touch 4 KiB / 64 KiB / 2 MiB 间隔的有用带宽分别为 27.0 / 1.85 / 0.043 GB/s。Random 256 MiB sparse：explicit 144.7 GB/s，cold managed 0.77 GB/s，prefetched 212.8 GB/s，reused 212.2 GB/s。

容量压力：GB200 上 prefetched/reused managed 在 25%~90% CUDA-visible memory 区间保持 4683~4736 / 4674~4701 GB/s；105% 跌至 2385 / 2722 GB/s；125% 跌至 968 / 1214 GB/s。GH200 趋势相同，绝对值约 3.2 TB/s 跌至 424 / 453 GB/s。

CPU-GPU 交接（1 GiB，R=1）：managed 272.1 ms（baseline 54.2 ms + handoff 217.9 ms）；managed prefetch 79.9 ms；explicit copy 60.5 ms；host-mapped 60.2 ms。R=32：explicit copy 73.3 ms 最快，prefetch 92.6 ms，host-mapped 218.7 ms，managed 284.4 ms。

模型验证：affine reuse 模型在 16 MiB~1 GiB 工作集下，验证点（R=2,4,8,16,32）的中位 APE ≈ 0.40%；20 个 size-reuse 组合全部正确预测最快策略。host-mapped 与 explicit copy 的 crossover 预测 R* ≈ 1.06，与实测一致（host-mapped 在 R=1 略快，R≥2 后 explicit 更快）。

Conclusion: 本文通过 placement-controlled 微基准测试，揭示了 NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell GB200 上 CUDA 统一内存"统一寻址 ≠ 统一性能"的核心现象。GB200 相对 GH200 在 resident 与 prefetched 带宽上有明显提升（local HBM 3963 vs. 3165 GB/s；managed prefetch 4606 vs. 3121 GB/s），但 cold first touch、host/system memory 路径（304 GB/s，仅 HBM 的 7.7%）、不规则访问模式以及 oversubscription 仍是主要性能瓶颈。预取与复用可将 managed 内存恢复至接近本地 HBM 的性能，而冷首次访问或跨步/稀疏访问则会显著放大运行时页管理开销；超出 CUDA-visible 内存后，性能断崖式下跌（125% 时 prefetched 从 4.6 TB/s 降至 968 GB/s）。作者给出的测量校准分析模型将执行时间分解为计算、本地/远程访问、fault、migration、eviction、sync 六类成本，并用仿射模型精确刻画 CPU-GPU 复用权衡（中位 APE ≈ 0.40%，20/20 策略选择正确）。实践建议：（1）对带宽敏感的 managed kernel 优先预取或建立 GPU residency；（2）避免持续 oversubscription；（3）多次 GPU 复用时优先 explicit 或 prefetched placement，单次或低复用时 host-mapped 也具有竞争力。微基准套件与脚本将在双盲评审后开源。

Abstract: NVIDIA Grace--Blackwell systems make CPU--GPU memory increasingly unified at the programming level, but unified addressability does not make the memory system uniform. A CUDA managed allocation on GB200 may be served from GPU-local HBM, accessed through host/system memory, demand-migrated, prefetched, reused after GPU access, or evicted and reloaded under capacity pressure. The problem is that these states share a programming interface while exercising different hardware paths and runtime mechanisms, making a single ``Unified Memory bandwidth'' number misleading. This paper presents a placement-controlled microbenchmark study of CUDA Unified Memory on NVIDIA GB200, using GH200 as a Grace--Hopper baseline and GB10/DGX Spark as a validation platform. Our methodology separates local HBM access, host/system-memory access, explicit movement, managed first touch, prefetch, reuse, access-pattern sensitivity, oversubscription, and CPU--GPU handoff, then summarizes the observations with a measurement-calibrated model of compute, access, migration, eviction, synchronization, and handoff costs. On GB200, a 1~GB STREAM-style triad reaches 3963~GB/s from local HBM but 304~GB/s through host-mapped CPU/system memory; for a 256~MB streaming kernel, cold CPU-initialized managed memory reaches 14.1~GB/s, while managed prefetch and reuse reach 4606~GB/s and 4504~GB/s. Below the capacity boundary, prefetched and reused managed memory remain above 4.6~TB/s, but at 125\% of CUDA-visible memory they fall to 968~GB/s and 1214~GB/s, showing that Grace--Blackwell unified memory must be understood through placement, access history, locality, reuse, and capacity pressure.

</details>


### [151] [TrimSO(2): Fast and Memory-Efficient Training of Equivariant Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20029)
*Chen Wang,Yuanchang Zhou,Guangming Tan,Mingzhen Li,Weile Jia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: TrimSO(2)是一种针对基于SO(2)卷积的等变原子间势能模型的快速、内存高效训练算法，通过将表示变换集成到模型现有数据流中，避免中间张量物化，显著降低HBM流量和峰值内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于SO(2)卷积的等变原子间势能模型虽达到最先进精度，但其训练过程耗时且内存密集，现有实现需为密集矩阵乘法周围的表示变换物化大型边张量，导致内存使用和数据移动增加，限制了SO(2)较低算法复杂度的实际效益。

Method: TrimSO(2)通过三种核心策略将SO(2)表示变换集成到模型数据流中：(1) Gather上旋转——直接在gather节点特征时旋转到矩阵乘积输入布局，避免单独的边特征张量；(2) 重组与激活融合——在激活中执行GEMM输出的重组，避免单独的重组边张量；(3) Reduction上逆旋转——将逆旋转与消息聚合结合，避免单独的全局帧边消息张量。该方法支持前向、反向和双反向计算所需的训练高阶微分。

Result: TrimSO(2)在前向、反向和双反向计算中实现2.71–16.73×算子加速，模型级HBM流量减少3.81–9.88×，在A100和H100 GPU上针对官方eSEN、UMA和EquiformerV3工作负载实现2.07–2.94×训练加速和1.53–3.16×峰值训练内存降低，同时保持与PyTorch实现的数值一致性（相对L2误差最大2.77×10⁻⁷）。

Conclusion: TrimSO(2)通过避免中间张量物化，在保持SO(2)基等变模型原有数学运算的同时，显著提升了训练效率和内存效率，证明了数据流优化是加速基于SO(2)的等变势能模型训练的有效途径。

Abstract: Equivariant interatomic potentials enable accurate and efficient simulations of molecules and materials. Among them, models based on SO(2) convolutions reduce the cost of tensor products and achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, but their training remains time-consuming and memory-intensive. Existing training implementations materialize large edge tensors for representation transformations surrounding dense matrix multiplications, increasing memory usage and data movement. We observe that these transformations can be integrated into the model's existing dataflow, avoiding separate intermediate materialization. We introduce TrimSO(2), a fast and memory-efficient algorithm for SO(2)-based equivariant models. It realizes this principle through rotation on gather, recombination with activation, and inverse rotation on reduction, with support for the higher-order differentiation required for training. By avoiding intermediate materialization, TrimSO(2) delivers 2.71-16.73$\times$ operator speedups across forward, backward, and double backward and reduces model-level high-bandwidth memory traffic by 3.81-9.88$\times$. Finally, TrimSO(2) achieves 2.07-2.94$\times$ training speedups and 1.53-3.16$\times$ reductions in peak training memory over PyTorch implementations for official eSEN, UMA, and EquiformerV3 workloads on A100 and H100 GPUs.

</details>


### [152] [JointServe: Serving Multi-Model Agents on Memory-Constrained GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19822)
*Daijin Hu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: JointServe 是一种面向内存受限 GPU（单卡 80GB 量级）的多模型智能体推理服务系统。它将权重分片与 KV 缓存块统一视为竞争同一 HBM 预算的"驻留对象"，利用智能体调用图的"有向调用、间隙执行、双态驻留"三大结构特性，通过意图驱动预取、部分分片驻留（k∗）、抢占式传输调度器（保留 κ 带宽下限保护活跃会话 KV）和动态权重/KV 配额调整（carve-out），在 SWE-bench、τ-bench、OSWorld 等真实智能体轨迹上将 SCT 缩短最多 49%，SLO 达标率从 2.8–24.5% 提升到 76.8–100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM 智能体已从"单模型+工具调用"演变为"规划器+多专家模型协同"，这些异构专家权重无法全部驻留在单块 GPU 内存中。朴素的全模型交换方案存在两大代价：(1) 权重串行传输延迟首令牌（7B FP16 专家仅 H2D 传输即需 0.63s，更不用说磁盘读取路径的 67.76s）；(2) KV 缓存被驱逐后丢失，切换回来时需重新 prefill（SWE-bench 中位上下文 27.5K token 下每次回切需 2.64s）。现有方案（全模型快速加载、INT4 量化共驻、适配器共享基座、会话感知路由）各自只解决局部问题，且量化会"将权重竞争迁移为 KV 竞争"，共享基座假设对异构专家池不成立。核心问题是：在单卡紧内存预算下，应该让哪些字节（权重分片还是 KV 块）驻留，何时移动，依据谁的信号？

Method: 系统设计包含四层核心机制：

1. **统一驻留模型（Unified Residency Model）**：将权重层组 𝒲 与 KV 单元 𝒦 视为独立可选的驻留对象，在统一预算 B_f 下最大化预期避免的恢复工作量 U(S)=Σ p_i·c_i（p_i 为决策窗口内复用概率，c_i 为最便宜恢复路径代价，权重与 KV 各自有 c_i^W=α+s/BW_H2D 或 c_i^K_recompute 的成本模型）。算法 1 提供 (1−ε) 近似保证（ε=ε_C+ε_S+ε_K），通过价值压缩（高分 KV 桶保留 h=⌈2/ε_K⌉ 最小对象）、值舍入动态规划（保留最小字节代表）、低分 KV 前缀索引三分量实现联合选择。

2. **信号驱动的模型预取（Intent-Driven Prefetch）**：在调用方 GPU Worker 输出流上挂载轻量级意图拦截器（intent tap），从工具调用头中确定性识别目标模型，将交换窗口前移到调用方生成阶段与工具执行间隙；无显式意图时回退到一阶 Markov 转移模型，再回退到流行度。

3. **部分分片驻留与流式热交换（Partial Shard Residency）**：每个异构模型保留 k∗ 层组常驻，切换时仅需流式加载 L−k∗ 增量层（分片粒度在 PCIe 上）；运行时通过 per-group ready 事件保证依赖，使 prefill 可在首层到达后即开始，后续层与计算重叠。论文给出在公共释放时间与单保留通道假设下的可调度性充分必要条件：Σ_{j=1}^k t_j ≤ d_k。

4. **抢占式传输调度器与双态 KV 层级**：三层流量（目标预取>分片流>背景 KV）以块粒度排队，高优先级可在块边界抢占；κ-floor（默认 15% 链路带宽）为活跃会话的 KV 恢复保留最低份额；carve-out 控制步根据工作负载动态调整权重与 KV 配额（如崩溃预算下将配额从 50/50 拉偏到 12GB 权重侧以容纳 k∗=23 层的 70B 模型）。KV 采用双态：HBM 热态 + host RAM 温态，后者以 0.05s 替代 2.64s 的 GPU 重新 prefill（20× 优势）。

实现层：基于 SGLang，约 1.5K 行 Python，通过 submit_plan/ready_event/kv_load/kv_offload 四类钩子集成；控制面开销 <0.1% 解码步（每请求约 27.5μs）。

Result: 在 A800-SXM4-80GB 单卡（有效 H2D 带宽 24.3 GB/s）上对比 vLLM、SGLang、ServerlessLLM、INT4-CoResident、INT4-Swap 五个基线：

- **合成工作负载（按内存预算 b 扫描）**：紧预算（b=0.4，24 GB 可用）下 SCT p50 为 516s，比最强全模型交换基线降低 21.7%，比 vLLM 快 15×；崩溃预算（b=0.2，8 GB 可用）下所有全模型基线在 35,000s 窗口内未完成，JointServe 用 758s 完成，差距 46×；充裕预算（b=1.0）下仍比 ServerlessLLM 降低 37.5%，与 INT4-CoResident 持平。
- **真实智能体轨迹**：SWE-bench 上 SCT 降低 49.1%，SLO 达标率从 2.8%→76.8%，物理模型交换从 478 次降至 2 次；τ-bench 上 TTFT p50 提升 45×，SLO 达标率从 24.5%→100%（SCT 仅改善 5.2%，因用户思考间隙吸收了基线的部分交换延迟）；OSWorld 上 TTFT p50 从 31.7s 降至 0.1s，SCT 降 43.3%。
- **量化可组合但不可替代**：7B 紧预算下 JointServe-INT4 比 INT4-Swap 快 21%；32B 紧预算下 JointServe-INT4 比最佳可行基线快 2.3×；崩溃预算下 FP16 分片与 INT4 全模型交换双双越过容量墙，仅 JointServe-INT4 在 14B 与 32B 下仍可行。
- **微观基准**：流式热交换在 1.83s 内使专家可用（prefill 在 0.11s 启动），对比引擎重载的 67.76s 加速 37×；控制面每批 32 请求 811μs，carve-out 步每 64 请求 0.5μs，意图提取每请求 1.2μs。
- **机制消融（b=0.4，标准工作负载）**：去掉部分驻留 → SCT +18.0%（权重交换从 98→257 次）；去掉 host KV 层级 → SCT +53.8%（KV 重计算从 106→286 次）；去掉自适应控制（意图预取+carve-out+κ-floor）→ SCT +24.3%；三者单独拆除在稳态工作负载上接近中性（−4.7%、+0.5%、+0.1%），但同时拆除具有超加和效应，并在 b=0.2 时跨越可行性边界。
- **成本**：在 $2/GPU·h 下，每千次会话 $10.30 vs 最强基线 $14.67，降低 30%。

Conclusion: 服务多模型智能体在内存受限 GPU 上迫使权重与 KV 状态竞争同一字节，JointServe 将此竞争视为单一调度问题：统一驻留公式在单一恢复成本尺度上衡量权重分片与 KV 块；从智能体自身输出流读取的信号在请求存在之前即移动字节；分片运行时在 1.83s 内完成专家交换（对比全量重载 67.76s）。在跨内存预算与三种真实智能体工作负载下，该系统在整模型系统停滞的场景中保持会话交互性，在整模型系统无法运行的场景中保持可行性。随着智能体不断在固定硬件上组装越来越多的专用模型，作者认为"驻留"（而非原始容量）才是值得调度的资源。论文也指出其局限性：依赖异构全参数专家（共享基座专家更适合适配器方案）、意图提取假设工具调用头在调用方输出流中可见、增益幅度受迁移带宽与 prefill 成本影响；未来工作可结合集群副本数与单实例驻留、利用中间激活作为 host 重载与重计算之间的第三 KV 恢复源、根据估计误差自适应选择精度与重求解频率。

Abstract: LLM agents are evolving from a single model calling tools to planners that orchestrate multiple expert models whose capabilities live in distinct weights. This shift breaks a hidden assumption of today's serving systems: that the working set of models fits in GPU memory. On the memory-constrained GPUs typical of private and edge deployments, naive whole-model swapping serializes weight transfer with computation and, without host-backed KV restoration, discards session state at a switch. We present JointServe, a serving system that treats weight shards and KV blocks as residency objects competing for one unified memory budget. JointServe exploits three structural properties of agent workloads (directed calls, gapped execution, and dual-state residency) to prepare models before they are called: an intent signal parsed from the caller's own output stream triggers prefetch during generation, partial k* residency reduces switching to incremental layers, and a preemptive transfer scheduler protects live-session KV with a guaranteed bandwidth share. A carve-out control step adjusts the weight/KV allocation as workload demands change. Evaluations show that JointServe reduces session completion time by 21.7% over the strongest whole-model swap baseline and stays usable in a crash regime where every whole-model swap baseline fails to finish (a 46-fold gap). On replayed SWE-bench, tau-bench, and OSWorld traces, it cuts session completion time by up to 49% and lifts SLO attainment from 2.8-24.5% to 76.8-100%.

</details>


### [153] [The Cost of Context: Profiling the Energy Footprint of Input Tokens in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19819)
*Boris Ruf,Marcin Detyniecki*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM推理中prefill阶段（输入处理阶段）的能耗特征展开实证研究。通过在NVIDIA A100上对Llama-3.1 8B和Qwen-2 7B进行高分辨率遥测，对比了未优化的Hugging Face基线（采用SDPA+连续KV缓存）与优化的vLLM（采用PagedAttention+FlashAttention）两种推理引擎。核心发现：vLLM在112k tokens时可实现最高8.9倍的能耗效率优势，且其J/T（焦耳/Token）曲线在三个数量级的上下文范围内保持近似平坦；而HF基线由于KV缓存碎片化及内存带宽瓶颈，延迟在~16k tokens处即开始线性增长。输入/输出token能耗比在两种引擎中呈现相反趋势——优化引擎中该比值从~850倍缩小到~750倍（因decode效率高），而未优化引擎中保持~150-230倍的较小常数比值（因prefill本身代价高昂）。研究将"Prefill悖论"（高瞬时功耗 vs. 子线性边际能耗）解释为"完成竞赛"（Race to Finish）现象——高功耗恰恰是实现并行效率的机制，而非矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献在LLM输入token的能耗特性上存在明显矛盾：硬件级基准（如TokenPowerBench）报告prefill阶段GPU功耗可飙升3倍，与自注意力的O(n²)复杂度一致；而系统级使用研究（如Caravaca等）却观测到即使处理5万token的上下文，总能耗仅边际增加，呈亚线性特征。这一"Prefill悖论"源于缺乏对prefill与decode阶段独立、细粒度的能耗特征刻画。此外，主流能耗估算方法仅基于输出token计数而忽略输入token，与RAG、长文档摘要等以输入为主的实际应用场景严重脱节。本文旨在弥合硬件遥测与应用层估算之间的鸿沟。

Method: 1) 遥测方案：基于NVML以1ms采样率采集GPU瞬时功耗，与推理引擎的prefill_start/prefill_end事件标记对齐积分得到E_prefill；2) 工作负载：采用对数扫描L∈[2⁸, 2¹⁷]的合成prompt，使用模型原生tokenizer精确控制token数（语义无关，因为注意力计算与内容无关）；3) 两组对照：HF Baseline（Eager+SDPA+连续KV缓存）vs. vLLM（PagedAttention+FlashAttention）；4) 平台：NVIDIA A100 80GB，bfloat16精度，单一确定性运行（greedy decoding，无批处理）；5) 对比强度协议：固定输出长度G=128，通过E_out=(E_total-E_prefill)/G推导每个输出token的能耗，建立E_out/E_in的强度比；6) 组件归因：结合瞬时功率P_avg与归一化延迟（ms/token）分析Compute Saturation Cliff与Memory Bandwidth Wall两个临界点。

Result: 1) 能效阈值识别：GPU功耗在>16,384 tokens时达到~280-310W的饱和平台（A100电气极限），标志着Compute Saturation Cliff的进入；2) 能效差异：在L≈112k时，vLLM处理Llama-3.1仅需3.54s/1005J（0.0090 J/Tok），而HF基线需25.54s/7600J（0.0678 J/Tok），效率提升7.6倍（Qwen-2达8.9倍）；3) J/T曲线特征：vLLM在三个数量级的上下文范围内保持近似平坦的J/T，而HF基线延迟呈线性O(n)增长，反映O(n²)的总复杂度主导；4) 输入/输出比：在vLLM中，L=1k时E_out/E_in≈850倍，L=112k时降至~750倍（decode高效使比值收窄）；HF基线中该比值保持~150-230倍，因其prefill本身昂贵（高~9倍）而decode仅贵1.5-2.6倍，缩小了二者差距。核心阐释："Prefill悖论"非数据矛盾，而是"Race to Finish"现象——高瞬时功耗恰是实现子线性每token能耗的并行效率机制。

Conclusion: 本文建立了一组上下文扩展定律（context-scaling laws），区分了引擎级优化（PagedAttention、FlashAttention、kernel fusion）与模型固有约束。结论指出：1) 预填充能耗矛盾本质上是编排挑战而非算术限制——未优化基线因无法掩盖自注意力内存流量的二次增长而触及效率阈值；2) 优化引擎通过并行执行有效摊销固定硬件成本，在三个数量级范围内维持平坦的J/T分布；3) 内存编排策略是延迟效率阈值的关键因素，在112k tokens处可带来最高8.9倍的能耗效率优势；4) 对纯文本现代优化栈而言，即使超过10万token，输入token相对输出token仍可忽略；但该平衡在多模态输入或未来架构变化下可能改变；5) 可持续AI的研究焦点应从模型约束转向基础设施级优化。未来工作方向：批处理对decode阶段的能耗摊销、FP8/INT4量化的精度-能耗取舍、MoE与70B+参数模型的架构可扩展性研究。

Abstract: The rapid adoption of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and long-context LLMs has shifted the computational burden toward the prefill phase---the initial stage where the model processes all input tokens in parallel before generating a response---yet its energy impact remains poorly characterised. We investigate the contradiction between massive hardware-level power spikes and the sub-linear marginal cost of input tokens reported in system-level studies. Through high-resolution telemetry of Llama-3.1 and Qwen-2 models on NVIDIA A100 hardware, we identify the efficiency threshold where $O(n^2)$ attention complexity overcomes GPU parallelisation. Our results quantify how optimised memory orchestration (PagedAttention) delays this scaling bottleneck across three orders of context scaling, yielding up to an 8.9$\times$ energy efficiency advantage at 112,000 tokens compared to standard baselines. Furthermore, we characterise the energy disparity between input and output tokens, demonstrating that optimised serving (vLLM) causes this ratio to narrow (from $\approx$850$\times$ to 750$\times$) as context scales due to high decode efficiency, whereas unoptimised baselines show a much smaller, roughly constant gap ($\approx$150--230$\times$) because their prefill is itself expensive. This work establishes context-scaling laws that differentiate engine-level optimisations from inherent model constraints, providing an empirical framework for sustainable LLM deployment.

</details>


### [154] [Parallel Sparse Outputs for Tensor Compilers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19308)
*Adrian Gushin,Pau Sum,Willow Ahrens*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Birdseed，这是首个支持所有循环顺序和任意标准稀疏格式并行执行的稀疏张量编译器，通过"张量正规形"（normal form）概念实现轻量级合并，支持并行稀疏scatter，并直接写入list、bytemap、hash和dense等fibertree格式，在内存和时间复杂度上均优于现有工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏张量计算在科学计算和机器学习中至关重要，但现有的并行稀疏编译器要么不支持并行，要么对访问模式或输出格式做出限制性假设（如要求输出某维dense、依赖排序状态等），无法通用地处理所有标准稀疏格式和循环顺序。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1) 张量正规形（Tensor Normal Form）——定义唯一性和单调性两个不变量，将私有化的稀疏张量转换为正规形；(2) 轻量级合并算法，通过采样随机负载均衡（基于Hoeffding不等式的概率保证）和无重复累加器实现高效归约；(3) 面向稀疏scatter的并行分配的合并（Coalescence）接口，避免符号执行开销；(4) 专用于编译器的稀疏哈希结构，支持跨分片的桶对齐与O(P²)时间合并；(5) 对list、bytemap、hash、dense等格式的专门的分配与合并策略。

Result: Birdseed在内存和时间上均渐进优于ESC和WingSpan：相比ESC内存减少N·r/[10(P+1)]倍、时间改善N·r·lg(nnz·r)/(P+lg(nnz))倍；相比WingSpan内存减少13/10倍、时间改善min(P, lg(P·nnz))倍。实验上，SpMSpV相比Eigen获得2.9×几何均值加速、相比WingSpan bytemap获3.5×加速；外积SpGEMM相比WingSpan获5×串行加速和26.8×并行扩展加速；SpAdd相比MKL获4.2×加速；稀疏直方图构建相比Halide rfactor获11.3×加速。

Conclusion: Birdseed是首个通用并行稀疏张量编译器，支持所有循环顺序和任意标准稀疏格式，是现有系统能力的超集，在历史性困难的并行scatter内核上实现了显著加速。

Abstract: Sparse tensor compilers are commonly used high-performance tools that optimize tensor algebra programs over notoriously complex sparse data structures. Despite the ever-increasing size and scale of sparse datasets, there exists astonishingly little research on developing a parallel sparse tensor compiler. Existing approaches fail to parallelize or make assumptions about access patterns or output formats that limit generality. This paper presents Birdseed, the first tensor compiler to support all loop orderings over any standard sparse format in parallel. More specifically, Birdseed supports parallel sparse scatters and directly writes into list, bytemap, hash, and dense levels of fibertree sparse formats. Our approach exhibits asymptotic memory and time improvements over all previous work. We additionally demonstrate empirical speedups on challenging kernels to parallelize, such as histogram construction and SpMSpV.

</details>

### [155] [Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19065)
*Renbo Tu,Yang Liu,Shuying Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文在电商候选生成场景下对比了生成式检索（GR）和稠密检索（DR），发现评估指标不同会导致"赢家"不同：GR在最佳相关商品价值上领先，DR在精确目标召回率和全列表价值上领先。进一步分析表明，GR的价值优势主要来自流行度（popularity），仅将同一静态价值先验通过一次重排序加入DR即可反转GR的领先优势，同时保留召回率优势。在工业级数据集上，14B参数的GR模型仍劣于47倍小的稠密编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型和语义ID的发展，生成式检索（GR）被认为是稠密检索（DR）的有力替代方案，但缺乏在电商场景下受控的细粒度对比。论文质疑GR是否在所有评估维度上都能一致地优于DR，尤其是在电商候选生成中检索到的商品不仅与用户相关性不同，还具有不同的商业价值。

Method: 1. 使用TIGER和LIGER框架进行受控对比：GR通过语义ID前缀约束束搜索解码，DR通过共享编码器表示的余弦相似度检索，两者仅在检索读出方式上不同。2. 提出互补评估指标：条件最佳商品价值（BV）衡量两方法共同覆盖用户中最佳相关商品的价值差；价值加权NDCG（vNDCG）衡量全列表的相关价值。3. 定义静态商品价值评分 v_i(w) = w_p·pop_i + w_r·rate_i + w_b·brand_i，三者加权和为1。4. 提出DR+prior：将商品价值作为先验通过单次重排（α=0.5）融合到DR相似度分数中，无需重新训练或解码。5. 在Amazon Toys 2014和2023数据集上进行对比，并通过共购信用、随机控制、LLM评分等鲁棒性检验。6. 在内部工业电商数据集上用Qwen3 14B GR与约300M GTE稠密编码器对比。

Result: 1. 在两个公开数据集上，GR在BV@50上领先（2014：ΔBV为-0.020，2023：-0.016，即DR落后），DR在Recall@50、NDCG@50、vNDCG@50上领先。2. 流行度贡献了GR价值领先的最大部分：2014年49.8%，2023年65.4%。3. 加入静态价值先验后，DR+prior在BV@50上反超GR（2014：+0.023，2023：+0.006），vNDCG@50也最高（0.240、0.175），Recall@50虽低于原始DR但仍高于GR。4. 冷启动商品：DR和DR+prior检索到的冷启动目标数远多于GR。5. 工业数据集上，含约300M参数的GTE密集编码器在LLM评判的NDCG@50上（0.474）优于14B参数的GR（0.453），DR+prior进一步提升至0.530（提升11.8%）。

Conclusion: GR在电商候选生成中并非DR的一致更强替代品。评估指标的选择决定了表面上的赢家：GR在最佳相关商品价值上占优，DR在精确目标召回和全列表价值上占优。GR的价值优势主要源于流行度这一静态属性，可通过一次无需重训的重排序转移到DR，从而同时获得最佳的BV和vNDCG。含商品价值先验的DR应成为未来GR系统的有力基线。

Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) has emerged as a strong candidate generator for sequential recommendation as language models and semantic-item identifiers have improved. However, GR is not a uniformly stronger replacement of dense retrieval (DR) in online retail candidate generation. We examine their differences on two Amazon Toys datasets under different metrics. GR leads on best relevant item value among users both methods cover, while DR leads on exact-target recall and relevant value across the ranked list. With deep analysis, we find that popularity contributes the most to GR's measured value lead. Adding the same static item value to DR in one reranking step reverses this lead and keeps recall above GR. Finally, on an industrial-scale internal e-commerce dataset with LLM-judged relevance, we show that a 14B SID-LLM still underperforms a $47\times$ smaller dense encoder.

</details>


### [156] [Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19578)
*Yuanfeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. Subsequently, a semantic student branch employs a residual mapping mechanism and a magnitude-agnostic cosine distillation objective to achieve high-fidelity cross-modal alignment without disrupting established collaborative signals. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic norm reconstruction mechanism to rigorously calibrate the physical scales of novel and warm items during global retrieval. Extensive experiments across three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualGCN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in strict cold-start scenarios while comprehensively preserving recommendation accuracy for highly active items.

### [157] [Twenty Days Later: A Pre-Registered Test of History-Based Forecasts of Brand Mentions in Gemini Answers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19608)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Counts of which brands a large language model names are useful only if they hold long enough to act on. We test this with a pre-registered replication. The same 162 requests (54 questions in English, Estonian and Finnish about three software categories, four of twelve candidate brands per question, three repeats) were sent to gemini-3.1-pro-preview in three waves within about ten hours on 22 and 23 September 2026, and again on 13 October 2026, 20.3 days after the third wave, with identical request bodies. The plan and its decision rule were frozen, hashed and registered on OSF before the first call. The outcome is a lexical mention label per answer and brand, 648 per wave. The primary forecast, each brand-and-question cell's mention rate over the nine earlier answers, scored Brier 0.0281 and log loss 0.126, against Brier 0.0259 for the six-answer forecast of the 8-hour wave and a registered ceiling of 0.0559. It beat brand history (0.104), the overall rate (0.234) and a constant 0.5 (0.250) on both scores and in all nine question families (exact sign-flip p = 0.0039), so durability holds under the registered rule. A forecast frozen from the first wave alone scored 0.0599, 0.0587 and 0.0604 at horizons of 1.5 hours, 9.6 hours and 20.7 days. Of the 202 cells unanimous in the 8-hour wave, 194 were unchanged at D1 and none reversed. The latest wave alone was nearly as accurate as the pooled history (Brier 0.0292; pooled lower in 5 of 9 families, p = 0.28). Every answer reported the requested model version, and none issued a search query although search was enabled. A blind human check of 96 labels agreed with the rule on 94; both disagreements were adjudicated as rater omissions, so after adjudication the rule matched on 96 of 96. The test covers one model, one interval and twelve known brands, and estimates no decay rate.

### [158] [Creating SquashFS Images to Support HPC and AI Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20578)
*Julie Mullen,Albert Reuther,LaToya Anderson,Michael Jones,William Arcand,William Bergeron,David Bestor,Alex Bonn,Daniel Burrill,Chansup Byun,Vijay Gadepally,Michael Houle,Matthew Hubbell,Hayden Jananthan,Piotr Luszczek,Peter Michaleas,Guillermo Morales,Andrew Prout,Antonio Rosa,Chuck Yee,Jeremy Kepner*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: HPC users often download datasets on HPC systems for analysis and processing. When these datasets are comprised of hundreds of thousands (or more) of small files, accessing them in parallel can put a tremendous burden on the metadata servers of central parallel file systems. If the dataset is read-only, an effective solution is to compress the dataset into a SquashFS image. There are, however, a number of workflows that can be used to create such a dataset image, and we observed that some were more efficient than others. To provide more effective guidance for our userbase, we benchmarked eleven different workflows for creating SquashFS dataset image files of datasets with thousands to millions of very small files. We took into account whether the data arrived as this http URL , zip, or files-and-directories downloads, whether the image creation was on the central file system or local compute node storage, and the number of SquashFS file compression threads used. This paper shares the results of these benchmarks and provides recommendations to HPC system users toward the best workflows to use for SquashFS image creation.

### [159] [XViewRank: Overlap-Conditioned Score Fusion for LLM-Augmented Sparse Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20122)
*Xinxuan Lv,Minghan Li,Guodong Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Large language models can reduce vocabulary mismatch in sparse retrieval by generating alternative views of a query. Once these views are searched independently, however, their ranked lists may be complementary, redundant, or affected by query drift, making fixed fusion suboptimal. We present XViewRank, a lightweight retrieval-side method for conditionally fusing BM25 results from an original query, a hypothesis view, and a step-back view. For each pooled candidate, XViewRank retains three normalized BM25 scores and three query-level overlaps between the retrieved result sets. A small nonlinear scorer uses the overlaps as context that changes how the view-specific scores are interpreted, without jointly encoding query and passage text. Under a matched-input protocol, XViewRank improves nDCG@10 and MAP numerically over reciprocal rank fusion on both TREC DL 2019 and 2020, with a statistically significant MAP gain on DL19. Additional analyses show that the clearest benefit occurs when the view rankings have low agreement, while the evidence on DL20 is weaker. The results support overlap-conditioned score fusion as a compact retrieval-side alternative to fixed fusion, while also delimiting where its advantage is empirically established.

### [160] [Reading the Neighborhood: Text-Attentive Graph Reranking for Automated Subject Indexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20048)
*Lakshmi Rajendram Bashyam,Ralf Krestel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Subject indexing assigns descriptors from a controlled vocabulary to bibliographic records, a task characterized by thousands of labels, few positive examples per label, and a long tail of rarely used descriptors. Existing extreme multi-label classifiers treat the vocabulary as a flat list, ignoring the semantic relations that thesauri encode. We present TAGHN, a heterogeneous graph reranker over a per-document subgraph of retrieved candidates augmented with the thesaurus neighborhood. The relevance of a candidate descriptor is estimated jointly from its similarity with the document and also the degree to which the candidate's thesaurus neighborhood matches the document content. A decomposed scoring head combines interpretable graph-derived features with retrieval signals. On STW, an economic thesaurus of 6,198 descriptors, TAGHN reaches 0.380 macro F1 against 0.346 for a fine-tuned cross-encoder and 0.278 for a fixed-vocabulary XMLC classifier. In terms of micro F1, it outperforms reranking models and stays competitive (-3.0) with the best fixed-vocabulary XMLC model. Qualitative analysis shows the graph resolving errors that per-label scoring cannot, selecting a narrower gold descriptor where an unstructured reranker settles for its broader parent.

### [161] [RCER: Reconstructing Cross-Evidence Relations for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19398)
*Linyao Zheng,Xuhang Shi,Zhifang Mao,Xiuquan Hou,Sai Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Iterative retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) accumulates knowledge from retrieved evidence to answer complex questions, but existing methods struggle to reconstruct entity correspondences and inferential dependencies across retrieved passages as new information emerges. We propose RCER, an iterative RAG method that reconstructs these cross-evidence relations directly from accumulated source passages. Inter-round relational evidence acquisition identifies entity correspondences and relational dependencies to drive dynamic problem decomposition and iterative retrieval. Reasoning context reconstruction independently constructs a coherent reasoning context through joint selection of complementary passages and derivation of cross-evidence inferences. Cross-evidence compositional reasoning leverages these inferences to establish entity correspondences and compose relations across selected passages for answer derivation. Experiments show that RCER outperforms the best baselines by 2.83 EM and 3.06 F1 points on average across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and achieves superior performance on narrative and implicit reasoning tasks.

### [162] [Smart Alone, Blind Together: Why Accuracy Fails to CertifyTheory of Mind in Multi-Agent Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19051)
*Will Beaumaster,Paul Schrater*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文论证了在多智能体团队中，心智理论（ToM）模块的部署不应以单信念准确率作为认证标准，而应采用考虑错误代价、成对交互与显著性消元的部署级认证（Blind-Spot Gate）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实践以ToM推断准确率作为模块部署门槛，但准确率忽略了错误代价和错误间的相关性（依赖结构），导致认证在两个方向上系统性地失败：既可能放行有害部署，也可能拒绝有益部署。

Method: （1）成本敏感阈值（Elkan 2001）的推广：阈值由错误代价决定，而非由推断难度决定；（2）相关性错误的认证理论：Theorem 1（Esary正相关+超/次模性给出期望收益单调关系）、Corollary 1（认证在相关错误下的失败方向）、Theorem 2（当错误信念相互作用时，无任何纯accuracy-k规则对所有模块都正确）；（3）Möbius展开将期望收益分解为各阶错误率 m(S) 与交互 β(S) 的乘积；（4）Blind-Spot Gate：二阶证书 B̂=b₀+Σqᵤcᵤ+Σ_{u<v}(qᵤqᵥ+λΔ_{uv}) I_{uv}，通过单/对注入回放估计代价与交互；（5）实验覆盖任务分配、Level-Based Foraging、Hanabi三个领域，使用注入错误、训练分类器、贝叶斯模块与五种语言模型（含Claude四款与GPT-5.4-mini），并结合人类判断数据。

Result: （1）阈值随错误代价上升：任务分配h=0→1阈值0.655→0.779，Hanabi五条命→一条命0.621→0.845；未触及代价通道的错误阈值不变（如LBF低估等级始终0.697）。（2）准确率双向失败：分类器在任务分配中33/35单元实际有益却被拒；贝叶斯模块与GPT-5.4-mini在Hanabi中被错误放行（含负收益部署）。（3）冗余远低于独立假设——以hinted队友为例：GPT-5.4-mini至Opus 5.5单信念错误32%→11%，但三人全错仅从16%降至9%（独立预测3.4%→0.15%），n_eff介于1.11–1.66。（4）Blind-Spot Gate在48语言模型单元20次切分里零显著误批准（准确率3.2次/切分）；在7个分类器（未开发模块）上regret 0.004对0.479；在贝叶斯模块上17/20切分中避免显著误批准。

Conclusion: 心智理论模块应按部署而非按模块认证——核心问题是错误代价、错误重叠还是叠加以及错误共现频率；准确率在错误信念存在相互作用时原则上不可作为通用证书。冗余不是准确率的副产物，需通过模型多样化或证据/延迟策略另行购买。Blind-Spot Gate以A/B测试的安全性提供部署前证书，在样本稀缺时优于直接测量。

Abstract: Coordinators that act on what they infer about teammates are usually certified by the accuracy of those inferences. We argue that accuracy is the wrong certificate, for two reasons. First, the accuracy needed to act depends on what a wrong action costs, so the bar belongs to the deployment, not the module. Second, a module's errors are rarely independent, and dependence has a sign: positively associated errors help where their damage overlaps and hurt where it compounds, so an accuracy threshold fails in a predictable direction, and once wrong beliefs interact and can do harm, no rule based on accuracy is right for every module. We test these predictions in task assignment, Level-Based Foraging and Hanabi, with injected errors, trained and Bayesian modules and five language models, and in human judgments. Accuracy fails in both directions, approving harmful language-model deployments in Hanabi, where shared errors compound, and rejecting beneficial ones in task assignment, where costly errors are rare. In our tasks it also buys far less redundancy than independence predicts: from GPT-5.4-mini to Claude Opus 5.5, error on teammates the models have evidence about falls from 32% to 11%, but the chance that all three observers misread one falls only from 16% to 9% (independence: 3.4% to 0.15%). We propose certifying the deployment, with a Blind-Spot Gate that prices error costs, pairwise interactions and measured dependence without deploying the module. On held-out data from the cells it was developed on, it makes no significant false approval in 20 splits (accuracy: 3.2 per split), and in preregistered tests on modules it was not developed on, it recovers what accuracy rejects (seven classifiers: regret 0.004 against 0.479) and catches what accuracy approves (a Bayesian module: significant false approvals in 17 of 20 splits for accuracy, 1 for the gate).

</details>


### [163] [When Is Smaller Greener? Right-Sizing Language Models for Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19345)
*Sajid Siraj,Maria Barbati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对AI智能体中语言模型选择问题，提出应以"成功完成任务"为功能单元（而非每次调用）来比较模型在能耗、成本和时间上的表现。论文构建了一个通用决策模型，得出每个资源都存在一个"交叉任务长度"使小模型失去优势，由此将任务划分为三个区域（短任务、长任务、中间权衡带），并提出两阶段决策框架（无偏好Pareto筛选 + 偏好加权选择）。通过对15个开源模型在两类多步任务上的实测，验证了模型预测的交叉点与观察值基本吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI智能体中语言模型的选择普遍采用"每次调用"的比较方式（如看排行榜、选最小模型），但这种方式具有误导性。智能体的任务只有当所有步骤都成功时才算完成，单步可靠性的微小差异会通过级联放大为整体任务成功率的巨大差异；失败的尝试同样消耗资源。因此，按调用比较可能导致按任务比较时得出相反结论，亟需一个基于"成功完成任务"为功能单元的模型选择框架。

Method: 1) 将"成功完成的任务"作为比较的功能单元（借鉴生命周期评估LCA思想），构建通用决策模型：定义每步可靠性ρ_a、每步资源消耗r_{a,k}、任务长度L、最大尝试次数K及任务完成概率约束β；2) 推导三个关键性质——观测2（每步全面劣于另一模型的模型可永久剔除）、观测3（每种资源存在唯一交叉任务长度L*_k）、观测4（交叉长度将任务划分为三区域：短任务小模型占优、长任务大模型占优、中间为偏好权衡带）；3) 建立两阶段框架：Stage 1为无偏好Pareto筛选，Stage 2仅在存在真实权衡时启用SAW+TOPSIS加权选择；4) 模型涵盖四种特殊情形（二元/分级结果 × 可重试/不可逆动作）；5) 实施预实验：15个开源模型（0.6B–27B参数）在两类多步代理任务（订单任务、工具任务）上的实测，使用单块GPU实测能耗。

Result: 1) 实验验证H1假设（成功率随任务长度下降，曲线满足单交叉条件）：188对模型比较中，129对恰好交叉一次，33对存在多次交叉但多在曲线接近或前几步（对决策不重要的区域）；2) 实验验证H2假设（交叉长度预测准确性）：88个观测交叉中，72个的闭式预测落在95%置信区间内，订单任务中位数偏差9步、工具任务中位数偏差4步；3) 每步筛选剔除了订单任务中4个、工具任务中5个模型（部分被更小模型剔除，如Ministral 3 3B在工具任务中淘汰了Qwen3 8B）；4) 最节能模型随任务长度变化：订单任务中Llama 3.2 1B（1–2步）→Llama 3.2 3B（3–100步）→Qwen3 8B（>100步）；工具任务中提前转向更大模型（50–60步时27B模型已最优）；5) 不可逆任务（V2）下，更严格的完成概率约束可导致无可行模型，提示应改造任务而非更换模型。

Conclusion: 论文得出以下结论：1) "小即绿"的观点仅在短任务下成立；2) 长任务中大模型可能反而更节能，因为失败重试成本超过单步资源差异；3) 模型选择应以任务成功为单元，存在明确可预测的交叉长度划分三区域；4) 两阶段框架将客观效率与主观偏好分离，使多数情况下无需权重即可做出选择；5) 实践启示包括：将长任务拆分为可单独校验的短任务、为不可逆步骤加入人工确认、设计任务内动态切换模型的策略；6) 主要局限在于仅测GPU能耗、样本量小、未在标准基准上做留出测试（待完整研究解决）。论文将框架定位为持续更新的决策支持服务，未来方向包括完整基准验证、动态切换策略、多智能体场景、实际从业者偏好研究及扩展资源度量范围。

Abstract: AI agents use large language models (LLMs) to plan and act over multiple steps, yet models are usually compared per call rather than per completed task. This paper asks: which model should an agent use to complete tasks reliably while minimising energy, cost and time? We show that per-call comparisons can be misleading for agentic AI. Because a task succeeds only if all required steps succeed, small differences in per-step reliability can produce large differences in overall task success. Failed attempts also consume resources. We therefore evaluate models using energy, cost and time per successfully completed task, treating the completed task as the functional unit. On this basis, we develop a decision model for choosing LLMs in agentic workflows. The model applies to tasks with binary or graded outcomes and to settings with or without retries. We show that each resource has a crossover task length at which a smaller, less reliable model ceases to be the greener, cheaper or faster option. These crossovers divide tasks into three regimes: for short tasks smaller models are preferred, for long tasks larger models are preferred, and only between these extremes do preferences among objectives matter. We embed these results in a two-stage framework that separates efficiency from preference. A Pareto screen first removes models that are never competitive; a weighted decision is required only when a genuine trade-off remains. A pilot study of 15 open-weight models from five developers, ranging from 0.6B to 27B parameters, on two multi-step agent tasks with measured GPU energy supports the predicted structure. The model with the lowest energy per completed task changes with task length and task type, and observed crossover points generally match those predicted from per-step measurements. These findings provide a practical framework for right-sizing language models in agentic AI.

</details>


### [164] [AdCoEvo: A Co-Evolving Multi-Agent Advertising Delivery System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19454)
*Tianzhu Hu,Hang Yu,Zeyuan Zhao,Zeyu Pan,Huan Luo,Chun Gan,Mingzhe Cao,Liubin Wang,Mingming Li,Jiao Dai,Jizhong Han,Songlin Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AdCoEvo提出了一种协同进化的多智能体广告投放系统，通过角色专业化（Planner、Optimizer、Inspector）在不同时间尺度和操作粒度上连接投放决策，并通过离线训练和在线协同进化持续优化策略，在广告投放效率和成本控制上显著优于基于规则的方法和固定参数的多智能体系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有广告投放方法虽然在出价、预算分配等单个任务上实现了部分自动化，但仍依赖人工进行整体协调，难以支持大规模运营，且无法将个体经验转化为可复用的运营能力。此外，广告市场动态变化，投放策略需要及时更新以保持有效性。

Method: 1. 角色专业化与协作执行：系统由三个角色组成——Planner负责账户级预算规划，Optimizer负责广告单元投放策略调整，Inspector负责周期末诊断，为下一周期提供指导。2. 两阶段训练：第一阶段通过监督微调（SFT）和离线强化学习（GSPO）培养操作能力；第二阶段在持续投放过程中基于已结算的业务反馈轮换更新各角色参数，实现协同进化。3. 角色奖励构建：根据各角色的影响范围和反馈时机设计奖励信号。4. 协同进化机制：借鉴SAO的单轨迹异步更新思想，周期末结算反馈后轮换更新一个角色参数，更新后的策略在下一周期生效，通过联合执行改变其他角色遇到的投放状态和反馈。

Result: 在AuctionNet模拟器上的实验表明：相对于基于规则的操作基线（Rule），AdCoEvo在Sparse环境中将广告主价值（ADV）提升14.02%，同时将每次转化成本（CPA）降低7.07%；相比固定参数的多智能体系统，ADV提升3.96%，CPA降低1.24%。在General环境中也取得了类似改进。此外，AdCoEvo在API成本和推理延迟方面也优于多个主流基础模型（如GPT-5.6-Terra、Claude-Sonnet-5等），验证了领域特定训练和协同进化的有效性。消融实验验证了角色协作、操作能力培养和协同进化各自对性能的贡献。

Conclusion: AdCoEvo通过角色专业化和协同进化机制，有效实现了广告投放全流程的自动化和对市场变化的适应性。实验证明，运营级决策、角色协作和后训练均有助于提升投放性能，而协同进化在离线强化学习基础上进一步带来收益。不过，收益在不同环境中存在差异，协同进化的有效性仍需在具体投放场景中评估，角色决策频率、影响范围对协同进化的作用以及优势估计和更新机制的改进值得进一步研究。

Abstract: Digital advertising is an important means for platforms to reach potential users and drive business growth. Advertising delivery is the core link between marketing objectives and actual returns. Existing methods have achieved partial automation in individual tasks such as bidding and budget allocation, but they still rely on human operators for overall coordination, making it difficult to support large-scale operations. They also often fail to achieve optimal performance, and individual experience remains difficult to turn into reusable operational capabilities. In addition, as advertising markets change, advertising delivery systems need timely strategy updates to remain effective in dynamic markets. To automate the entire advertising operations process and improve adaptability to market changes, we propose AdCoEvo, a co-evolving multi-agent advertising delivery system. Specifically, the system connects delivery decisions across different timescales and operational granularities through role specialization. Diagnostic results guide account planning and strategy adjustment in the next period. The multi-agent system updates its model parameters based on actual delivery outcomes and continually improves delivery strategies through mutual feedback among planning, adjustment, and diagnosis, thereby achieving co-evolution. Experiments show that, relative to the rule-based operational baseline (Rule), AdCoEvo increases advertiser value by 14.02% while reducing cost per acquisition by 7.07%. Compared with a multi-agent system with fixed parameters, AdCoEvo increases advertiser value by 3.96% and reduces cost per acquisition by 1.24%, indicating that co-evolution can yield greater delivery returns.

</details>


### [165] [LAGO: Language Agents with Reusable Growing Options](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19843)
*Yuran Wu,Mengkang Hu,Qionglin Qiu,Fanqing Meng,Qiguang Chen,Yuhang Zhou,Qiudan Zhang,Xu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LAGO是一个将专门化语言智能体视为可复用时序扩展选项的元智能体框架。系统通过持久化选项库实现跨任务复用与生长,在不更新模型权重的前提下,在SWE-bench Verified上以冻结Qwen3.5-35B-A3B达到58.6%解决率,并在控制协议下优于mini-SWE-agent与Terminus 2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单体工具调用循环在长视野任务中存在上下文溢出、注意力稀释和错误累积等问题;现有静态多智能体系统无法自动获取和复用跨任务能力,导致重复子问题被反复从零求解。

Method: 提出LAGO双层架构:元智能体分解任务,从持久化选项库检索或生成智能体选项,每个选项封装为四元组(spec, π, β, v),包含角色规范、LLM-工具循环策略、终止条件和验证器。通过准入规则、新颖性检查、去重、剪枝和版本化机制管理库增长。目标函数包含任务成功率、质量与库大小惩罚项的权衡。支持可选的元智能体SFT微调以改进分解质量。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified完整500任务上以冻结Qwen3.5-35B-A3B获得58.6%解决率;在150任务固定子集上,mini-SWE-agent、Terminus 2与LAGO分别为49.3%、57.3%、60.3%。50任务组件消融显示:禁用分解少解决4个,打乱复用内容少2个,禁用库少6个。跨模型实验中,LAGO在SWE-bench Pro上将DeepSeek-V3.2单智能体基线从34%提升至50%;固定执行器时,Qwen3-30B SFT元智能体比基础版本高6点。库复用率达78.8%-86.4%,初始化后净增长有限。

Conclusion: 可复用智能体选项是任务流的有效抽象,分解质量在某些任务和模型条件下起重要作用。库治理机制有效,但组件层面的因果关系具有任务和模型依赖性。复用频率被测量但未完全隔离其因果价值,分解的有用性取决于子问题的可分离性和跨任务重复性。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks expose a weakness of monolithic tool-use loops: one agent must decompose, execute, and verify a task within a single trajectory. We introduce LAGO, which treats specialized language agents as reusable temporally extended options. A meta-agent retrieves options from a persistent library or spawns new ones, dispatches sub-tasks, verifies results, and admits successful novel options. The library grows across tasks without updating model weights. On 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks, frozen Qwen3.5-35B-A3B in both roles resolves 58.6% under single-attempt evaluation with the official Docker evaluator. On a fixed 150-task subset, we re-run mini-SWE-agent, Terminus 2, and LAGO with the same policy, temperature, task IDs, and evaluator; their resolve rates are 49.3%, 57.3%, and 60.3%, respectively. Cross-model experiments provide evidence consistent with a role for decomposition quality. A 50-task component ablation finds four fewer resolved tasks without decomposition, two fewer with shuffled reused content, and six fewer without the library. These results support reusable agent-options as a practical abstraction for task streams, while leaving component-level causality task- and model-dependent.

</details>


### [166] [Drivers of LLM Consensus Formation Under Competing Incentives: A Simulation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20200)
*Isabel Jones,Matthew Edwards,Janina A. Hoffmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究将行为心理学中的"网络共识博弈"(Network Consensus game)适配到LLM多智能体场景中，系统评估了7个LLM在竞争性激励下达成共识的能力与机制，发现不同模型表现差异巨大，且开放源模型无法像人类一样有效达成共识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
