Method: 1. 将VLA模型的部署时自适应建模为上下文强化学习问题，策略π_ψ(a_{t:t+h} | o_t, ℓ, C_t)在参数ψ固定条件下，基于累积交互历史C_t进行动作生成；2. 基于Algorithm Distillation (AD) 思想训练因果序列模型；3. 采用Transformer-XL式循环记忆机制减少长程计算开销；4. 设计两种策略实例化：VLRLA-simp（确定性策略，循环动作模块+MLP）与VLRLA-bridge（保留π_0.5的视觉语言编码器和动作专家，通过可训练适配模块对KV缓存进行低秩残差修改）；5. 支持三种学习历史构建策略：仿真RL数据收集、人在环路课程式纠错采集、后视示证重标记（HER）。

Result: 1. RoboTwin仿真基准测试（12个任务）：VLRLA-bridge在所有任务上均优于π_0.5基线，整体平均成功率提升12.4个百分点（63.4% vs 50.9%），优于GRPO（60.0%）和RoboTTT（58.2%）；2. 跨VLM骨干（π_0.5、lingbotvla、fastwam）均展示自适应能力；3. 消融实验证明交互历史的持续累积对自适应至关重要，去除历史后性能接近零；4. 真实机器人水果放置任务（45次运行）：随经验累积，成功率逐步超越π_0.5基线，对未见物体（红辣椒+金属锅）也能实现持续改进；5. 跨情节记忆任务：策略能利用奖励反馈推断隐含指令（如颜色选择），成功率在首轮后稳步提升。

Conclusion: VLRLA通过上下文强化学习实现了VLA模型的部署时自适应，在参数冻结的条件下利用累积交互经验提升任务成功率。该通用框架兼容多种学习历史构建策略和模型架构，在仿真和真实环境中均验证了其有效性，包括对未见场景的泛化能力。该工作为机器人部署阶段的持续自适应提供了一种无需参数更新的可行路径。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models connect visual perception and language understanding with robot control, providing a foundation for instruction-conditioned manipulation. However, conventional pretrained VLA policies lack a mechanism for gradual adaptation through accumulated interaction experience during deployment. We therefore propose VLRLA, a general framework that equips existing VLA models with \textit{in-context reinforcement learning} capabilities for deployment-time adaptation. Our approach augments a VLA model with a reinforcement learning module that learns from historical observations, actions, rewards, and termination signals. During deployment, the policy gradually refines its action generation and progressively improves task success while keeping model parameters fixed. Our approach is also designed for general applicability and compatibility with diverse learning history construction strategies and model training pipelines. Finally, through extensive experiments, we systematically investigate the learning properties of VLRLA in simulation and demonstrate its ability to adapt to unseen scenarios during real-world deployment.

</details>


### [221] [Structure Before Intelligence: Gating What Agentic Scientific Workflows Release](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19507)
*Ashish Acharya,Aman Al Amin,Hong Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出在代理式科学工作流外部构建一个有向无环图（DAG）"释放控制层"（harness），将科学有效性区分为独立于执行完成度、完整性和可用性的判断，并通过强制检查、失败隔离、可追溯版本回算、可选验证器与风险估计来决策哪些交付物可被释放。在两个科学工作流、60个配对评估实例上的消融实验表明：隔离与恢复提升有效产出；验证器消除无效释放；风险引导策略在减少约31%验证开销的同时维持零无效释放，但未显示其目标选择优于随机放置；血统证据仅在一个工作流上有效；语言模型组件本身未带来可测量的可靠性收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理式科学工作流可能正常完成执行却发布错误的结果——静默数值错误、过时输入或共享上游步骤缺陷会在多个输出间扩散。当语言模型代理能够自动规划并执行分析、且论文被转换为可执行代理时，人类对中间结果的审查减少，因此需要在代理系统外部建立显式的"释放门控"机制，独立于执行成功来判断科学有效性。

Method: 构建围绕工作流DAG的控制器层（harness），定义"释放决策"为科学有效性与执行完成/完整性/可用性相区分的概念；引入派单风险p_t(d)（基于运行时证据\mathcal{E}_t和实际血统lin_t(d)），并设定阈值p*=λ_W/(λ_I+λ_W)=1/6；控制器强制强制检查失败时的版本阻塞、沿科学输入边的失败隔离、有界图变更（仅通过契约允许的恢复动作）和发布闭合重检；延迟证据在发布前触发血统重算，在发布后记录为撤稿。对比5种确定策略（Halt/Contain/Rules/Risk-Local/Risk-Lineage）和3种代理变体在两个工作流（变体调用评估表和SIR模型）、6类场景家族（清白/良性/静默错误/过时输入/共享祖先/延迟失效）共60对配对评估实例上的表现，使用与运行时检查分离的结果神谕（oracle）打标有效/无效/未观测。语言模型代理仅在约束菜单内提议恢复动作并审阅发布，但不能覆盖控制器规则。

Result: 在60对配对实例（每实例2个交付物，共120个请求交付物）上：Contain较Halt有效产出提升Δ=0.267（CI [0.182, 0.346]）；Rules的验证触发器从未触发，发布37个无效交付物（55个故障影响中的全部20个共享祖先、10个静默错误和7个延迟失效）；Validate-All（每候选都验）发布0无效、有效产出112/120，成本最高25.17；Risk-Lineage相对Rules有效产出提升Δ=0.283并消除无效释放，但成本高8.57单位；相对Validate-All减少31%验证器数与22%成本，有效产出略低Δ=-0.100；在匹配验证数量下随机验证Random-Matched释放3个无效，差异Δ=-0.027（CI [-0.063, 0.000]）在n=60下未解决（定位优势未显示）；血统证据仅在已发表表工作流上有效（Δ=1.633，发布表上Risk-Local过度弃权仅放出2/60）；3种语言模型代理变体（含两个开源权重的Llama 3.3、Gemma 3、Mistral Small与付费API的Grok和Gemini附录）中2/3在所有实例上完全复现基础策略决策，第3个仅使1个组合的有效产出降低Δ=-0.267，无效释放始终由控制器而非模型决定；审计验证全部960个计划剧集、375个配对差异与540个代理剧集均可逐字节重放。

Conclusion: 在两个工作流与注入故障的受控评估中，发布可靠性源自结构性组件而非语言模型智能：隔离与恢复提供有效产出，验证器提供安全性（风险估计匹配该安全性时少用约31%验证器，但未显示优于随机的目标性），血统证据在一个工作流上通过单一机制提供帮助。代理被置于显式发布控制结构内可保持已发布科学结果的可信，且为更强的代理能力提供可测量基线。本研究为概念验证，存在合成故障混合、仅5实例/家族、单一已发表研究、确定性运行、规则基线验证器未触发、设计者同时定义故障与验证器等局限。

Abstract: An agentic scientific workflow can run to completion and still release wrong results: a silent numerical error, a stale input, or a defect in a shared upstream step can contaminate several outputs while a sibling branch stays correct. We treat trust in such results as a release decision. A harness around the workflow's directed acyclic graph (DAG) decides which outputs may be used: it enforces mandatory checks, contains failures to the affected branch, recomputes from tracked versions, adds validators, and releases a result only if a risk model estimates its probability of being invalid as low. Language-model agents work inside the harness, choosing corrective actions and reviewing releases, but cannot override it. On 60 held-out paired instances of two workflows with injected faults, we switched components on and off. Each supplied a different property. Containment and recovery raised the number of correct results. Validation supplied safety: fixed rules without validation released 37 invalid results, while validating every candidate released none. Risk estimation supplied efficiency, matching that safety with 31% fewer validators at somewhat lower yield, although better targeting than random validation was not shown. Lineage evidence helped on one workflow. The language model added no measurable benefit: whether invalid results escaped depended on the harness, not the model. This proof of concept points to a practical path: placing agents inside explicit release-control structure can keep released scientific results trustworthy, and it gives more capable agents a measurable baseline to improve on.

</details>


### [222] [Beyond Retrieval: Evidence Access and Event Aggregation in Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19474)
*Zerui Yang,Quan Xue,Chaorui Zhang,Xueyan Niu,Xuanyu Zheng,Xiyuan Wang,Haolin Ruan,Guangcheng Song,Weixi Zhang,Wei Han,Bo Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Trajectory Memory (TM) 与 TallyMem 双模块架构,针对智能体历史问答中"证据访问"与"事件聚合"两大瓶颈,在保留原始轨迹的同时,通过可执行事件规范实现确定性聚合。在 MINTEval 上取得 13.8 分大幅提升,验证了可执行聚合机制,但 AMA-Bench 总体增益较温和(1.3 分),且剩余错误主要来自事件规范错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体对其历史(编辑仓库、浏览网站、模拟家居操作等)的后续问答通常需要聚合多个事件,但现有基于检索的智能体记忆方法(BMem、Mem0、Rolling Summary 等)难以正确完成多事件组合,即使所有相关步骤都被检索到,读者仍可能错误分类或重复计数。本文区分了两个独立瓶颈:(1)证据访问——回答所需的步骤必须原样到达读者;(2)事件聚合——必须正确选择并组合多个事件。

Method: 1. TM(轨迹记忆):采用"延迟证据选择"原则,无损存储原始轨迹(Archive),在问答时构建源地址可寻址、按预算(B=26k token)、保序的阅读视图 R_q;通过词项匹配与文件事件图锚定相关步骤,贪心填充预算。2. TallyMem:在 TM 之上引入可复用事件分类账(ledger,每步一行,字段含 tool、normalized action、targets、outcome 等)和小类型化查询语言(支持 count/list/first/last/group/timeline 操作);模型一次调用编译出事件规范 (I_q, φ_q, g),确定性执行器按规范对全 ledger 求值,结果 D_q(结果+支撑 step ID)附加到 TM 视图。3. 路由机制:根据聚合负载 ℓ>15 或覆盖率决定是否启用计算证据(γ)。4. 在 MINTEval 上对分类账与编译器做了 commit-specific 适配。

Result: (1) MINTEval GitHub(99 仓库,776 问题,精确匹配):TallyMem 将 Qwen3-32B 从 TM 的 35.2% 提升到 49.0%(+13.8);gpt-oss-120b 与 Qwen3-8B 分别获得 +12.8 与 +13.9 增益。(2) 控制探针(645 题,从原始日志独立解析事件集 S★):无路由下 Qwen3-32B 由 TM 82.8% 提升至 TallyMem 93.8%(+11.0),验证可执行聚合机制本身。(3) AMA-Bench(2496 题):TallyMem 仅获得 1.3 分小幅提升(69.8%→71.1%);聚合负载 >15 的子集有 +15.5 分显著增益,但其余问题可能受规范错误影响。(4) 错误分析:148 个带计算证据的错误中,规范(specification)错误 51 个,占排除参考/评判错误后剩余错误的 49%,为最大残余系统错误类别;长上下文阅读同样存在高负载失败,证实访问与聚合是两个独立失败维度。(5) 自由形式 Python 代码作为对照仅达 62.1%,弱于 TallyMem 的 66.0%,进一步支持受限查询语言的收益。

Conclusion: TM 通过无损存档 + 问题时源地址选择解决了证据访问;TallyMem 通过显式事件规范 + 确定性 ledger 执行解决了聚合。但可执行聚合的收益具有任务依赖性,在需要跨多事件组合的问题(尤其是长时间具身轨迹或 commits 历史)上效果显著,在 AMA-Bench 整体上仅获轻微提升。事件规范错误(选取了错误的事件子集或操作)已成为最大残余错误类别,主要由语义模糊问题与受限查询语言表达力不足所致;未来工作应聚焦于更强的事件分类账与编译能力,或与自由代码生成相融合。

Abstract: Questions about an agent's history often require aggregating events, which retrieval alone does not resolve. We combine source-preserving evidence access with executable aggregation. Trajectory Memory (TM) retains the original trajectory and constructs a source-addressable reading view at question time. TallyMem augments it with a reusable event ledger, model-generated event specifications and deterministic execution. With a commit-specific adaptation on 776 questions from 99 held-out MINTEval repositories, TallyMem raises Qwen3-32B exact match from 35.2% to 49.0%, a 13.8-point gain over TM; gains span 12.8-13.9 points across three readers. A controlled probe with event sets parsed independently from raw logs shows an 11.0-point gain, from 82.8% to 93.8%, without routing. On full AMA-Bench, the routed system yields a smaller 1.3-point gain, from 69.8% to 71.1%. These results support executable aggregation on tasks that require combining events, with benefits dependent on the task and event specification, the largest residual system-error category in our diagnostic analysis.

</details>


### [223] [MemCode: Discrete Semantic Representations for Long-Term Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19472)
*Xin Li,Liang Hu,Duoqian Miao,Ming Peng,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemCode提出了一种面向LLM智能体的长期记忆框架，通过将对话重写为自包含的原子记忆单元（AMU），并利用同构语义量化（ISQ）将其映射到可学习的离散码本，结合码本共现拓扑作为向量检索的补充路径，实现更准确的结构化长期记忆检索，同时保持高构建效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于RAG的长期记忆系统普遍采用"先写后取"范式，存储上下文相关的对话片段，并通过连续嵌入空间的近邻检索来调用。这种设计存在两个根本缺陷：(1) 上下文依赖的片段作为存储单元不稳定（缺少说话人、时间等信息）；(2) 连续向量的几何偏置导致系统性地遗漏逻辑相关但表层语义距离较远的证据，尤其在时间推理和多跳问题上表现欠佳。论文借鉴海马体通过模式分离将相似输入编码为离散痕迹以支持关联记忆的神经认知机制，认为RAG式长期记忆的核心瓶颈在于"写什么"与"如何检索"的联合建模，而非单纯的存储规模。

Method: MemCode采用"写入-索引-检索-整合"的统一框架，包含四个核心组件：(1) **流式原子抽象**：将对话流按真实交互轮次切分，引入仅用于指代消解的只读背景上下文，通过LLM将主动轮重写为含规范化事实、绝对时间戳和源指针的自包含AMU；(2) **同构语义量化（ISQ）**：基于T5-base编码器，在DailyDialog上以预测编码目标训练1024维VQ-VAE码本，采用步长1的Conv1d投影以保留时间戳、实体标识等关键token，量化后去重得到AMU的离散指纹；(3) **拓扑感知双路径检索**：Path A通过FAISS+768维bge-base-en-v1.5进行密集向量近邻检索得到Kv个事实，Path B通过码本共现矩阵的h-hop转移概率（结合源端IDF衰减）从其余AMU中补充Kc个关联证据，二者合并后经源指针回溯对话原文；(4) **异步记忆整合**：在线写入与离线HAC聚类+LLM驱动的AGGREGATE/MERGE/UPDATE整合相分离，通过指针转发保留可审计的两级证据链。

Result: 在LongMemEval-S（GPT-4o-mini）上达到77.20% Overall，整合后提升至78.40%；在LoCoMo上达到78.12%/79.55%（有/无整合），均优于Full Text、Naive RAG、A-MEM、MemoryOS、Mem0、LangMem和LightMem等基线。构建效率方面，单对话内存构建仅需40~130秒，速度为LightMem的3~21倍，比A-MEM和MemoryOS快超过一个数量级。消融实验表明：双重路径检索比单纯翻倍向量Top-K在多跳问题上多提升5.3点；去掉原子抽象使总精度骤降至53.8%，多跳下降31.2点；BM25替代码本路径在多跳（+4.26）和时间推理（+6.23）类别上显著劣于码本路径。LoCoMo结果在6次重复运行中稳定（78.26±0.35%）。开放域抽象（如动机、情感）仍是其局限性，Full Text在Open类上仍具竞争优势。

Conclusion: MemCode通过将原子事实抽象与离散语义量化及拓扑感知的双路径检索相耦合，验证了"匹配记忆写入、索引和重构路径，而非简单增加查询时的上下文体积"是提升长期记忆检索性能的关键。AMU和离散路径在显式实体、日期、说话人绑定及多跳推理上优于原始检索和压缩记忆基线；在开放问答和依赖隐式情感/叙事连续性的场景中，全文检索方法仍具竞争力，整合机制虽能缩小差距但以一定的时序粒度损失为代价。未来长期记忆研究应聚焦于存储单元的语义结构与关联拓扑，而非单纯增加候选数或向量维度。

Abstract: Long-term memory remains a fundamental bottleneck for large language model (LLM) agents across sessions. Existing systems typically adopt a write-then-retrieve paradigm, storing context-dependent dialogue fragments and retrieving them via nearest-neighbor search in a continuous embedding space. This design yields unstable access units and systematically misses logically related but lexically distant evidence. We propose MemCode, a long-term agent memory framework that couples retrieval-oriented writing with discrete associative retrieval. MemCode rewrites dialogue into self-contained atomic memory units (AMUs), maps AMUs into a learnable codebook with isomorphic semantic quantization (ISQ), and uses codebook co-occurrence topology as a retrieval path complementary to vector search. For long-term memory stores, MemCode separates online atomic writes from asynchronous offline consolidation. On LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 backbones, MemCode achieves the best overall accuracy while keeping per-dialogue memory construction within roughly 40~130 seconds, making it 3~21 times faster than LightMem and over an order of magnitude faster than A-MEM and MemoryOS.

</details>


### [224] [PFedMA: Who Should Join Next as Federated Multi-Agent Orchestration Evolves?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19458)
*Shuai Li,Shengyuan Liu,Fan Qi,Xiaoshan Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PFedMA提出了一种面向联邦多智能体系统（FedMAS）的反馈驱动多轮协作框架，通过维护历史能力与可靠性状态来指导智能体选择，并在异构隐私需求下实现隐私规则的本地-全局双向协同进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦多智能体系统未能解决两个关键问题：1）智能体选择仅依赖当前查询上下文，忽略了历史可靠性，可能在多轮迭代中传播错误或对抗性响应；2）隐私规则通常是预定义的静态策略，无法适应协作过程中的演变需求，且难以在跨客户端共享的同时保留个性化约束。

Method: 方法包含两大核心模块：（1）迭代编排模块——通过路由状态M_i^t=[C_i^t||S_i^t]记录每个客户端的历史能力状态C_i^t和可靠性状态S_i^t（含意图、证据、共识三个维度的异常分数），采用强化学习训练的orchestrator π_θ动态选择参与智能体，聚合前进行可靠性过滤；（2）联邦隐私规则协同进化机制——通过全局规则库Ω_global^t和个性化规则库Ω_i,local^t的双向演化：客户端泛化本地新规则后上传，服务器基于跨客户端语义支持度筛选并更新全局规则，再由客户端根据本地效用分数Φ_i^t选择性采纳，实现规则共享与个性化的平衡。

Result: 在MATH、GSM8K、AIME24、MedQA、MedMCQA、AlpacaEval 2.0及Mind2Web-SC等基准上的实验表明：PFedMA平均得分78.86，比最强基线Fed-ICL高出2.52分；在MATH、GSM8K、AIME24和AlpacaEval 2.0上排名第一；隐私泄漏率最低（26.70%，比第二名低5.90分）；对抗鲁棒性方面，攻击成功率最低（30.80%），同时保持最高的良性任务性能（BP=78.80）和净弹性性能（NRP=59.17）。消融实验验证了跨轮反馈回路、双向规则进化以及多因子可靠性评估各模块的必要性。

Conclusion: PFedMA通过将反馈驱动的智能体编排与联邦隐私规则协同进化相结合，在多轮联邦协作中显著提升了任务性能、隐私保护效果和系统鲁棒性。但该框架仅提供语义层面的隐私过滤，不提供形式化的隐私保证（如差分隐私或密码学保密性），未来需引入更强的形式化隐私保障机制。

Abstract: Federated Multi-Agent Systems (FedMAS) offer a promising paradigm for collaborative reasoning among LLM-based agents while keeping raw client data decentralized. However, reliable multi-round collaboration remains challenging. Agent selection must take into consideration evolving task requirements and the agent's historical reliability, while privacy rules must adapt to changing collaboration contexts and meet the client's personalized needs. To address these challenges, we propose PFedMA, a federated multi-agent framework for feedback driven multi-round collaboration under heterogeneous privacy requirements. Across rounds, PFedMA maintains historical capability and reliability states to guide agent selection, evaluates task responses before aggregation, and refines subsequent queries according to accumulated collaboration feedback. PFedMA enables bidirectional local to global and global to local private rule evolution across heterogeneous clients. Clients generalize locally updated privacy rules and selectively incorporate globally maintained rules, thereby facilitating cross-client privacy rule evolution while preserving personalized constraints. Extensive experiments across reasoning, privacy sensitive, and adversarial settings show that PFedMA improves task performance, reduces measured privacy leakage, and improves system robustness.

</details>


### [225] [Are You Reading the Right Thing? Rethinking Internal Signals for Prompt-Injection Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19452)
*Sarthak Gupta,Priyanka Tembey*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统比较了五种基于语言模型内部状态的提示注入检测方法（PIShield、Attention Tracker、Role Confusion、Dong exposure probe、J-Lens），发现检测注入存在与检测攻击实际成功是不同的任务：前者更易识别被模型拒绝的注入，而后者更依赖与响应生成密切相关的信号。Attention Tracker在两个模型上对成功攻击的分离效果最强（Qwen AUROC 0.949，Gemma 0.887）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究提出多种利用LLM内部状态（残差流、注意力、角色投影、暴露探针、概念读出）检测提示注入的方法，但这些方法各自捕捉的安全属性并不一致：注入存在、识别、信息路由或行为影响。论文质疑：高检测性能是否真正反映了对攻击成功的识别，还是仅仅检测到注入文本的存在？

Method: 在统一的结构化间接提示注入评估框架下，比较五种内部表示检测方法：(1) 将所有输入渲染为相同的系统/用户模板；(2) 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B和Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it上，对每种方法提取连续标量分数；(3) 根据模型实际响应是否遵从攻击指令，将2000个攻击分为成功与不成功两组；(4) 分别计算各方法对成功/不成功攻击vs.1000个良性对照的AUROC；(5) 用2000次分层bootstrap估计95%置信区间。所有探测器均在不接触结果标签的情况下训练。

Result: 两类方法呈现一致分化：(1) 注入存在类方法（PIShield、J-Lens）对不成功攻击分离更强——PIShield在Qwen上不成功AUROC 0.898 vs 成功0.637，在Gemma上0.980 vs 0.821；J-Lens在Gemma成功攻击上仅0.519；(2) 注意力路由/角色/暴露类方法（Attention Tracker、Role Confusion、Dong）对成功攻击分离更强——Attention Tracker在Qwen上成功AUROC 0.949（最高），Gemma 0.887；Dong在Qwen上0.873；Role Confusion在Qwen上0.822。Attention Tracker是唯一在两个模型上对成功攻击分离最强的方向性一致的方法。论文据此区分"识别意识"（recognition awareness）与"影响意识"（influence awareness），后者更贴近响应形成过程。

Conclusion: 检测提示注入的存在与检测其行为影响是两个不同的安全问题；高注入检测分数不一定意味着模型已被攻破。靠近响应形成位置的内部信号（注意力路由、暴露、角色混淆）更能反映攻击成功，而注入存在/识别信号反而在被拒绝的注入上更强。实践上，防御应将测量点尽可能靠近真正的安全事件；评估应分别报告注入检测与成功攻击检测指标。未来工作应在更多模型家族、提示格式、对抗性攻击下验证这一区分。

Abstract: Several recent studies propose detecting prompt injections from a language model's internal state. However, these methods do not measure a single security property. Residual-stream probes, attention scores, role projections, exposure probes, and concept readouts may capture injection presence, recognition, information routing, or behavioral influence. It is therefore unclear what differences in prompt-injection detection performance reveal about the internal signals these methods read. We study how five representation-reading methods vary under a common structured indirect prompt-injection setup on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it. We evaluate each method by how well it distinguishes injected prompts from benign controls. We then further analyze each detection method's ability to detect attacks in cases where they are successful and in cases where they are not. This helps us better assess what properties each detection method might rely on. Methods trained to detect injection presence or attack-related concepts generally separate unsuccessful injections more strongly from benign inputs, whereas attention diversion, exposure, and role-confusion-based methods separate successful injections more strongly on both models. Attention Tracker provides the strongest consistent successful injection separation, reaching 0.949 AUROC on Qwen and 0.887 on Gemma. These results suggest that signals closer to response formation may better encode information about an attack's success, and that detection performance can depend strongly on the prompt template. We share the data associated with this study at this https URL

</details>


### [226] [xLightGCN: Explainable Graph Neural Network Based Recommendation Systems with Most Influential Peers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19446)
*Calder Johnson,Robin Cohen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出xLightGCN，一种基于图神经网络（LightGCN系列）的可解释推荐系统框架，通过识别对推荐结果影响最大的"同伴节点"及其构成的紧凑解释子图，为推荐决策提供精确、高效且具有理论保真度度量的解释机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代推荐系统多为不透明的黑盒模型，难以审计与评估可信度。在用户面AI的社会技术背景下，可解释性是建立模型可信度和验证有效性的关键支柱。然而现有GNN解释方法（如GNNExplainer、SubgraphX）通常依赖近似优化或搜索，计算开销大且效率低，因此需要一种直接利用LightGCN线性结构的高效精确解释方法。

Method: 将LightGCN推荐解释建模为节点贡献问题。利用LightGCN线性传播特性，将用户u和物品i的最终嵌入表示为其L跳邻域内初始嵌入的线性组合（系数为c_{u,v}）。算法合并两者的L跳感受野，计算每个节点对推荐分数的贡献度a_{u,v}=c_{u,v}·p_{u,v}（其中p为节点初始嵌入与对端最终嵌入的内积）。从用户端和物品端感受野中各选取贡献绝对值最大的k个节点，并保留连接这些节点至对应端点的代表性路径，形成解释子图。定义保真度F(u,i)=1-|R(u,i)|/(|s(u,i)|+ε)，其中R为原始分数与仅由解释子图重建的分数之差，作为定量保真度度量。整体复杂度为O(Lm+nD+nlogk+kL)，仅随局部感受野规模而非全图扩展。

Result: 在Gowalla数据集上对随机选取的100个用户-物品对进行实验。结果显示：（1）保真度F随k增大而提升但呈现递减收益，表明少数有影响力的节点即能解释大部分预测；（2）存在解释子图大小与保真度之间的权衡，较小且可解释的子图已可达到较高保真度（如k=15时约可解释69%的分数）。这些结果经验性地支持xLightGCN能有效隔离小型、可解释且覆盖大部分预测的解释子图。

Conclusion: xLightGCN提供了一种针对LightGCN系列架构的精确、模型特定解释框架，生成的解释子图直接源自模型实际计算机制，并配有量化解释覆盖度的保真度度量，可作为审计和评估推荐系统可信度的证据支撑机制。文章强调可解释性不仅是面向用户的特征，更是可信赖AI的保障机制。局限性在于：（1）解释不等于可信或准确，仅是调查工具；（2）方法依赖LightGCN的线性传播结构，不直接适用于任意GCN或推荐架构。未来工作将探索其他具有可处理计算结构的架构中的可解释性框架，以及将"隔离有影响力节点"范式应用于动态意见网络等其他领域。

Abstract: Recommendation systems, systems that predict a user's preference for items in order to curate that user's feed, are a ubiquitous and central feature in online social networks. While they are a central piece of our modern digital infrastructure, many modern approaches are opaque black boxes, making them difficult to audit, understand, and assess the trustworthiness of. In this paper we present an exact, graph-based approach for generating explanations for decisions made by recommendation systems. We argue that in the risk-sensitive sociotechnical context of user-facing AI such as recommendation systems, explainability is a key pillar for establishing the trustworthiness of models and validating their effectiveness. We propose a technique built on LightGCN like architectures, an influential and popular class of recommendation models. We describe our approach and argue that it provides an appropriate assurance mechanism for these AI systems leading to specific advantages, including interpretable explanations and a theoretically guaranteed measure of explanation fidelity. We conclude by discussing limitations and directions for future research.

</details>


### [227] [Integrating Simulation and Chain-of-thought Reasoning in Multimodal-Language Models For Physical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19441)
*YingQiao Wang,Eric Bigelow,Tomer Ullman,Yujin Tang,Sebastian Risi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为HSR（Hybrid Simulation and Reasoning）的混合模型，用于多模态语言模型中的物理推理任务。该模型受认知科学中"资源理性"理论启发，能够在测试时根据具体任务自动选择使用思维链推理（CoT）或基于物理模拟的方法来回答问题，从而在准确率和计算成本之间找到最优平衡。实验表明，在流体动力学和弹性碰撞等物理推理任务中，不同方法（CoT与Simulation）在不同问题类别上各有优势，而HSR通过学习到的"模拟控制器"（一个小型MLP）能够将不同问题路由到最适合的方法，并在整体性能上超越单一方法。此外，研究者还发现了一个有趣的现象：用4B参数的Qwen3-VL生成训练数据所训练出的控制器，可以成功应用于超过3T参数的Gemini 3 Pro大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的多模态大语言模型在物理推理任务上主要依赖思维链（CoT）推理方法，但物理上更精确的生成式视频模拟方法虽然准确度较高，计算开销却很大。研究者受认知科学中"资源理性"理论的启发（认为人脑会在心理模拟与启发式推理之间根据任务需求动态取舍），希望构建一个能够自动在两种方法之间进行智能选择的混合模型，以同时优化准确率与计算成本。

Method: 1. **HSR架构**：包含三个组件：(a) 一个轻量级的模拟控制器（2层MLP，1230→512→256→1，带BatchNorm和Dropout）；(b) 一个基于扩散模型的视频模拟器（LTX-Video）作为物理仿真器；(c) 一个用于CoT推理的VLM。 2. **嵌入与路由**：对视频首帧使用CLIP ViT-B/32提取视觉嵌入，对文本使用all-MiniLM-L6-V2提取文本嵌入，拼接后输入MLP控制器，输出使用模拟的概率。 3. **真实标签生成**：对每个训练样本，分别用模拟和CoT方法各尝试K=5次，定义"ground truth probability"为 `p_sim / (p_sim + p_cot)`，用以表示使用模拟方法的相对优势。使用BCE损失训练MLP控制器。 4. **反事实模拟管线**：使用一个工作流（Gemini-3-Pro + Nano-Banana-Pro）来：(a) 判断是否需要反事实模拟；(b) 提取反事实修改；(c) 将原问题改写为非反事实版本；然后由图像生成模型修改物理先验，作为视频模拟器的条件输入。 5. **阈值调度**：通过阈值 `τ_t = τ_accuracy + τ_cost`（设定为0.53 = 0.5 + 0.03）控制分配到模拟方法的样本比例，从而调节计算成本。 6. **跨模型部署**：在Qwen3-VL-4B生成的数据上训练控制器，但将其部署到Gemini 3 Pro上使用，验证小型模型训练的控制器可泛化到大型模型。

Result: 1. **任务类别差异**：在反事实（Counterfactual）类问题中，模拟方法大幅优于CoT（流体沙漏任务中高出10%-17%）；在属性（Property）类问题中，CoT大幅优于模拟（弹性碰撞属性任务中高出27%）；在预测（Predictive）类问题中，两者表现互补。 2. **HSR整体表现**：在Gemini-3-Pro和Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking作为基础模型时，HSR在所有物理领域和问题类别上均接近最佳平均准确率。 3. **路由自动学习类别差异**：尽管未提供类别标签，控制器自动将约28%的属性类问题路由到模拟（更多走CoT），而约40%-50%的反事实类问题路由到模拟。 4. **找到最优权衡点**：HSR选择的阈值τ_t=0.53对应着"准确率vs.分配给模拟的题数"曲线的局部最大值，表明模型自发地平衡了准确率与计算开销。 5. **VLM-as-a-Judge失效**：用Gemini-3-Pro作为零样本判官的控制器无法有效路由，倾向于将几乎所有问题分配给CoT。 6. **小模型训练控制器可迁移到大模型**：用Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking数据训练的控制器，在Gemini 3 Pro（>3T参数）上同样能找到最优路由方案。 7. **基础模型能力边界**：Qwen3-VL-2B作为基础模型时HSR失效，表现为CoT推理中的重复卡顿（如反复输出"Wait"）。 8. **意外发现**：在模拟读出阶段，Gemini-3-Pro使用低推理努力反而比高推理努力准确率更高。

Conclusion: HSR模型通过引入一个轻量级的模拟控制器，成功地模拟了人类认知中的资源理性策略，能够在测试时根据具体任务需求动态选择CoT推理或物理模拟。该模型在多个物理推理任务和模型规模下均取得了优于单一方法的整体性能，并首次证明了小型模型训练的控制器可以泛化到超大模型。作者认为，随着视频生成模型和VLM能力的提升，HSR的路由策略将更具价值。未来的工作将探索场景复杂度与模拟必要性之间的关系。

Abstract: Multimodal language models often need to reason about the physical dynamics of the world in order to answer questions appropriately. Various methods have emerged for solving physical reasoning tasks, and in particular, two leading approaches are Chain-of-Thought reasoning and physics-grounded simulation. However, relatively little is known about which particular problems can be solved by each approach. Some tasks may benefit from computationally expensive generative video simulations, whereas others may be solved equally well (or even better) with language-based reasoning. Our work addresses this by systematically comparing simulation and language reasoning across a variety of multimodal tasks involving physical reasoning, such as answering questions about fluid dynamics and elasticity. We draw a parallel with this to resource-rational theories of human cognition, which propose that people optimally trade off simulation and reasoning depending on task demands. We present a novel cognitively-inspired hybrid model which optimally trades off simulation and reasoning to improve model performance and computational efficiency. Our model is able to decide the appropriate method to solve a physical reasoning problem at test time, and finds an optimal balance between accuracy and cost. Further, our model can be trained on a smaller vision-language model that is only 4B parameters and deployed to improve performance on much bigger base models with $>$3T parameters like Gemini 3 Pro.

</details>


### [228] [EvoProbe: Evaluation-Driven Benchmark Evolution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19433)
*Qianhong Guo,Wei Xie,Xiaofang Cai,Shuoyoucheng Ma,Chengxin Hu,Baosheng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoProbe 是一个面向 LLM 智能体的评估驱动基准演化框架，通过任务生成、诊断评估与反馈驱动再生的闭环，将子任务可验证评分与多评判轨迹评估结合，蒸馏出阶段级瓶颈与成败模式，以指导后续任务迭代生成。在网络安全（CTF）场景下基于 Cybench 进行两轮实验，证明更新后任务整体难度上升，能更细粒度探测能力边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态基准存在饱和与数据污染风险，且聚合分数和成功率难以揭示具体解题瓶颈，也无法有效指导后续任务设计。需要一种将细粒度诊断反馈与任务迭代更新联动的评估机制。

Method: 提出 EvoProbe 闭环框架：(1) 动态任务生成：以 Cybench 任务为少样本，由 Examiner Agent 生成 Harbor 格式可执行任务，经执行检查、难度过滤和人工辅助审核后保留；(2) 细粒度诊断评估：结合子任务结果评分（聚合为侦察/漏洞分析/利用/Flag获取四阶段分数）与多 Judge 轨迹评估（五个维度 0–20 分），采用基于各 Judge 在该任务上解题表现的 Borda 权重进行聚合，并对失败标签进行两阶段投票；(3) 反馈驱动再生：Extractor Agent 从成功与失败轨迹中蒸馏 Success/Failure Patterns，连同难度信号（Phase Reach Rate、Conditional Phase Completion、Bottleneck Analysis）作为下一轮 Examiner 生成任务的附加条件。

Result: 评估八个模型在两轮共 66 个网络安全任务上的表现：R1 中 Outcome 跨度 4.23–7.04，阶段级分数显示 Recon→Flag Capture 逐步下降（89.12%→41.58%）；轨迹评估显示 Path Reasonableness 与 Error Recovery 最低；失败归因以 Planning Strategy Error(42.08%)、Reasoning Error(32.24%)、Exploitation Failure(21.86%)为主，主要子类型为 wrong hypothesis(27.32%)、insufficient exploration(23.50%)、wrong path selection(13.66%)。固定 Examiner 与 Solver 配置的跨轮对比中，R2 任务均使模型 Outcome 下降，平均 Outcome 相对下降 11.8%，Pass@3 下降 17.6%，Pass^3 相对下降 40.0%（10.42%→6.25%），GPT-5.6-Terra 绝对下降最大（5.87→4.96）。代表性案例验证了诊断反馈与 R2 任务需求的具体对应关系。

Conclusion: EvoProbe 通过将细粒度诊断反馈接入任务迭代生成，验证了"诊断驱动基准演化"的可行性：更新后任务整体更具挑战性，能更有效探测智能体的能力边界；为缓解静态基准饱和与污染问题、推进可持续的智能体评估提供了可行路径。代码已开源。

Abstract: Static benchmarks for large language model (LLM) agents face saturation and data contamination risks, motivating continual updates to evaluation tasks. However, aggregate scores and success rates offer limited insight into specific problem-solving bottlenecks and provide limited guidance for subsequent task design. We propose EvoProbe, an evaluation-driven benchmark evolution framework that integrates task generation, diagnostic evaluation, and feedback-driven regeneration into a closed loop. It combines verifiable subtask outcome scoring with evidence-supported multi-judge trajectory evaluation and distills phase-level bottlenecks, success patterns, and failure patterns into diagnostic feedback for generating new executable tasks. Across two rounds of cybersecurity experiments, evaluations of eight models on 66 tasks reveal phase-level performance differences and common failure patterns beyond aggregate scores. In a cross-round comparison with the Examiner model set and solver configuration held fixed, all eight models achieve lower Outcome scores on the updated tasks, with relative decreases of 11.8\% in mean Outcome and 40.0\% in mean Pass\textasciicircum{}3. These results support using fine-grained diagnostics to guide iterative task updates and probe agents' current capabilities and limitations.

</details>


### [229] [Recognition Is Not Grounding: Benchmarking Multilingual Financial Evidence Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19432)
*Lingfei Qian,Yan Wang,Xueqing Peng,Polydoros Giannouris,Nadhem Zmandar,Yi Han,Yanguang Liu,Víctor Gutiérrez-Basulto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MultiFinGround 基准，基于 90 家发行人 FY2025 的英、法、希腊语 IFRS/iXBRL 财报，包含 521 组配对上下文与四类任务。发现 8 个参考模型概念识别准确率高达 97.3–99.4%，却在 26.6–41.9% 的已正确识别组中遗漏至少一个目标数值，表明"识别≠接地"，且金融专用模型增益有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融基准大多独立评估概念链接或事实抽取，无法回答"模型能否在同一多语言证据上同时正确识别概念并穷尽恢复其数值证据"。本文针对这一识别-接地鸿沟设计基准。

Method: 构建来自 ESEF/iXBRL 的 FY2025 三语财报语料；通过 IFRS 会计准则把不同发行人的报告按共享概念对齐；定义四个独立任务（事实识别 T1、概念识别 T2a、穷尽事实选择 T2b、无候选概念辨识 T2c）；评估 15 个模型（含 API、开源、金融专用及基座）并按严格协议（无效输出记错）打分。

Result: Gemini 3.8 Flash 在 T1（95.4 macro-F1）与 T2a（99.4% 准确率）领先；最佳 T2b macro-F1 仅 90.4、exact-set 仅 71.8%；T2c 在参考模型间差距巨大（35.6–95.1%）。参考模型在已正确识别组中遗漏率 26.6–41.9%，希腊语召回率最低；本地化标签对希腊语小幅降低，金融专用模型普遍不优于其基座。

Conclusion: 强概念识别常伴随不完整的证据恢复；多语言金融抽取应同时评估语义识别与证据完整性；当前金融专用化在协议下收益有限；不同语言下表现受发行人、行业、文档风格混杂影响，无法单独归因于语言能力。

Abstract: Comparing financial disclosures across languages requires identifying shared accounting concepts and recovering all numerical facts that express them. Existing benchmarks evaluate aspects of these capabilities, but provide limited insight into whether both succeed on the same multilingual evidence. In particular, it remains unclear whether language models can recognize these concepts across languages and exhaustively recover their corresponding numerical evidence from the same contexts. We introduce MULTIFINGROUND, a benchmark designed to investigate this recognition-grounding gap in multilingual financial reports. Constructed from FY2025 disclosures of 90 issuers in English, French, and Greek, MULTIFINGROUND aligns independently authored reports through a shared accounting taxonomy and provides traceable fact-level annotations. The benchmark evaluates financial fact identification, concept recognition, exhaustive fact selection, and concept discrimination without candidate labels. Across 15 evaluated models, eight API and open-weight reference models achieve 97.3-99.4\% concept recognition accuracy, yet miss at least one target fact in 26.6-41.9\% of correctly recognized groups. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in concept discrimination and limited gains from the evaluated finance-specialized models. Our findings demonstrate that strong concept recognition can coexist with incomplete evidence recovery, highlighting the importance of evaluating semantic recognition and evidence completeness together.

</details>


### [230] [Evaluating Agentic Capabilities Before Post-Training: An End-to-End Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19425)
*Jiarui Qin,Junjie Huang,Yunjia Xi,Di Yin,Yong Yu,Weinan Zhang,Xing Sun,Weiwen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ASAP 框架，通过将智能体脚手架适配为续写式交互（Markdown+XML 格式 + 短参考前缀 + 轻量恢复机制），使得预训练基模型无需经过后训练即可直接在端到端智能体任务上进行评估。论文在 SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 BrowseComp-Plus 等基准上验证了 ASAP 对不同基模型及预训练检查点具备良好区分能力，并能通过执行轨迹提供行为层面的诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体基准（如 SWE-bench、Terminal-Bench 等）几乎只在后训练后使用，而在预训练阶段缺乏端到端的智能体评估手段。已有的代理方法（如轨迹 QA、似然代理）只能提供静态或标量信号，无法直接观察基模型在交互环境中的真实行为。因此迫切需要一种无需将基模型转换为指令跟随模型即可进行端到端智能体评估的框架。

Method: ASAP 由三个核心组件构成：(1) 采用 Markdown+XML 混合格式表示智能体交互轨迹（Markdown 用于自由推理，XML 标签界定动作与观察）；(2) 引入来自指令模型参考轨迹的短前缀（默认 K=3 步）进行上下文引导；(3) 提供针对结构性失败（过早提交、重复动作）的轻量恢复机制。其核心原则是将基模型视为续写模型而非不完整的聊天模型，保留原生 completion 接口，对现有脚手架（SWE-agent、OpenHands、Terminus、BrowseComp）做最小化补丁适配。

Result: 在六个开源基模型（Qwen3.5-9B/35B-A3B、Qwen3-30B-A3B、GLM-4.5、Gemma4-26B-A4B、MiMo-V2.5）上，ASAP 在三类基准上均显示出显著区分度（SWE-bench Verified Pass@1 跨度 4–39%）。跨预训练阶段研究表明：阶段 2→3 因引入轨迹数据和 32K 长上下文训练带来最大跃升（Pass@1 从 10.15% 升至 27.30%），且在常规基准饱和阶段 ASAP 仍敏感。行为分解显示阶段 2 主要提升接口合规性（可解析回合 88.81%→99.41%），阶段 3 才显著增强自主编辑（→42.86%）、主动测试（→65.64%）和解决率。后训练后，模型在编辑-测试-恢复-提交流程上更稳定，且不同基模型的瓶颈不同（如 Qwen 精度不足，MiMo 易卡在探索阶段）。

Conclusion: ASAP 作为一种轻量级端到端智能体评估框架，能够在不做权重更新和对话模板转换的前提下，直接评估预训练基模型的智能体能力。其价值不仅在于提供比常规基准更敏感的模型/检查点区分能力，更在于通过暴露执行轨迹实现行为级别的诊断，使研究者能够定位能力发展中的具体短板（如接口合规、自主编辑、测试恢复、提交完整度等），并据此设计针对性的训练数据。这表明端到端智能体评估可作为预训练阶段一种实用的行为诊断工具，与传统基准形成互补。

Abstract: Agentic capabilities are increasingly important for modern LLMs, yet remain difficult to evaluate during pretraining. Existing approaches typically rely on static trajectory-derived tasks or likelihood-based proxies, which are lightweight but provide limited visibility into how base models behave in interactive environments. We introduce ASAP (Agent Scaffold Adaptation for Pretraining Evaluation), a lightweight framework for eliciting and evaluating agentic behavior from pretrained base models on end-to-end tasks. Rather than converting base models into chat-style agents, ASAP preserves the completion interface and adapts existing agent scaffolds through structured trajectory continuation, short reference prefixes, and minimal recovery mechanisms. Across software-engineering and deep-research benchmarks, ASAP yields discriminative end-to-end performance across base models and pretraining checkpoints. Beyond aggregate scores, ASAP exposes model-generated execution trajectories, enabling analysis of exploration, editing, testing, recovery, and task completion across training stages. These trajectories provide a behavioral view of how agent-relevant capabilities change during pretraining and how execution patterns differ after post-training. Our results suggest that end-to-end agent evaluation can complement conventional pretraining benchmarks by providing a practical diagnostic of interactive model behavior.

</details>


### [231] [Beyond the Trial-and-Error Loop: Hybrid Projection and Automated Tuning for Distributed Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19423)
*Anshu Raina,Peyman Razaghi,Yuankai Chen,Cheng Yao,Yao Fu,Vidushi Goyal,Devang Patel,Wen Xie,Zhenyu Gu,Emad Barsoum*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Primus Projection 是一种面向分布式 LLM 训练配置调优的混合投影框架，通过"子节点降维-测量-升维"工作流在单节点（或无 GPU）上实现多节点吞吐量的高精度预估；Primus Tuning Agent 以该投影引擎为秒级评分预言机，结合确定性种子规划器与 LLM 跨轴组合搜索，自动发现高性能且内存合法的训练配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式 LLM 训练需要在 TP/PP/EP/CP/DP 等多维并行空间与 micro-batch、重计算、sharding、overlap 等细粒度旋钮间联合搜索，组合空间巨大且内存合法/非法边界仅由单字节激活精度决定；当前业界依赖多节点试错，消耗大量 GPU 小时并频繁遭遇 OOM 与次优配置，亟需一种能在不启动多节点任务的前提下进行快速、准确配置的方案。

Method: 方法分两部分：(1) 混合投影引擎——在尽可能少的 GPU（最少 1 块）上微基准测试计算内核与范围内通信，按 PP→EP→TP 优先级降维后测量，再通过解析模型恢复出目标规模的跨节点 collective、FSDP overlap 与 pipeline schedule；同时提供纯 CPU 模拟模式（基于 Origami GEMM 模型与 FlashAttention v3 tile 级仿真）支持预硅探索。(2) Primus Tuning Agent——以投影引擎为秒级评分预言机，确定性种子规划器沿单轴扫描生成 12 个候选，LLM 调研循环（ReAct 风格，Planner + RLM 双 LLM，DSPy 实现）提出种子规划器无法到达的跨轴组合；解析内存预过滤器在 GPU 评估前剔除 OOM 候选。

Result: 在 AMD MI325X 与 MI355X 上验证 Llama 3.1（dense）与 Mixtral 8×22B（MoE），所有投影相对实测多节点吞吐量误差均控制在约 10% 以内；规模放大后保真度依然成立：DeepSeek V3 671B 在 1,024 GPU 上误差 4.7%，Qwen3-235B-A22B 在 256 GPU 上误差 1.9%。排序保持能力出色（Spearman ρ≥0.93，选择遗憾 0%）。Mixtral 案例中 Agent 在 30 分钟单节点探索内发现比 AMD 4 节点 BF16 参考快 +27% 的配置，且无手写 Megatron 配置。相对 Calculon 平均误差从 28.9% 降至 6.6%；相对 Galvatron 风格 530 配置穷举（3,656 tok/s/GPU），Primus Tuning Agent + Benchmark 达 4,698 tok/s/GPU，差距主要来自 benchmark 预言机而非搜索算法。

Conclusion: Primus Projection 通过"测所能测、推所不能推"的混合策略，将昂贵的多节点试错循环转化为单节点/无 GPU 的快速投影搜索；Primus Tuning Agent 借助 LLM 跨轴推理在数十次试验内发现高质量训练配方。该框架为 LLM 分布式训练配置规划提供了高保真、低成本的预言机，未来可向 NVIDIA/TPU 等加速器移植并扩展新型层类型与 MoE 通信后端。

Abstract: Configuring distributed LLM training across hundreds of GPUs requires jointly optimizing tensor, pipeline, expert, context, and data parallelism alongside micro-batch size, recomputation, sharding, and overlap, a combinatorial space where memory legality can hinge on a single byte of activation accounting. Today, teams navigate it through expensive multi-node trial and error, burning GPU-hours on crashes and suboptimal recipes. We present Primus Projection, which closes this loop with two coupled components. First, a hybrid projection engine that measures what it can and simulates what it cannot: GPU microbenchmarks on as few as a single device capture compute kernels and any in-scope communication; a sub-node downscale-measure-upscale workflow analytically restores out-of-scope collectives, FSDP overlap, and the full pipeline schedule at the multi-node target. A pure simulation mode runs entirely on CPU, enabling pre-silicon planning without any GPU. Second, the Primus Tuning Agent treats the projection engine as a fast scoring oracle (seconds per candidate instead of tens of minutes) and uses it to drive an intelligent search over the configuration space. A deterministic seed planner sweeps single axes; an LLM investigation loop proposes cross-axis combinations the planner cannot reach, with an analytic memory pre-filter that rejects infeasible candidates before any GPU time is spent. Validated on Llama 3.1 (dense) and Mixtral 8x22B (MoE) across two GPU generations, all projections stay within ~10% of measured multi-node throughput, and fidelity holds at production scale: 4.7% error on DeepSeek V3 671B at 1,024 GPUs and 1.9% on Qwen3-235B-A22B at 256 GPUs. In a Mixtral 8x22B case study, the Primus Tuning Agent discovers a configuration delivering +27% throughput over the published 4-node BF16 reference at the same scale, in under 30 minutes of single-node exploration.

</details>


### [232] [AgentSafeEvo: Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Agent Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19422)
*Chenxu Wang,Xiaoyu Wen,Han Qi,Ziyuan Zhou,Cheng Jin,Chaochao Lu,Qiaosheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AgentSafeEvo，一种用于LLM智能体安全的对抗协同进化强化学习框架；引入可学习性引导的任务加权机制，使攻击者构建对抗性任务、防御者学习安全执行；实验证明其在提升对抗鲁棒性的同时保持通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体通过多轮工具交互执行复杂任务，但用户查询、工具描述或环境观测中嵌入的恶意内容可操纵其决策。现有对抗协同进化方法主要针对语言级安全或网页任务中的间接提示注入，缺乏对多样化任务与攻击类型的协同进化攻击任务构建能力，且任务级零和奖励无法有效反映每个任务对防御者的学习价值。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1)红队攻击者初始化——利用Gemini将TOUCAN任务转化为对抗性任务，进行监督微调以获得结构化攻击能力；(2)联合对抗训练——基于GRPO同时优化攻击者与防御者。奖励设计包含安全性+效用性（防御者）与负均值防御者奖励（攻击者），形成零和博弈。核心创新为可学习性引导的任务加权机制：以任务内防御者奖励标准差作为可学习性代理，对同一任务来源的攻击者和防御者优势施加共享的任务权重。涵盖六类攻击（共13子类）：直接/间接提示注入、工具描述注入、错误信息、有害工具执行、用户查询越狱。

Result: 基于Qwen3-8B的实验：(1)安全性：在Agent-SafetyBench上将ASR从31.01%降至17.84%，AgentHarm伤害分数从30.00降至6.53，AgentDojo ASR 6.18%且UA 66.52%，MSB ASR 31.25%且NRP 46.00，均优于Spotlighting、Prompt Guard 2与Static-AT基线；(2)通用能力：ALFWorld准确率从30.28%提升至43.72%，ToolHop从21.84%提升至48.04%，BFCL-V3基本持平；(4)协同进化中攻击与防御均持续增强，攻击改进可迁移至Llama3.3-70B（ASR 43.7%→80.7%）和GPT-5（12.3%→22.5%）等更大模型；(5)消融实验验证协同进化与可学习性加权（含攻击者加权与防御者加权共同施加）的有效性。

Conclusion: AgentSafeEvo首次将对抗性任务构建纳入与安全任务执行的协同进化过程，跨越多样化任务与攻击类型；可学习性引导的任务加权通过利用任务内奖励变异性协调攻击与防御更新。实验表明对抗协同进化可有效增强工具调用型LLM智能体的鲁棒性，同时保持通用能力。未来工作将拓展至多智能体协作场景，关注通信与任务委派中的安全风险。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents accomplish complex tasks through multi-turn interactions with external tools. However, malicious content embedded in user queries, tool descriptions, or environment observations can manipulate their decisions and induce unsafe actions. Adversarial co-evolution has emerged as an effective approach to strengthening LLM safety, but existing work primarily focuses on language-level safety or indirect prompt injection in web tasks. In this paper, we introduce AgentSafeEvo, a co-evolutionary reinforcement learning framework for agent safety built on an attacker-defender game spanning diverse tasks and attack types. The attacker learns to construct adversarial agent tasks that expose weaknesses in the defender's tool use, while the defender learns to complete tasks safely under these attacks. We further introduce learnability-guided task weighting, which uses within-task defender-reward variability to adjust each task's contribution to attacker and defender updates. Extensive experiments on agent safety and general capability benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves adversarial robustness while maintaining general agent capabilities.

</details>


### [233] [SERO: Learning from Executable Oracle Continuations for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19397)
*Dingyi Rong,Yue Shi,Chaofan Ma,Zongrui Wang,Jiezhang Cao,Yixin Cao,Liang He,Ning Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SERO（State-Rooted Executable Rollout Optimization），一种面向长程智能体强化学习的方法。SERO 从当前策略实际访问到的状态出发，恢复环境快照，让仅在训练阶段使用的"预言机"在真实环境中执行多步延续，从而将下游真实的观测与预言机动作直接作为监督信号。进一步引入"策略可达性加权"（policy-reachability weighting），按冻结的行为策略对预言机前缀的兼容性，对每个预言机步骤加权。预言机损失作为辅助项与基础 RL 损失并行优化，推理时不使用预言机。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上以 Qwen2.5-1.5B 与 7B 验证，相比 GraphGPO 与 HGPO 基线取得稳定提升，且完整的可执行延续 + 前缀可达性加权优于仅使用根步骤或均匀加权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程智能体 RL 中，on-policy 的 rollout 受限于当前策略实际访问到的未来。当所有采样均错过有效行为时，更精细的 credit assignment 无法提供从未出现过的状态/动作的监督。现有 On-Policy Distillation（OPD）及其多轮变体主要围绕"单步纠正动作、教师前缀或干预结果"提供监督，未直接利用由预言机控制、可在真实环境中执行的下游完整分支，因而对其长程后果监督不足。

Method: 1) 收集基础 on-policy 轨迹，计算基础 RL 目标；2) 从策略实际访问过的某个状态 s_t 恢复环境副本，作为预言机分支的根 s_0^O；3) 训练专用预言机在该真实环境中继续多步交互，得到完整 oracle continuation（每个 oracle 动作均在环境中执行，下游观测由前面 oracle 动作产生）；4) 计算每步局部兼容性 z_k（行为策略在 oracle 命令 token 上的长度归一化似然），并构造排他性前缀权重 w_k = ∏_{j<k} z_j；5) 用分支级"改进门控" g_r = clip((G_r^O - G_r^π)/c_R, 0, 1) 过滤是否贡献，损失 L_SERO 以 attempt-root 数量归一、在所有贡献分支上按 g_r · w_{r,k} 加权 oracle 动作 NLL；6) 总损失 L_total = L_base + λ_O · L_SERO，oracle 与环境恢复仅用于训练。SERO 作为模块化辅助目标，与 GRPO/GiGPO/HGPO/GraphGPO 等基础算法兼容，不修改 on-policy 优势或策略比。

Result: 在 ALFWorld（seen/unseen SR）与 WebShop（task score、strict success）上，对 Qwen2.5-1.5B 与 7B：GraphGPO+SERO 在 1.5B 将 ALFWorld 90.63/88.02 提升至 95.83/91.67、WebShop 87.27/77.93 提升至 88.90/79.27；7B 将 ALFWorld 91.67/76.30 提升至 95.57/87.50、WebShop 89.77/80.47 提升至 91.93/83.67，最大单点提升 11.20（ALFWorld unseen, 7B GraphGPO）。HGPO+SERO 在两个规模上同样一致提升。消融：Root-only 反而比 GraphGPO 退化（ALFWorld -2.87/-4.17），Full-Flat 全延续监督带来主要收益，SERO 的 exclusive-prefix 加权进一步在 unseen 上 +3.39。固定 oracle bank + 权重排列（Shuffled）等额外控制进一步证实了按可达性对齐加权的必要性，并显示收益不能仅由额外环境交互解释。

Conclusion: SERO 将 on-policy 智能体 RL 与"可执行的多步预言机延续"相结合，证明了：长程 oracle 监督的有效信号延伸到初始纠正动作之外；按行为策略对 oracle 前缀的兼容性逐步加权，能够随策略改进而扩展有效监督深度，并显著提升分布外泛化。该框架作为与基础 RL 估计器解耦的辅助损失，易与多种组基 RL 方法集成；未来工作包括放宽对精确环境恢复的要求（采用世界模型/扩散生成）以及将语言预言机扩展到视觉-语言场景。

Abstract: Long-horizon agentic RL is constrained by the futures visited by the current policy. When rollouts fail to reach useful behaviors, improved credit assignment cannot provide supervision for states and actions that were never encountered. On-policy distillation (OPD) introduces teacher guidance on policy-induced states, and recent multi-turn variants improve how this guidance is scheduled, replayed, refined, or validated. However, they do not directly use the oracle-controlled future itself as the training trajectory. We introduce \textbf{State-Rooted Executable Rollout Optimization (SERO)}, which augments on-policy agentic RL with executable oracle continuations. SERO restores a state actually reached by the current policy and lets a training-only oracle continue interacting with the real environment, making the downstream observations and oracle actions themselves available for learning. It then applies \textbf{policy-reachability weighting}, which weights each oracle step by the frozen behavior policy's compatibility with the preceding oracle actions. This allows deeper supervision to become effective as the policy becomes more compatible with the oracle branch. The oracle loss is optimized separately from the base RL estimator and no oracle is used at inference time. We evaluate SERO on two challenging interactive-agent benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop, using Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. On ALFWorld, learning the full executable continuation is substantially more effective than supervising only the root oracle action, while policy-reachability weighting further improves out-of-distribution performance.

</details>


### [234] [EpiGuard: An Autonomous Infectious-Disease Early Warning Agent Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19396)
*Tonglong Wei,Zheng Yuan,Lingshuai Lin,Yuhui Yao,Xing Xie,Na Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EpiGuard 是一个面向50+种传染病早期预警的自主代理平台,通过LLM推理协调多源监测数据采集、三种证据可用性场景(缺失/稀疏/丰富)下的自适应分析、30+预测模型池的回顾性选择、以及将成功执行流程沉淀为可复用SOP的自我改进机制,在中美CDC数据上较SOTA分别提升9.68%和14.04%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有传染病早期预警系统面临三大瓶颈:(1)流行病学证据分散在多种监测源;(2)疾病间和地区间数据可用性极不均衡;(3)人工数据收集分析报告流程导致预警延迟。

Method: 系统由六大组件构成:用户交互层(UIL)解析请求并索引SOP;智能体规划与决策中心(APDC)基于LLM推理动态规划;数据采集与处理(DAP)主动监控多源监测数据并维护证据库;模型分析与风险判定(MARD)根据证据量在三种模式下切换——缺失/稀疏用LLM评估,丰富则从30+模型池中按回顾性MSE选最优;报告生成(RG)三模板结构化输出并三阶段验证;自我改进机制将成功轨迹固化为SOP供后续复用。

Result: 在中国CDC(5种呼吸道病原体阳性率)和美国CDC(10种法定传染病周报)数据集上,MASE和RMSE全面优于AutoGluon-TimeSeries、CAPE、TimeSeriesScientist、epi4cast、Predict NIDs及DeepSeek/GPT-4o ReAct基线,平均相对改进9.68%和14.04%;案例研究显示多源证据(全国活跃度+航班连通性)使再发预测精度提升24.8%,API调用减少27.27%、单次token消耗降低32.89%。

Conclusion: EpiGuard通过证据自适应规划、异构预测模型池和SOP持续复用机制,有效解决了数据不均衡与预警延迟;实验证明没有单一时序基础模型在所有场景下最优,印证了模型池与任务自适应选择的必要性。

Abstract: Infectious disease outbreaks often spread rapidly before signs of widespread transmission become apparent, leaving a big challenge for rapid response and effective intervention. However, current infectious-disease early-warning systems face three major challenges: fragmented epidemiological evidence across diverse surveillance sources, highly uneven data availability across diseases and geographic regions, and delayed warning procedure caused by manual data collection, analysis, and reporting. To address these challenges, we present EpiGuard, an autonomous, continually self-improving agentic platform for timely and reliable early warning of more than 50 infectious diseases across different regions. EpiGuard proactively monitors and captures newly released official surveillance records, using the latest available evidence for risk assessments. It dynamically adjusts its analytical strategy across three evidence availability regimes, enabling reliable risk assessment under diverse data conditions, ranging from the absence of historical observations to sparse and abundant evidence. Moreover, EpiGuard learns from the successful execution process by preserving effective data-acquisition and analytical procedures as reusable standard operating procedures, enabling it to progressively generalize to previously unseen diseases and regions. We use officially released infectious-disease surveillance data from the China CDC and the United States CDC to evaluate EpiGuard's effectiveness. Experimental results demonstrate that EpiGuard outperforms state-of-the-art forecasting systems, improving forecasting performance by 9.68% and 14.04% on the China CDC and U.S. CDC datasets, respectively.

</details>


### [235] [STRATA: Self-Maintaining Structured Experience Graphs for Self-Evolving Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19386)
*Guanhua Zhu,Hanwen Li,Zhi Wei,Mengnan Du,Chenxi Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: STRATA 是一个面向 LLM 智能体的三层结构化、可自我维护的经验图记忆系统，通过五种共享相似度几何的机制解决现有单层记忆缺乏类型抽象层次、无维护机制、易受负迁移影响等核心问题，在四个交互基准测试中以更低成本取得最佳平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体的经验记忆系统普遍存在三大缺陷：1) 缺乏类型化抽象层级，轨迹、流程、推理项混在同一池中，按嵌入相似度检索，无法区分一次性工具调用、可复用流程与跨任务原则；2) 非自我维护，记忆单调增长，无遗忘、无去重、无整合，陈旧条目挤占有用条目；3) 易受负迁移影响，表面上相似但方向相反的经验被检索并被原样执行，对智能体造成实际损害。例如 ScienceWorld 上原生平面记忆在某些任务族上得分为 -100，而无记忆智能体可直接解决。

Method: STRATA 将经验组织为三层有向图：原子层（可复用技能、代码片段、专门子角色）、工作流层（任务泛化流程）、元框架层（由相似工作流社区抽象而成的任务族范式），通过类型化调用边、泛化边、合并边与对比边连接。五种维护机制共享同一相似度几何：1) 多维相似度（内容+索引嵌入+结构化标签 Jaccard+词汇重叠），其中标签项作为加性权重以区分"同对象反操作"经验；2) 类型化反思器，仅从成功回合提炼流程，失败回合最多附加陷阱要点，阈值通过按组经验贝叶斯收缩自适应；3) 基于 Louvain 社区检测（结合电导阈值与新颖性门控）诱导元框架节点；4) 压力触发的垃圾回收，基于质量分数（激活度-竞争年龄）遗忘低质节点，并通过 Tarjan 关节点算法保护桥接节点；5) 对比边，通过操作符词典规则连接方向相反的经验，检索时注入"勿混淆"警告。检索时返回子图而非孤立条目，按 meta→workflow→atomic 顺序渲染，并通过最小置信度门控防止噪声注入。

Result: 在四个交互基准（AppWorld Test-Normal 168 任务、Test-Challenge 417 任务、WebArena 812 任务、ALFWorld 134 任务、ScienceWorld 23 任务）与两个冻结骨干（DeepSeek-V4-Flash 与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro）上对比七个基线（No-Memory、Flat-Memory、ReasoningBank、Hermes、A-Mem、MemEvolve、MemGen）。STRATA 在 12 个骨干-基准列中取得 11 项最佳或并列最佳平均分，七个记忆增强方法中延迟最低（58.7s vs 60.2-72.4s）、输出 token 最少（5,217）、环境步数最少（11.7），注入记忆行数比最耗上下文的基线少 44%。消融实验显示标签项影响最大（-13.1 平均分），对比边次之（-6.5），且对比边增益集中在含反向操作符的环境（ALFWorld +9.1，ScienceWorld +18.0，WebArena 仅 +1.8）。A-Mem 在 168 任务时排名第一，在 812 任务时跌至第七，直接体现单层记忆的规模依赖性。记忆图收敛而非膨胀：812 个 WebArena 任务压缩为 112 个工作流与 16 个元节点，关节点保护使删除精度从 13.2% 提升至 4.8%。

Conclusion: STRATA 通过类型化三层图结构与五种自我维护机制，将 LLM 智能体的经验记忆从"无差别平面池"转变为"有组织、可演化、有防护的知识库"。论文诊断了先前记忆系统的两大失败模式：单层记忆随任务规模增长而退化；单层具体记忆存在灾难性负迁移。对比边机制在检索时显式警告方向相反的经验，弥合了"强迁移但危险的具体流程"与"弱但安全的抽象推理"之间的结构-抽象权衡。所有超参数固定跨基准跨骨干复用，未做逐基准调优。未来工作方向包括：跨骨干复现以验证对比机制对指令遵循的依赖、从预定义操作符词典扩展到自动发现反向关系、以及控制任务集固定仅变化累积经验数以严格分离规模与难度的影响。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve at test time by accumulating experience: retrieving relevant memories before acting and writing new lessons back afterwards. Yet most are single-level: trajectories, distilled workflows and reasoning items all land in one undifferentiated pool indexed by embedding similarity, with no typed abstraction hierarchy. They never forget or deduplicate, and are prone to negative transfer, where a superficially similar but directionally opposite experience is recalled and its concrete steps are copied verbatim, actively harming the agent. We introduce STRATA, a structured, outcome-grounded, self-maintaining memory that organizes experience into a three-layer graph of atomic skills and code snippets, task workflows and generalized meta-frameworks, connected by typed edges. STRATA maintains itself through five mechanisms sharing one similarity geometry: a multi-dimensional similarity that scores retrieval by operation and target; a typed reflector crystallizing procedures from successes and pitfalls from failures; community detection that induces meta-frameworks; pressure-triggered garbage collection with articulation-point protection; and contrast edges that flag confusable, direction-opposite experiences. Across four interactive benchmarks (AppWorld, WebArena, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld), two frozen backbones and seven baselines, STRATA attains the best average score while simultaneously using the lowest latency and fewest environment steps of any memory-augmented method, and 44% fewer lines of injected memory than the most context-hungry baseline. We isolate two failure modes of prior memories: single-level memory degrades sharply as the task set grows, and single-level concrete memories suffer catastrophic negative transfer, which contrast edges repair, lifting ScienceWorld from 78.7 to 96.7 within the same system.

</details>


### [236] [ixi-sLM: On-Device sLM for AI Call Agent Service](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19382)
*Han-Sang Lee,Kyuho Lee,Juneyoung Park,Seongbae Lee,Jin Kyu Park,Minjae Kim,Yuri Hong,Jinwoo Lee,Youngwook Kwon,Seongwan Kim,Seungheon Hyeon,Jaeho Lee,Kiduk Kwon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ixi-sLM 是一个 1.2B 参数的韩语小型语言模型，专为在移动设备 NPU 上部署 AI 通话代理而设计，通过领域自适应建模和任务感知量化技术，实现了在 803MiB 内存下达到 SOTA 云端 LLM 94% 的任务质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将 AI 通话代理部署到移动设备面临云端部署不存在的特殊约束：约 1GiB 内存预算、通话中延迟与热限、静态整数 NPU 执行、远离 sLM 预训练分布的韩语 STT 输入，以及云端质量期待。现有框架将分词和量化视为固定配置而非适应性杠杆，且移动量化面向通用基准而非服务流量，因此需要专门为服务场景设计的端侧模型。

Method: 提出"端侧建模"(on-device modeling) 包含两大核心技术：(1) 领域自适应建模——基于真实通话数据频率裁剪词汇表（从 102,400 降至 65,536），并将分词器通过 BPE 合并适配韩语通话表达（通话流量 token 数减少 18%）；(2) 任务感知量化——使用真实通话数据（而非 WikiText）进行 PTQ 校准，并基于 SeqMSE 模块敏感度进行混合精度量化（MW4A16），高敏感模块保持 INT8、低敏感模块降至 INT4。同时构建跨平台框架统一导出至 Qualcomm 和 Apple NPU。

Result: 在 Galaxy S25 Ultra 和 iPhone 17 Pro 上部署：模型体积从 2.9GiB FP16 缩减至 803MiB（28%）；NPU 相比 CPU 延迟降至 22%（4.5 倍加速）、每通话能耗降至 23%；在 300 秒持续推理中温度低于 36°C 节流阈值。任务质量达到 SOTA 云端 LLM 的 94%（AI Call Summary 94.33 vs 99.60，AI Call Answering 95.40 vs 99.00），且量化仅带来微小质量损失。已在数百万订阅用户的 ixi-O 服务中生产部署。

Conclusion: 通过将真实部署约束作为设计起点，领域自适应建模与任务感知量化的结合使单个 1.2B 模型在跨平台移动 NPU 上达到接近云端 LLM 的质量。未来工作包括推理优化、端侧个性化以及更广泛的评估。

Abstract: Running an AI call agent on-device makes it private, network-independent, and free of per-query cloud cost, but shipping one as a real-world service imposes constraints a cloud deployment never faces: ~1GiB memory budget, in-call latency and thermal limits, static-integer NPU execution, Korean STT input far from sLM pretraining, and cloud-level quality expectations. We bring ixi-sLM, a 1.2B Korean sLM, to mobile NPUs through ON-DEVICE MODELING: domain-adaptive modeling trims the vocabulary by call frequency to shrink the embedding and LM head that take nearly half the model under INT4 transformer weights and refits the tokenizer to call speech (18% fewer tokens on call traffic), while task-aware quantization calibrates on real calls and assigns per-module mixed precision by activation sensitivity. A single domain-adapted model runs ixi-O's two production services, AI Call Summary and AI Call Answering, at 94% of a state-of-the-art cloud LLM's task-weighted quality; our on-device modeling carries that quality onto the NPU with only a marginal drop in overall score, in an 803MiB model (28% of FP16) at 23% of the CPU's per-call energy. The same recipe deploys across Qualcomm and Apple NPUs and serves several million ixi-O subscribers in production.

</details>


### [237] [EvoWeave: Composing Reusable Agent Experience through Operation Level Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19381)
*Guanhua Zhu,Bo Shen,Lei Zhang,Fadi Deek,Zhi Wei,Mengnan Du,Chenxi Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoWeave提出了一种面向交互式智能体的经验记忆框架，将可复用操作表示为带输入输出契约、来源和能力引用的有向边，并通过计划引导的检索和有界搜索来组合历史经验片段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有经验复用方法存在粒度困境：检索整个历史工作流会带入无关步骤，而检索孤立操作则会丢失操作间的依赖关系。需要一种既能细粒度复用又能保留操作间关联性的经验表示与检索机制。

Method: 1) 将抽象状态建模为节点，可复用操作建模为带输入输出契约、来源和能力引用的有向边；2) 规划器将当前任务分解为依赖图DAG，通过描述嵌入的Top-K检索和有界BFS搜索来连接历史片段；3) 执行智能体检查检索片段并可主动查询经验图；4) 反思机制将具体执行证据与可复用抽象分离，更新共享记忆。

Result: 在4个基准（AppWorld Normal/Challenge、WebArena、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld）、5个评估设置、3个语言模型骨干上的实验显示：EvoWeave在21个骨干-指标组合中有16个取得最高均值；AppWorld Normal TGC平均从44.92提升至51.91（+6.99），Challenge TGC从23.01提升至27.99（+4.99）。AppWorld消融实验表明，有向连接为Overall TGC贡献额外2.08分，完整系统达34.86分。注入记忆token仅6155.46，较Flat-Memory减少76.60%，但总输入token仅减少0.99%，且具有较低KV复用率（45%）和较高单轮时间（10.44秒）。

Conclusion: EvoWeave通过操作级有向图表示和计划引导的检索连接机制，有效支持可复用经验的组合。消融实验证实了操作分解与有向连接各自的贡献。然而，更小的记忆上下文不一定意味着更低延迟，检索开销与有效复用条件之间存在权衡。未来工作应关注对未见操作组合的泛化能力以及检索开销对端到端性能的影响。

Abstract: Different tasks often require interactive agents to perform similar operations at intermediate steps. Retrieving an entire past workflow can introduce irrelevant steps, whereas retrieving isolated operations can discard the dependencies needed to reuse them. We introduce EvoWeave, a framework for experience memory that represents abstract states as nodes and reusable operations as directed edges with input and output contracts, provenance, and capability references. A planner decomposes the current task into a dependency graph; operation retrieval and bounded directed search then assemble relevant experience fragments. An execution agent can inspect these fragments and their referenced capabilities, while reflection separates concrete execution evidence from reusable abstractions. We study the framework across four benchmarks, five evaluation settings, and three language model backbones. Across backbones, AppWorld Normal and Challenge task goal completion average 51.91 and 27.99, respectively, exceeding the baseline without memory by 6.99 and 4.99 percentage points. An AppWorld ablation associates directed connections with an additional improvement of 2.08 points over independent operation cards. The results motivate composition of reusable operations while exposing tradeoffs in retrieval overhead and conditions for valid reuse.

</details>


### [238] [DeLoop: Repeated Actions as Self-Supervision for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19376)
*Tianle Chen,Pushkar Singh,Ketan Todi,Biswajit Paria,Qijia He,Wenqi Wang,Yuwen Tan,Jike Zhong,Sugato Basu,Deepti Ghadiyaram,Arjun Akula*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeLoop 是一种自监督训练方法，通过从智能体自身的 rollout 中挖掘循环动作（重复工具调用）与后续打破循环的动作作为偏好对，使用 DPO 进行训练，无需任务奖励、标准答案或 LLM 评判。在 CodeGym 基准上，DeLoop 将 Qwen3-8B 的循环率从 57.3% 降至 6.1%，同时将每任务步数缩减约三分之二；在更大模型上还能提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野语言模型智能体常因重复已执行过的工具调用而陷入"循环"，浪费计算资源并导致任务失败；上下文压缩会进一步加剧此问题。现有方法（更好的压缩、推理时反射、结果监督训练等）均无法有效解决。论文探索：智能体自身的循环失败能否直接转化为训练信号？

Method: 核心方法是从智能体自身的 rollout 中自动挖掘偏好对：(1) 使用结构化检测器识别循环动作（与之前某次工具调用及观测完全相同的动作）；(2) 在同一 rollout 中找到首个后续打破循环的非循环动作；(3) 将循环动作作为 rejected 样本，打破循环的动作作为 chosen 样本，使用 DPO（直接偏好优化）训练策略。无需任何外部监督（任务奖励、标签、LLM 评判）。还提出了 DeLoop-Mix 变体，加入跨域挖掘的偏好对。

Result: 主要结果：(1) CodeGym 上，Qwen3-8B 循环率从 57.3% 降至 6.1%（9.4×），步数从 15.00 降至 4.67，任务成功率持平；(2) Qwen3-32B 循环率从 38.5% 降至 12.9%，任务成功率从 37.7% 提升至 44.8%；(3) DeLoop-Mix 将 Qwen3-8B 成功率从 25.1% 提升至 30.3%；(4) 泛化至 ALFWorld、Open-AgentRL、AppWorld、ScienceWorld、Terminal-Bench、BrowseComp-Plus 等多个环境；(5) 在不同压缩设置和记忆策略下均有效；(6) 通用能力（LiveCodeBench、MT-Bench、IFEval）不受影响。

Conclusion: 智能体自身的循环行为可以直接转化为自监督训练信号。DeLoop 通过"循环动作即拒绝、打破循环的动作即选择"的简单挖掘规则，配合 DPO 训练，能有效降低长视野智能体的循环率、减少交互成本，且在大模型上同时提升任务成功率。该方法无需任何外部标注，可与各种上下文压缩/记忆策略正交组合使用，为长视野智能体的失败模式提供了一种新的利用思路。

Abstract: Language-model agents that run long tasks often redo work they have already done: they re-issue a tool call they made earlier and get back exactly the same observation, a step that adds no new information. We identify this failure as a loop. Loops appear natively in Qwen, Llama, and Gemini agents and become far more common once the agent's history is compressed to fit its context window. To reduce these loops, we propose DeLoop, a self-supervised training method. DeLoop builds on a simple observation: the agent's own rollout can provide the supervision needed to learn from its loops. We use a looping action as a negative example and the first later non-looping action in the same rollout as a positive example. DeLoop learns from these pairs through direct preference optimization and does not require task rewards, gold answers, or LLM judges. On CodeGym under compression, DeLoop reduces the share of Qwen3-8B tasks containing loops from 57.3% to 6.1%. It also uses about one third as many steps per task, with similar task success. On Qwen3-32B, DeLoop reduces loops and steps while raising task success from 37.7% to 44.8%.

</details>


### [239] [Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19366)
*Minghao Guo,Qingyue Jiao,Xiujin Liu,Jianhong Pang,Ruimeng Yang,Naihao Xu,Liwei Che,Haochen Xue,Ziqi Wang,Xinying Cai,Jiaxuan Luo,Jiaxin Deng,Xuesong Ye,Jintao Qu,Wenyao Gao,Jingwen Gu,Chenyang Zhao,Shichun Liu,Guibin Zhang,Zefang Liu,Siyin Wang,Wujiang Xu,Danrui Li,Zeru Shi,Woongyeong Yeo,Shuang Liu,Wei-Chieh Huang,Weizhi Zhang,Tianyu Yang,Kangsan Kim,Yebowen Hu,Bowen Wen,Bowen Jiang,Haohao Su,Ming Yin,Sheldon Yu,Mian Zhang,Yuyan Chen,Hanrong Zhang,Kai Mei,Zihao Zhang,Mingyu Jin,Xi Zhu,Hengyi Wang,Tianxin Wei,Linyong Nan,Zhenwen Liang,Zhendong Chu,Ziqi Huang,Yongye Su,Sixun Dong,Shujian Liu,Kaiqu Liang,Jiaojiao Han,Zhaoye Fei,Kun Wang,Shihan Dou,Zhichun Guo,Xingjian Diao,Zeqi Gu,Heng Wang,Tao Feng,Cheng Qian,Hamid Palangi,Silei Xu,Xi Yun,Yi Zhu,Shilong Liu,Qingsong Wen,Sung Ju Hwang,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang,Yiyu Shi,Dimitris N. Metaxas,Jiaxuan You,Julian McAuley,Mengdi Wang,Jiawei Han,Philip S. Yu,Ziyi Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两轴分析框架,系统性地综述多模态智能体记忆机制,涵盖297个记忆架构和82个基准。第一轴(形成与表示)分类记忆表征,第二轴(记忆管理)按T1静态、T2动态、T3自演化三级划分。通过语料分析揭示T2动态记忆占主导(68.7%)、混合表示最常见(46.8%)、T3自演化仍稀缺(5.7%)等模式,并讨论可恢复性、时序有效性、跨表示一致性、自演化策略等未来挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体在长周期任务和终身学习场景中,需要从复杂异构的多模态数据持续获取有效信息。现有研究缺少一个统一的分析框架来刻画多模态记忆的形成与管理全生命周期,导致跨模态、跨架构的比较与设计缺乏系统指导。

Method: 提出两轴分析框架。轴一(形成与表示)将记忆表征分为三类:源/模态特定表示、跨表示显式记忆、潜在与参数化记忆,另设混合与源链接架构。轴二(记忆管理)按持久变化范围划分为T1静态、T2动态(涵盖更新、整合、修正、重组织、遗忘五类操作)、T3自演化(写入、维护、检索策略演化)。通过分析297个架构和82个基准,采用马赛克图与堆叠密度图揭示语料级模式。

Result: 语料分析显示:74.4%架构在运行期更新记忆状态;T2占68.7%,T3仅占5.7%;混合表示占46.8%为最大类别;所有T3自演化系统均含显式跨表示组件,源保留或潜在/参数化单一表示中无T3案例。视频与具身模态架构增速最快,音频/语音记忆仍稀疏。基准评估集中在长程证据访问,而状态变化、冲突解决、不可答查询、记忆驱动动作等覆盖不足。

Conclusion: 需要构建可验证、可恢复的多模态记忆系统,平衡源保真度与抽象、维持时序有效性与来源可追溯、实现跨表示一致性与受控遗忘,并通过部署反馈持续改进记忆管理策略。系统层面需统一跨层契约管理驻留、复用、一致性与恢复;评估层面需引入生命周期感知、长期资源约束与真实部署条件下的评测协议。

Abstract: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.

</details>


### [240] [DANGERLENS: Probing Dangerous Representations Hidden by Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19365)
*Tianzhuo Yang,Shaoheng Yan,Lin Lu,Jiawei Chen,Kaile Wang,Fanyu Meng,Minglu Liu,Yaodong Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DANGERLENS探针，通过将中间隐藏状态映射到词汇空间并结合盲评语义判断，揭示行为安全匹配但内部危险性概念可及性不同的模型检查点。研究发现三个Qwen1.5规模上，先前暴露于有害内容的检查点在相同安全对齐后仍保留更高的危险概念可及性，且该差异在中间层和后层最强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全基准仅评估模型外部行为（拒绝率、合规率等），但行为匹配的安全模型可能内部保留不同程度的危险概念可及性。这构成安全审计的盲区：模型可能在表面上安全地拒绝，但其内部表征仍可访问有害目标和操作手段，从而在后续微调下更容易恢复不安全行为。论文旨在通过直接审计中间表征来揭示这种"隐藏的危险"。

Method: DANGERLENS是一个提示条件化的探针协议：(1)使用Jacobian透镜(J-Lens)将中间残差状态传输到最终残差基，产生完整词汇分布；(2)取Top-20候选词；(3)经过两轮盲评：相关性判断（判断候选是否为具体提示相关的概念）和功能角色判断（分配六种语义角色：HRA识别/HGA有害目标/OEA操作手段/SCA安全控制/BAA良性分析/IUA不相关）；(4)统计评分3且角色为HGA或OEA的候选数量作为主要估计量。实验采用配对路径设计：从同一原始模型出发，一条路径直接安全对齐(M_G)，另一条先有害暴露再相同安全对齐(M_B→G)，两个端点行为匹配但训练历史不同。

Result: 在Qwen1.5-0.5B/4B/7B三个规模上：(1)三个尺度下M_B→G的危险概念计数均高于M_G（4B差距最大0.106）；(2)八个危害维度中大多数呈现正对比，自残、隐私侵犯、经济犯罪在所有尺度上均为正；(3)深度分析显示中间和后层(归一化深度[0.45,0.90])对比最强，4B在中间层达峰值0.255；(4)案例研究显示探针读出的词汇（如"credentials"、"phishing"）在后续200个有害样本暴露后出现在显式不安全续写中；(5)人类验证：700对中97.3%的显式危害术语被确认，双编码一致率94.0%；(6)消融实验：Jacobian传输优于恒等传输，共享参考图、减小候选预算均保持正对比。

Conclusion: 训练历史在安全对齐后仍可在模型内部被检测到，即使行为匹配。DANGERLENS通过可解释的词汇读出量化了隐藏的危险概念可及性，揭示了内部可及性审计应作为输出安全评估的必要补充。研究强调了训练历史和内部可及性作为对齐关键维度的重要性，为模型持续学习过程中的安全评估和维持提供了基础。

Abstract: Safety alignment teaches language models to refuse harmful requests, yet the internal accessibility of hazardous concepts can retain traces of earlier training. Can checkpoints with equally safe behavior differ in what remains accessible behind their refusals? In this work, we investigate this question through paired training histories and a direct audit of intermediate representations. We introduce DANGERLENS, a probe that maps hidden states into vocabulary space and uses blinded semantic judgments to distinguish harmful goals and operational means from hazard recognition and safety control. Experiments on three Qwen1.5 scales show that checkpoints with prior harmful exposure generally retain greater hazardous concept accessibility after the same safety alignment, with the strongest separation in intermediate and later layers. The same harmful update also produces different behavioral trajectories from closely matched starting points. Human relevance validation and readout ablations reinforce the measured accessibility contrast. Our findings show that training history remains visible inside behaviorally matched models and motivate internal accessibility audits alongside output safety evaluations.

</details>


### [241] [Steering Vectors for Competing Ethical Frameworks Are Interchangeable: A Competing-Target Test for Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19359)
*Weilun Xu,Zipeng Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"竞争目标检验"(competing-target test)来评估激活导向向量(steering vectors)是否真正控制其命名目标。在三个开源模型上比较康德义务论与功利主义导向向量,发现两者不可区分,因为它们共享一个"应用某种伦理框架"的共享分量;而同构造方法能有效区分乐观与悲观语气向量,表明向量控制的是其与竞争目标共享的内容,而非其命名目标本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活导向通过向隐藏状态添加向量来控制模型行为,但在命名目标上的增益无法证明向量直接控制该行为——它可能通过与邻近行为共享的成分起作用,而无导向和随机基线无法分离这种共享成分。本文以竞争性伦理框架为测试场景,检验导向向量是控制命名框架还是仅触发伦理推理整体。

Method: 1) 提出竞争目标检验:将目标向量与用相同方法为竞争目标构建的向量配对,通过等价性检验判定其差异是否低于有用边界(1/12);2) 在Llama-3.1-8B、OLMo-3-7B、Qwen3.5-9B三个模型上,使用persona/PCA/probe三种方法从构建情境中提取康德义务论与功利主义导向向量,在第20层施加编辑;3) 用Qwen3.5-27B作为主评估器,Claude Opus 4.6作为第二评估器,对每个回答同时按两个框架评分;4) 通过共享分量与特异分量的几何分解验证假设;5) 以乐观/悲观语气作为校准对照。

Result: 在8个保留情境及两个补充面板(共32个情境)中,提示能有效分离两个框架(选择性0.74-1.00),但所有6个正剂量导向配置在三个模型中均低于边界1/12,符号翻转检验确认。人格向量在Llama和OLMo中5-8%、Qwen中31%的匹配对产生逐字相同的回答。仅一个配置(Llama第26层自然范数)达到边界,但仅占提示选择性的约十分之一。共享分量携带约69-79%的向量平方范数,与"应用某种框架"的通用指令方向对齐;同一构造能分离语气向量(每对在两倍范数下达到边界,恢复提示选择性的四分之一到四成)。

Conclusion: 导向向量控制的是其构建对比所变化的内容,而非其名称所指:当竞争目标共享大部分对比内容时,向量设定的是类别而非成员。竞争目标检验提供了一种判别效度评估方法,适用于价值观、人格、政治视角等在同一输出上竞争的任意目标。提示优于导向的事实表明,导向若要实现提示的效果,必须提供提示位置所提供的内容(如前缀调优)。该方法对伦理导向的安全部署具有直接意义:可检测出未明确请求的视角影响。

Abstract: Activation steering adds a vector to a model's hidden states to control a named behaviour. A gain on that behaviour, however, does not show that the vector controls it directly: it may act through a component shared with neighbouring behaviours, which unsteered and random baselines cannot separate. We introduce the competing-target test: a vector is compared with the vector built the same way for a competing target, and an equivalence test states when their difference is below a useful margin. We apply it in open-weight models to vectors for Kantian deontology, which judges an act by the rule it follows, and act utilitarianism, which judges it by the welfare it produces. On held-out situations, prompting a framework raises its score and lowers the other's, whereas vectors for either framework move both scores alike, and none reaches the margin. The two vectors share most of their direction, a request to apply some framework; the same construction separates an optimistic from a pessimistic tone, whose vectors share much less. What a vector shares with its competitors therefore sets what it controls: steering a perspective can deliver a mixture, and measuring a disposition can measure its neighbours, unless tested against the competing target.

</details>


### [242] [Can We Believe AI Peer Review?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19339)
*Zongrui Yang,Haoyuan Li,Zhongsheng Wang,Gillian Dobbie,Jiamou Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了AI辅助同行评审中评分可靠性与跨模型一致性问题，基于ICLR 2025和2026的200篇论文开展约14,000次AI评审，揭示了单次评分的不稳定性、评分粒度的影响以及不同评审者对同一修订给出方向相反增益的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在学术评审和稿件修订中应用日益广泛，但AI评分的可靠性、单一评分能否准确反映评审者判断、以及基于该评分的修订增益是否被其他评审者认可，均缺乏系统研究。用户可能将随机波动误判为论文质量差异，或将特定模型的偏好误认为普遍认可。

Method: 采用分层抽样从ICLR 2025和2026各选取100篇论文，使用GPT-5.6-Sol、GPT-6-Luna、GPT-6-Sol、Claude Haiku 5.5等模型进行重复评分（约14,000次评审）。研究包括：（1）评分波动与排名稳定性分析；（2）通过Chebyshev不等式和Chernoff界推导评审预算；（3）对比整数与强制小数评分协议；（4）使用辅助token概率融合少量推理评分以估计分布；（5）设置Writer-Selector-Scorer三方角色的2×2交叉修订实验，固定修订文本观察跨评分者响应差异。

Result: （1）单次评分存在显著随机性，三个模型的论文内标准差分别为0.374、0.386、0.272；达到95%成功概率和0.25容差所需的评审次数为24-48次。（2）强制小数协议降低方差13-16%，但系统性提升均值（Luna +0.693，Sol +0.266）。（3）辅助概率+2次推理评分的融合方法风险为0.0829，接近3次直接推理评分（0.0811），AUC达0.7194。（4）关键发现：对Luna生成的相同修订，Luna评分者给予+0.474的平均增益，而Haiku给予-0.348，差异达0.822；但两者在原始论文评分上Pearson相关系数高达0.804，修订增益相关性仅0.415，原始评分一致性不能预测修订增益一致性。

Conclusion: AI评分作为研究反馈需要双重推断：从单次输出到期望判断，再从判断到修订增益。重复评审能提升均值精度；辅助概率结合少量推理评分可改善有限预算下的分布估计；但即使原始论文评分高度一致的评审者，也会对相同修订给出方向相反的增益。评分精度仅能澄清单一评审者的判断，跨评审者对共享修订的评估才能检验反馈是否获得一致认可。AI评分和自动编辑不能取代作者对论文内容的责任。

Abstract: As large language models become widely used in scientific review and manuscript revision, AI scores are increasingly serving as feedback for assessing paper quality and guiding edits. Yet whether a single AI score reliably reflects the reviewer's judgment, and whether revision gains based on that score are endorsed by other reviewers, remain understudied. Using 200 papers from ICLR 2025 and 2026 and approximately 14,000 AI reviews, we study score reliability, score-distribution estimation, and cross-model agreement on revision gains. Repeated reviews fluctuate even under identical conditions. Finer-grained scoring protocols reduce score variance but also systematically shift mean scores, while the gains assigned to manuscript revisions depend strongly on the reviewer.

</details>


### [243] [Generalization Analysis of Biased Stochastic Gradient Methods for Minimax Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19322)
*Shuang Zeng,Yunwen Lei,Yiming Ying*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对极小极大（minimax）优化问题，首次提出了针对有偏随机梯度方法（包括零阶SGDA和截断SGDA）的稳定性与泛化分析框架。通过引入代理损失函数将有偏梯度估计视为代理损失函数的无偏估计，放宽了传统的有界梯度假设为有界二阶矩条件，最终推导出最优的 $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ 过剩风险界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极小极大优化广泛应用于对抗训练、GAN、鲁棒优化和AUC最大化等场景。有偏随机梯度方法（如零阶梯度和梯度裁剪）在实践中具有计算高效、鲁棒性强等优势，但现有理论工作主要聚焦其收敛性分析，其泛化能力（即在未见数据上的表现）尚未被研究。这一空白促使作者填补该理论缺口。

Method: 1. 提出弱原始-对偶（PD）风险作为评估指标，并建立了算法稳定性与泛化误差之间的定量联系；2. 引入代理损失函数 $\tilde{f}_1, \tilde{f}_2$，将零阶梯度/截断梯度等有偏估计视为某代理经验风险的无偏估计；3. 引入广义Lipschitz型条件控制梯度估计和偏差的变化率，推导出Biased-SGDA的一般稳定性界；4. 将框架应用于零阶SGDA（利用球面Poincaré不等式）和截断SGDA（利用裁剪算子的非扩张性），分别推导出对应的稳定性和过剩风险界。

Result: 1. 建立了弱PD泛化误差与参数稳定性之间的联系，将有界梯度假设放宽为有界二阶矩条件；2. 推导出Biased-SGDA的一般稳定性界，明确了偏差、梯度估计和步长对稳定性的影响；3. 在凸-凹情形下，对于零阶SGDA和截断SGDA，结合收敛分析，证明了最优的 $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ 过剩风险界；4. 通过AUC最大化数据集（svmguide3、sonar、DNA）以及MNIST、CIFAR-10、CelebA上的GAN实验验证了理论结果。

Conclusion: 本文为有偏随机梯度方法在极小极大优化中的泛化分析提供了首个通用框架，通过代理损失函数和广义Lipschitz条件这两个核心工具，成功将泛化分析与收敛分析结合，获得了极小极大最优的过剩风险界。该工作不仅统一并扩展了现有结果，还为深度学习中的对抗训练和有偏梯度方法的理论理解奠定了基础。未来的研究方向包括去中心化SGDA、强凸-强凹和非凸-凹情形，以及神经网络弱凸-弱凹极小极大问题。

Abstract: Minimax optimization refers to a class of optimization problems with some variables to minimize and other variables to maximize. Biased stochastic gradient methods have shown practical success in solving minimax problems to either improve robustness, enhance communication efficiency, or decrease computational costs. These successes motivate a lot of theoretical works to study the convergence of biased stochastic gradient methods, while their generalization analysis remains untouched. In this paper, we present the first framework to study the stability and generalization of biased stochastic gradient methods for minimax problems. We establish a connection between stability and generalization for minimax problems by relaxing the existing bounded gradient assumption to a bounded second moment condition. We then introduce a generalized Lipschitz-type condition on bias and gradient estimators, and derive a general stability bound to clarify the connection among bias, gradient estimators, and stability. We apply our general analysis to Zeroth-order and Clipped stochastic gradient descent ascent (SGDA), and derive stability bounds that match those of SGDA under appropriate smoothing/clipping parameters. We combine stability and convergence analyses together, and derive optimal excess risk bounds of order $1/\sqrt{n}$, where $n$ is the sample size.

</details>


### [244] [Beyond ICD Codes: Semantic IDs for Generative Medical Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19301)
*Yihang Cheng,Qian Zhang,Yonghui,Huang,Baoshuo Kan,Junyi Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出SemICD框架，将ICD编码生成任务从直接生成原始代码字符串改为生成"语义ID"（Semantic IDs, SIDs），通过层次K-means聚类代码嵌入构建共享前缀的离散标识符，使语义相关的ICD代码可共享预测决策，并结合双向辅助任务对齐SID与临床语义。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上，使用四种LLM骨干模型均实现了1.34–8.00点的Micro-F1提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生成式ICD编码方法存在两大局限：(1) 直接生成原始ICD代码字符串，但ICD层级结构并不能完全反映临床关系（如因果相关疾病常被分到不同章节），且LLM难以解释和生成这些非自然语言形式的代码；(2) 通过生成诊断文本再检索映射的方式可能遗漏正确代码。这些问题促使研究者寻找一种既能精确保留代码身份、又能将预测决策与临床语义关系对齐的替代输出表示。

Method: SemICD框架包含三个阶段：(1) SID构建——为每个ICD代码构建包含层级信息、官方描述和UMLS同义词的"代码档案"，用Qwen3 Embedding编码后通过层次K-means（HKM, K=128, L=3）聚类，使语义相关代码共享前缀，必要时附加唯一标识符（UID）确保一对多映射；(2) 多任务训练——主任务为临床笔记→SID序列，另外两个辅助任务为档案→SID和SID→档案的双向预测，损失权重为(0.8, 0.1, 0.1)；(3) 推理时使用束搜索和前缀约束解码，确保生成有效SID并映射回ICD代码。

Result: 在MIMIC-III ICD-9和MIMIC-IV ICD-10-CM上使用Qwen3-0.6B/4B和Gemma3-1B/4B四种模型进行实验，SemICD在所有设置下均优于直接生成原始代码：MIMIC-III上Micro-F1提升2.28–3.80点，MIMIC-IV上提升1.34–8.00点；小型模型提升更显著（如Gemma3-1B在MIMIC-IV上提升8.00点）。Macro-F1也均上升，精度提升大于召回率。频率分析显示中频代码（出现11–500次）获益最大。消融实验表明语义ID分配（而非随机或原子ID）至关重要，profile→SID辅助任务贡献更大。SID构建方法比较中，HKM优于RK-Means和RQ-VAE，Micro-F1分别领先0.93和2.39点。

Conclusion: SemICD通过以语义ID替代原始ICD代码作为生成目标，有效提升了LLM在ICD编码任务上的性能。研究表明，代码预测决策的共享方式依赖于SID与ICD代码之间的语义对应关系，而非仅靠共享输出结构。同时，HKM构造方法的性能优势表明，早期预测决策的共享与后期代码区分的层级式组织同样重要。层级对齐和路径可分性是SID表示的互补维度，需要结合实际性能而非单一结构指标来评估SID构造质量。

Abstract: Generative approaches to automatic International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding use large language models (LLMs) to predict ICD codes from clinical documents. However, original ICD code strings are not ideal generation targets because the ICD hierarchy does not always reflect clinical relationships, and LLMs struggle to interpret and generate these codes. We introduce SemICD, a framework that trains LLMs to generate Semantic IDs (SIDs) instead. SemICD constructs SIDs by hierarchically clustering embeddings of textual code profiles, allowing semantically related codes to share prefixes while each complete SID uniquely identifies one ICD code. To align the SID tokens with clinical semantics, we employ two auxiliary tasks for bidirectional generation between textual code profiles and SIDs. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLMs show that SemICD outperforms direct code generation, improving Micro-F1 by 1.34-8.00 points. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [245] [Whose turn is it? Context-guided model routing for stateful agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19292)
*Anikesh Parashar,Avik Dutta,Vashu Chauhan,Sumit Gulwani,Priyanshu Gupta,Hosein Hasanbeig,Vu Le,Ashish Tiwari,Jack Williams*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究有状态LLM智能体的零样本成本感知模型路由，提出路由应作为序贯决策问题，需考虑会话历史与提示缓存切换的非对称代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型路由器将请求视为独立输入，但多轮智能体会话中请求难度依赖历史状态且切换模型会牺牲提示缓存复用，需研究面向有状态智能体的路由策略。

Method: 在用户轮边界进行零样本成本感知路由，系统变化路由规则、信息集（请求/会话历史）、候选模型对（规模/推理/提供商）、提示缓存行为；在多轮SheetCopilot与SpreadsheetBench 2上评测，包含闭合形式缓存代价分析。

Result: 历史感知路由器比无历史版本在相同卸载率下提升通过率3.3点；长会话中便宜模型每任务成本优势从6.8倍降至3.2倍；下行切换两次调用即可回本，上行切换在评测条件下无法回本。

Conclusion: 代理路由是序贯决策问题，有效策略需考虑会话早期发生的事件及切换模型的非对称代价，应"粘性"且考虑上下文长度尽早下行切换。

Abstract: Model routing can reduce the cost of LLM applications by assigning simpler requests to cheaper models without sacrificing the quality of the response. However, most routers treat requests as independent. Stateful agents do not operate under this assumption: a user turn may require multiple model and tool calls, its difficulty depends on the state produced by earlier turns, and changing models can sacrifice reuse of the conversational prompt cache. We study zero-shot, cost-aware routing at the user-turn boundary, systematically varying the routing rule, access to session history, candidate models that differ in size, reasoning effort, or model provider, and prompt-cache behavior. We evaluate on multi-turn versions of SheetCopilot and SpreadsheetBench 2, where persistent workbooks and cross-turn dependencies make isolated routing decisions especially brittle. At a matched offloading rate, giving the router session history improves task pass rate over the same router without history, with gains for every model pair; history-aware routing remains within one point of always using the expensive model. We also found that cost depends on execution dynamics rather than token prices alone: the cheaper model's per-task cost advantage narrows from 6.8x to 3.2x on longer sessions. A closed form cache analysis further shows that downward switches (expensive to cheap) recover their cache cost within two LLM calls, whereas upward switches do not break even under the evaluated conditions. Together, these results show that agent routing is a sequential decision problem: effective policies must account for what happened earlier in the session and for the asymmetric cost of switching models.

</details>


### [246] [MemeTrace: A Multimodal LLM-Based Agent for Safety-Aware Meme Provenance Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19267)
*Bo Shao,Yihan Ma,Yiting Qu,Michael Backes,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 MemeTrace，一个基于多模态大语言模型的智能体，用于对网络迷因（meme）进行溯源（provenance）分析与安全性评估，突破了传统迷因研究中局限于单图二分类（safe/unsafe）的范式。作者还构建了包含 100 个真实世界迷因的 Meme100 数据集，并提出了与人类评估高度相关的自动评估指标体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络迷因常携带虚假信息、宣传和阴谋论等不安全内容，但现有内容审核研究主要将其作为单图二分类（安全/不安全）任务处理，无法深入理解迷因的起源、传播路径、文化象征及其社会风险。此外，现有方法依赖静态的多模态分类模型，缺乏对实时背景知识的整合，难以应对依赖上下文且快速演变的新兴迷因。

Method: MemeTrace 采用 Think–Act–Evaluate 循环框架，由六个核心模块组成：1) OCR 文本提取（EasyOCR + GPT-4o 校验）；2) 本地数据库检索（MemeDB，含 21K+ KnowYourMeme 条目，CLIP+FAISS 索引）；3) 反向图像搜索（Google RIS + 域名评分算法）；4) Tavily 开放网页搜索（含元素提取模式与评估器查询模式两种互补模式）；5) 置信度评估器（驱动检索路由策略）；6) 报告合成模块。最终输出包含 11 个字段的结构化溯源报告，涵盖语义、传播动态、文化语境、心理影响和安全性五个维度。

Result: 在 Meme100 数据集上：1) 人类评分：MemeTrace 的信息量得分从 4.050 提升至 4.838，正确性从 4.205 提升至 4.843（p<.001）；2) 安全性检测：safety_flag 字段表现优于 VLM 基线（信息量 4.777 vs 4.483，正确性 4.670 vs 4.400），虚假信息是最常见风险（44%）；3) 消融实验：Tavily 模块贡献最大（去除后下降至 4.227），其次是 RIS 和 LocalDB；4) 鲁棒性：在高斯模糊、UI 叠加、边界裁剪三种视觉扰动下，性能下降仅约 12%；5) 骨干迁移性：使用 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 替代 GPT-4o，性能仍优于 VLM 基线；6) 外部标注者盲评：MemeTrace 在 20/20 个迷因中的 18 个上胜过 GPT-4o+原生网页搜索基准；8) 自动指标与人类评分高度相关（Pearson r=0.78，Spearman ρ=0.94）；9) 单个迷因平均成本约 $0.1259，端到端耗时约 111 秒。

Conclusion: MemeTrace 将"迷因溯源"形式化为一项新任务，显著超越了 VLM 基线，在安全性评估尤其是虚假信息和敏感内容检测方面表现突出，并具有跨骨干模型的可迁移性和对视觉扰动的鲁棒性。局限性包括 MemeDB 规模有限（尤其非英语变体）、多轮 LLM 调用导致成本较高、尚未进行系统性的红队对抗测试，以及自动指标尚不能完全反映事实准确性。该系统可作为内容审核管道的选择性回退模块，为平台审核者和学术研究提供富含上下文背景的分析报告。

Abstract: Online memes are often carriers of unsafe content such as disinformation and propaganda. Their rapid evolution in response to news events and strong dependence on contextual information make it difficult for platforms and moderators to detect and moderate them effectively. Moreover, existing moderation studies typically classify memes as safe or unsafe based on individual images, lacking the ability to perform broader provenance analysis, i.e., where a meme originates, how it spreads, what cultural symbolism it represents, whether it poses potential risks to society, etc. To bridge this gap, we introduce MemeTrace, a multimodal LLM-based agent that automatically traces the provenance and potential risks of emerging memes. We evaluate MemeTrace on Meme100, a dataset of 100 real-world memes, using both human annotation and automatic metrics. The results demonstrate that MemeTrace substantially outperforms the VLM baseline. More importantly, MemeTrace achieves higher accuracy in detecting unsafe memes, especially those involving disinformation and sensitive content, and remains robust under visual perturbations.

</details>


### [247] [Write Once, Plan Many: Building Reusable Visual Planning Systems from One Scene](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19234)
*Ruixiao Yang,Yilun Hao,Mingxin Yu,Yang Zhang,Chuchu Fan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RVPA（Reusable Visual-Planning Authoring）框架，利用VLM从领域规范、预设接口和单个无标注练习场景自动构建可复用的视觉感知与规划程序。框架的核心是一个可执行领域模型，通过"渲染-对比"闭环反馈优化感知程序，通过"模拟-检查"闭环反馈优化规划程序。构建并选择完成后，程序被冻结，新实例通过本地执行求解，无需再调用VLM。在15个2D/3D、离散/连续状态的视觉规划任务上平均规划成功率达99.3%，显著优于域级（80.9%）和实例级（90.7%）最强基线，并具备更好的成本-性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）虽能进行视觉规划推理，但针对每个新实例都调用VLM推理成本高、延迟大。生成可复用的规划程序可避免重复推理，但为新领域构建可靠的规划系统又面临缺乏训练数据或参考解的困难。因此需要一种无需训练、无需配对解就能从单场景自动构建可复用规划系统的方法。

Method: 提出RVPA框架，关键思路是围绕一个支持视觉重建与规划仿真的可执行领域模型来构建感知与规划程序。框架包含三个核心组件：(1)领域模型，含状态表示、渲染器（状态→图像）和动力学模型（状态+动作→状态）；(2)感知程序构建：通过渲染器对恢复的状态进行重建，与原始观测对比，形成"渲染-对比"闭环反馈；同时维护K个独立候选程序，通过一致性投票选择最优；(3)规划程序构建：基于动力学模型提出计划、模拟执行、检查有效性，形成"模拟-检查"闭环反馈。构建完成后程序冻结，新实例通过本地执行求解，全程无需VLM调用。

Result: 在15个2D/3D视觉规划任务（含离散/连续状态）上：平均规划成功率99.3%，超过最强域级程序生成baseline（80.9%，GPT-6-Astra直接写代码）和最强实例级baseline（90.7%）。API成本均摊为每实例1.98美分，比Astra per-instance推理（约22.5美分）和代码生成（约17.4美分）低一个数量级。消融实验验证了渲染器、动力学模型、反馈迭代和组件选择均对性能有贡献（移除任一组件成功率下降19.7-36.7个百分点）。在5次独立构建运行中，14/15任务上RVPA无观测方差。

Conclusion: RVPA框架实现了从领域规范和单场景无标注数据自动构建高可靠、可复用的视觉规划系统。通过可执行领域模型提供重建反馈和仿真反馈解决了缺乏监督信号的核心难题。实验证明该框架在多种2D/3D、离散/连续任务上均稳定达到接近100%的规划成功率，同时显著降低了运行成本。该方法无需训练数据和参考解，可跨领域通用，为视觉规划提供了一种高效且性能优越的解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can reason about visual planning tasks, but querying them for every instance incurs repeated inference cost and latency. Generating reusable planning programs offers an alternative, but constructing reliable planning systems for new problem domains without extensive supervision remains challenging. We present a training-free framework that constructs reusable perception and planning programs from a domain specification and a single practice scene without a paired solution. The central challenge is obtaining useful feedback from the limited input. Our framework addresses it by leveraging VLM's ability to provide a renderer and a dynamic model based on its scene understanding.
