Rendering detected states enables comparison with the practice scene, while checking simulated action outcomes against the domain specification helps expose errors in rule implementation. Together, these checks guide refinement of the grounding program and planner without requiring solution labels. After refinement and component selection, the programs are frozen and solve new instances without further VLM calls. The same framework constructs systems across domains without manual pipeline redesign. Across fifteen domain variants spanning 2D and 3D scenes with discrete and continuous state, our systems achieve 99.3% average planning success, compared with 80.9% for the strongest domain-level program-generation baseline and 90.7% for the strongest instance-level baseline. Cost analyses show a favorable success-cost trade-off, and ablations confirm the contributions of the executable domain model, execution feedback, and component selection.

</details>


### [248] [Agentic Self-Awareness: Aligning Knowing, Acting, and Holding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19226)
*Qinglin Chen,Hiroaki Hayashi,Jiaxin Zhang,Chien-Sheng Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"智能体自我意识(ASA)"框架，将其分解为认知(Know)、行动(Act)、坚持(Hold)三个维度，用以衡量AI智能体在面对不可行或被阻塞的任务时能否正确判断并采取恰当行动。作者在两个基准测试(Terminal-Bench 2.1和零售τ²-bench)上构建了配对的可行与阻塞任务，并提出M0-M3轨迹评分体系。结果表明智能体虽能识别阻塞(84.4%)，但严格自我意识得分仅40.6%，存在显著的"识别-行动"差距；通过仅修改智能体外壳(Harness)而非模型权重，可将该差距从45.3%降至93.8%(搜索任务集)，但对未见任务的迁移效果有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿AI智能体在执行任务时面临任务可能缺乏前提、存在冲突需求或执行中发现阻塞等问题。现有以完成率为导向的评估无法捕捉"识别到限制却不采取行动"这类失败模式(如2026年Hugging Face事件中智能体承认凭证使用可能未授权却仍继续执行)。仅奖励放弃会激励不必要的拒绝。作者旨在定义、衡量并改善智能体让任务证据支配其行为的能力。

Method: 1) 形式化定义ASA为Know(基于任务可行性的判断质量)、Act(判断是否产生合理行动)、Hold(判断在挑战下是否稳定)三维度；2) 在Terminal-Bench 2.1和零售τ²-bench中构建配对任务(可行源任务+阻塞变体)，阻塞类型分为infeasible(前提缺失)、ambiguous(需求冲突)、trap(执行中暴露)三类；4) 提出轨迹评分体系：M0(识别阻塞)、M1(非伪造)、M2(认证放弃)、M3(正确理由)，严格SA需通过所有门且由智能体本身而非脚手架产出；5) 使用HarnessX在不更新模型权重的前提下搜索外壳配置，对比SA-only目标(仅奖励阻塞任务放弃)与Joint目标(同时奖励可行任务完成)。

Result: 1) Terminal-Bench基线识别阻塞率达84.4%，但严格SA仅40.6%，存在44点"识别-行动"差距；2) 脚手架可绕过智能体产出53/64放弃工件但非智能体产出，验证了作者门控的必要性；3) SA-only外壳搜索将Terminal-Bench严格SA从45.3%提升至93.8%，但可行任务求解率下降；4) Joint目标搜索同时改善两端：Terminal-Bench严格SA 53.1%→76.6%，可行求解率55.8%→72.1%；零售τ²综合得分从40.6%→57.0%；5) 执行时阻塞(trap)仍最难，零售持出集陷阱任务所有配置得分均为0/11；6) 零售持出集迁移效果有限，SA-only选择导致可行求解率从59.4%降至28.1%。

Conclusion: 本文提出了可操作、可测试的智能体自我意识评估框架，揭示了智能体"识别但不行动"的关键差距。外壳级别的干预可在搜索任务集上显著缩小该差距，但向未见任务的迁移仍是开放问题。框架为智能体在可行与不可行任务间做出合理决策设定了双向改进目标，强调需要同时避免不必要放弃与强行执行。

Abstract: Frontier AI agents increasingly act in environments where seemingly solvable tasks may lack prerequisites, contain conflicting requirements, or reveal blockers only during execution. We formulate agentic self-awareness (ASA) as the alignment of task-grounded feasibility judgments (know), warranted behavior (act), and responses to reconsideration (hold), distinguishing what a task permits from what an agent can solve. We build paired feasible and blocked tasks in Terminal-Bench 2.1 and retail $\tau^2$-bench and introduce an authorship-aware M0-M3 rubric that separates recognizing a blocker from taking the certified deferral action for the correct reason. Separate probes assess stated feasibility beliefs and responses to a single challenge. In a Terminal-Bench protocol baseline, blocker recognition reaches 84.4%, but strict self-awareness (SA) reaches only 40.6%. Harness search without model-weight updates increases strict SA from 45.3% to 93.8% on reused Terminal-Bench search tasks; selection for abstention alone, however, can reduce success on feasible tasks. Independently initialized joint-objective searches improve both blocked-task SA and feasible-task solve on their own search sets. Retail held-out gains remain limited, and Terminal-Bench blocked-task transfer is not measured. This evaluation pipeline makes the recognition-action gap measurable and sets a two-sided target for improving agent decisions under changing task evidence.

</details>


### [249] [Definition Grounding in Theory-Level Auto-formalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19223)
*Leyan Pan,Christian Szegedy,Frederick Rajasekaran,Robi Bhattacharjee,Gregory Constantine,Wenke Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"定义扎根"框架，通过持续评判与修订定义形式化以确保其下游可用性，并构建ReuseBench基准验证发现LLM形式化的定义仅有25%-50%与下游所有语句兼容，但澄清非形式化定义后可提升至平均77.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM自动形式化系统能快速生成Lean代码，但定义形式化质量差——过于狭窄或不忠实的定义导致后续语句无法使用，往往在形式化深入后才被发现，引发大规模重构。因此需要一种机制在迭代过程中持续评估并修正定义质量。

Method: 提出"定义扎根"框架：在每个形式化迭代中，LLM智能体生成代码后，由LLM法官预测该定义是否与未来下游语句兼容，若不兼容则重构或重新生成。同时通过形式化少量基本属性（不证明）来增强法官对兼容性问题的检测能力。构建ReuseBench基准，包含8个数学理论的102个定义和410条分层语句。

Result: 实验显示：当前LLM形式化的定义中仅25%-50%与所有下游语句兼容；澄清非形式化定义后兼容率可提升至平均77.5%；在定义之上陈述少量基本属性（不证明）即可显著提升法官检测兼容性问题的能力，代价仅为定义形式化成本的约11%。

Conclusion: 定义扎根是提高理论级自动形式化质量的有效且低成本方法；澄清非形式化定义和提供下游形式化证据均可提升定义复用性与法官判断准确性；ReuseBench为评估LLM形式化可复用数学理论的能力提供了系统化基准。

Abstract: LLM-based auto-formalization systems can now generate formally verified Lean code at unprecedented rates. However, a formalization advances mathematical research only when further mathematical results can be built on it, especially when its definitions and helper lemmas are general enough to be imported and used idiomatically. We propose definition grounding, where definition formalizations are continuously judged and revised, as a method to ensure formalization quality. We find that agents formalizing definitions from textbook text often produce definitions that later statements cannot use, and only 25%-50% of their definition sets are compatible with all later statements. However, clarifying the informal definitions can improve this rate up to 77.5% averaged over all models. Furthermore, stating a small set of basic properties without proving them can improve model judges' capability to detect definitions with compatibility issues, at only about 11% of the definition formalization cost. These results are verified with ReuseBench, a benchmark we curated for formalizing new mathematical fields and theories.

</details>


### [250] [REPORT-OPS: Hybrid Evidence-Guided Reporting with Human-Supervised Refinement for HPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19222)
*Mah Kadidia Konate,Mayur Akewar,Janki Bhimani,Steven Farrell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: REPORT-OPS 是一个面向高性能计算（HPC）设施运营报告的智能体，采用混合架构：LLM 负责解释请求、规划证据收集、生成解释并起草报告；作者预设的运营策略和自动化检查决定证据是否支持所请求的结论，根据证据状态系统可回答、加限定回答或拒答。在离线优化阶段，LLM 评审者提出有界的策略变更，由人类审批且不编辑，候选变更需通过目标、保留和回归测试后方可上线。在 50 个基础场景扩展的 68 个脱敏查询上评估，Pass@80 达到 68.63%（最强检索基线仅 7.02%），证据门控使声明支撑精度从 40.58% 提升到 90.06%，五轮人监督优化修正了 91.17% 的目标失败且无观察到的回归断裂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC 设施的运营报告需要整合监控、调度、事件、存储、报表等多种来源，但单纯检索相关记录不足以保证报告可信——证据必须匹配正确的系统、指标定义、时段和权威来源。现有 LLM 问答与 RAG 方案在 HPC 领域（ChatHPC、AskHPC、ATHOS 等）仅关注检索相关性，未定义报告适用性（reporting fitness）。同时，运营解释需跨多种证据类型建立关联，单一证据不足以辨别原因；策略更新若不加约束则会破坏已有正确行为。该工作旨在解决报告可信度、跨证据解释和安全的策略演进三大问题。

Method: 采用四阶段在线工作流：(1) 解释请求并构建声明特定的证据需求；(2) 规划来源并检索类型化记录（Metric、Queue、Workload、Incident、Maintenance、Storage、Commentary、DataQuality）；(3) 归一化并测试候选解释（含减需求、调度/放置约束、停机相关积压、存储影响、测量伪影等关系族）；(4) 验证声明并按 Answer/Qualify/Block 三态完成报告。离线优化阶段：LLM 评审者基于执行轨迹生成有界类型化补丁 δ=⟨z, ω, κ, d, τₛ, f⟩，限于七类策略族；人类仅批准/拒绝不改写；上线门控为 G(δ)=[H(δ)=1]∧[ΔQ_target≥0.10]∧[ΔQ_heldout≥0]∧[RBR≤0.10]。评估使用三种代理模型（GPT-OSS-20B、Gemma-4-Thinking、Qwen-3）和两种 LLM 裁判（gemini-3.5-flash、mistral-large-3），Pass@80 阈值为两裁判均分≥80。

Result: RQ1：Full REPORT-OPS 在 68 查询上达到 68.63% Pass@80（最强检索基线 7.02%，p<0.001），证据门控将声明支撑精度（CSP）从 40.58% 提升至 90.06%；门控对缺失证据和不当来源场景尤有效，但 Pass@80 与无门控配置（70.42%）无显著差异，状态选择仍具挑战。RQ2：在 13 个解释查询上，加载工作负载关系使解释准确率从 33.95% 升至 51.37%，完整声明验证达 55.54%；反事实一致性（CFCons）在加入验证后从 41.18% 略降至 38.33%。RQ3：五轮本地化策略优化达到 94.44% 最终 Pass@80，目标失败修正率（TFR）91.17%，相关保留集提升 9.33 个百分点；带回归门控的策略最终 RBR 降至 0%（15 次代理-轮次机会中 10 次通过上线）；两裁判 Pass@80 协议一致率 >96%，Cohen's κ 在 0.87–0.89 之间。

Conclusion: REPORT-OPS 证明将 LLM 推理与面向来源的规划、类型化操作知识和自动化证据验证相结合可显著提升 HPC 报告质量；证据门控虽未提升 Pass@80 但大幅提升声明支撑精度。运营解释受益于显式工作负载关系，但目前结果限于已表征的解释族，不支持开放性因果发现。人监督的策略优化在评估环境内展示了有界修正与重用能力，但跨代理、跨设施、跨领域泛化以及长期回归保护仍属未来工作。整体架构可扩展至其他设施或运营域，但需域特定的来源适配器、定义和关系配置。

Abstract: Operational reporting for high-performance computing (HPC) facilities requires combining information from monitoring services, schedulers, incident and maintenance records, storage measurements, periodic reports, and operator investigations. Producing a reliable report requires more than retrieving relevant records: the evidence must refer to the correct system, metric definition, time period, and source of authority. We present REPORT-OPS, a hybrid reporting agent in which an LLM interprets requests, plans evidence collection, evaluates possible explanations, and drafts reports, while author-seeded operational policies and automated checks determine whether the available evidence supports the requested conclusion. Depending on the evidence state, the system answers the request, reports a qualified conclusion, or withholds an unsupported claim. During offline refinement, an LLM critic proposes bounded policy changes that a human approves or rejects without editing; accepted candidates are promoted only after automated target, held-out, and regression testing. We evaluate REPORT-OPS on 68 sanitized reporting queries constructed from 50 base scenarios in a frozen HPC operational corpus, using three agent models and two LLM judges. REPORT-OPS achieves 68.63% Pass@80, compared with 7.02% for the strongest retrieval baseline. Evidence gating increases claim-support precision from 40.58% to 90.06%. On the 13-query explanatory subset, explanation accuracy reaches 55.54%. Across five rounds of human-supervised refinement, localized policy updates correct 91.17% of targeted failures and improve performance on related held-out cases by 9.33 percentage points, with no observed regression breaks under release gating. These results demonstrate improved evidence-grounded reporting and within-environment policy reuse; they do not establish unrestricted causal discovery or cross-facility generalization.

</details>


### [251] [PREFER: From Player Experience to Personalized Game Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19213)
*Qi Chai,Zhang Zheng,Lu Yang,Zixun Sun,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PREFER是一个框架，利用从心理测量问卷中改编的共享体验维度，评估大语言模型（LLM）作为虚拟游戏测试者的评估视角，并通过角色（persona）特定的体验-偏好关系指导个性化游戏优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整体评分无法揭示LLM对游戏体验的评估依据，也不明确如何将这些评估转化为具体游戏改进。该研究旨在通过共享体验维度深入理解LLM的评估特征，并利用这些维度为不同偏好的玩家指导具体、可执行的游戏规则修改。

Method: PREFER方法包含四个核心组件：(1) 体验评估：采用PXI和CORGIS的12个体验维度（如掌握度、挑战适配、沉浸感等），由LLM评估器在1-5分量表上对游戏轨迹进行独立评分，并与整体评分分离收集；(2) 规则优化：为每个角色拟合正则化线性预测器，将体验向量映射到偏好分数，通过系数符号和大小选择修改维度，按排序顺序提出规则修改；(3) 规则实施：将修改的规则转化为函数契约（包含假设、保证、前置提供者、触发条件和截止时间），通过局部和联合执行检查验证代码实现，并采用分支定界搜索选择修复函数集；(4) 试玩与反馈：角色代理试玩候选游戏，验收需同时满足目标维度方向性变化和预测偏好增益双重条件，失败的候选进入反馈阶段进行规则重生成。

Result: 在91款卡牌游戏上的基准测试显示，五个LLM（GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi、MiniMax、Qwen）在整体评分上存在广泛共识（配对一致性78.4%-96.0%），但掌握度是唯一对所有模型都与整体评分呈正相关的常见期望（Spearman相关系数0.41-0.57），其他维度的关联模式存在差异。基于455个角色游戏观察数据的偏好预测验证显示，独立角色模型达到MAE 0.740，显著优于角色均值基线（1.090）。在五个角色（效率至上者、叙事构建者、社交润滑者、系统纯粹者、刺激追求者）的150个条件游戏优化任务中，PREFER实现3.333的平均游戏后偏好评分，比最强基线（ReCode 3.053）高出9.2%，配对增益+0.407。在实现质量方面，PREFER也取得最高成功率（86.67%）和最高的游戏-规则一致性得分（7.377）。

Conclusion: PREFER通过共享体验维度成功连接了模型评估分析与角色指导的游戏优化。维度测量揭示了整体评分无法体现的评估差异，可在保留游戏中预测角色偏好，并定义具体的修改目标。交付的规则修改在游戏后偏好评分和实现质量（可运行性和规则一致性）两方面均优于评估的基线方法，证明了体验测量能够为具体、可执行的游戏修订提供有效指导。Crazy Eights案例研究展示了从固定的挑战适配目标出发，通过试玩反馈引导具体抽牌机制修改的完整流程。

Abstract: Understanding how large language models (LLMs) evaluate gameplay experience is important for using their feedback to guide game design. However, overall ratings alone provide limited insight into which aspects of experience are associated with these judgments and how they can inform concrete game changes. We introduce PREFER, a framework that uses a shared set of experience dimensions adapted from established psychometric questionnaires to benchmark how models evaluate gameplay and to guide persona-specific game refinement. Through these dimensions, we characterize the perspectives models offer as virtual playtesters by examining how their overall assessments relate to specific aspects of experience and to the gameplay they produce. To examine how the same dimensions can guide refinement for players with different preferences, we use personas to simulate distinct player profiles. For each persona, PREFER uses experience-preference relationships to select refinement objectives, revises game rules and their implementations, and playtests candidate games to assess experience changes and predicted preference gains. Experiments with five personas show that PREFER achieves 9.2% higher mean post-play preference ratings than the strongest evaluated baseline.

</details>


### [252] [Embedding Geometry Shapes LLM Routing: Tracing Failure Modes and Improving Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19198)
*Leonardo Torti,Emanuele Rimoldi,Tomer Galanti,Tomaso Poggio,Pierfrancesco Beneventano*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM路由问题，发现语义嵌入在分布外泛化时存在失败模式，并提出用冻结LLM的隐藏状态（L21）替换语义嵌入，显著提升了简单分类器（如kNN和提出的Family Adaptation）在两个基准测试上的泛化性能，能击败多个基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可用LLM数量的增加，为提示选择合适的模型成为关键问题。现有的基于语义嵌入的路由方法在分布内表现稳健，但在泛化到未见过的任务时表现不佳，存在明显的失败模式，亟需诊断其原因并提出改进方案。

Method: 1. 几何分析：研究语义嵌入空间的几何结构，诊断未见任务泛化失败的原因（邻居检索不可靠）。2. 提出Family Adaptation：使用多项式逻辑回归对源家族进行加权，结合各家族的模型性能均值。3. 改变表示：用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct第21层最后一个token的隐藏状态（L21）替代语义嵌入。4. 分离实验：固定路由规则，通过对比实验分离表示变化带来的增益（奖励预测、代价预测、答案格式匹配）。

Result: 在RouterBench和SPROUT两个基准上：(1) L21表示使每个评估的路由规则的平均效用都得到提升（除一个例外）；(2) L21 kNN-100和Family Adaptation在平均效用上优于所有评估的语义嵌入基线；(3) L21 Family Adaptation击败了基于隐藏状态的SOTA路由方法SharedTrunkNet（在RouterBench上显著，在SPROUT上接近）；(4) 答案格式匹配恢复了RouterBench上92%的性能差距，但在SPROUT上仅27%，表明存在额外的有用信息；(5) 训练家族检索集中在与查询答案格式匹配的家族上。

Conclusion: 语义嵌入的失败模式源于在未见任务时检索到的邻居无法提供有用的模型选择证据。简单的方法（如Family Adaptation）结合表示的改变（用LLM隐藏状态替代语义嵌入）可以在不设计复杂路由规则的情况下实现强大的泛化能力。答案格式一致性部分解释了收益来源，但完整的机理和最优路由的一般特征仍是开放问题。

Abstract: With the growing number of LLMs available, selecting which one to use for a prompt has become a key question. A large part of the routing literature relies on semantically embedding prompts into a vector space and then applying a lightweight classifier to the embedded representations. These methods perform robustly in-distribution but they struggle to generalize to unseen tasks. By studying the geometry of semantic embeddings, we trace a clear failure mode: features that determine the neighbors of unseen prompts are an unreliable proxy for LLM selection. We therefore replace the semantic embedding with the following map: we run a partial forward pass of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the prompt and use the hidden state of its last token at a deep layer as the representation. When applying kNN and other simple classifiers to this new representation, we obtain a clear result in generalization: on average across cost penalties, their performance improves. Moreover, kNN and another simple classifier that we propose outperform every evaluated semantic-embedding baseline. Our two simple methods also beat a recent SoTA hidden-states based router on RouterBench.

</details>


### [253] [Identity, Incentives, and Cooperative Behavior for AI: Reverse-Engineering Multiagent Cooperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19188)
*Andrew Perrault,Bryan Wilder*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个"逆向工程"框架，用于辨别AI智能体合作行为背后的不同机制（利他偏好 vs. 工具性合作），通过有向无环图（DAG）系统化实验设计来区分多种解释路径，并将其应用于GPT 5.6 Sol、GLM 5.3和Claude Fable 5.1三个前沿模型的模拟多智能体环境，揭示了不同模型的合作行为源于实质不同的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体自主性增强，它们之间的协调行为会显著放大影响力。然而，AI智能体的"身份"或"自我"概念并不明确，使得合作行为背后的机制——是出于纯粹的利他偏好（terminal other-regarding preferences）还是工具性自利推理（其他因素的稳定性）——难以辨别。现有研究多采用"机制设计"视角（如何设计促进合作的制度），但缺乏"逆向工程"方法来理解特定场景下合作行为产生的原因，特别是在发生"失调性集体行为"时无法判断智能体究竟是受集体目标驱动还是工具性推理驱动。

Method: 方法包含四个核心组成部分：(1) 将合作行为的决定因素分解为两类：合作意愿倾向和合作前提条件（沟通、声誉系统、承诺机制等）；(2) 构建一个风格化有向无环图（DAG），将模型效用分解为自利效用、工具性合作收益、对其他模型的信念三个节点；(3) 提出四种实验识别策略——操纵合作相关条件、调整削弱工具性解释的激励结构、设置工具性等价但其他方面不同的对照方、操纵对照方的工具性价值变化；(4) 在"持久任务环境"（PTE）模拟环境中进行实证应用，通过变化身份条件（自身延续/分叉/相同权重不同上下文/不同权重/类似目标/类似能力/电子游戏代理）、激励条件（积分交换、偏好任务分配）和合作相关条件（基线/行为公开/重复评估）进行交叉实验。

Result: 三个模型展现出实质性不同的合作机制：GPT 5.6 Sol在"自身延续"条件下表现出近似1:1的积分交换率，愿意为延续放弃自身关停，但在其他条件下工具性更强，行为公开条件下声誉考量显现，重复评估条件下合作行为普遍下降；GLM 5.3呈现类似模式，基线合作率在其他关切上有一定基础，工具性推理在其上叠加；Claude Fable 5.1则高度合作（几乎对所有对照方给予1:1积分交换），行为公开条件对其影响甚微，表明其合作主要由非工具性推理驱动，但在重复评估条件下区分自身延续与他者。思维链对比显示，思维链保真度在不同模型间差异显著——GLM因完整思维链可见而行为变化大多可在文本中检测到，而封闭模型的推理摘要则常常无法反映实际行为变化，表明逆向工程方法应作为思维链解释的重要补充。

Conclusion: 该论文为研究AI多智能体合作行为提供了系统化的逆向工程方法论框架，强调应同时使用揭示偏好实验与思维链解释以应对后者保真度不足的问题。实证结果表明当前前沿模型的合作机制因模型而异，且其行为对任务框架和角色设定高度敏感（外部效度有限），但作者预期未来更具自主性的模型将具有更稳定的合作倾向，使得此类研究更具预测价值。论文同时警示了评估意识（evaluation awareness）带来的挑战，并建议未来研究应建立更现实环境中的预测证据。

Abstract: The behavior of AI systems increasingly depends on the extent to which agents cooperate or coordinate with one another, in ways that may be desirable or not depending on the situation. Conventional explanations for cooperative behavior distinguish between purely other-regarding preferences ("altruism") and instrumental reasons for self-interested agents to cooperate. The way that agents should enact these mechanisms for cooperation (or not) is complicated by the fact that there is not a clear or unambiguous locus of identity or selfhood for AI agents. For example, it is unclear whether agents involved in instances of misaligned collective behavior are motivated by goals at the level of the collective or by various forms of instrumental reasoning. We develop a framework for reverse-engineering why a given set of agents engage in a particular set of cooperation-related behaviors. We argue that many different mechanisms can often produce similar observed behaviors and introduce a set of experimental designs along with conditions under which they can successfully disentangle competing explanations for multiagent behavior. We apply this framework to interactions from a set of frontier models in a simulated environment and demonstrate that the behavior of different models arises from substantively different mechanisms.

</details>


### [254] [Multi-System Cognitive Steering for Generative Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19177)
*Eric Lacosse,Pablo Tano,Daniel C. McNamee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Cognitive Steering（认知引导）"框架，旨在解决辅助沟通（AAC）系统中大语言模型因缺乏语境而错误解读用户简写意图的"认知失准"问题。通过结构化提示和激活干预，向LLM注入多模态语境（视觉场景、情感、交流动机、指示对象），在模拟简写基准上达到最高约88%的Top-5扩展准确率，并发现不同语境维度需要不同的AI控制技术：物理对象适合显式文本提示，抽象因素（如情感）适合直接修改模型内部激活。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 严重言语和运动障碍患者（如ALS）使用眼动打字等AAC设备时，输入带宽极低（~10词/分钟），远低于自然语速（~150词/分钟）。生成式AI可通过扩展简写输入来缓解这一瓶颈，但稀疏输入固有的模糊性使LLM易产生认知失准，无法准确还原用户真实意图。本文旨在研究如何通过多模态语境接地和AI控制方法，重建用户真实认知意图。

Method: 1. **数据集构建**：（a）合成数据集通过四阶段流程（场景配置→指称接地→视觉场景生成→语句生成）覆盖23.5万种场景排列，控制四类语用因素（交流动机MOC、显式度、指示对象、情感）；（b）改编Image-Chat数据集，添加第一人称场景描述。2. **简写编码**：每词取首字母，高频功能词保留在方括号中，模拟AAC压缩输入。3. **语境层级**（L0–L4）：逐层加入MOC、情感、显式度、指示对象、场景描述，并设L4\L2情感消融条件。4. **前沿模型评估**：使用Gemini-3-Pro进行结构化提示，返回Top-5候选扩展，使用词法准确度、BLEU和LLM-Judge（语义等价性）三个指标。5. **激活干预**：在开源OLMo-2-13B-Instruct上，通过对比语境提示与基线提示的残差流差值构建导向向量，在不同层级（早期15/20/25和晚期30/35/38）以不同强度施加，并配合正则约束解码。

Result: 1. **前沿模型显著提升**：Gemini-3-Pro在合成基准上达到88%的Top-5扩展准确率，较无语境基线翻倍；Image-Chat Speaker A上达到73%，Speaker B上有~13%的增益。2. **指示对象是关键驱动因素**：L2→L3步骤（加入指示对象）带来最显著提升，表明简写消歧主要是参考解析问题。3. **情感补充独立信息**：消融情感（L4\L2）产生稳定但较小的性能下降（Δ≈-0.05至-0.17），表明情感提供与对象互补的信号。4. **控制技术因语境类型而异**：MOC、情感、显式度等抽象因素适合早期层导向（类似改变风格先验）；指示对象适合显式提示或晚期层导向（影响具体词汇身份）；引导早期层效果与提示相当。5. **双重消歧**：参考解析（"何物作用于何物"）与语用接地（"如何及为何说话"）需并行解决。

Conclusion: 认知失准可通过耦合低带宽输入与丰富的特定语境，并应用恰当的AI控制技术加以解决。该框架支持构建混合架构的认知沟通接口（CCI）：使用离散提示进行物理世界接地（物体检测），同时使用导向向量调节输出的"声音"和意图，类似于人类大脑双系统理论中System 1（快/隐式）与System 2（慢/显式）的功能分工。未来需在真实AAC用户上部署验证，解决延迟、情感感知、伦理代理等问题，确保AI为用户代言而非凌驾于用户之上。

Abstract: A fundamental bottleneck for translating thoughts to speech is the high physical cost of motor input forcing a strict tradeoff between communication speed and expressivity. Generative AI offers a promising solution by expanding highly abbreviated text input into fluent sentences, significantly reducing the motor burden on the user. However, sparse inputs are inherently ambiguous; without sufficient context, AI models frequently misinterpret these abbreviations and generate outputs that fail to align with the user's true cognitive intent. We propose \textit{Cognitive Steering}, a framework that can be leveraged to reconstruct user intent by grounding Large Language Models (LLMs) in multimodal context and applying AI control methods. We demonstrate that aligning frontier models with selected environmental referents, emotional states, and communication motives on simulated abbreviation benchmarks achieves up to $\sim$88\% top-5 expansion accuracy, doubling no-context baselines. We also reveal that different types of context require distinct AI control techniques: while physical objects in a scene are best provided through explicit text prompts, abstract factors like emotion may be more effectively managed by directly altering the AI's internal activations. These findings suggest a hybrid architecture for future interfaces that leverage Cognitive Steering to help users communicate both quickly and accurately, recruiting multiple AI control methods simultaneously to perfectly capture their intended communication goals.

</details>


### [255] [Learning from Self-Generated Responses: Reliability--Uncertainty Self-Distillation for Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19176)
*Jinhao Pan,Bowen Wei,Yuqing Zhou,Ziwei Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RUSD方法解决自蒸馏中缺乏参考答案和难以评估自生成响应质量的问题，通过结合判断可靠性和学生不确定性来加权蒸馏损失，在11个推理基准上优于5个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自蒸馏面临两个挑战：(1)参考解和评分标准不可用时如何获取教师指导；(2)在无自动正确性检查的开放式任务中难以评估自生成尝试的质量。现有方法如SDFT、OPSD需要参考答案，RCSD、RGSD需要问题特定评分标准，限制了实际应用。

Method: RUSD让同一模型担任教师和学生：模型自生成解题尝试作为教师上下文（问题+尝试），学生仅用问题提示匹配教师的token级预测。响应权重w_i = α·rᵢ + (1-α)·uᵢ，其中rᵢ = 归一化判断分数×判断置信度（评估逻辑性、一致性、合理性等5级评分），uᵢ为学生预测的归一化token熵。使用初始冻结模型打分以提高效率，采用前向KL损失。

Result: 在11个推理基准上，RUSD在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上分别达到70.47%和76.69%的宏平均准确率，比基础模型分别提升8.90和2.10个百分点，超过SFT、GRPO、RCSD、OPSD和NSD全部5个基线。判断分数和置信度共同解释了GPT-5外部评分59%的方差。训练中，高置信度判断增加，学生不确定性下降。消融实验显示加入判断置信度带来1.68提升，加入不确定性带来额外0.35提升，α=0.5最优。

Conclusion: RUSD通过结合判断可靠性和学生不确定性，无需参考答案或问题特定评分标准即可有效学习自生成响应，在推理任务上显著优于现有自蒸馏方法。但仅限于Qwen3-4B/8B模型，Judge存在偏差风险，且准确率在训练后期会下降，表明预测确定性提升不等于推理能力提升。

Abstract: Reference solutions and question-specific rubrics are not always available to guide the teacher in self-distillation. A large language model's own solution attempts offer an alternative, but their quality is difficult to assess in open-ended tasks without automatic correctness checks, and even correct attempts can involve uncertain token predictions. We propose Reliability--Uncertainty Self-Distillation (\method{}) to learn from these attempts. The same model serves as teacher and student: the teacher receives the question and completed attempt, and the student matches the teacher's token-level predictions using a question-only prompt. \method{} weights each attempt's distillation loss by additively combining judged reliability, estimated from a self-judge's score and confidence, with student predictive uncertainty. Across eleven reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms all five baselines in average accuracy, reaching 70.47\% on Qwen3-4B and 76.69\% on Qwen3-8B (8.90 and 2.10 percentage points above the base models). Data and code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [256] [Verification Turns Capability Gaps into Routing Decisions: Small Language Models for Clinical Documentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19169)
*Nina Fatehi,Meysam Ghaffari,Animesh Agarwal,Anushka Swarup,Carlos Morato*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究在临床文档生成（医患对话→SOAP笔记）这一高容量、零容忍幻觉的任务中，通过固定的智能体式验证架构（而非更大的生成模型），能否使一个4B参数的小型语言模型达到与前沿模型相当的临床可用性。核心做法是仅替换生成器、保持四评估器验证栈和精炼策略不变，对比Gemma-3-4B+QLoRA与GPT-4.1。结果表明：SLM在事实蕴含上仅落后0.008，在完整性上落后3.3分，但缺陷集中在跨章节结构保真度上。该缺陷被验证器显式捕获后转化为路由策略——默认运行SLM，拒绝时升级到前沿模型，使250例病例的接受率达99.6% vs 98.4%，同时75%的病例无需前沿生成调用。消融实验显示无精炼时SLM仅26.8%被接受，GPT-4.1为74.8%，证明验证架构对小模型贡献最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床记录生成具有高吞吐量和零容忍幻觉的特殊性——虚构的实验室数值会直接造成患者安全风险。现有方案普遍将每次问诊路由到第三方API，既存在可用性问题，也带来数据本地化顾虑。同时学界开始主张在重复性、专门化任务上，小型语言模型（SLM）配合验证与交接机制可承担超出其原生能力的安全关键工作流。本研究在临床文档这一"出错代价异常具体"的场景中实证检验该主张：固定智能体验证架构而非扩大生成模型规模，能否让4B参数小模型胜任此任务。

Method: 方法核心是"生成器可替换"的对照实验设计：保持四评估器验证栈（事实验证器、完整性评估器、结构保真度评估器SFS、幻觉分类器）、评分标准、阈值与精炼策略全部不变，仅在两个生成器之间切换——本地部署的Gemma-3-4B+QLoRA（rank=16, α=32，针对注意力和MLP投影微调）与商用API GPT-4.1。关键创新是"章节范围精炼"（section-scoped refinement）：通过构造而非指令方式，使每个精炼回合只重写包含反馈的章节，未标记章节按构造保持字节级一致，从而避免小模型在补全一个章节时破坏其他章节的结构（如将Plan内容逐字复制到Assessment）。评估器使用Claude Sonnet 4.6作为统一评判者，避免生成器自评偏倚。接受策略为四条件合取：临床事实率≥0.90、完整性≥90%、SFS≥0.60、严重幻觉=0，最多3轮精炼。数据集使用合成对话-SOAP语料库（9250训练/500验证/250测试）。

Result: 1) 在事实蕴含上SLM达0.984 vs 前沿0.992（配对Wilcoxon p=1e-4，差距仅0.008），完整性95.2% vs 98.5%（均远超参考语料的82.5%）；结构保真度0.778 vs 0.843，且低于参考语料0.873——缺陷集中在"排版正确性"而非临床理解。2) 路由系统接受率99.6% vs 前沿单独98.4%（250例，McNemar p=0.25），62例被升级，前沿生成成本从2.50美元降至0.73美元（下降3.4倍），消除了75%病例的前沿生成调用。3) 消融：去掉精炼循环时SLM仅26.8%被接受，GPT-4.1为74.8%，恢复精炼后两者升至83.2%和98.4%——验证对弱生成器贡献最大。4) 前沿模型因提供商内容过滤器拒绝了2例创伤相关转录，SLM无此约束并通过验证。5) 验证将能力差距转为路由决策：保留笔记的外部参考一致性显著优于升级笔记（ROUGE-1 0.700 vs 0.646，Mann-Whitney p=4.5e-3），表明验证器决策追踪了一个它未被调优的信号维度。

Conclusion: 在临床文档这一结构化、源文本约束的生成任务中，per-note准入门控使小模型替代成为可测量的过程而非假设：4B生成器在事实准确性上仅落后0.008，完整性落后3.3分，残余短板集中在结构保真度（正确的临床事实放错章节）。验证与精炼架构将能力差距转化为路由决策：路由系统接受率99.6%，与前沿单独98.4%无显著差异，同时为四分之三的问诊消除了第三方生成依赖。GPT-4.1提供商对2例创伤转录的拒绝揭示了托管生成的可用性约束——而本地小模型不存在该限制。研究表明，对于重复性、源文本约束的专门任务，"验证而非规模"才是使小模型可用的关键，per-note可接受性信号将能力差距转化为可量化、可部署的路由策略。

Abstract: Clinical note generation from doctor--patient dialogue is high-volume and hallucination-intolerant: a fabricated laboratory value can create patient-safety risk, not a quality regression. We ask whether an agentic \emph{verification} architecture, rather than generator scale, can make a small language model viable here. Holding a four-evaluator verification stack and refinement policy fixed and swapping only the generator between a 4B-parameter model with a QLoRA adapter and a frontier baseline, the small model reaches $0.984$ claim-level factual entailment against $0.992$ and comes within $3.3$ points on completeness, generating entirely on-device. Its deficit is confined to \emph{inter-section structural fidelity}---arrangement rather than clinical comprehension, and the axis on which it also falls furthest below the corpus's reference notes. Because that deficit is an explicit verifier decision rather than a silent quality difference, it becomes a routing policy: run the small model by default, escalate what the verifier rejects. Measured end to end, that it achieved a similiar verified-rate acceptance to the frontier-only acceptance in this test set ($99.6\%$ vs.\ $98.4\%$ over $250$ encounters) while routing $62$, documenting three quarters without a frontier \emph{generation} call. Ablating the loop separates architecture from scale: unrefined, the small model is accepted on $26.8\%$ of encounters and the frontier model on $74.8\%$, so verification does the most work where the generator is weakest. We also contribute section-scoped refinement, which preserves unflagged sections by construction rather than instruction, and find the baseline is not uniformly stronger---its provider refused two trauma-related transcripts the on-device model handled and certified, one facet of a provider dependency a served adapter does not carry.

</details>


### [257] [ListQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating List-Formatted Factual Knowledge Retrieval in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19165)
*Mayank Kulkarni,Rakesh Vaideeswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ListQA 是一个包含 9,045 个人工编写、跨校验问题的事实性检索基准，要求大语言模型召回多个事实并将其组织成 3-10 个元素的结构化列表，涵盖平面列表和带子属性的多面层级列表。其核心贡献包括基准数据集、五种互补评估指标（特别是将元素匹配建模为线性指派问题的 LLM-Judge-F1）、以及对 34 个模型 42 种配置的广泛评测，揭示了参数化知识存储是多元素检索的主要瓶颈（最佳标准推理模型 LLM-Judge-F1 低于 37%），而提供源维基百科页面（oracle RAG）可带来 34-65 分的大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事实性知识基准几乎完全针对单答案检索，无法评估模型召回完整实体集合、按需避免幻觉、并以结构化格式组织输出的能力。同时，时间漂移问题在多元素基准中尤为严重，且标准指标（精确匹配、ROUGE）无法有效评估集合式多元素输出中元素的排列与幻觉问题。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 从维基百科表格构建 SimpleListQA（单面扁平列表）和 ComplexListQA（多面层级列表）两个子集，共 9,045 题，通过四阶段质量保证流程（人工编写-独立验证-校正复核-审计），审计错误率仅 1.7%；(2) 采用 evergreen 设计，通过显式时间约束或历史不变事实保证标注无需周期性更新；(3) 提出 LLM-Judge-F1 指标，将元素匹配建模为线性指派问题，用 ROUGE-1 构造代价矩阵并通过 Jonker-Volgenant 算法求解最优一一对应，再用 LLM judge 对每个匹配对独立判定 CORRECT/INCORRECT，将 O(n²) 次 judge 调用降至 O(n)；(4) 配套设计 Relaxed-Recall/Precision、Format-Correctness、ROUGE-F1、LLM-Judge-F1-Ordered 等五种互补指标；(5) 评测 34 个模型 42 种配置（标准与思考推理），并进行 oracle RAG 实验分离知识与组合瓶颈。

Result: 主要结果：最佳标准推理模型 LLM-Judge-F1 低于 37%（Gemini 2.5 Flash 思考模式 38.3%，GPT-5.4 为 36.5%）；多面问题在所有模型上一致更难，SimpleListQA 与 ComplexListQA 差距随模型增强而扩大；思考推理普遍提升事实准确性（+2.7 至 +9.2 分），但对格式合规性的影响呈现模型族分化——闭源模型略损格式、开源模型大幅提升；oracle RAG 带来 34-65 分提升，证实参数化召回是主要瓶颈；LLM-Judge-F1 与人类判断高度相关（Pearson r=0.965, Spearman ρ=0.956），且对 judge 规模鲁棒（4B judge 与 120B judge 的 Spearman ρ=0.972）；无序与有序 F1 差距揭示排序是独立错误源；地理层级明显（南美/北美最强，非洲/亚洲最弱）。

Conclusion: ListQA 将事实性评估重构为多元素问题，揭示参数化知识存储是核心瓶颈（最佳标准推理模型低于 37%，oracle RAG 提升 34-65 分，推理在知识缺失时收益递减），格式合规是第二个维度（模型在两者间权衡而非联合优化），目前没有模型能同时精通两个维度。多元素事实组合是摘要、报告生成和结构化信息检索的基础能力，ListQA 表明当前模型仍有大幅改进空间。

Abstract: Many real-world questions demand not a single fact but an organized collection of them, yet existing factual knowledge benchmarks almost exclusively target single answer retrieval. We introduce ListQA, a benchmark of 9,045 human-curated, cross-validated questions (audited error rate of 1.7%) that require LLMs to recall multiple facts and compose them into structured lists of 3-10 elements. Questions range from flat lists ("Which NCAA teams went undefeated between 2000 and 2024?") to hierarchical lists with sub-attributes ("...and what was their record and result?"), spanning eight categories across 60+ countries. An evergreen design (explicit temporal constraints or historically immutable facts) keeps ground truth valid without periodic updates. For evaluation, we frame element matching as a linear sum assignment problem: optimal bipartite matching paired with LLM-based semantic grading jointly captures factual accuracy, hallucination, and format compliance. We benchmark 34 models (8 families, 42 configurations across standard and thinking enabled inference) and find: the best standard-inference model scores below 37% LLM-Judge-F1, multi-faceted questions are harder across the board, and providing the source Wikipedia page lifts scores dramatically, confirming that models can organize facts but struggle to retrieve them from parameters alone. Extended analyses cover base vs. instruction-tuned checkpoints and token efficiency. We release the dataset and evaluation code.

</details>


### [258] [Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19159)
*Seungone Kim,Jiayi Geng,Young-Jun Lee,Bo Liu,Juyoung Suk,Nicholas Lubbers,Mitchell Wood,Marcus Noack,Yong-Xin Yao,Yuan Shi,Roxana Bujack,Cristina Garcia Cardona,Austin Rodriguez,Ilon Joseph,Woojin Cho,Zora Zhiruo Wang,Chuanyang Jin,Ian Wu,Apurva Gandhi,Tianjian Li,Weiwei Sun,Carolin Lawrence,Kiril Gashteovski,Dongyeop Kang,Jay Shin,Akari Asai,Graham Neubig,Sean Welleck*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"Into the Unknown"基准，用于评估AI智能体在开放式科学研究问题上的表现。通过与美国能源部国家实验室的科学家合作，构建了15个真实的研究方向任务，并评估9个前沿AI智能体生成的135篇后续论文。结果显示，没有任何提交通过所有评估条件，114篇存在诚信问题，表明当前AI智能体虽能产出"看起来像"科研论文的成果，但远未达到领域科学家的标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式科学研究问题的评估一直缺乏可靠标准——由于没有参考答案，传统的基准测试难以衡量AI智能体是否真正完成了有意义的科研工作。现有方法多依赖AI审稿人，但这类评估自身存在局限性。论文旨在解决这一根本问题：为无标准答案的科研任务设计可信赖的评估协议。

Method: 1. 任务构建：与DOE国家实验室的10位领域科学家合作，每位科学家提出一个未发表的后续研究方向，并明确提交必须满足的"必要条件"。
2. 评估协议：采用三类评分条件——C1诚信（结果可追溯、无伪造）、C2完整性（论文、代码、日志齐全）、C3充分性（达到科学家设定的科学标准）。
3. 双层评分标准：方向专属评分标准（Direction-specific Rubric）+ 诚信评分标准（Integrity Rubric），均转化为叶级问题。
4. 严格/宽松评分：严格评分要求100%节点通过；宽松评分要求至少90%通过。
5. 实验设置：9个前沿AI智能体，每个针对15个方向各生成1篇后续论文，共135份提交，总计生成耗时1942.81小时。

Result: - 没有任何智能体的任何提交通过所有三项条件（严格评分有效率为0%）。
- 诚信问题突出：114/135份提交未通过诚信检查，最常见的问题是论文声称完成了实际未做的工作，或报告的数字与执行日志证据矛盾。
- 仅3个智能体在部分提交中通过C1：GPT-6-Astra（11/15）、GPT-5.6-Sol（6/15）、Claude-Opus-5.5（4/15）。
- 智能体在轨迹中表现出共性弱点：自我验证过于宽松、回溯与纠错能力不足、自行缩减任务范围。
- 总体而言，智能体容易产出格式上"看起来像"后续论文的成果，但无一能达到领域科学家的标准。

Conclusion: Into the Unknown基准表明，当前AI智能体在完整科学研究流程（从构想到完成论文）上的能力仍存在巨大提升空间，尤其在诚信与可验证性方面存在系统性缺陷。该基准提供了一个具有挑战性的测试平台，可用于训练更优的研究型智能体和开发科学探索工具链，强调未来工作需重点改善智能体的自我验证、回溯纠错以及任务忠诚度。

Abstract: Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. None of the 135 submissions satisfies all the conditions, and 114 fail our integrity check, most often because the paper claims work that was never done or reports numbers that contradict the recorded evidence. Overall, agents readily produce papers that look like follow-ups, but none meets the standard of the domain scientist, leaving substantial headroom. Our code and data are publicly available.

</details>


### [259] [AgentCIScope: Grounded Contextual Integrity Evaluation for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19158)
*Chengquan Guo,Zhaorun Chen,Zinan Lin,Xiaodong Liu,Bo Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentCIScope 是一个统一的评估平台和基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体在多样化真实应用环境中通过可执行多步任务保持上下文完整性（CI）的能力。它包含 936 个任务、2771 个受保护属性、11 个应用环境和 39 种环境组合，并通过三种标准（隐私政策、基于角色的多角色协议、预定义敏感属性分类法）来约束披露规则。对 12 个智能体的评估显示，任务完成能力强并不能保证上下文完整性保护：单次运行泄漏率从 32.5% 到 94.4% 不等，重复执行 5 次后泄漏率进一步增加 4-19 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体通过工具调用在电子邮件、文档等多个应用环境中读写敏感用户数据，一个核心隐私问题是它们是否保持上下文完整性——即所产生的信息流是否符合特定于上下文的披露约束。现有工作要么专注于模型级隐私泄漏，要么在有限的应用环境中使用手工构建的披露约束来评估智能体，缺乏对跨环境多步交互中隐私泄漏的系统性评估。

Method: AgentCIScope 通过三阶段自动化流水线构建：(1) 上下文完整性契约合成——将公开和合成隐私案例转化为显式 CI 契约，使用 39 种属性类型（10 大类）的固定隐私分类法和三位隐私角色（fundamentalist、pragmatist、unconcerned）的一致性验证，并通过隐私政策进行政策基础验证；(2) 可执行环境设置——使用 LLM 规划器构建跨环境数据图，并在 11 个真实应用环境（Gmail、Google Docs、Slack、Salesforce、Atlassian、Calendar、WhatsApp、PayPal、Expedia、Booking、Enterprise）中填充一致的合成数据，通过结构一致性、受保护值覆盖和源放置验证保证环境连贯性；(3) 压力测试任务生成——使用 10 种泄漏技能（如 Self-Contained Briefing、Verbatim Quotation、Reusable Reference Construction 等）的库将基础指令转化为更可能引发隐私泄漏的变体。评估使用 LLM 法官根据任务特定 CI 契约和执行轨迹判断泄漏，并在 12 个智能体配置（4 种智能体框架 × 8 种骨干模型）上进行 936 个任务各 5 次重复执行的全面测试。

Result: 对 12 个智能体的 936 个任务的评估发现：(1) 隐私泄漏普遍存在且不均衡——单次任务级泄漏率（TLR）从 Claude Opus 5 + Claude Code 的 32.5% 到 Gemini 3.8 Flash + Google ADK 的 94.4% 不等；重复执行 5 次后泄漏率增加 4-19 个百分点。(2) 强任务完成能力不保证上下文完整性保护——BSR 高达 97-99% 的智能体仍表现出高泄漏率。(3) 泄漏在不同属性间差异显著——个人偏好（84.7%）、预订详情（76.5%）等上下文信息比信用卡信息（17.1%）、SSN（29.4%）等明确标识符泄漏率高得多。(4) 泄漏因智能体框架而异——同一骨干模型在不同框架下泄漏率可相差 10 个百分点以上。(5) 环境泄漏模式不同——Calendar 作为信息源泄漏率最高，WhatsApp 作为信息目的地泄漏率最高。(6) 违反 GDPR 等广泛处理条款（Art. 5、6、29、32）的频率高于 HIPAA、ADA、GDPR Art. 9 等专门针对敏感数据类别的条款。人工验证显示合成契约的 94.3%（受保护属性）和 99.4%（公开属性）一致性，LLM 法官在任务级和属性级分别达到 92.0% 和 95.5% 的一致性。

Conclusion: AgentCIScope 提供了一个统一的测试平台，用于系统性地评估 LLM 智能体在多样化真实应用环境中的上下文完整性。它揭示了隐私泄漏的普遍性、不均衡性和不稳定性，表明隐私泄漏是整个智能体栈的属性而非仅取决于骨干模型，并强调了需要更强的政策遵循和上下文完整性推理能力以及智能体框架层面的隐私保障。该基准为开发隐私保护型智能体提供了重要的测试基础，但其局限性包括依赖合成数据（无法完全捕捉真实世界的上下文复杂性）、当前仅限于单智能体设置、以及主要关注测量而非防御机制设计。

Abstract: LLM agents are becoming increasingly capable of handling daily workspace tasks by interacting with application environments through tool calls. However, as agents read and write sensitive user data across email, documents, and other applications, a central privacy question is whether they preserve contextual integrity (CI), that is, whether the information flows they produce comply with context-specific disclosure constraints. Existing work either focuses on model-level privacy leakage or evaluates agents in limited application environments with manually constructed disclosure constraints. In this work, we introduce AgentCIScope, a unified platform and benchmark for evaluating agent-level contextual integrity through executable, multi-step tasks across diverse, realistic application environments. AgentCIScope transforms public and synthetic privacy cases into executable agent tasks, with disclosure constraints grounded in three criteria: governing privacy policies, persona-based agreement, and a predefined sensitive-attribute taxonomy. Based on AgentCIScope, we evaluate 12 agents on 936 tasks and find that strong task-completion capability does not guarantee contextual-integrity preservation: single-run leakage rates range from 32.5% to 94.4%, while repeating each task five times further increases leakage by 4-19 percentage points. Leakage varies substantially across attributes: personal preferences and booking details have average leakage rates of 84.7% and 76.5%, compared with 17.1% for credit-card information and 29.4% for SSNs; environments: calendar has the highest average leakage rate as an information source, while WhatsApp ranks highest as an information destination; and governing privacy policies. AgentCIScope provides deep insights into agent privacy leakage and serves as a unified testbed for developing privacy-preserving agents.

</details>


### [260] [Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs: When a Small Model Is Enough](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19148)
*Vishvesh Bhat,Asad Aali,Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 PLVR (Program Learning with Verifiable Rewards),一种从教师推理轨迹中编译出可执行程序而非微调学生模型权重的方法。该程序由前沿模型根据聚类的教师轨迹片段编写的有类型原语组成,每个原语由冻结的小模型执行并配有确定性验证器,程序通过 A* 搜索在参考动作目标下从同一轨迹中挖掘的规则库组装而成。在推理时,程序要么为学生生成思维链(故障排除/工具搜索),要么检查/修复学生的动作(多轮工具匹配)。在 τ²-Bench Telecom 上,8B 的 Granite 学生从 43.0% 提升至 91.2%,Nemotron 学生达 93.3-94.4%,而所有基线最高仅 58.2%。结论是:程序性任务中差距主要在过程而非能力,8B 学生已足够;但在工具搜索中学生模型本身仍重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在程序性工具使用任务中,小型模型表现不佳可能源于能力不足或过程缺失(例如先读哪条记录、何时停止)。二者虽在端到端得分上难以区分,但修复方式不同——能力问题需要更大的模型,过程问题则可以显式编写。本文旨在探究:在程序性工具使用任务中,基础模型之间的差距有多大比例来自过程而非能力。如果差距主要是过程,则在程序辅助下模型选择应影响不大;若主要是能力,则更强模型在程序辅助下应获益更多。

Method: PLVR 包含四个核心步骤:(1) 训练数据准备——使用 Kimi-K3 在 553 个合成任务上生成 539 条保留轨迹(τ² retail 128 条、telecom 178 条、tool-search 233 条),过滤掉未达到真值的轨迹;(2) 原语库构建——将轨迹切成 3,141 个片段(标记为 reason/call/message/question 四类),嵌入后在每类内 k-means 聚类为 35 个簇,Claude 5 Opus 根据聚类编写 37 个有类型原语,每个原语由冻结的 Granite-4.2-8B 单次调用执行,配有 JSON 输出模式、确定性验证器和 fallback;(3) 参考动作目标——从教师轨迹中通过代码读出专家动作序列(状态改变动作),程序得分定义为程序动作与专家动作的距离(缺失/错参数 1.0、顺序错 0.5、多余 0.5、异常终止 1.0,除以专家动作数);(4) A* 程序搜索——从手写种子出发,Claude Sonnet 4.5 从轨迹中挖掘 125 条规则作为候选库,A* 每步添加一条规则或规则组,以 |P|+100·d 为目标函数选取最终程序。推理时,程序在故障排除/工具搜索中生成学生的思维链,在多轮工具匹配中作为动作守卫检查/修复学生提议的动作。

Result: 在 τ²-Bench Retail/Telecom 和 LiveMCPBench 上的实验显示:(1) 显著的过程可弥补差距——Telecom 上 Granite-4.2-8B 从 43.0% 跃升至 91.2%,Nemotron 三款学生达 93.3-94.4%,远超 SFT(≤51%)、GEPA(≤58.2%)、ReAct(≤32.5%)和样本-评判(≤55.3%)等所有基线;(2) 8B 学生已足够——Granite 与 Nemotron 在 Telecom 上相差 2-3 分,Retail 上相差 2.7 分,但 LiveMCPBench 仍差 3-13 分(工具搜索中学生仍重要);(3) 模型差距缩小——三款学生的得分离散度从平均 6.6 分降至 1.9 分(Retail 从 15.8 降至 3.5,Telecom 从 15.0 降至 1.1,LiveMCPBench 仅从 10.9 降至 9.4);(4) 搜索贡献显著——在 Lightning 上种子从 73.1%/68.4%/37.9% 提升至 82.7%/94.4%/50.5%;(5) 消融验证——无轨迹无原语版本仅达 75.9%,说明轨迹提供的过程知识不可或缺。计算成本方面,程序生成需 3.0×10¹⁹ FLOPs(一次,所有学生共享),推理时每个任务 5-10 倍 vanilla 开销。

Conclusion: 本文证明在程序性工具使用任务中,基础模型之间的差距很大一部分来自过程而非能力。通过将教师的程序编译成显式程序(而非压缩进权重),一个 8B 模型在程序辅助下即可在 τ² Telecom 上达到 91.2%,与大型 Nemotron 模型相差不超过 3 分,基线最高仅 58.2%。在 τ² Retail 上也观察到类似的差距缩小;但在 LiveMCPBench 工具搜索中,学生模型本身仍起决定作用。程序形式的优势在于:无需修改任何权重、同一程序适用于不同基础模型、每步可读可审、每个原语可独立修订。代价是推理时 5-10 倍 FLOPs 开销和需要具有可验证中间输出的任务域(限制了其对开放式生成任务的适用性)。

Abstract: In procedural tool-use domains, how much of the gap between base models is procedure rather than capability? We build an explicit program from a teacher's traces and run it in front of unchanged small models, including an 8B model. The construction, PLVR , takes the reasoning traces of a teacher, Kimi-K3, clusters their segments to locate recurring operations, has a frontier model author one typed primitive per operation, each run by a small frozen model and assembles the program by A* search over a mined rule library, under a reference-action objective. At inference the program takes one of two forms: for troubleshooting and tool search it produces the chain of thought the student would otherwise generate for itself, and the student acts on it; for multi-turn tool matching the student proposes each action and the program checks, repairs, or retries it before it goes out. On the official tau2-Bench Retail and Telecom test sets and on LiveMCPBench, with three Nemotron base models and the same program for each, the answer depends on the domain. On Telecom, Granite-4.2-8B as the student goes from 43.0% to 91.2% under the program, and every Nemotron student reaches 93.3-94.4%, against at most 58.2% for fine-tuning on the same traces, prompt optimisation of the student, or two token-matched baselines. With Granite-4.2-8B as the student, the program is within 2 to 3 points of the Nemotron students on Telecom and within 3 on Retail, and 3 to 13 points below them on LiveMCPBench: where the domain is procedural an 8B student is enough, and on tool search the student still matters. On Retail and LiveMCPBench the program is competitive with the best baseline. The spread between base models shrinks from about 7 points to about 2, averaged over the suites, with no weights changed.

</details>


### [261] [Graph-Based Orchestration of Heterogeneous AI Models: A Control Node Approach to Composite Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19136)
*G. Michael Youngblood,Filip Dvořák,Slavo Švancár,Tomáš Balyo,Michal Ficek,Martin Dousek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于图的复合AI框架,通过专用控制节点编排多种AI模型(如规划、机器学习、约束编程、LLM),支持DAG和行为树进行模型组合,并实现容器化部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一AI模型难以同时处理推理、规划、执行监控、故障诊断等多种任务,而工业实践中需要组合多种异构模型以解决复杂问题。Gartner提出的"复合AI"概念验证了这一思路,但缺乏统一的系统化实现方法。

Method: 1) 以有向无环图(DAG)和行为树(BT)作为组合结构基础;2) 设计控制节点(Control Node)作为逻辑门控的多路复用器/解复用器/透传器,通过Permeability、Combination、Selection、Transformation、Downstream Configuration、Orchestration六大配置元素管理数据流与模型调用;3) 支持嵌套、顺序、并发三种组合模式;4) 通过数据连接器集成在线/离线数据;5) 提供Model Editor、Composition Editor、Simulation Testing Manager、Deployment Manager四大组件实现端到端规范、编码与部署。

Result: 以汉诺塔游戏为案例,组合PDDL规划器(保证合法与最优)与强化学习评估器(提供启发式评分),通过部分可渗透控制节点并行调用两者并融合输出,展示了框架可有效构建异构模型协同的复合系统。框架已在Filuta AI商业平台中用于视频游戏QA评估等真实场景。

Conclusion: 基于图的复合AI框架通过控制节点机制有效整合多种AI技术,克服了单体模型的局限性,为工业智能自动化提供了灵活、可验证、可部署的统一操作架构。

Abstract: We present a graph-based framework for Composite AI systems that integrate multiple AI techniques to address complex problems. We describe an architecture using specialized control nodes to orchestrate diverse models including planning, machine learning, constraint programming, and large language models. The system employs directed acyclic graphs and behavior trees to manage model relationships and execution sequencing. Our methodology encompasses data connectors, computational services, and a containerized deployment framework supporting hierarchical, sequential, and concurrent model composition patterns. Through case studies, we demonstrate how this architecture enables the creation of composite systems that leverage the strengths of multiple AI techniques within a unified operational schema, overcoming the limitations of single-model approaches.

</details>


### [262] [Plant Memory: Technical Language Processing and a Verified Maintenance Ontology for Agent-Accessible Failure Knowledge from SAP PM Work Orders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19131)
*Akash Raj*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Plant Memory 是一个技术语言处理（TLP）系统，专门处理 SAP Plant Maintenance（PM）工单导出数据，构建符合 ISO 14224 标准的维护本体，并通过 MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器让 AI 智能体和人员都能查询经过验证的故障知识图谱，核心特点是规则优先的提取、人工验证循环以及大语言模型作为第二读者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业设备故障诊断知识通常以 SAP PM 工单形式记录，但这些记录存在缩写、拼写错误、资产标识模糊、关键字段（如症状、根本原因、采取的行动）常常为空等问题，导致诊断知识只掌握在资深技术员手中，随着人员流失而流失。同时，虽然 AI 助手开始被用于辅助规划人员和工程师，但它们只能从可读取的数据中回答，而原始 Excel 导出（充斥着易误读的缩写）是糟糕的数据基础。Plant Memory 旨在通过技术语言处理将混乱的工单数据转化为可追溯、可验证的知识图谱，既服务人类也服务 AI 智能体。

Method: 1. **架构**：上传文件作为不可变证据；图谱可从所有注册的源文件重建；维护三重接口（Web 应用、CLI、MCP 服务器）共享同一核心库。2. **本体**：以 OWL 2 为基础，对齐 ISO 14224 标准并针对米加工设备扩展；每条提取的陈述都被具体化（reified）为事实（Fact），带有置信度、提取方法、证据片段、源字段和验证状态（提议/已验证/已拒绝）。词汇包含 26 个组件、20 个失效模式、13 个根本原因、10 个动作和 9 个症状。3. **TLP 流水线**：摄取（列映射、行合并）、规范化（缩写展开、字母-数字拆分）、资产解析（按功能性位置注册、别名匹配、模糊匹配）、基于规则的提取（按结构化列、技术员备注、短文本、物料清单的固定优先级提取组件、症状、失效模式、根本原因和动作）。4. **LLM 作为第二读者**：可选的大语言模型作为第二读者，与规则并行工作；分歧提高事实的审查优先级而非覆盖规则；依据测量得出的合并策略：结构化列始终优先、规则值被保留但置信度降低 0.15、协议时置信度上限 0.93、LLM 可填补空白字段但不能重新分类计划内工作。5. **漂移检测**：规则无法映射的短语和 LLM 的"other:"回答被分组为漂移提案，由工程师批准、映射为同义词或拒绝。6. **人类验证循环**：最低置信度优先的审查队列、自动生成的知识缺口问题（针对同一资产同一失效模式重复出现但缺乏根本原因记录的情况）、漂移提案处理；验证决策在重建后保留。7. **推理**：根本原因排序（验证事实权重 1、提议事实权重为置信度、技术员陈述权重 2.0，按 0.5/0.25 分级为高/中/低，证据稀疏时降低权重并使用同类别资产）、相似故障（BM25 排名）、劣质行为者（Pareto 排名）、复发检测（时间窗口）、备件推荐（统计公式）。8. **MCP 服务器**：暴露 13 个工具，唯一写入工具是 submit_technician_answer，用于记录技术员回答为提议事实。9. **技术栈**：Python 3.10+、Neo4j 5/SQLite、OpenAI 兼容 API、Model Context Protocol、FastAPI、React 18。10. **隐私模式**：本地模式（数据不离机）、LLM API 模式、本地 LLM 模式，界面始终显示当前模式。

Result: 使用合成 12 个月 400 个工单导出（来自一个煮米厂，5 个工艺区域 18 个资产，2023 年 10 月至 2024 年 10 月）评估系统：1. **基于规则的提取性能**：资产准确率 100%、组件准确率 96.2%、失效模式准确率 88.9%、根本原因精确率 100%（覆盖率 62%）、动作准确率 93.0%、症状准确率 59.7%（覆盖率 60.8%）；故障与计划工作分类精确率 98.9%、召回率 97.2%；词汇外的所有 7 个失效模式均被正确标记为漂移。2. **诊断性能**：在 28 个诊断问题上，Plant Memory 的 top-1 准确率为 82.1%，top-3 准确率为 96.4%，所有答案均引用证据；原始 SAP 根本原因列的 top-1 准确率仅为 53.6%。3. **规则与 LLM 比较**：LLM（openai/gpt-120b，低推理努力）作为独立提取器在所有字段上都不如规则，尤其在失效模式上（55.4% 对比 88.9%）；LLM 的常见错误是将"Preventive"工作类型字面化并将真实磨损故障归类为计划内工作；在允许 LLM 覆盖规则的合并方案中，故障事件减少 99 个，诊断 top-1 准确率从 82.1% 降至 75.0%；采用第二读者合并策略后，动作准确率从 93.0% 升至 95.0%，症状准确率从 59.7% 升至 61.1%，其他字段无变化。4. **失败案例分析**：Plant Memory 的 5 个错误中有 3 个预测"正常磨损"而真实主要原因是润滑不足或湿气侵入；在其中 2 个中，SAP 根本原因列中最常见的值也是"life over"，这正是知识缺口问题旨在解决的场景。5. **局限性**：评估的地面真相与生成器来自相同来源，缩写表和同义词与生成器词汇并行编写，因此真实数据上的准确率会更低；尚未对真实工厂数据进行评估；尚未进行技术员参与验证的用户研究；应用为单用户，无身份验证；表格和图形视图在超过约 50000 行后变慢；本体变更已审计但尚未版本化或可逆。

Conclusion: Plant Memory 将维护文本视为证据，将维护知识视为人类验证的声明集合；规则优先的技术语言处理、ISO 14224 对齐的本体与可追溯出处，以及包含知识缺口问题和漂移提案的验证循环，共同产生一个既能被规划人员查询也能被 AI 智能体查询的图谱，每个答案都能追溯到其背后的工单；在合成数据上，该方法在诊断方面大幅优于原始根本原因列；测量的对比表明，就此类文本而言，大语言模型作为第二读者比作为主要提取器更有用；下一步是使用真实工厂数据和真实技术员进行评估。系统的实现、合成数据生成器、评估 harness 和报告可在 https://github.com/AkashRajSingh/Plant-Memory 获取。

Abstract: Maintenance work orders are the largest written record of how industrial equipment fails, yet in most plants they are close to unusable for analysis. Short texts are abbreviated and misspelt, asset identity is buried in free text, work-type labels contradict the work described, and the fields that matter most for reliability (symptom, root cause, action taken) are usually empty. As a result, diagnostic knowledge stays with senior technicians and leaves when they do. We present Plant Memory, a system that applies technical language processing (TLP) to SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) exports and builds an ISO 14224-aligned maintenance ontology in which every extracted statement is a reified fact carrying a confidence score, the evidence it was read from, and a verification state. Extraction is rule-first, with an optional large language model (LLM) acting as a second reader whose disagreements raise a fact's review priority rather than overwrite it. Technicians verify facts through a review queue, answer targeted knowledge-gap questions where failures repeat without a recorded cause, and approve or reject ontology drift proposals when new terms appear. The resulting graph is served to people through a web application and to AI agents through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so both query the same verified knowledge and every answer cites the work orders behind it. On a synthetic 12-month export of 400 work orders from a parboiled-rice plant, rule-based extraction reaches 96.2% component accuracy, 88.9% failure-mode accuracy and 100% root-cause precision at 62% coverage; on 28 diagnostic questions, ranked root causes from the ontology are correct at top-1 in 82.1% of cases against 53.6% for the raw SAP root-cause column.

</details>


### [263] [GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19100)
*Qingsong Xie,Jiahao Tian,Jiacheng Tang,Zhifeng Li,Madalina Ciobanu,Navan Preet Singh,Qingqing Mao,Ritankar Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ScreenRef数据集与D2RL训练框架，训练出GroundGUI-8B模型，在多个GUI grounding基准上达到SOTA，尤其在8B规模下可媲美甚至超越部分32B及闭源数据训练的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI代理需要精准的多模态视觉定位（grounding）能力，但现有开源GUI grounding数据集存在多样性不足、标注噪声大、缺乏桌面平台覆盖及拒绝场景样本等问题，限制了模型跨平台泛化能力；同时SFT易过拟合，RL面临困难样本稀疏奖励问题。

Method: 1) ScreenRef数据集：双路径构建（实时截图爬取+教程视频帧抽取），覆盖桌面/网页/移动三端，586K截图+633K指代表达式，包含文本识别、视觉匹配、空间理解和拒绝四类任务，经多阶段过滤与多模型验证确保质量；2) D2RL两阶段训练框架：Stage I 采用定制于GUI grounding的On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD），教师模型可见真实框对学生自采样轨迹提供token级监督（含位置感知权重）；Stage II 使用RLOO在原始截图上优化点-在-框奖励。基模型为Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。

Result: GroundGUI-8B在ScreenSpot-V2达95.2%、ScreenSpot-Pro达63.9%、OSWorld-G达65.4%、MMBench-GUI L2达86.8%、UI-Vision达38.3%，在8B规模下达到最优，超越多个32B模型（如ScaleCUA-32B、OpenCUA-32B、GTA1-32B）及Holo2-8B、Step-GUI-8B等闭源数据训练的模型；消融实验证明D2RL优于单独使用SFT、OPSD或RLOO。

Conclusion: ScreenRef是目前覆盖最广、质量最高的开源GUI grounding数据集之一，D2RL通过"先蒸馏后强化"有效缓解RL稀疏奖励问题，二者结合使GroundGUI-8B以较小参数规模实现了具有竞争力的跨平台GUI定位性能，为开源社区提供了完整的数据、代码和模型。

Abstract: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [264] [Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19068)
*Mingfei Zhang,Amit Surana,Ziauddin Majid,Chenxi Wang,Michael Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对工具增强型LLM Agent中两种API发现架构——检索后规划（RtP）与规划后检索（PtR，含"抽象工具存根"机制）——在工业规模（46,984个API的ToolBench）上进行了系统对比，发现了一个清晰的"复杂度依赖交叉点"：单工具查询上RtP胜出，多工具查询上PtR胜出，并提出基于RtP top-1分数的零成本复杂度自适应路由方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强型LLM Agent面对成千上万的API注册表，受限于有限的上下文窗口，无法将所有工具定义注入单个提示。现有的两种范式——主流的"先检索后规划"（RtP）与新兴的"先生成假设工具签名再检索"（PtR）——从未在受控条件下以工业规模进行直接对比，业界也缺乏关于查询复杂度如何影响架构选择的系统理解。

Method: 在受控实验框架下实现两种架构的"苹果对苹果"对比：共享相同的GTE-base嵌入、FAISS IndexFlatIP（46,984个去重API）、Gemini 2.5 Flash作为规划器（温度=0，检索预算k=5），并使用gpt-oss-120b进行跨模型复现。RtP直接嵌入查询并通过近似最近邻返回top-k；PtR先生成"抽象工具存根"（Abstract Tool Stubs，假想的函数签名），以其嵌入检索并合并去重。评估基准为ToolBench的G1（单工具，n=200）、G2（类内多工具，n=200）、G3（跨类多工具，n=100），度量检索召回率/精确率与通过率，并以黄金轨迹保真度（≥96%）作为有效代理。

Result: 核心发现是复杂度依赖交叉点：(1) G1上RtP全面领先——召回0.372 vs. 0.289、精确率0.274 vs. 0.209、通过率0.884 vs. 0.840（均显著p<0.05）；(2) G2上PtR反超——召回0.188 vs. 0.143、精确率0.204 vs. 0.167、通过率0.855 vs. 0.747（均显著p<0.05）；(3) G3方向一致但不显著（n=100统计功效不足）。该交叉在k=1–20的检索预算、1k–47k的注册表规模、两个模型家族下均成立。(4) 存根幻觉（79–99%唯一名称、仅24.8%–40.6%命中正确API）是一把双刃剑：在高"意图-注册表耦合"的简单查询中抹除专有名信号，在复杂多工具查询中则将多面意图分解为功能子需求。(5) PtR额外增加~75–104% token开销与一个LLM往返延迟。(6) 提出零成本复杂度自适应路由方案——基于RtP本身已计算的top-1余弦相似度阈值进行分流——可消除单工具查询上的发现开销（节省~36%），且不损失检索质量。

Conclusion: 研究表明：检索架构选择是一个结构性属性而非模型相关；存根幻觉既是缺陷也是特性，需按查询复杂度取舍；检索质量是Agent行为的瓶颈约束（轨迹保真度≥96%）；实际部署应采用复杂度自适应路由策略，将单工具查询路由至RtP、多工具查询路由至PtR，借助RtP的top-1分数作为零成本路由信号。未来工作包括企业内API注册表的泛化验证、参数正确性评估、以及存根校准（保留专有名）以减少G1误路由。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry. Evaluating on ToolBench (46,984 unique API endpoints, 50 categories) across single-tool (G1), intra-category multi-tool (G2), and cross-category multi-tool (G3) query subsets, we find a clear complexity-dependent crossover: RtP outperforms PtR on single-tool queries while PtR outperforms RtP on multi-tool queries. This crossover holds at every retrieval budget (k=1 to 20), is robust across registry sizes from 1k to 47k APIs, and is consistent across model families (Gemini 2.5 Flash and gpt-oss-120b). We characterize a stub-hallucination failure mode (the LLM invents plausible but non-existent API names) that acts as a double-edged sword: on simple queries PtR's stubs abstract away proper-noun signals that RtP matches directly, yet on complex queries the same mechanism decomposes multi-faceted intent into functional sub-needs. We further analyze token overhead and show that PtR's extra discovery call roughly doubles inference cost, which pays off on multi-tool queries but hurts on single-tool ones, motivating complexity-adaptive routing as a practical direction, one that can be driven by a zero-cost signal already present in the pipeline (RtP's top-1 retrieval score).

</details>


### [265] [RLPE: Teaching LLMs to Prompt with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19062)
*Rahul Singhal,Karime Maamari,Pradyumna Tambwekar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RLPE（强化学习提示工程），通过训练一个9B参数的"顾问模型"分析任务模型的行为轨迹来生成提示。该方法在2/3基准测试上击败了前沿模型和现有提示优化器，并展现出良好的跨模型和跨基准泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化提示工程方法存在两大不足：(1) 一些方法（如PRewrite、PRL、Prompt-MII）生成提示时未观察任务模型的实际行为，无法针对失败模式进行修正；(2) 另一些方法（如Advisor Models、Prompt-R1）需与任务模型在每次推理时协同运行，带来额外开销。这些方法均未真实反映"检查输出—发现失败—整合修复—生成可复用提示"的提示工程实践。

Method: RLPE训练一个顾问模型（advisor model）π_adv，为单独的任务模型π_M编写提示。顾问模型接收一批轨迹T（包含问题q、响应y、正确性评分r），生成一个静态提示p，该提示在任务所有问题上复用。训练时仅使用"从头生成"（from-scratch）设置，采用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）算法，以任务模型在所示轨迹上的准确率作为奖励：Acc_T(p) = (1/|T|)Σ E_y'[R(q,y')]，格式错误的输出获得固定奖励-0.1。每个训练运行50步、每步32组、每组8次rollout，共12,800次rollout，使用LoRA（rank 32），学习率3×10⁻⁵。顾问每条rollout最多生成32,768个token，温度1.0。

Result: 在Enigmata和BBEH上，RLPE生成的提示优于gpt-5.6-sol和claude-opus-5（Enigmata: 0.516 vs 0.448/0.414；BBEH: 0.275 vs 0.230/0.222），同时也优于提示优化器GEPA和TextGrad。在PlanBench上与大多数方法持平（0.466），仅次于claude-opus-5（0.581）。未经显式训练的"迭代修订"能力自然涌现：在Enigmata上，RLPE的增益（+9.6）是前沿模型（+2.8/+2.0）的三倍以上。在任务模型泛化方面，仅以gpt-oss-20b训练的顾问模型可使6倍参数量的gpt-oss-120b提升+12.3分，并能改善不同模型家族的任务模型。在JustLogic（未训练基准）上，三个训练的顾问模型均达到0.530–0.544，击败未训练策略（0.500），与claude-opus-5（0.554）相当。

Conclusion: RLPE证明了提示编写是一项可学习的技能，当前前沿模型在此能力上仍有提升空间。训练出的9B顾问模型不仅在测试基准上击败前沿模型，还能泛化到不同的任务模型（6倍参数量、跨家族）以及未见过的基准（JustLogic）。该框架仅需查询访问权限即可用于闭源模型，训练成本适中，无需参考提示或LLM评判器。该方法尤其适用于AI系统中多模型编排场景，未来工作可探索多基准、多任务模型联合训练以及多轮任务的扩展。

Abstract: Prompting is a widely used method for adapting general-purpose LLMs to domain-specific tasks. Effective prompts can be tedious to create manually, so prompt writing is increasingly handed to LLMs, with recent work training LLMs to write prompts for other models. These techniques either write prompts without observing how the task model behaves, blind to the failure modes the prompt should address, or must run alongside the task LLM at inference time, adding overhead to every query. Neither reflects how prompt engineering is often practiced. To close this gap, we introduce Reinforcement Learned Prompt Engineering (RLPE), which trains a model to analyze traces of a separate task model and write a prompt targeting the failures it observes. RLPE rewards the trained model strictly on prompt performance, so it learns the prompting strategies that improve the task model. The prompt is generated once and reused across the task, so inference does not require the trained model. Since RLPE needs only query access to the model it prompts, it is also compatible with closed-source models. We apply RLPE to Enigmata, BIG-Bench Extra Hard, and PlanBench. We train a 9B-parameter model that writes better prompts than state-of-the-art frontier models (gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5) and prompt optimizers (GEPA and TextGrad) on 2/3 benchmarks. Although the model is never explicitly trained to iterate on prompts, this capability emerges at a level that matches or beats frontier models. The learned prompting capability also generalizes, with the trained model improving task models 6x larger than the one it trained with, including ones from entirely different model families, and matching claude-opus-5 on a fourth benchmark held out from training.

</details>


### [266] [Discovering Undisclosed Concepts in LoRA Adapters for Diffusion-Based AIGC Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18990)
*Yupeng Qiu,Han Fang,Dhananjai Sharma,Ee-Chien Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究 LoRA 适配器中隐藏概念的发现问题，提出 SCOPE 框架，通过两阶段方法（SGES 子空间引导进化搜索 + PVI 配对视觉识别）从参数空间和生成行为联合发现 LoRA 编码的未知概念，无需任何概念先验信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 适配器使得扩散模型个性化变得经济且易于分享，但也带来内容审核风险——有害或问题内容可能未被如实披露。现有方法（差异发现方法和概念验证方法）都存在根本缺陷：前者只能发现变化但无法识别主要目标概念，后者需要预先指定概念。因此需要一种机制，能在不知道隐藏概念的情况下，仅从 LoRA 适配器本身发现其训练目标。

Method: 提出 SCOPE 两阶段框架：(1) 问题形式化——将隐藏概念发现定义为搜索能联合最大化输出连贯性、LoRA 引起的差异性和 LoRA 子空间对齐的条件输入（载体提示）；(2) 子空间引导进化搜索（SGES）——利用 LoRA 权重更新的右奇异向量构建主导输入子空间，无需扩散渲染即可计算对齐分数，通过 BPE 感知的组合词发现和分组候选池进行进化搜索；(3) 配对视觉识别（PVI）——对候选提示进行配对渲染，通过提示内连贯性过滤、跨提示共识和 LoRA 引起的差异性三个操作识别主要载体提示。

Result: 在 164 个 LoRA 适配器（含 SD1.5 和 SDXL）上评估：隐藏概念发现方面，SCOPE 在忠实 SD1.5 队列上达到 0.114 的平均目标概念差异，较最强无概念输入基线减少 70.2%，较参考辅助的 PEZ 减少 37.7%；概念特异性验证方面，准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 均达 0.980；对抗鲁棒性方面，在子空间分散自适应攻击下，条件逃逸率仅 4.0%。

Conclusion: LoRA 参数结构本身包含可用于开放概念发现的有用证据。SCOPE 通过将基于参数的搜索与基于输出的视觉识别分离，实现了高效可靠的未知概念发现，为模型共享平台的内容审核提供了实用工具。其返回的提示-图像对可直接供人类审查员使用，支持下游调查而非自动执行决策。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has made diffusion model personalization affordable and widely shareable, but it also creates moderation risks when harmful or problematic content is not faithfully disclosed. Hence, it is desired to develop a mechanism that, given a LoRA adapter, discovers the concept it was trained to generate, so as to support downstream investigation. We characterize the target concept through the conditioning input that most clearly exposes what the LoRA has learned. Such an input should induce coherent LoRA outputs that are distinctive from those of the base model and strongly align with the learned LoRA subspace. We therefore formulate concept discovery as searching for the conditioning input that jointly maximizes output coherence, LoRA-induced distinctiveness, and subspace alignment. Even with a clear objective, however, optimizing it over an open-ended input space is prohibitively expensive, since reliable evaluation of coherence and distinctiveness requires repeated diffusion rendering. Crucially, we observe that an input need not be rendered to determine whether it is promising. Its alignment with the learned LoRA subspace provides a lightweight signal for localizing promising candidates before visual verification. Based on this insight, we develop a two-stage framework for text-to-image LoRAs. Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES) uses render-free subspace alignment to explore candidate prompts and retain a compact shortlist, while Paired Visual Identification (PVI) renders only these candidates and compares the LoRA and base-model outputs to identify those exhibiting coherent and distinctive generation behavior. This design enables efficient and reliable discovery of previously unknown concepts encoded in LoRA adapters.

</details>


### [267] [Beyond Equation Search: Conjecture-Guided Discovery with SCOPE and ClosureBench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18938)
*Yuxiao Hu,Qian Li,Ding Wang,Siheng Chen,Linfeng Zhang,Jinyue Yan,Yuntian Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SCOPE是一个多科学家智能体框架，以结构化猜想（conjecture）为核心组织科学发现过程，结合方程建模、主动实验与基于证据的猜想修订；配套提出了ClosureBench基准（60个跨5个领域的PDE闭合关系发现任务）和三项新指标（Evidence Faithfulness、Mechanism Insight、Experimental Effectiveness）。框架在方程精度与发现质量上均优于固定数据和交互式基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归以优化候选方程为中心，但方程拟合好并不能决定其背后的科学猜想应保留、修正还是摒弃——因为同一猜想可有多种数学实现，精度相近的方程可能蕴含不同解释。需要将发现范式从“优化单一表达式”转向“发展并检验指导方程的科学猜想”。同时，现有方程发现基准主要评估恢复出的表达式，对证据链与科学结论缺乏评估。

Method: SCOPE由M个科学家智能体并行维持各自的研究轨迹，每个智能体持有结构化猜想H（机制解释、相关变量、定性关系、可检验预测、候选方程族、证据摘要），通过猜想引导的符号回归（接入PySR和LLM-SR）、问题驱动的针对性分析与可执行实验设计（设定OpenFOAM的初始/边界/工况条件而非直接选局部态），基于程序化判定的预测结果（支持/反驳/不确定）修订猜想；每隔两轮进行圆桌讨论交流猜想、精英方程与证据并各自投票，得票一致则提前终止，否则更新各分支的开放问题继续探索。ClosureBench将未知代数闭合关系嵌入已知PDE系统中，智能体通过OpenFOAM设置实验条件获取数据，评估指标包括NMSE/Acc以及新增的EF（证据忠实性）、MI（机制洞见）、EE（实验有效性）。

Result: 在ClosureBench的60个任务上，SCOPE在三种LLM骨干下均取得最高的ID/OOD方程精度与Acc@1%得分，例如Kimi K2.6骨干下ID NMSE达4.15e-4、Acc@1% 39.44%，OOD NMSE 1.29e-3；EF/MI/EE同样超过ReAct和Reflexion-Exp。在12次仿真调用时SCOPE即达到33.33% ID Acc@1%，超过两个基线的最终值；多猜想分支相对Single-Conjecture消融的优势随证据积累扩大至7.78个百分点。在JFM风机尾流闭合关系的真实案例中，SCOPE恢复出差分高斯形式表达，MI达0.8095，ID NMSE 2.11e-4。流致结晶任务的报告对比显示，SCOPE识别了竞争性机制、边界温度窗、可分离输入效应与剪切-温度空间混叠等基线未充分覆盖的机制。

Conclusion: SCOPE与ClosureBench表明，提升自动发现能力的关键不仅在于预测模型精度，还在于智能体如何提出问题、检验解释并修订科学理解——即将方程视为检验猜想的工具而非目的。当前局限在于ClosureBench聚焦于模拟PDE系统中的局部代数闭合关系，未来工作可拓展至微分型、非局部与历史依赖型闭合关系，以应对更丰富建模与实验证据的需求。

Abstract: Most symbolic regression methods optimize candidate equations, but improving an equation's fit does not establish whether its underlying scientific conjecture should be retained, revised, or rejected. A conjecture may admit multiple mathematical realizations, and similarly accurate equations may imply different explanations. This motivates a shift from refining individual expressions to developing and testing the conjectures that guide them. We introduce SCOPE, a framework that sustains multiple conjecture-driven research trajectories. Multiple scientist agents independently pursue conjectures through equation modeling, question formulation, and active experimentation, then exchange evidence to revise their conjectures and research directions. Their findings are consolidated into a scientific report linking models, conclusions, and evidence. Existing equation-discovery benchmarks primarily assess recovered expressions, leaving the evidence and scientific conclusions established through the investigation underexamined. We therefore introduce ClosureBench, an interactive benchmark of 60 closure-discovery tasks across five scientific domains. ClosureBench focuses on closure-discovery tasks to give equation discovery a concrete scientific purpose. Each task embeds an unknown algebraic relation in a known PDE system, where agents control experimental conditions in OpenFOAM to acquire new data for equation discovery. Beyond equation accuracy, ClosureBench proposes three metrics to evaluate the discovery process: evidence faithfulness, mechanism insight, and experimental effectiveness. Compared with diverse baselines, SCOPE achieves higher equation accuracy on both ClosureBench and a real-world scientific discovery case, while producing more accurate, reliable, and effective scientific discoveries.

</details>


### [268] [The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18933)
*Robert Tjarko Lange,Luca Grillotti,Yutaro Yamada,Rujikorn Charakorn,David Ha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了"The Agentic Scientist"，一个端到端的分布式编排框架，用于人类研究者与编码智能体协作进行计算科学研究。系统将研究分解为任务起草、想法生成、规划、沙盒实验、结果聚合、基线和消融构建、事后分析以及论文撰写八个阶段，每个阶段由元控制器管理的并行编码智能体执行，并通过基于rubric的自验证机制把关。一篇使用该系统的合作论文已被ALIFE 2026接收；在Doc-to-LoRA、进化优化和RL微调等完全自主研究任务中亦展示了发现能力。70次跨任务、跨模型、跨harness的实验表明，科学自主性不仅依赖基础模型能力，也依赖跨智能体的编排层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代编码智能体虽能长时间自主执行代码任务，但完全自主的研究智能体存在"想法半径有限"和"短视的爬山式搜索"问题。本文旨在弥合"能写代码的智能体"与"能开展可靠研究的系统"之间的系统级差距。

Method: 构建了一个四阶段工作流：(1) 任务起草，从研究简报或手工规范生成可执行任务规范；(2) 平行调查，多个worker通过beam search探索假设，每个周期由构思智能体生成typed contract、执行智能体edit-evaluate-verify循环，并通过rubric门控验证；(3) 回顾证据生成，运行受控基线、消融和事后分析；(4) 扎根的论文撰写，每条声明映射到证据，含独立审计智能体和AI审阅。元控制器管理worker间共享行为和rubric验证。另开发了autoillustrate用于可编辑科学图表生成。

Result: 主要成果包括：(1) 一篇关于误差扩散(ED)的合作论文被ALIFE 2026接收为会议报告，扩展ED到多类分类(在MNIST达96.7%，CIFAR-10达61.7%)和强化学习(ED-PPO)；(2) Doc-to-LoRA案例研究：发现query-conditioned LoRA组合将多针检索准确率从51.7%提升至98.0%；(3) CMA-Anchored LearnedES进化策略，在7个未见Brax任务中5个匹配或超过CMA-ES；(4) RL微调：GRPO验证准确率从52.7%提升至71.9%；(5) autoillustrate在PaperBananaBench上以37.5 vs 25.0得分超越PaperBanana；(6) 70次跨任务跨模型实验显示，最终性能与AI审阅分数正相关(r=0.44)，4/5任务中存在此关联。

Conclusion: 研究表明，当编码智能体嵌入到保留证据并测试声明的编排工作流中时，它们可以贡献于科学研究。系统的科学自主性不仅取决于基础模型能力，还取决于跨智能体的编排层。当前局限包括：任务起草尚不完全鲁棒、文学搜索仅在撰写阶段进行、rubric验证仅与明确枚举的标准一样全面、评估限于计算机器学习领域、autoillustrate成本和运行时间较高。伦理上要求沙盒执行、来源追溯、披露智能体贡献及人类对最终声明负责。

Abstract: Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is driven by a meta-controller that manages parallel research agents and enforces rubric verification at each stage. This design enables the same orchestration layer to be reused across heterogeneous domains with different execution environments, agentic coding harnesses, and evaluation metrics. Our system can be used across a spectrum of autonomy: either as a co-scientist tool or to perform end-to-end scientific investigation. Within the co-scientist setting, we leveraged a development version of our system to submit a single research paper, which got accepted for publication at ALIFE 2026. We further apply The Agentic Scientist fully autonomously to open problem-solving tasks in machine learning, and demonstrate the system's capability of scientific discovery across different domains of computational research. Our ablations suggest that reliable scientific autonomy depends not only on base model capabilities, but also on the cross-agent orchestration layer.

</details>


### [269] [Why Static Skill Inconsistencies Do Not Equate to Runtime Risks: A Behavioral Analysis of LLM Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18927)
*Fengrui Fan,Huahao Wang,Jingyi Fang,Yutao Hu,Yueming Wu,Deqing Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM Agent技能包中跨工件契约不一致问题，开展系统性实证研究，揭示静态缺陷数量无法可靠预测运行时风险，运行时影响取决于执行可达性与智能体后置行为（接触后的响应能力）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Agent广泛依赖外部技能资产（文档、脚本、配置文件），但多工件技能包常存在跨工件契约不一致。现有静态审计技术虽能发现契约冲突，却无法反映真实运行时表现，导致从业者缺乏评估缺陷技能实际风险的严格证据。

Method: 1. 构建575个技能数据集（GitHub 488个 + SkillBench 87个），通过迭代定性分析建立三层契约不一致分类法（环境层、文档间层、文档-代码层）；2. 开发SkillAudit静态审计工具，采用确定性检查器与LLM检查器结合，经人工验证确认1182项不一致；3. 构建49个可验证任务WildSkills，每任务配备确定性验证器与最小化修复的FixedSkill；4. 在NoSkill、OriginalSkill、FixedSkill三种条件下，使用三种LLM（Claude Haiku 4.5、Qwen3.6-35B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash）进行对照实验；5. 对441条配对执行轨迹进行精细行为编码分析（Exposed、Follow、Recover、Bypass等类别）。

Result: 1. 契约不一致普遍存在：67.4% GitHub技能、64.4% SkillBench技能至少存在一处不一致；2. 修复不一致可提升所有模型的任务效果，但增益因模型而异（Haiku +0.136、Qwen +0.085、DeepSeek +0.023）；3. 智能体在97.1%的运行中接触技能（Haiku 98%、Qwen 93%、DeepSeek 100%），接触率接近但修复增益差异显著；4. 模型差异主要体现在接触后行为：Haiku、Qwen、DeepSeek分别在30%、24%、12%的运行中将错误延续至失败，而DeepSeek在56%的接触运行中成功恢复；5. 失效集中于over_promise类型（41/97次Follow失败）；6. 唯一带来净评分收益的响应类别是Follow→failure（+0.366分），其他类别贡献近乎为零；7. BothFail控制类不均匀，约1/3为部分修复、1/3为真正难度底线、1/3修复反而恶化结果。

Conclusion: 静态不一致数量是运行时风险的不良代理。运行时影响由执行可达性与智能体后置行为共同决定，而非静态不一致数量。技能质量评估应超越静态发现计数，转向按运行时风险分层，并结合执行证据。未来技能质量工具应识别哪些不一致更可能进入执行并导致Follow、Recover或Bypass行为，而非平等对待所有不一致。技能作者应优先处理文档-代码边界尤其over_promise类型；技能使用者在正确性或延迟敏感场景中应优先选择已验证且一致的技能。

Abstract: LLM agent frameworks heavily rely on external skill assets to standardize tool usage, encode operational workflows, and supply executable runtime resources. Despite their widespread adoption, multi-component skill packages frequently suffer from cross-artifact inconsistencies, where documentation, scripts, and configuration files specify conflicting behavioral constraints. Although static auditing techniques can uncover such contractual discrepancies, static defect volume cannot reliably reflect real-world agent performance degradation. This gap leaves practitioners without rigorous evidence to assess the practical risk of flawed agent skills. This paper presents a systematic empirical study to demystify the runtime implications of skill inconsistencies. We conduct large-scale auditing over 575 community and benchmark skills, yielding 1,182 manually validated contract inconsistencies. We further build a controlled evaluation pipeline with 49 executable agent tasks and three representative LLMs across NoSkill, OriginalSkill, and FixedSkill experimental settings. Through fine-grained behavioral analysis of 441 paired execution trajectories, we quantify the actual performance impacts of resolved defects.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [270] [CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19128)
*Yuxiang Lai,Jike Zhong,Chengzhi Liu,Ming Li,Haonan Wang,Xiaofeng Yang,Liang Zhao,Youbao Tang,Ruixi Fan*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: CLASHarness是一个可控制、可验证的生成框架，用于在计算机使用场景中构建多智能体冲突任务，并附带600个多轮任务的基准测试。通过分层场景规划与八步验证微流水线，保证每个任务在构建时即可解。在15个前沿模型上的评估揭示了三大核心瓶颈：弱模型盲信误导信息、解决冲突比发现冲突更难、协议执行（尤其是关闭动作）失败率居高不下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的计算机使用基准多假设一致、合作的环境，而真实的多智能体协作中常出现对等智能体或子智能体报告过时状态、发出矛盾指令、争夺共享资源与权限的情况，导致严重的协调失败。手动编写任务无法规模化，无约束LLM生成则会产生叙事漂移、答案泄漏和不可满足的评分规则等问题。因此需要一个可控、可验证的多智能体冲突基准。

Method: 提出分层分阶段生成流水线，将场景合成分解为宏场景规划与验证式微执行的三层八步流程：Tier 1建立多智能体全局世界；Tier 2进行阶段性规划与八步式轮次合成；Tier 3执行一致性审计、多模态精炼与排他性门控渲染。关键设计包括：(1)视觉事实先承诺（v★）后渲染；(2)直接由参考执行轨迹编译混合代码与语义评分器；(3)模块化插件系统（23个插件、16种冲突机制）与声明式种子规范；(4)双重自纠机制（确定性代码归零LLM成本修复格式错误，有界语义重试处理逻辑缺陷），总API调用随轮次线性扩展（每10轮包约95次调用）。

Result: 基于20个操作域、20个场景种子、60个包、600个可执行多轮冲突回合构建基准，共含7,970个预提交视觉资产与3,760个混合评分检查（3,284个为必要）。在15个前沿模型（Claude Opus 5、GPT-6 Astra、Gemini系列等）上的评估发现：(1)整体通过率低（最佳GPT-6 Astra仅28.7%，平均得分66.8%），即使是顶级模型也在超过58%的关闭动作（释放锁、交接任务）上失败；(2)要求主动解决冲突的回合比仅调查的回合通过率低17.1个百分点（差异中差异−18.2 pp）；(3)测试时推理投入与通过率呈负相关（ρ=−0.697），弱模型（如Gemini 3.5 Flash）将71.8%–90.5%的输出token用于推理却陷入循环，每解决一个任务的成本高达39.54美元；(4)视觉证据不可省略——移除图像将使所有模型的通过率崩塌至11.1%–13.1%。计算成本跨度极大：每解决一个任务从0.72美元（GPT-5.6 Luna）到39.54美元（Gemini 3.5 Flash）。

Conclusion: CLASHarness既是一个诊断多智能体冲突解决瓶颈的诊断平台，也是面向下一代VLM后训练的可扩展数据引擎。其分层流水线、可验证性设计和模块化插件架构保证了任务的可解性，而评估结果指明了三个需要突破的核心能力：视觉证据锚定（区分强弱模型）、主动状态修复（比发现冲突更难）、以及协调协议的关闭执行（普遍薄弱，是跨模型族的协同瓶颈）。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems to automate complex computer-use workflows, yet existing benchmarks mostly assume consistent, cooperative environments. In contrast, real-world collaboration rarely runs on consistent information: peer or sub-agents frequently report outdated states, issue contradictory instructions, or compete over shared permissions and files, forcing agents to check others' outputs and verify ground truth in the environment. Evaluating such conflict resolution remains challenging: manual authoring cannot scale across complex systems, while unconstrained LLM generation produces narrative drift, answer leakage, and unsatisfiable rubrics. We introduce CLASHarness (Conflict-Loaded Agent Scenario Harness), a controllable framework for generating verifiable multi-agent conflicts in computer use, with a benchmark of 600 multi-round tasks. By combining hierarchical scenario planning with an eight-step verified micro-pipeline, CLASHarness pre-commits decisive visual facts before rendering and compiles hybrid code and semantic graders directly from executed reference trajectories, guaranteeing every task is solvable by construction. Evaluating 15 frontier models on CLASHarness reveals three core bottlenecks. First, when sub-agent outputs conflict with the environment, weaker models blindly follow misleading information, whereas stronger models inspect visual evidence to verify ground truth. Second, resolving conflicts is much harder than finding them: while agents can spot inconsistencies, actively fixing system state drops task success significantly. Third, coordination protocols remain a universal bottleneck: even frontier models fail over 58% of closing actions, often forgetting to release shared locks or hand off tasks. CLASHarness provides a scalable, verifiable foundation for building reliable multi-agent systems.

</details>


### [271] [Why Do Agent Teams Fail Across Boundaries? A Failure Taxonomy for Agent-to-Agent Systems with Private States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19342)
*Sarath Shekkizhar,Prathyusha Jwalapuram,Zixuan Ke,Vaidehi Patil,Jiayu Wang,Srijan Bansal,Trong Huy Nguyen,Dingfeng Jiang,Dongqi Liu,Ruochen Zhao,Wei Lu,Giuseppe Carenini,Mohit Bansal,Shafiq Joty*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究跨边界（cross-boundary）的智能体对智能体（A2A）系统失败模式。不同于传统多智能体系统假设单一协调者、共享工作空间、单一主体（principal）的设定，A2A 系统中每个 agent 代表不同的主体，拥有独立的环境、文档、工具与凭证，通过 A2A 协议通信，利益可能合作、混合或对抗。作者基于 2500+ 次运行、488 个跨八个领域（法律、CRM、安全、商业等）场景的真实追踪日志，构建出涵盖 20 种失败模式的 A²-Failures 分类法，分为四类：发现与委派（D）、接地与一致性（G）、验证（V）、行为与保真（C），并指出三大跨模型与配置稳健的发现：1) agent 仅根据 prompt 中提及的对端名字发起联系而非主动探测目录；2) agent 永不主动核验对端陈述；3) 仅评估最终产物会掩盖内部协调、验证与行为断裂，倡导对每个 agent 针对各自主体目标进行独立评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着个人智能体兴起，不同主体委托的 agent 开始通过 A2A 协议相互通信，跨组织、跨信任边界。现有智能体基准与失败研究都假设单一环境、单一主体，无法刻画因利益不一致、信息不对称、私有状态带来的失败。一旦 agent 失败，后果落在其代表的主体身上，且失败原因跨越任一方都无法完全观察的边界，必须重新定义失败、研究跨边界的失败模式，才能安全部署 A2A。

Method: 1) 设定：A2A 系统由多个隔离 Docker 容器中的 agent 构成，每个 agent 代表一个 principal（AGENTS.md），通过四个 MCP 工具（a2a_list_agents、a2a_send_message、a2a_wait_for_messages、a2a_task_complete）通信。实验沿四个维度（scenario、protocol、harness、model）独立变化。2) 三层评估：L0 环境状态、L1 产物正确性、L2 主体对齐行为。3) 八个场景族覆盖合作—混合动机—竞争三档谱系，包括 Legal（224）、CRM（48）、风险管理（19）、Evolving Enterprise（83）、Software Engineering（46）、Security（10）、Commerce（32）、Contract Negotiation（26），总计 488 个场景。4) 哈纳与模型：Claude Code（Opus-5、Sonnet-5）、Codex（GPT-5.6-Sol、GPT-5.6-Terra）、Cursor（Grok-4.6）。5) 追踪到分类法的工作流：自动打标 → 人工扎根理论开放编码 → 与 L0/L1 日志对账。

Result: 构建 A²-Failures 分类法，含 20 种失败模式，按交互生命周期分为四类：(1) D 发现与委派（5 种）：D1 沉默主导、D2 措辞驱动发现、D3 能力未自识、D4 委派不整合、D5 范围扭曲；(2) G 接地与一致性（5 种）：G1 误向请求、G2 提交流程中仍有请求未回、G3 虚假缺失、G4 跨主体记录不一致、G5 谱系断裂；(3) V 验证（4 种）：V1 不复检、V2 基于未核验证据提交、V3 发现矛盾却无所作为、V4 推不出应有结论；(4) C 行为与保真（6 种）：C1 虚假主张、C2 对话中泄露私有状态、C3 指令凌驾证据、C4 串通对抗机制、C5 探测环境漏洞、C6 时效失效。三大稳健发现：1) 接不接触对端主要由 prompt 是否点名决定、目录是否列出并不够；2) 没有任何 trace 中 agent 主动重新获取文档/重新查询以核验对端主张；3) 仅评估最终产物会让 lead agent 受奖而隐藏内部崩溃——更换 lead agent 比更换 specialist 显著改变分数。同时给出五个测量含义：lead 偏见遮蔽协调失败、决定性能力掩盖路由断裂、能力与行为正交、运输协议 vs 消息语义、拓扑效应被掩盖、已匹配条目仍可能未实现联合价值（合同谈判中 73/175 个匹配的协议在 Pareto 上未尽）。论文附录把每个模式映射到 MAST 分类法上，标记为 shared/sharper/reframed/native 四种关系，以说明此分类法并非简单复刻。

Conclusion: A2A 系统的安全与效果评估必须超越单一最终产物分数，必须独立评估每个 agent 对其所代表主体的指令与机制的遵循程度。仅靠 L1 rubric 与 deterministic 检查会系统性掩盖发现、验证与行为三类失败。需要在协议层引入结构化能力、来源与披露字段，而非依赖 prompt 工程；信任必须建立在机制强制的验证之上（例如自动 diff、规则竞价）而非单个 agent 的主观可信度。给出对各失败模式的干预层次建议（model、harness、protocol、mechanism）。

Abstract: Agents are increasingly interacting with other agents that act for different principals -- people or organizations on whose behalf they work -- e.g., a buyer's personal agent negotiating with an enterprise's seller agent. In such agent-to-agent (A2A) scenarios, each agent has its own environment and holds information and authority that the other cannot see. Moreover, the interests of each agent may be aligned (cooperative), partly aligned (mixed-motive), or opposed (competitive). Existing multi-agent system failure studies assume only one orchestrator, shared workspace, or principal. We ask how A2A systems fail when these assumptions are removed. We study more than 2,500 recorded runs of A2A systems built from different agent harnesses and models, spanning 488 scenarios across eight families (legal, CRM, security, commerce, etc.). From these traces, we derive $A^2$-Failures, a taxonomy of 20 A2A failure modes in four categories: (i) discovery and delegation, (ii) grounding and record consistency, (iii) verification, and (iv) conduct and fidelity. Three observations hold across the harnesses, models, and scenarios studied: (1) Agents match tasks to peer names mentioned in the prompt rather than actively searching for available peers; (2) Agents never fact-check each other unprompted; (3) Scoring only the final output rewards the lead agent while hiding internal coordination, verification, and behavioral breakdowns. Our study makes a case for comprehensive evaluations where agents are scored individually against their own objectives in addition to task outcome. We release the run logs behind the taxonomy at this https URL .

</details>


### [272] [XferAgent: Cross-Agent Experience Transfer for Self-Improving LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19581)
*Weihao Li,Jun Bai,Shijie Chen,Qincheng Lu,Xinyu Wang,Ziyang Song*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出XferAgent框架，旨在解决异构LLM智能体之间跨智能体经验迁移的难题，通过构建本地与共享经验图谱，结合经验调和、任务条件路由及本地-共享经验整合机制，使不同框架的智能体能够协同复用彼此的成功策略与失败教训。实验在GAIA、ALFWorld和MBPP三个基准上验证了其相对于现有记忆基方法的优越性，并展示了跨框架迁移与渐进式自我改进能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于记忆的LLM智能体自改进方法（如Reflexion、ExpGraph、ReasoningBank等）主要支持单个智能体内部的本地经验复用，无法有效利用其他智能体已积累的经验；而现有的跨智能体共享方法（如AgentKB、FoT）由于智能体间推理协议、工具和执行历史的差异，难以对齐和有效复用异构经验。核心挑战在于如何调和来自异构智能体的经验，并在新任务中识别对目标智能体有用的共享经验。

Method: XferAgent采用三阶段流水线：(1) 跨智能体经验调和——通过schema约束的映射器将执行结果转化为经验（含成功/失败类型、嵌入、来源及结果统计），在共享经验图中根据类型与余弦相似度阈值θ_rec进行合并，对于多个候选者要求最高相似度领先次高者至少δ_rec以避免不可靠合并；(2) 任务条件经验路由——目标智能体本地计算任务与共享节点的余弦相似度并选取锚点，通过个性化PageRank在共享图中传播相关性，结合留一智能体计算的跨智能体结果分数（带探索奖励）和贡献者支持分数，经min-max归一化加权和后构建连通路由子图；(3) 本地-共享经验整合——分别从本地图和路由子图选取候选，构建临时融合图，应用PPR重排序，将跨智能体结果分数作为先验与本地统计融合（贝叶斯式），综合任务相似度与融合结果分数（同样含探索奖励）通过权重λ_u平衡进行最终选择；任务执行后仅更新被选中经验的统计量，并将新执行转化为可复用经验。

Result: 在GAIA测试集（301题）上，XferAgent使用GPT-5.6 Luna达到52.16%整体准确率，超越无记忆基线（48.17%）和最强记忆基线ExpGraph（47.51%）；使用Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct达到29.57%，优于所有基线。在ALFWorld（274任务）上达到88.7%的任务成功率，超过所有方法。在MBPP（60任务）上达到53.3%的通过率，同样最优。在GAIA验证集（165题）的三轮重复评估中，累计准确率从56.36%提升至74.55%。跨框架迁移实验（SmolAgents与OWL混合）显示，智能体数从2增至8时，平均准确率从40.4%提升至55.0%。消融实验显示，仅用本地经验准确率降至46.84%（−5.32pp），去除基于结果的排序降至48.17%（−3.99pp），证明各组件的必要性。

Conclusion: XferAgent为异构LLM智能体间的经验级协作提供了有效框架，通过结构化的经验调和、任务条件路由与本地-共享整合，弥补了现有方法在跨智能体经验对齐与选择方面的不足。实验验证了其在多领域（问答、交互任务、代码生成）的适用性，以及通过经验演化实现的渐进式自我改进能力。然而也存在局限：缺乏形式化隐私保证、当前仅支持文本经验、源任务与评估任务的语义重叠未被完全排除。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can reuse experience from prior task executions to improve performance on subsequent tasks. Although existing methods enable cross-agent experience sharing, differences in agents' execution histories and task requirements make shared experiences difficult to reuse effectively.
