Result: 在TRAJECT-Bench（Pi harness）上，Qwen3-8B经HPD训练后自主任务成功率（TS）从基模型的3.09%提升至22.98%，运行时合规率（RC）从19.90%提升至49.23%。Full HPD在TS、F1、Step-SR、RC上均优于T-only消融（22.14% vs 18.20% TS），Harness验证教师动作带来主要增益，联合控制状态监督进一步提升完成率。跨基准迁移测试中（BFCL v4 92个案例无需重训练），Full HPD达到21.74% TS。模型规模研究表明HPD在0.6B至32B的Qwen3各尺寸上均稳定改善TS和F1。该方法在不同harness（ReAct、Compiler、OpenCode）和不同骨干（Llama3-8B、Gemma4-12B、Qwen3-MoE）上均可适配。

Conclusion: HPD通过将运行时控制语义显式化为特权监督目标并联合训练三视图，有效弥合了模型策略与harness执行语义之间的策略不匹配。该方法将可执行的运行时契约转化为密集监督信号，使模型在保持原生harness接口的前提下学习每个决策边界的harness兼容动作，为智能体训练提供了一条将执行语义而非仅任务动作作为对齐目标的路径。

Abstract: Deploying a general-purpose model as an agent means running it inside a product-specific runtime harness that decides which actions are executable, how state advances, and when the loop may terminate. Ordinary trajectory supervision shows which action was taken but leaves the runtime semantics behind that action implicit. We introduce Harness Policy Distillation (HPD), which makes these runtime control semantics an explicit training target alongside actions to align the harness policy. HPD replays reference trajectories through the harness to recover the runtime semantics that are implicit in ordinary trajectory data, and represents them as control documents at each model-call boundary. These documents provide privileged information for a teacher to generate actions, while harness verification ensures that the resulting targets are executable under the runtime contract. We jointly train a shared model on the runtime semantics recovered from control-state privileged information and native history, thereby internalizing these semantics into the model policy. At deployment, the trained model uses the original harness interface without requiring the control document or any additional supplement. On TRAJECT-Bench with the Pi harness, Qwen3-8B trained with HPD reaches 22.98% autonomous task success and 49.23% runtime compliance, against 3.09% and 19.90% for the unadapted model. Harness-verified teacher actions substantially improve the native deployment policy, while joint control-state supervision provides further gains in task completion and runtime compliance. HPD turns executable runtime semantics into dense supervision for learning harness-compatible actions at each decision boundary.

</details>


### [309] [Long-Horizon RL Needs Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20256)
*Kai Ruan,Jinghao Lin,Tao Chen,Ziqi Zhou,Qianshan Wei,Zihe Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究长视野强化学习中，针对仓库级代码问题解决任务，提出了一种结合Muon优化器、单轨迹异步采样、token平均损失、截断重要性采样以及长度和工具错误惩罚的联合训练方案，在两个模型家族上均优于SPO基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野智能体（如代码问题解决）需要在推理、工具使用和环境反馈间进行长程协调，且只能从稀疏的二元结果奖励中学习。异步采样导致rollout与learner策略之间存在策略滞后，不同长度的轨迹需要适当的加权方式，且更新时rollout仍在进行。作者旨在研究在这种条件下，优化器选择（Adam vs Muon）以及各训练组件如何影响学习效果。

Method: 方法核心是一个"单一rollout异步训练配方"：(1) **Muon优化器**：基于谱范数解释，对隐藏权重矩阵应用近似正交化（Newton-Schulz迭代），embedding/output head等使用AdamW；(2) **SPO++框架**：在valid token上做跨轨迹优势标准化，采用DAPO Clip-Higher（ε_low=0.2, ε_high=0.28）；(3) **辅助奖励塑形**：长度惩罚（响应超过2048 token累积至-0.5，按比例封顶）和工具错误惩罚（-0.5），两者在每轮合并后clip到[-0.25, 0.25]加入token优势；(4) **截断重要性采样（TIS, C=2）**：修正训练/采样策略差异；(5) **Token级损失聚合**：用总有效token数归一化（区别于序列级平均）。在R2E-Gym上训练MiniCPM5-2B和Qwen3.5-4B，对比Adam vs Muon，以及各组件的消融。

Result: 在两个模型家族（MiniCPM5-2B和Qwen3.5-4B）的选定训练运行中：完整配方（含Muon + SPO++ + 辅助惩罚 + TIS + token级聚合）在训练后期均达到比SPO基线（无论使用Adam还是Muon）更高的训练成功率。Muon相对Adam带来明显增益，完整配方相对SPO+Muon的进一步提升说明优化器与全套配方组件需协同。消融实验表明：去掉长度惩罚后token级与序列级聚合在不同seed下表现差异较大；部分Adam配置在训练后期出现成功率下降。

Conclusion: 将Muon优化器与单轨迹异步更新、重要性修正及辅助奖励塑形相结合，在两个模型家族的仓库级问题解决评估运行中均获得了高于SPO基线的训练成功率，验证了Muon在长视野、稀疏奖励、异步采样条件下的有效性，并强调了优化器选择与训练配方各组件协同设计的重要性。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents must coordinate reasoning, tool use, and environment feedback over extended interactions. Learning from sparse outcome rewards requires weighting trajectories of different lengths and updating the policy while rollouts are still being collected. We examine a single-rollout asynchronous recipe combining Muon, token-averaged loss, truncated importance sampling, and auxiliary length and tool-error penalties. Single-rollout sampling allows asynchronous learning without waiting for multiple trajectories for the same issue. We study optimizer choices and recipe components for repository-level issue resolution across two model families. The evaluated training runs show higher training success with the full recipe than with the baselines.

</details>


### [310] [Retrieval Over Training: Similarity search-based Model Selection for Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20243)
*Christos Panourgias,Roberto Stanzione,Adrien Petralia,Themis Palpanas,Paul Boniol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RAMSAD，一种基于检索的时间序列异常检测模型选择框架。该方法通过相似度搜索在知识库中检索最相似的历史时间序列，并转移其检测器性能推荐，避免了训练专用元学习选择器。RAMSAD在分布内（ID）和分布外（OOD）设置下均优于现有基线，尤其是在OOD场景中以远低于全集成的成本达到与之相当或更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测领域没有单一最佳检测器，不同数据集需要不同的检测器。现有的模型选择方法（尤其是基于元学习的分类/回归方法）在分布外（OOD）场景中性能显著下降，且计算成本高。本文旨在开发一个既无需训练元学习器、又能鲁棒处理域偏移的模型选择框架。

Method: RAMSAD的核心思想：将异常检测器选择问题转化为非参数的相似度检索问题。具体包括三个核心组件：（1）相似度空间构建——使用时序基础模型（TSFM，如Chronos2）将时间序列分片编码为向量，并可选地对齐时间序列与文本描述以增强OOD语义；（2）段到序列的聚合——通过结合平均检索距离与候选序列被检索的频率，将片段级检索匹配转化为序列级排序；（3）检测器推荐——根据检索到的top-k邻居的预存性能档案（VUS-PR矩阵），对各检测器平均性能进行排序选择。框架还支持可选的多模态语义对齐模块以应对OOD域偏移。

Result: 在TSB-AD基准（870个时间序列，32个检测器）上的实验显示：RAMSAD在ID设置下VUS-PR达到0.74，优于所有现有基线（包括最佳模型选择器SATZilla的0.69）。在OOD设置下，RAMSAD的下降幅度最小（-0.16），且选择N=10个检测器时比最佳OOB集成（OE）快4.7倍且准确率更高。RAMSAD选择延迟仅20毫秒，是所有模型选择器中最快的。TSFM嵌入空间优于原始空间，对齐的TSFM空间在OOD中提升明显。RAMSAD还可作为RAG组件提升LLM选择性能（VUS-PR从0.28-0.42提升至0.66-0.72）。

Conclusion: RAMSAD建立了基于检索的模型选择作为时间序列异常检测中强大且高效的范式，证明了无需训练选择器即可实现优秀的检测器选择。其核心要点是：RAMSAD是总体最优方法，尤其在选择小型集合时在ID和OOD中均达到SOTA；TSFM基础检索空间优于原始空间，对齐TSFM空间在OOD转移中带来最大提升。未来的工作方向包括扩展到多变量时间序列、时序概念漂移以及查询远离所有覆盖域的情况。

Abstract: Anomaly detection is a fundamental task for time-series analytics, with important implications for the downstream performance of many applications. Despite the large number of anomaly detection methods proposed in the literature, recent benchmark studies have shown that no single detector performs best across highly heterogeneous time series. Therefore, a practical and scalable solution is to develop a model-selection method that, for a given time series, selects the anomaly detector most likely to perform well. Nevertheless, the model selection approaches proposed in the literature suffer from a significant drop in accuracy when applied in Out-of-Distribution (OOD) settings. In this paper, we tackle the aforementioned limitation and propose RAMSAD, a retrieval-based framework for model selection in time-series anomaly detection. Given a new time series, our method queries a knowledge base of previously observed instances, retrieves the top-k most similar series, and transfers detector recommendations from their performance profiles. The framework can operate with standard similarity measures as well as embedding-based representations. Our results show that RAMSAD outperforms existing baselines in In-Distribution (ID) settings and is the most robust selector in OOD, where, when selecting a small subset of detectors, it matches or exceeds ensembles that run the entire detector pool, at a fraction of their cost. Overall, we demonstrate that similarity-based retrieval constitutes a strong and efficient foundation for model selection in time-series anomaly detection.

</details>


### [311] [From Spectral to Frobenius: When Muon Loses Its Spectral Implicit Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20112)
*Yongtao Wu,Mahdi Mansouri,Zhenyu Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明实际Muon优化器（使用有限次Newton-Schulz迭代和正稳定常数）会选择Frobenius最大间隔方向而非理想化Muon的光谱最大间隔方向，并在特定条件下可恢复光谱最大间隔行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的隐式偏差分析仅针对理想化的Muon（精确正交化），而实际Muon使用有限次Newton-Schulz迭代和正稳定常数ε，其是否保持光谱最大间隔偏差尚不清楚。本文旨在回答这一核心问题：实际Muon是否保留了其理想化版本的光谱最大间隔偏差？

Method: 1. 在线性可分二元分类设置下分析实际Muon的隐式偏差；2. 利用局部线性化引理将稳定化Newton-Schulz更新表示为梯度下降加上可求和扰动；3. 利用轨迹稳定性引理证明Muon与梯度下降参数轨迹有界距离；4. 解析地解耦Newton-Schulz迭代次数、稳定常数、多项式选择对隐式偏差的影响；5. 通过构造对数增长的迭代次数来恢复光谱最大间隔行为。

Result: 1. 固定有限K≥1和ε>0时，实际Muon选择Frobenius最大间隔方向（无动量和EMA/Nesterov动量均成立）；2. 仅去稳定化（ε=0）而不增加迭代次数可导致既非Frobenius也非光谱最大间隔的方向；3. 三次多项式在K→∞时可恢复光谱最大间隔，五次多项式则不一定；4. 对数增长的K_t=⌈2log(t+2)/log(3/2)⌉可使三次多项式恢复O(1/log(T+1))的光谱间隔差距；5. 五次多项式需随机梯度相关稳定方案才能以O(loglog(T+2)/log(T+1))恢复。

Conclusion: 理论分析和实验均证明实际Muon（有限Newton-Schulz迭代+正稳定化）在可分线性分类中具有Frobenius最大间隔隐式偏差，而非理想化Muon的光谱最大间隔偏差。稳定化是主导因素；仅通过去除稳定化无法恢复光谱偏差。光谱最大间隔偏差可通过迭代次数对数增长来恢复。这些发现对理解实际Muon优化器的渐近行为具有实际意义。

Abstract: Prior work on implicit bias shows that gradient descent selects the Frobenius max-margin direction on linearly separable problems, whereas Fan et al. (2025) established spectral max-margin behavior for spectral-norm steepest descent methods, including idealized Muon with exact orthogonalization. In practice, however, Muon approximates orthogonalization using finite Newton-Schulz iterations and a positive stabilization constant. We prove that these implementation choices cause Muon to select the Frobenius rather than the spectral max-margin direction in linear classification with separable data. We also establish this behavior for both exponential moving average and Nesterov-style momentum. The key technical ingredient is a summable perturbation argument showing that the resulting parameter trajectories remain at bounded distance from those of gradient descent. We then disentangle the roles of Newton-Schulz iteration count, the stabilization constant, and the Newton-Schulz polynomial, revealing distinct asymptotic behaviors, including directions that achieve neither Frobenius nor spectral max-margin. Finally, we show that Muon can recover its spectral max-margin bias with Newton-Schulz iterations growing logarithmically over training.

</details>


### [312] [Rethinking Prediction Horizons: Decoupling Model Queries from State Updates in Few-Step MeanFlow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20071)
*Tinglan Wang,Haixu Liu,Shaobo Chen,Nuo Qian,Qi Gao,Kai Wen,Yu Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将MeanFlow中的模型查询区间（prediction horizon）与状态更新时长（state update duration）解耦，发现在CIFAR-10等数据集上延长预测时域在中点改善FID但在起点恶化FID，且该效应依赖于进入查询的输入状态分布。冻结的四查询规则可在不重新训练或增加查询次数的情况下降低FID，但与查询起始时间调整和网格控制相比并非通用最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeanFlow预测区间平均速度，但传统的少步采样将模型查询的区间与状态更新的时长耦合在一起，这隐藏了一个可独立调整的推理控制量。本文旨在解耦这两个量并系统研究预测时域作为独立推理控制的特性。

Method: 通过固定模型、更新网格和查询次数，仅改变预测时域 $h_k$（保持更新时长 $\delta_k$ 不变），在7个独立训练的CIFAR-10检查点上进行位置扫描和因子实验。采用冻结的四查询规则（$\rho=(1,1,2,1)$）和温和规则（$\rho=(1,1,1.2,1)$），并与查询起始时间（Start）和状态网格（Grid）控制进行匹配预算比较。

Result: 1) 在CFG=2的CIFAR-10上，延长中点预测时域从0.25到0.50在7/7检查点上改善FID（均值增益2.023），但延长起点时域恶化FID。2) 前缀CFG干预实验显示中点时域增益从0.109增至1.308 FID，表明存在对输入状态分布的敏感性。3) 冻结规则在9/9 CIFAR历史检查点、3/3 ImageNet-256和4/4 AFHQv2检查点上有FID增益。4) 但在匹配预算下，历史CIFAR测试中查询起始时间调整更优，且在两个ImageNet公共模型上时域分配不带来额外FID增益。

Conclusion: 预测时域是少步MeanFlow中一个位置敏感且状态敏感的独立推理控制维度，但并非通用最优方案。有效的预测时域取决于查询位置和进入状态分布，且相对于其他时间控制（查询起始、状态网格）何时为最优取决于具体的配置和评估器。

Abstract: MeanFlow predicts interval-average velocities, but conventional few-step sampling ties the interval queried from the model to the duration of the state update. We separate these two quantities at inference, fixing the model, update grid, and number of queries while varying the prediction horizon. Our central finding is that the horizon response depends on both query position and the states entering that query. Across seven independently trained CIFAR-10 checkpoints at classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale 2, a longer horizon worsens FID at early steps but improves it at the midpoint. To probe whether query time alone determines this response, we fix the midpoint query and current/subsequent guidance while changing only earlier CFG. In held-out factorial outcomes on five previously studied checkpoints, the mean midpoint horizon benefit increases from 0.109 to 1.308 FID, indicating sensitivity to the incoming-state distribution. A frozen four-query rule reduces mean CIFAR-10 FID by 2.023 without retraining or extra queries, including gains on five checkpoints trained after rule selection. A milder rule also improves mean FID by 1.041 on a stronger frozen grid, with fixed-rule FID gains on the evaluated public ImageNet-256 and AFHQ checkpoints. However, matched-budget calibration favors query-start shifting in historical CIFAR tests, and the tested Horizon allocation adds no FID benefit beyond Grid+Start on two public ImageNet models. Thus, prediction horizon is a distinct, position- and state-sensitive inference control, but not a universally preferred one.

</details>


### [313] [Trainable at Depth, Solvable at Small Size: What the Loss Surface of a Polynomial Activation Dictates for Designing, Initializing and Training Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20069)
*Xiuyi Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种多项式激活 f(z)=z+λz³，叠加单位球投影与恒等残差路径的设计，同时在两个尺度上进行分析：作为深层堆叠可在MNIST上无归一化训练至100层，作为小模型其平方损失构成多项式系统可被精确求解。小规模模型的损失曲面几何（临界点理想的维数与度）直接解释大规模模型的可训练性，给出设计、初始化与训练故障的判读规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络为何可训练，损失曲面是何形状？已有研究多在端到端训练曲线层面讨论激活与归一化，缺乏一个能在代数上"可解"的小尺度模型来精确读取几何，并反过来指导大规模训练的设计。论文试图用同一个构造同时回答两个尺度的问题：小尺度精确求解损失曲面的临界集合，大尺度实证哪些设计决策使深度堆叠可训练。

Method: 构造：多项式激活 f(z)=z+λz³，clamp 截断后做逐样本 ℓ2 投影至单位球，配合无归一化的恒等残差分支 hⁱ=φ(Wⁱhⁱ⁻¹)+hⁱ⁻¹。解构为可独立开关的多项式/投影/归一化/残差四类组件，对照 ReLU/GELU/SiLU/SwiGLU/GeGLU/BatchNorm/LayerNorm/RMSNorm 等进行MNIST网格扫描。小尺度方面：保留未截断多项式，对平方损失的临界方程在 Q[θ,r] 中构造理想，借助 Gröbner 基计算 dim I 与 |I|，并用 Bertini 做数值不可约分解以验证 H2（损失在分量上为常数）与 H3（Hessian零特征值数等于分量维数）。

Result: 深尺度：激活选择是二阶量；纯立方在深度10比 ReLU 低约3.86点，投影恢复其中1.59点，单位球投影使20层崩溃的堆叠在30层追平 ReLU 至0.29点内，但50层时所有设计都坍塌至约10.28%。无归一化恒等残差将100层多项式从10.99%提升至94.50%，300层仍保持93.80%，修复的是饱和而非梯度消失；在残差求和后做归一化会抵消其增益。所有 GLU 变体在深度10无归一化时均停在11.35%（偶然水平）。小尺度：1个隐藏单元的未归一化多项式平方损失临界理想 dim=0、|I|=5，仅1个实解即原点（输出为零的网络，L=∑y_a²=1.2500，Hessian 非零且不定，特征值 ±3.1600 的鞍点）；加入投影或残差均使 dim I 增至5，Bertini 在26个不可约分量上验证 H2 与 H3 全部成立；残差臂可将两样本损失压到 1.40e-27 而普通臂被限制在不可达的下确界 100/169≈0.5917。

Conclusion: 激活函数是二阶设计，尺度控制是首要设计：恒等残差路径与 ℓ2 投影是两类互补的参数无关机制（前者承载信号跨越尺度增长，后者将尺度钳制在单位球），二者不可在求和后再归一化。可解小模型直接开出三条处方：① 控制尺度且绝不在残差求和后重归一化；② 残差分支以零初始化，使堆叠从深度无关的恒等映射起步，输入梯度范数为解析值 √32=5.6569，规避常规尺度 5.40×10³ 倍的偏差；③ 训练失败应通过隐藏层范数诊断为饱和而非梯度消失。Gated 单元被视作同一种尺度失败模式的二级实例。多项式激活本身相对于现代部署的逐点非线性并无精度优势。

Abstract: What makes a deep network train, and what shape is its loss surface? We answer both with one construction at two scales: a polynomial activation f (z) = z + {\lambda}z 3 , clamped and projected onto the unit sphere, plus an unnormalized identity path. As a deep stack it trains to one hundred layers on MNIST with no normalization machinery; as a small model its square loss is a polynomial system we solve exactly. The small scale explains the large one: it prescribes how to design, initialize and train the stack.

</details>


### [314] [On the Convergence of Semi-Gradient TD: A Mean Field Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20014)
*Haruki Settai,Tadashi Kozuno,Shinji Ito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从平均场视角研究带函数近似的半梯度时序差分(TD)学习的收敛性。作者针对两层神经网络识别出一种稳定性机制:熵诱导的松弛能够支配移动的Bootstrap目标敏感性。在条件ρτ>Lp下,证明了参数分布指数收敛到唯一不动点,并量化了相对无正则Bellman解的偏差。该机制还推广到熵正则化的离策略软Q学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半梯度TD在函数近似下因bootstrap目标与参数分布共同演化而产生非保守向量场,可能导致不稳定甚至发散。现有对非线性半梯度TD的收敛性分析有限:线性情形下结果成熟,但神经网络平均场意义下的特征学习与末次迭代收敛性无法同时获得。作者希望填补这一理论空白,识别并证明一种简单稳定性机制。

Method: 1. 采用两层神经网络在平均场参数化下刻画半梯度TD动力学,引入Langevin噪声得到McKean-Vlasov扩散(连续时间群体动力学)。2. 定义冻结目标函数F(μ,ν)=H(μ,ν)+R(ν)-τH(ν),其中H为平方TD误差,R为二次正则,τH为熵正则。3. 提出两个关键假设:混合光滑性(Assumption 1,常数Lp控制目标律对在线律变化的敏感性)和Gibbs族的统一对数Sobolev不等式(Assumption 2,常数ρ)。4. 引入Gibbs响应映射T(μ)=argmin_ν F(μ,ν),证明在条件ρτ>Lp下:(a)冻结目标最优性间隙G(t)指数衰减(Lemma 1);(b)T在Wasserstein距离下是压缩映射,具唯一不动点ν*(Lemma 2)。5. 两步结合得W_2(ν_t,ν*)指数收敛(Theorem 1)。6. 量化ν*相对真实值函数V^π的偏差(Theorem 2):‖V_{ν*}-V^π‖≤√(τ/(1-γ)·KL(ν^π‖g_{λ,τ}))。7. 将整套分析推广至熵正则化软Q学习(Theorem 3、4)。8. 用Bakry-Émery给出ρ的下界估计,通过tanh等光滑激活验证常数有限。

Result: 1. 定理1:在ρτ>Lp下,半梯度TD的连续时间平均场参数律(ν_t)在W_2下指数收敛到唯一自洽平衡ν*,W_2(ν_t,ν*)≤√(2ρτ)/(ρτ-Lp)·√G(0)·e^{-(ρτ-Lp)t}。2. 定理2:‖V_{ν*}-V^π‖_{L²(d^π)}≤inf_ν[(1+γ)/(1-γ)·‖V_ν-V^π‖+√(τ/(1-γ)·KL(ν‖g_{λ,τ}))];在可实现情形简化为‖V_{ν*}-V^π‖²≤(τ/(1-γ))·KL(ν^π‖g_{λ,τ})。3. 定理3、4:同样的收敛机制对软Q学习成立,并量化相对软Bellman不动点的偏差。4. 在MinAtar的Asterix/Breakout上数值验证:正则化(尤其二次正则)抑制长期发散,Asterix上无正则TD在长期恶化,而Breakout上原本稳定。5. 与现有结果比较(Cai 2019, Zhang 2020, Agazzi&Lu 2022, Asadi 2023):本文首次在平均场半梯度TD中同时获得特征学习与末次迭代收敛保证(但限于正则化动力学)。6. 关键数值门槛:λ>D_Δ B_2+L_p 保证具体条件下ρτ>L_p。

Conclusion: 本文为带神经网络函数近似的半梯度TD学习提供了第一个同时具备特征学习和末次迭代指数收敛性的理论保证,核心机制是熵/二次正则化诱导的松弛必须足够强(ρτ>L_p)以压倒自举目标的移动敏感性。同时给出正则化偏差的显式定量界(以KL散度表达),揭示稳定训练与逼近无正则Bellman解之间的权衡。同一框架可推广到软Q学习,表明该机制在控制扩展中同样适用。局限性:仅在连续时间群体动力学层面分析,未涉及有限宽度、时间离散化及随机梯度收敛保证。

Abstract: Semi-gradient temporal-difference learning is a core algorithmic component of reinforcement learning, but bootstrapping with function approximation generally induces a non-conservative vector field and can lead to instability. We analyze this effect for two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime and identify a simple stability mechanism in which entropy-induced relaxation dominates the sensitivity of the moving bootstrap target. Under this condition, we prove exponential convergence to a unique fixed point and quantify its bias relative to the unregularized Bellman solution. We also show that the same mechanism extends to entropy-regularized off-policy control through soft Q-learning.

</details>


### [315] [Provable Transformer Context Compression for In-Context Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20004)
*Yajie Zhao,Yingjun Mo,Zhiyong Wang,Bo Tang,Chao Xu,Fang Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对Transformer在上下文强化学习（ICRL）中进行固定策略TD评估时的上下文压缩问题，刻画了精确复现TD迭代所需的最小上下文维度为Krylov维度，并给出了近似误差的极小极大上界与下界，最后证明了压缩计算可通过预训练学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICRL理论构造通常需保留完整交互历史，上下文规模Θ(dN)随交互长度线性增长，在长视野或高维问题中成为瓶颈。本文旨在回答：复现TD计算本质上需要多少上下文？当上下文不足时，最优近似误差是多少？

Method: 1) 设计两阶段固定参数线性注意力编码器：阶段1将N条原始转移压缩为n个状态token并计算经验统计量(Â, r̂)；阶段2通过Arnoldi递归发现k_L个Krylov方向并编译为压缩上下文。2) 证明精确复现前L次TD迭代所需最小上下文维度等于Krylov维度k_L。3) 对受限上下文维度m < k_L，提出sample-and-hold策略并证明其达到极小极大最优误差Θ(γ^m max{1, 1/(m(1-γ))})。4) 设计校准目标函数证明执行器参数可通过梯度下降从任意初始化全局收敛到目标TD更新规则。5) 提供连续编码器的Θ(nk_L)寄存器下界与完整实验验证。

Result: 1) 精确上下文维度 = Krylov维度k_L；固定参数网络可在前向传播中直接生成k_L-token上下文，复用内存Θ(nk_L)，达到最优常数因子2以内。2) 最优最坏情况近似误差为Θ(γ^m max{1, 1/(m(1-γ))})，sample-and-hold达到上界，匹配下界。3) 校准目标函数在有效参数空间中是全局强凸二次函数，预训练梯度下降以线性速率全局收敛到目标参数(C*, W*) = (-I, I)。4) 实验验证：12-block循环任务上k_L=12时上下文减少88.7-94.6%；mountain car上维度32的上下文比LSTD统计量小6-7倍；数值秩方法在精确秩满的任务上实现有效压缩。5) 实验同时表明标准Transformer瓶颈编码器无法自动发现Krylov结构，误差随m不下降。

Conclusion: 本文首次刻画了上下文强化学习中复现TD计算所需的内在上下文和内存复杂度，建立了精确复现阈值（Krylov维度）和受限上下文下最优近似误差的精确表征，并证明了执行器可通过预训练全局学习得到，为Transformer在RL中的内存高效部署提供了理论基础。开放问题包括：联合训练的编码器能否达到相同保证、策略控制下的扩展、以及多项式执行器深度下界对数的底数优化。

Abstract: Transformers can perform in-context reinforcement learning without parameter updates. However, existing theoretical constructions often require context sizes that grow with the number of sampled transitions, leading to increasing memory costs in large-scale problems. This raises a fundamental scalability question: how much context is intrinsically necessary to carry out such learning? We answer this question for fixed-policy TD evaluation. We show that, with a shared linear decoder, the minimum context dimension required to exactly reproduce the first $L$ TD iterates is the Krylov dimension induced by the sampled transitions. When the available context dimension $m$ falls below this threshold, exact reproduction is no longer possible. In this regime, we characterize the optimal approximation error and show that it decays as $\Theta(\gamma^m\max\{1,1/(m(1-\gamma))\})$ where $\gamma$ is the discounting factor. Moving from representation complexity to actual memory cost, we characterize the optimal retained memory for exact continuous representations as $\Theta(nk_L)$ and show experimentally that on a sampled task whose exact rank is full but whose numerical rank is small, a context accurate to $10^{-2}$ is $88.7\%$ smaller than the sparse sufficient statistics of TD. Finally, we establish the learnability of the shared executor through pretraining by proving global convergence of an auxiliary objective over effective attention parameters under suitable task diversity. Experiments across diverse TD evaluation problems validate parameter recovery and the predicted context--accuracy tradeoff.

</details>


### [316] [Empirical Boundaries of Reservoir Computing for Few-Shot Sequence Pattern Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19997)
*Mario Mallea,Angela Nebot,Franscisco Mugica*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对回声状态网络（ESN）及其变体在少样本序列到序列（seq2seq）模式任务上进行了系统的实证分析，映射了储层计算相对于SOTA模型的性能边界，并提出了G-ESN和共享读出机制等改进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer存在二次计算复杂度问题，且注意力机制主要作为联想短时记忆，缺乏持久状态动力学来跟踪长期依赖。ESN作为随机化RNN具有线性时间复杂度和内存效率优势，但在离散序列建模领域研究不足。本文旨在系统评估ESN在不同序列模式任务上的性能边界，与SOTA模型进行公平对比。

Method: 1. 在STREAM基准上评估多种ESN变体：LESN、ESN、LeakyESN、提出的G-ESN（数据依赖的自适应泄漏积分器）和Deep ESN。
2. 分析两种输入权重初始化策略：IID（独立同分布均匀分布）与ON（正交初始化）。
3. 对Deep ESN提出共享读出机制（跨层共享W_out）并与传统拼接读出对比。
4. 采用Ridge回归闭式解进行训练，在5个随机种子上对比LSTM、GRU、Transformer、EST和S6等模型。
5. 将任务分为状态跟踪任务（如Copy、Adding、Bracket）和关系路由任务（如S-copy、Sorting、SMNIST）两大类进行系统评估。

Result: 1. ON初始化对ESN处理独热编码数据至关重要，能使网络在准线性稳定状态下运行，在Copy、Disc. patt.等状态跟踪任务上接近完美表现，优于SOTA。
2. 提出的G-ESN（数据依赖泄漏积分器）在Adding问题上实现近零误差（0.006），是唯一能解决Bracket匹配任务的储层模型。
3. Deep ESN的共享读出机制在SMNIST、Adding、S-copy、Bracket等结构任务上优于传统拼接读出。
4. ESN变体在状态跟踪任务上整体优于SOTA，但在S-copy、Sorting、SMNIST等关系路由任务上劣于S6和Transformer。
5. ESN采用高效闭式MSE训练即可在分类任务上与基于交叉熵反向传播的SOTA模型竞争。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了储层计算的关键设计原则：输入权重初始化（ON优于IID）、保持准线性状态机制对记忆任务至关重要、数据依赖的门控机制（G-ESN）能扩展储层容量解决标准ESN无法处理的任务、深度储层的共享读出可作为结构正则化器。未来工作将探索这些洞见在NLP内容感知任务、与线性注意力框架的结合以及连续位置编码上的应用。

Abstract: Efficient sequence modeling remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning. Despite the success of Transformers, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have recently re-emerged as efficient alternatives. Particularly, Echo State Networks (ESNs) offer a compelling framework of randomized RNNs that have been extensively studied for time-series forecasting and dynamical systems. This paper presents an empirical analysis of distributional, architectural, and optimization variants of ESNs evaluated on few-shot sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) pattern tasks. These synthetic tasks utilize discrete symbol sequences, characterized by delays, inactive phases, and triggered markers to isolate and evaluate memory and pattern recognition capabilities. The minimality of these tasks is crucial to understand the strengths and limitations of machine learning models. Furthermore, when the input signal utilizes a one-hot encoding, ESN dynamics are governed strictly by their weight distributions, offering an ideal lens through which to study reservoir computing. Our findings map the performance boundaries of ESNs relative to state-of-the-art (SOTA) models. We show that preserving a linear state regime is vital for memory tasks, such as pattern completion or simple copy. We propose a data-dependent modulation mechanism for nonlinear input injection into the reservoir (G-ESN). G-ESN functions as a statistical filter capable of solving tasks that conventional ESNs cannot (the adding problem and bracket matching). Finally, for Deep ESNs, we evaluate a shared readout mechanism across layers that outperforms conventional concatenated readouts on structural tasks, including selective copy, sorting problem, and bracket matching.

</details>


### [317] [Safe-FCL: Continual Risk Awareness and Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation for Federated Continual Learning of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19968)
*Shuaijie Ma,Yongkang Hu,Yu Cheng,Jiuan Zhou,Yi Xie,Yushuo Zhang,Zhaoxia Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Safe-FCL提出了一种用于大语言模型联邦持续学习的安全防御框架，通过持续风险感知（CRA）和细粒度安全聚合（FGSA）两个机制，解决恶意客户端更新模式随任务演进而变化时的长期安全防护问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦微调LLM时恶意客户端更新会危害全局模型安全。随着联邦任务从单任务扩展到持续学习，恶意更新模式会随训练任务演进而演化，现有防御方法（如FLAME、LASA、Safe-FedLLM）的固定风险检测器无法识别新型威胁，持续适应新风险又会导致对历史风险识别能力的灾难性遗忘，且客户端级别的风险加权缺乏对模型模块可疑更新的针对性控制。

Method: Safe-FCL框架集成两个核心机制：（1）**持续风险感知（CRA）**：从序贯任务的LoRA更新轨迹中学习新兴恶意模式，通过从历史输入激活中构建正交保护基U_{k,ℓ}，在约束检测器参数更新时抑制沿历史重要特征方向的参数变化（公式2），以缓解遗忘；利用suspicious-update比例ρ̂_i推导客户端安全分数s_i。（2）**细粒度安全聚合（FGSA）**：提取LoRA模块更新的幅度特征z_{i,m}和方向特征u_{i,m}，与历史统计（μ_m, v_m, d_m）对比计算幅度/方向偏差a_{i,m}和b_{i,m}（公式6），结合CRA安全分数通过风险感知门控g_{i,m}=exp[-λ(1-s_i)D_{i,m}]（公式7）实现模块级聚合调控，最后用β速率在线更新历史统计（公式9）。

Result: 在5个安全任务（物理/隐私/财产欺骗/数字安全+OOD歧视）的Llama-3.1-8B联邦LoRA微调实验（10客户端含3恶意，每轮3客户端×10本地步×100轮）中：完成4任务后全局模型Rule/MD-Judge平均分达92.54%/95.98%，超越SOTA方法0.41/0.64个百分点；风险检测器AA提升2.01%，New ACC提升7.11%，OOD任务ACC达96.60%（领先最强基线4.93%）；OOD全局模型Rule提升2.33%、MD-Judge提升0.47%；消融实验证实CRA主要贡献于历史任务安全（如Task 3 Rule+2.80%、MD-Judge+1.40%），FGSA对OOD贡献尤为显著（+5.60%），二者具有互补性；交替任务序列下仍保持领先（Rule+2.38%、MD-Judge+1.04%）。

Conclusion: Safe-FCL通过CRA的持续风险检测器适应与历史保护子空间机制，和FGSA的客户端风险评分与模块级历史偏差结合的风险门控机制，有效解决了联邦持续学习中恶意更新模式演进带来的长期安全挑战，在全局模型安全、风险识别能力和OOD泛化方面均超越现有SOTA方法，验证了跨任务风险感知与模块级安全调控的互补价值。局限性：当前评估局限于文本模态的受控恶意客户端设置，未涵盖多模态、自适应攻击和协同恶意客户端等更复杂对抗场景，且随客户端和任务规模增长，评估分支优化、检测器适应和历史特征保留的计算与存储开销会增加。

Abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables large language models (LLMs) to learn collaboratively from distributed client data, but malicious client updates can compromise global model safety. As federated tasks evolve, changing malicious update patterns challenge the ability of existing defenses to maintain reliable risk detection over time. To address this challenge, we propose Safe-FCL, a framework integrating continual risk awareness with fine-grained safety aggregation for federated continual learning of LLMs. Specifically, the Continual Risk Awareness (CRA) mechanism learns emerging risk patterns across sequential tasks and constrains detector updates using a protective subspace derived from historical features, mitigating forgetting of previously learned malicious patterns while adapting to new risks. To translate risk awareness into aggregation-level safety control, the Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation (FGSA) mechanism combines client-level risk assessments from CRA with module-level deviations from historical update behavior to adaptively regulate aggregation contributions, suppressing potentially malicious updates while minimizing unnecessary restrictions on benign updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Safe-FCL outperforms current SOTA methods, improving global-model Rule and MD-Judge scores in federated continual learning by 0.41% and 0.64%, respectively, while increasing average risk recognition accuracy by 2.01%.

</details>


### [318] [Learning Graph Energies for Finite-Time Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19946)
*Amartya Banerjee,Xingyu Xu,Caroline Moosmüller,Harlin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"有限时间能量学习"方法，通过仅优化Metropolis-Hastings采样器的接受能量（在固定初始化、提议核和退火调度下），利用耦合接受/拒绝延续的梯度估计器，使生成器在固定步数内的终端分布更接近目标分布。在12个二元自旋目标上超越平衡正确能量和标量调优能量，在MOSES上将GEM的FCD降低3.7–10.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于能量的模型在平衡态下准确，但采样器在固定步数后停止时，平衡正确的能量未必能产生最准确的样本。终端分布取决于初始化、提议核、接受决策和退火调度，而非仅取决于平衡律。需要在有限采样预算下优化接受能量以提升终端样本质量。

Method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) 固定判别器目标——优化接受能量以最大化终端样本的判别器奖励，采用非饱和生成器目标J(θ;ψ)=E_{X_K~q_{θ,K}}[r_ψ(X_K)]；(2) 耦合延续梯度估计——借鉴Arya等人的耦合MH导数方法，对每个选定的接受/拒绝决策分别延续至步K并共享未来随机数，其终端奖励差加权局部接受概率的梯度；(3) 子采样决策——以包含概率p_it选取决策，使用Horvitz-Thompson逆包含概率加权，给出对∇_θJ的无偏估计。算法1交替执行能量更新和判别器重新拟合，生成阶段仅使用学习到的能量进行单轨迹采样。

Result: 在精确有限状态实验（6/8自旋Ising模型，K=4,8,16）：在全部18个参考设置和18个新目标设置中，学习能量均比平衡正确能量H获得更低的终端总变差；在14-15个设置中优于数值调优的标量倍数βH。在MOSES分子生成上，两系数能量组合E_θ=c[V_G+ω(V_G-V_pre)]在K=125时使FCD降低5.7%（2.508→2.366）、有效性提升5.42点；在K=250时FCD降低10.5%（2.044→1.829），但有效性降低0.78点（低于预设非劣效边界）；在K=1000时FCD降低3.7%（1.561→1.504），有效性几乎不变。联合准则（配对FCD检验+非劣效边界）在K=125和1000满足，K=250原始比较未满足。释放规则部署下在K=250和1000满足联合准则。

Conclusion: 有限时间能量学习通过仅修改接受能量（固定其他组件）可有效改善有限步采样质量，理论无偏梯度估计器由耦合MH延续支撑。精确状态研究证明超越标量温度控制的有限时间改进；MOSES实验证明该方法能适配预训练GEM势函数以降低FCD。但存在局限：长视野（K>64）下学习效果退化，分子量距离在K=1000下恶化，K=250的原始比较未通过联合决策准则，协议变更影响了部分预算的解释。

Abstract: Energy-based models can represent distributions over discrete structures such as molecular graphs, but an energy that is accurate at equilibrium need not yield accurate samples when the sampler stops after a fixed number of steps. We introduce finite-horizon energy learning, which adapts the acceptance energy of a Metropolis--Hastings sampler to the distribution it returns after a prescribed number of steps, with initialization, proposals, and annealing schedule held fixed. For graph generation, a frozen pretrained model supplies initialization and proposals, and a learned energy governs acceptance. A training-only discriminator scores completed samples, and coupled continuations of the accepted and rejected branches of a proposal give an acceptance-gradient estimator that is unbiased for a fixed discriminator under stated conditions, without equilibrated negative samples or differentiation through discrete states. Generation uses the learned energy in the original single-trajectory sampler, without discriminator evaluations or reranking. On twelve pairwise binary targets with exactly evaluated terminal laws, learned energies have lower median terminal total variation than the equilibrium-correct energy in every tested short-horizon setting, and than its numerically tuned scalar multiple in most settings. On MOSES, a learned two-coefficient combination of pretrained Graph Energy Matching (GEM) potentials lowers FCD by 3.7--10.5\% relative to scale-calibrated GEM at matched sampling steps, with validity gains at the shortest budget and a sub-point validity trade-off at higher budgets.

</details>


### [319] [Universal Sample-Based Embeddings of Higher-Order Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19899)
*Radovan Haluška,Christopher Solinas,Nathan R. Sturtevant,Martin Schmid,Michael Bowling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一框架，通过样本驱动的编码器将任意高阶对象（分布、函数、图）映射为固定大小的嵌入向量，并利用领域特定的解码器提供训练信号。该框架在三种截然不同的对象类型上得到验证，且单一训练模型能泛化到训练中未见过的家族成员。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法针对特定类型的高阶对象（分布、函数、图）设计，缺乏跨对象类型的通用表示框架。当对象的闭式参数化未知时，主流方法需要为每个对象单独训练模型，无法获得紧凑、可复用的向量表示，限制了在下游任务（如POMDP求解、神经算子学习）中的通用性。

Method: 框架包含三个组件：对象采样器（从对象生成样本集）、参数化拟合模型（作为解码器）、训练损失。编码器（基于多阶段集合Transformer）将样本集映射为排列与基数不变的嵌入向量θ；解码器以θ为条件重建对象。训练中将每个样本集一分为二：一半用于生成嵌入，另一半用于评估解码器，迫使嵌入捕捉可迁移的结构。编码器与解码器联合训练。具体实现上：分布用Flow Matching或归一化流解码器；函数用点积融合的集合编码器加交叉注意力解码器；图用ALLO（Laplacian表示）的变体作为解码器，节点表示与对偶变量均由嵌入预测。

Result: 在三类对象上均验证了单一模型可表示整个家族并泛化至未见成员：①分布（甜甜圈族）：仅32个样本即能恢复中心、半径、宽度，嵌入前4个主成分解释99.5%方差，并支持嵌入空间内的线性插值与算术运算；②函数（多项式、阻尼振子、Lotka-Volterra）：相对L2误差低至0.0047（L-V），微分算子可从函数嵌入映射到导数嵌入，ODE算子可从参数直接预测解嵌入，并可扩展至32维状态空间；③图（随机树、无标度网络、权重网格世界）：n=10时ROC-AUC达0.99，几何结构清晰区分边与非边，权重恢复Spearman相关系数约0.93。

Conclusion: 该工作是首个可跨高阶对象类型学习紧凑表示并泛化至整个家族的统一框架。其核心优势在于：单一架构通过样本接口服务不同对象类型；通过选择合适的解码器可继承领域原生能力（如采样、密度估计、谱重建）；嵌入作为紧凑向量可作为下游神经网络的输入/输出（如POMDP信念跟踪、神经算子）。实际应用包括Belief Embedding Tree Search（BETS）中的分布嵌入以及计算生物学中的跨尺度推理。

Abstract: Neural networks operate naturally on finite-dimensional vectors, yet many problems require reasoning about higher-order objects such as distributions, functions, and graphs. Such objects capture relationships within a ground set and rarely admit an explicit compact representation. Moreover, we typically want a compact representation not of a single higher-order object but of an entire family of such objects, including members unseen during training. While a few approaches exist for particular object types, none is designed to work across object types. We propose a unified framework that represents any higher-order object as a fixed-size embedding vector learned over a family of such objects. An encoder maps an object, seen only through a finite set of samples, to an embedding, and a domain-specific decoder supplies the training signal by modeling the object conditioned on that embedding. Since the encoder works only from samples, one architecture serves different object types. Because the decoder is a model already suited to single instances of the object type, the framework inherits that model's native operations and inductive biases. We instantiate the framework on distributions, functions, and graphs. In each case we show that a single trained model represents an entire family and generalizes to members unseen during training. Furthermore, we demonstrate the downstream utility of these embeddings: interpolating distributions in embedding space, solving differential equations in embedding space, and predicting unseen edges from a graph's embedding.

</details>


### [320] [Neural Wasserstein Splines: Representation-Invariant Second-Order Priors for Trajectory Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19878)
*Amartya Banerjee,Harlin Lee,Caroline Moosmüller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Neural Wasserstein Splines (NWSP)，一种基于样条的样本方法，用于从非配对快照中学习连续群体曲线，并通过 Wasserstein 平滑先验进行正则化。其核心创新是引入了一种表征不变的群体加速度代理，避免了传统粒子加速度惩罚对粒子表示的依赖，并在多个合成和单细胞基准测试中取得了具有竞争力的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从非配对快照推断群体动力学时，不同粒子表示可能导致相同的边际曲线却有不同的加速度代价。现有的二阶正则化方法（惩罚粒子加速度）依赖于任意的建模选择，缺乏表征不变性。本文旨在解决这一根本问题。

Method: 1. 生成器网络将潜在变量映射为三次样条控制点，无需数值积分即可在任何时间采样。2. 通过岭回归将生成器速度投影到标量势梯度的有限字典上，并对这个依赖于测度的投影进行时间微分。3. 引入"移动 Gram 修正"以正确微分投影，得到内在 Wasserstein 加速度的有限维代理。4. NWSP-N 扩展通过单独的速度拟合目标自适应学习势函数。5. 理论证明了固定字典下的表征不变性、估计误差的稳定性界和傅里叶逼近速率。

Result: 在 16 个数据集-协议设置中，NWSP 在 11 个设置中排名前二，NWSP-N 在 9 个设置中排名前二。加速度惩罚在 16 个设置中的 13 个改进了未正则化的样条。在 Circular Gaussian 等数据集上显著优于最佳基线（MFM：0.886 vs 0.427）。学习势函数大幅降低加速度估计误差（如 d=2 时从 0.705 降至 0.062）。实验证明移动 Gram 修正是必要的（周期密度曲线上将 L² 加速度误差从 0.577 降至 7×10⁻¹⁴）。

Conclusion: NWSP 提供了一种表征不变的二阶先验用于群体动力学推断，在理论上和实证上都表现出色。学习势函数扩展（NWSP-N）进一步提高了加速度估计精度，但代表了不变性在理论上不覆盖。该方法直接生成样条粒子路径，无需跨时间最优传输耦合，可在全支持数据上训练，为单细胞轨迹推断提供了强大的新工具。

Abstract: Population dynamics are often observed only as unpaired snapshots, which leave the evolution between measurements underdetermined. Second-order regularization can constrain it, but a penalty on the accelerations of sampled particles is a prior on joint particle paths, and different particle representations of the same marginal curve can have different acceleration costs. We therefore introduce Neural Wasserstein Splines (NWSP), a sample-based method that learns a continuous population curve under a Wasserstein smoothness prior. A neural network maps latent variables to the control points of a cubic spline in time, so samples at any time come from the spline basis without numerical integration. We project the generator's velocity onto gradients of a finite dictionary of scalar potentials and differentiate this measure-dependent projection in time, obtaining a finite-dimensional surrogate for the intrinsic Wasserstein acceleration, trained jointly with distributional fit losses. For a fixed dictionary and ridge parameter, we prove that the population penalty depends only on the marginal curve and bound its sensitivity to moment-estimation errors. Learned potentials (NWSP-N) sharpen acceleration estimates. On various synthetic and single-cell benchmarks, NWSP is highly competitive with transport and flow-based methods, ranking in the top two in 11 of 16 settings. The penalty improves on an unregularized spline in 13 of 16 settings and, while competitive with a particle-acceleration penalty, adds provable representation invariance.

</details>


### [321] [Memory-Efficient Subspace Optimization with Residual Correction: From Momentum SGD to Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19844)
*Sifan Yang,Hongyi Tao,Dingzhi Yu,Haomin Bai,Wei Jiang,Silin Gao,Pi Bu,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于残差修正的内存高效子空间优化框架，并将其集成到动量SGD（SMRC）和Muon（PMRC）中，在低秩子空间内维护优化器状态，同时通过正交补空间上的残差梯度修正参数更新。理论证明了SMRC和PMRC（单阶段及多阶段）在标准随机非凸假设下均达到$O(T^{-1/4})$的收敛率，与全空间对应方法匹配，同时将优化器状态内存从$O(mn)$降至$O((m+n)r)$。实验在LLaMA预训练（60M至1.3B）和六个监督微调任务上验证了PMRC的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于梯度主导奇异子空间的内存高效优化方法（如GaLore）在训练后期会因随机噪声主导子空间而无法收敛；而使用随机投影的方法（如GoLore）虽保证收敛但无法利用梯度主方向信息，实证性能较差。将残差修正框架与低秩优化器状态结合，旨在同时获得收敛保证和良好的实证性能，并将该思想推广到Muon优化器。

Method: 1. **残差修正框架**：在低秩子空间$P\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times r}$内维护动量$m_t$，参数更新为$W_{t+1}=W_t-\eta(Pm_t+\gamma(I-PP^\top)G_t)$，其中$\gamma(I-PP^\top)G_t$为正交补空间上的残差梯度修正。2. **SMRC**：将上述框架应用于动量SGD；分析中引入"子空间虚拟迭代"$U_t=W_t-c_\beta\eta v_{t-1}$以解耦动量与残差修正项。3. **多阶段SMRC**：周期性刷新投影基$P_k$，并通过"边界修正"$W_{k+1,1}=W_{k,T_k+1}-c_\beta\eta P_km_{k,T_k}$保持虚拟迭代序列的跨阶段一致性。4. **PMRC**：在低秩动量上应用msign（矩阵符号函数），构成$W_{t+1}=W_t-\eta(P\cdot\text{msign}(M_t)+\gamma QG_t)$；通过"加权动量追踪"分析处理矩阵符号步骤与残差修正之间的混合范数几何（核范数与Frobenius范数）。5. **多阶段PMRC**：周期刷新$P_k$，保持收敛率。6. **实用化PMRC**：引入残差上限（residual cap）稳定早期训练，并用近似SVD替代精确SVD加速基刷新。

Result: 1. **理论结果**：SMRC（单/多阶段）和PMRC（单/多阶段）在标准假设（光滑性、有下界、无偏随机梯度、$P_k^\top P_k=I_r$）下均达到$O(T^{-1/4})$收敛率，匹配全空间动量SGD和Muon的对应收敛率。2. **实验结果**：(a) 合成实验验证残差修正恢复GaLore在噪声主导子空间下的收敛性，多阶段基刷新追踪演化中的主梯度方向。(b) LLaMA预训练（60M/150M/350M/1.3B，C4数据集）：PMRC在所有规模上均取得最低训练和验证损失，在内存高效方法中七个下游基准平均准确率最高。(c) 监督微调（Qwen3-8B/LLaMA3.1-8B/OLMo-2-1124-7B × IFEval/GSM8K）：PMRC在多数设置下优于其他内存高效方法，且峰值GPU内存最低。3. **内存效率**：将优化器状态从$O(mn)$降至$O((m+n)r)$。

Conclusion: 本文提出的残差修正框架成功弥合了基于梯度依赖子空间的内存高效优化方法在收敛保证和实证性能之间的差距。SMRC和PMRC在理论上达到与全空间方法匹配的$O(T^{-1/4})$收敛率，在实践上通过LLaMA预训练和监督微调实验验证了其有效性。虚拟迭代和边界修正等分析工具有效解决了残差修正与子空间优化器状态之间的耦合问题，加权动量追踪分析为混合范数几何下的Muon变体提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Memory-efficient subspace optimization has emerged as a practical approach to reducing the memory cost of LLM training while preserving optimization performance. Previous algorithms typically rely on the leading singular subspace of stochastic gradients, yet the gradient noise may dominate the subspace in later training stages and can prevent convergence. To overcome this limitation, we adopt a residual correction framework, which maintains the optimizer states in the subspace and adds the orthogonal residual gradient to the parameter update. We first integrate this scheme into momentum SGD to develop SMRC, which attains an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for a fixed orthonormal basis, matching that of full-space momentum SGD. Our analysis introduces a subspace virtual iterate to resolve the coupling between the momentum and the residual correction. Furthermore, we extend SMRC to a multi-stage variant which periodically recomputes bases to track the evolving dominant subspace and retains the same rate. Since each basis refresh breaks the consistency of the virtual iterates, we devise a boundary correction approach that aligns them across stages. Beyond momentum SGD, we incorporate our framework into Muon and propose PMRC, which applies the matrix sign to the projected momentum. Through a weighted momentum tracking analysis that accounts for the residual gradient, we establish an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for PMRC, which matches the rate of full-space Muon. We also design a multi-stage PMRC with periodically refreshed bases, which maintains a convergence rate of the same order. Extensive experimental results confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithms.

</details>


### [322] [VaryST: Generalizable Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Beyond the Closed-World Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19813)
*Shengnan Guo,Jinjun Cheng,Xiaowei Mao,Jianhao Zhang,Haochen Lv,Yang Jiang,YiHeng Huang,Yan Lin,Youfang Lin,Huaiyu Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VaryST 提出了一种从零训练的紧凑型时空预测模型，通过动态构建预测上下文来应对变化部署环境下的泛化挑战，包括时间分布演化、空间域变化和观测可用性变化。模型核心包括：基于长期观测推导的节点表示、动态功能支持节点检索、以及以目标为中心的层次上下文解码，并配合基于重要性引导的观测扰动（IGOP）训练策略。在六个真实世界数据集上对十七个基线的广泛实验验证了其在域内精度、零样本/少样本跨时空泛化以及对变化观测可用性的鲁棒性方面的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时空预测模型通常受限于"封闭世界"假设，即训练与部署环境保持一致。然而实际部署中，时间分布会随季节性和长期趋势演变，空间域可能因传感器网络扩展而变化，观测可用性也会因传感器故障和通信中断而改变。这些变化导致模型机制与训练环境紧密耦合，节点特定嵌入、预定义空间支持集以及对持续观测的依赖限制了模型在新环境中的泛化能力。论文提出核心问题：模型能否在部署位置、时间、可用观测变化时仍保持有效？

Method: VaryST 由四大组件构成：(1) 长期观测推导表示（Long-Term Observation-Derived Representations）：对插值后的观测值和差分进行联合块编码，通过轻量级因果 Transformer 提取节点动态表示，结合时间、星期、Laplacian 位置嵌入等先验，避免固定节点嵌入；(2) 动态功能支持节点检索（Dynamic Functional Support Node Retrieval）：使用 RBF 相似度基于当前表示而非预定义邻域动态选择 K 个功能相关支持节点；(3) 以目标为中心的层次上下文解码（Target-Centric Hierarchical Contextual Decoding）：组织全局 token、功能支持 token、近期目标 token 和长期目标 token，并通过 Hop-aware RoPE 旋转编码注入目标相对结构信息；(4) 重要性引导的观测扰动（IGOP）：训练时根据注意力分数掩盖模型最依赖的历史块，促使模型利用替代的时空依赖。

Result: 在六个真实数据集（PEMS03/04/07/08、PM2.5、PEMSD3-Stream）上对 17 个基线的实验表明：VaryST 在四个 PEMS 数据集上 12 步预测均达到最优，MAE 较最强基线降低 3.16%-4.39%；时间泛化方面，PEMSD3-Stream 跨 2012-2017 零样本预测较 STOP 降低 MAE 约 19.4%；空间泛化方面，零样本跨网络转移相对域内参考的退化仅 3.68%-8.89%，而 STD-PLM 退化达 52%-91%；观测鲁棒性方面，在 10%-70% 缺失率下均保持最低 MAE，跨模式和跨缺失率泛化同样优于基线。消融实验验证了长期上下文、Hop-RoPE、全局 token 的关键作用，且在 PEMS07 上以更低推理延迟取得最优精度。

Conclusion: VaryST 通过动态构建目标特定的预测上下文，成功解决了时空预测中训练环境耦合的挑战。其无需预训练、不依赖节点特定嵌入或固定图结构的设计，使其在域内精度、时间分布演变下的零样本泛化、跨空间网络转移以及变化观测可用性条件下均表现出强健性能，为开放世界时空预测提供了一个紧凑而高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal forecasting is fundamental to many real-world systems, yet deployment environments are inherently varying: temporal distributions may evolve, spatial domains may change, and observation availability may shift from training conditions. Existing models are often tightly coupled to their training environments through node-specific representations, predefined spatial support sets, and reliance on consistently available observations, limiting generalization to changing environments. To this end, we propose VaryST, a compact spatio-temporal forecasting model trained from scratch that achieves strong generalization by dynamically constructing predictive context from available long-term observations. To accommodate temporal changes, VaryST derives node representations from long-term histories, capturing current behavior in the context of longer-term patterns. To adapt to spatial changes, it dynamically selects functionally relevant support nodes beyond predefined neighborhoods and integrates their information with recent and long-term target states and global context. To handle varying observation availability, VaryST selectively masks historical patches on which the model relies most during training, encouraging it to exploit alternative temporal and spatial dependencies for accurate forecasting when key observations become unavailable. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets against seventeen baselines show that VaryST achieves strong in-domain forecasting accuracy, substantially improves zero- and few-shot generalization under spatial and temporal changes, and remains robust to varying observation availability.

</details>


### [323] [ProtModernBERT: Compute-Efficient Protein Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19738)
*Alberto Martínez,Natalia Flechas Manrique,Llorenç Espinosa-Portalés,Luc Andrea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ProtModernBERT：一种基于ModernBERT架构改进的蛋白语言模型，通过引入旋转位置编码（RoPE）、FlashAttention、GeGLU激活等现代Transformer组件，在蛋白质序列上预训练。模型仅使用约80-90%的预训练FLOPs即可达到与Amplify-120M和ProtBert相当的下游性能，并显著缩小与ESM2的差距，尤其在随机初始化条件下表现出更强的架构归纳偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白语言模型（如ProtBert、ESM2、Amplify）的架构改进在低算力场景下研究不足，且训练成本对资源受限实验室构成障碍。本文旨在探索是否可以通过现代Transformer架构改进，以更少的算力实现具有竞争力的蛋白序列建模性能。

Method: 1. 基于ModernBERT架构构建ProtModernBERT（140M参数），集成RoPE、FlashAttention、GeGLU等组件；2. 使用UR100P数据集（~364M序列）预训练137B tokens，采用基于集群的验证协议进行超参数选择；3. 在DeepLoc、二级结构预测（CASP12、TS115、CB513、NEW364）、无序预测及ProteinGym零-shot基准上，与ProtBert、Amplify、ESM2对比；4. 引入随机初始化（randinit）实验以解耦架构与预训练的贡献。

Result: ProtModernBERT在仅5.8×10²⁰ FLOPs预训练下，匹配或紧追Amplify-120M和ProtBert（后者需6.0×10²¹ FLOPs），预训练算力减少80-90%；在随机初始化条件下显著优于ProtBert，与ESM2的差距大幅缩小；在ProteinGym零-shot任务中总体Spearman系数0.373与ProtBert（0.376）和ESM2-150M（0.387）相当，并在Organismal Fitness子任务上以0.379超越ESM2的0.305。

Conclusion: 现代架构组件（RoPE、FlashAttention、GeGLU等）在低算力环境下提供比参数规模更重要的强归纳偏置；通过架构优化可使定制化蛋白语言模型训练对资源受限实验室可行；RoPE在本实验预算下未带来一致精度提升但有利于训练稳定性与效率；二级结构预测仍是PLM面临的挑战。

Abstract: Large protein language models provide a powerful framework for learning sequence-function relationships and guiding experimental design. However, architectural improvements are underexplored, especially in low-compute regimes of relevance for resource-constrained research laboratories. We show that the training cost for encoder-only transformer architectures can be reduced by leveraging modern architectural refinements, offering an encouraging performance / compute-efficiency trade-off. We introduce ProtModernBERT, a modernized BERT-style model pre-trained on amino acid sequences, and compare it with ProtBert, Amplify, and ESM2 across a set of supervised structural tasks -encompassing secondary structure prediction, disorder prediction, and subcellular localization- and ProteinGym's zero-shot functional benchmark. We find that ProtModernBERT matches or closely tracks the performance of Amplify-120M and ProtBert with up to 80-90\% reduction in pre-training FLOPs, and narrows the gap to ESM2 when controlling for pre-training. Our analysis using a cluster-based validation protocol for hyperparameter selection and randomly initialized models disentangles the contributions of architecture and data, showing that modern components provide stronger inductive biases that are more consequential than parameter count in low-compute regimes.

</details>


### [324] [What Happens to the Goal? Distinct Failures of Policy Alignment in Goal Misgeneralization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19731)
*Julia Barth,Armin Sommer,Kunvar Thaman,Jannik Schilling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了强化学习中目标误泛化（goal misgeneralization）现象，通过内部机制分析与外部行为观察，识别出三种不同的策略-目标对齐失败模式，并发现目标丢失的深度直接决定了哪种恢复方法有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标误泛化是强化学习中常见但研究不足的失败模式：智能体在分布外表现良好却不追求预期目标。以往研究多停留在行为层面或单个智能体，缺乏对"目标到底发生了什么"的深入理解，也未探索机器人控制领域的相关现象。本文旨在从内部表征层面系统诊断失败机制，并建立诊断深度与恢复方法之间的对应关系。

Method: 论文采用三层递进的诊断方法：1) 线性探针检测目标信息是否在表征中保留；2) 世界编辑（world edits）测量策略对目标变化的反应，结合Fisher信息几何分析内部敏感度；3) 干预实验——"steering"（在h_fc处添加方向向量）和"rewiring"（冻结表征后行为克隆训练新读出层）。在3个Procgen环境和5个机器人任务（共8个环境）上对比目标误泛化（GM）智能体与对照组（Non-GM）。使用Fisher灵敏度Q = ΔᵀFΔ将策略反应的外部KL散度与内部表征位移联系起来，并识别共享竞争轴u_comp。

Result: 论文发现三种本质不同的策略-目标对齐失败：1) 功能目标替代（functional target substitution，如Maze中位置替代目标）；2) 策略捷径（policy shortcut，如Coin中持续向右的动作规则）；3) 线索竞争（cue competition，如Attribute Maze中形状与颜色的拉锯）。目标在网络不同深度丢失。当目标到达决策层时，沿共享竞争轴的steering可将恢复率从16.0%提升至95.3%；当目标仅到达策略层时，新下游布线可将恢复率从31.6%提升至84.3%；当目标无效时，两种方法均失效。

Conclusion: 目标误泛化并非单一表征失败，而是发生在不同深度的多种策略对齐失败。行为本身无法区分这些失败模式，但诊断目标丢失的位置即可预测哪种恢复方法有效：内部诊断（探针+世界编辑+Fisher分析）的深度直接映射到恢复策略的选择。研究表明，环境结构塑造了目标失败的方式，提示可据此预测不匹配失败的发生与恢复路径。

Abstract: Goal misgeneralization is a common failure mode in which an agent behaves competently out of distribution but does not pursue the intended goal. However, we still have a weak understanding of what happens to the intended goal in misgeneralizing agents. Across three Procgen environments and five robot tasks, we find three distinct forms of policy-goal misalignment: (1) functional target substitution, where behavior follows an alternative goal, (2) a policy shortcut, where behavior follows a learned action strategy, and (3) cue competition between intended and proxy goal cues. We distinguish these regimes by tracing where goal information remains available internally, how strongly it influences the policy, and what role it plays in action selection, and find that the goal is lost at different depths. Where the goal reaches the decision, as in cue competition, steering redirects the policy to the goal's location, raising intended-goal reach from 16.0% to 95.3%. Where it reaches the policy but not the decision, only new downstream wiring recovers goal reach, from 31.6% to 84.3% in the environment with the action shortcut. Where it is inert, neither works. Our results show that goal misgeneralization is not a single failure of goal representation, but distinct failures of policy alignment at different depths, tightly connected to which recovery works.

</details>


### [325] [New Model, Old Habits: Behavior Transfer under Model Swapping in Multi-Session LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19712)
*Youngbin Choi,Sehyun Hwang,Suhyeon Jun,Seoyeon Lee,Sunghyun Choi,MoonJeong Park,Dongwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了多会话LLM智能体在模型切换（model swapping）时的行为转移现象，提出了方向与作者感知的摘要策略DASH，用于在模型间传递历史时保留强模型行为并抑制弱模型行为的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多会话LLM智能体在实际部署中常因性能与推理成本的平衡而切换底层模型，但切换后历史记录对新模型（接收方）的影响尚缺乏系统性研究。已有工作多假设同一模型贯穿所有会话，忽略了模型切换带来的行为与性能变化。

Method: 1. 在MemoryArena三个智能体环境（Web Shopping、Travel Planning、Web Search）上进行受控的单次切换实验，涉及三对模型（Qwen3.5-4B/Qwen3.5-27B、Qwen3.5-4B/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、Qwen3.5-27B/Gemma-4-31B-it）。2. 定义并量化"行为转移"（behavior transfer），通过归一化行为偏移π衡量接收方对源模型推理与行动模式的采纳程度。3. 比较三种历史传输策略：原始历史传输、推理剪枝、按会话摘要。4. 提出DASH（Direction- and Authorship-aware Summarization of History）：弱→强切换时仅摘要弱模型轨迹，强→弱切换时保留原始历史。5. 在重复切换场景下验证DASH的效果。

Result: 1. 发现行为转移现象：强→弱切换通常提升接收方性能，弱→强切换则降低性能，即使控制预切换正确性后仍成立。2. 原始历史传输下行为转移最强，推理剪枝和摘要均能减弱行为转移，但并不一致地改善性能。3. 强→弱切换中原始历史传输效果最佳（均值PS 28.6/28.2），弱→强切换中摘要传输效果最佳（均值PS 29.9/43.8）。4. 重复切换实验中，DASH在大多数评估设置下优于原始历史传输和作者无关的DiSH基线，例如在Qwen3.5-4B/Qwen3.5-27B对的Web Shopping弱先路由中，DASH达到32.3 vs 原始传输23.5。5. DASH的优势主要源于保留强模型轨迹中的任务信息与有用行为指导。

Conclusion: 有效的多模型编排不仅需要选择使用哪个模型，还需考虑在模型切换时携带哪些行为模式。方向相关的历史传输策略——强→弱切换保留原始历史、弱→强切换采用摘要——在重复切换场景中通过DASH得到验证，表明同时考虑切换方向与轨迹作者归属是关键。

Abstract: Multi-session agents can switch between LLMs to balance performance and inference cost. Such switches require transferring a history for continuity, yet their effects on the recipient remain underexplored. Through controlled experiments with multi-session tasks, we uncover behavior transfer: recipients tend to adopt reasoning and action patterns from the models that generated their histories. This effect is most evident with raw-history transfer but is substantially reduced by summarization. Based on these findings, we propose Direction- and Authorship-aware Summarization of History (DASH) that preserves stronger-model behavior while minimizing weak-to-strong transfer via summarization. Experiments with repeated swaps show that DASH outperforms raw-history transfer and naive summarization baselines. These results suggest that effective multi-model orchestration requires considering not only which model to use, but also which behavioral patterns to carry forward.

</details>


### [326] [Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19687)
*Aryan Das,Arnab Bhattacharya,Vinay Kumar Verma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FSPO（Function-Space Policy Optimization），一种用于大语言模型强化学习的单策略自蒸馏框架，通过将稀疏的历史next-token分布存储为固定时间目标，在函数空间中实现时间合并，避免了传统EMA教师模型的额外内存开销。该方法在科学推理和工具使用基准上以更低显存获得了显著优于GRPO和SDPO的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励的强化学习）将整个响应压缩为单一标量奖励，存在信用分配粗糙的问题。自蒸馏方法（如SDPO）虽提供更密集的token级监督，但学生与教师源自同一策略，教师随学生持续演化形成"移动目标"问题，需额外正则化（如EMA）稳定，导致显著的内存开销。核心问题是：能否在不维护独立教师模型的情况下实现时间稳定且可靠性感知的自蒸馏？

Method: FSPO是单策略框架，包含四大核心组件：(1) 当前特权适配：通过比较无辅助策略与特权自教师（注入演示信息）的next-token分布构建密集监督，使用top-K稀疏化+JSD蒸馏，并引入"分歧修正"显式抑制学生过度赋值的token；(2) 函数空间时间合并：将早期优化步骤中稀疏的特权预测存储为固定时间目标（仅保留top-K分布+尾部质量），通过延迟和错峰刷新机制避免目标陈旧；(3) 可靠性自适应参考基础：根据策略在各问题上的滚动平均成功率动态调整参考解的监督权重，在策略反复失败时加强参考监督，在可靠时减弱；(4) 质量与覆盖感知的时间记忆：基于验证质量与结构互补性保留多样化的轨迹，并均匀采样避免主导模式淹没。统一目标为当前蒸馏、时间合并和参考基础三项加权和，采用循环调度从适配向合并过渡。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B和Olmo3-7B-Instruct上，于SciKnowEval的Chemistry/Physics/Biology/Materials四个推理子集和ToolAlpaca工具使用任务上评测，5小时wall-clock训练预算下，FSPO在两个骨干模型上均取得最高平均精度，比最强基线SDPO平均提升约4个百分点；在Olmo3-7B-Instruct上将峰值显存从约70 GB降至56 GB。同时收敛更快、生成token更少，并在灾难性遗忘评估中保留了更强的先验能力（接近甚至超过基础模型水平）。消融实验验证了四个组件的互补性，以及循环调度、可靠性自适应权重、JSD匹配、错峰刷新等关键超参的合理性。

Conclusion: FSPO证明可以在函数空间中有效保留时间知识，从而实现更内存高效、更稳定的自蒸馏，支持持续的后训练。其核心启示是：时间信息无需以参数快照或EMA教师的形式保留，稀疏的历史函数值即可提供足够的时间分离，同时避免了模型规模增大时的额外内存开销。这为大规模语言模型的自蒸馏后训练提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines current privileged adaptation with function-space temporal consolidation. FSPO stores sparse historical next-token distributions as fixed temporal targets, providing temporal separation without maintaining a persistent teacher model. It further introduces privileged disagreement correction to explicitly suppress locally overvalued actions, reliability-adaptive grounding that strengthens reference supervision when self-generated evidence repeatedly fails, and quality and coverage-aware temporal memory that retains verified behaviors and improves privileged demonstrations. Across reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, FSPO achieves the highest average accuracy under a 5-hour training budget, improving over the strongest baseline by approximately 4% points on average while reducing peak memory from about 70 GB to 56 GB on Olmo3-7B-Instruct.

</details>


### [327] [Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19636)
*Xiaocong Yang,Xuanyu Meng,Yuji Zhang,Jiawei Han,ChengXiang Zhai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 SAE-IDF，利用大语言模型（LLM）的稀疏自编码器（SAE）将符号映射为稀疏表示，结合逆文档频率（IDF）进行稀有度加权，在 12 个跨 6 类符号系统（形式数学证明器、代码、表模式、知识图谱、跨语言本体、生物医学本体）的匹配任务上，无训练地一致优于同一模型的稠密基线，同时提供人类可读的逐特征解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经-符号模型受限于符号骨干的人工构建，难以规模化；不同符号系统之间的对齐（本体匹配、模式匹配、实体对齐、跨语言代码检索等）历来由各类专用方法分别解决，缺乏统一方法。LLM 隐藏状态虽通用但存在各向异性和叠加问题，稠密维度的叠加使稀有度加权和可解释性都不可行。

Method: 对每个符号在其原生上下文（实例、公理、列样本等）中由 LLM 阅读，提取目标层残差流在符号 token 位置的状态；由该层预训练的 JumpReLU SAE 编码为稀疏码，跨 token 和视图取均值；用参考集合上的逆文档频率（IDF）对每个特征进行稀有度加权；最后以加权向量的余弦相似度排序候选。引入随机字典、移除主成分、白化、去均值等强基线作为对照。

Result: 在 Gemma-2-9B 上 12 个任务全部超越稠密基线，最高提升 +0.45 MRR（Lean 4→Metamath）；Llama-3.1-8B 上 14 行中 13 行超越稠密。多层/多宽度/多稀疏度/多尺寸（2B-27B）共 39 种配置（78 次运行）下均优于稠密、PCA-移除与未加权 SAE。基于余弦裕度的弃答在 90% 精度下保持高覆盖率。消融表明学习到的特征方向与 IDF 加权均不可或缺；随机字典在任何任务上都不如稠密。案例研究显示匹配可分解为一两个稀有、可命名概念（如"费用与付款结构""取整运算"）。

Conclusion: LLM 的 SAE 特征字典充当了异构符号系统的可解释共享坐标空间；SAE-IDF 无需训练、对齐对或任务专用管道，就能统一处理六类符号系统的匹配，是通向通用神经-符号骨干的关键一步。局限：依赖基础模型对各符号体系的阅读能力，在无法阅读的化学记号（SMILES/IUPAC/InChI）上接近随机；IDF 依赖匹配的参考集合；未完成多系统合并中决定对应数量的完整流程。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases. A neuro-symbolic model, with its interpretable architecture and System 2 reasoning capacity, is a promising alternative if built at the scale of LLMs; however, its symbolic backbone is usually constructed with human effort, so existing neuro-symbolic models are bottlenecked by the scope of the symbol component and usually domain-specific. A data-driven method could instead build a larger symbolic system by aligning and merging existing ones. We target its first, foundational step: matching units across these heterogeneous systems. Our method, SAE-IDF, encodes a symbol in its native context into a sparse code with a sparse autoencoder (SAE), re-weights each dimension by its rarity and matches across systems. On 12 tasks across 6 kinds of symbolic system, SAE-IDF outperforms the same LLM's dense baseline on all tasks with Gemma-2-9B and all but one with Llama-3.1-8B, by up to 45 points, consistently across SAE layers and configurations. SAE-IDF is also interpretable: every dimension of the sparse code has a human-readable meaning, so each match decomposes into named concepts (features). Our work paves the way to a universal symbolic backbone.

</details>


### [328] [Divergent Paths: Learning an Outcome-Predictive Representation of LLM Agent Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19614)
*Alexander Gill,Guram Gogia,Francisco Guzmán*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Precog-RM，一种基于 Transformer 的少样本元学习模型，将智能体轨迹视为动作-观测嵌入空间中的路径，用以预测任务的成功或失败。该模型在三个智能体基准（τ²-Bench、BFCLv3、AgentClinic）和三个策略模型上表现出色，并能作为 GRPO 训练中的早停控制器，在 τ²-Bench retail 任务上减少高达 47.3% 的训练 FLOPs，同时保持与基线相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的智能体轨迹分析（如信用分配、失败诊断、数据过滤）通常直接处理原始 token 序列，但决定结果的信号仅占表面形式的一小部分。现有方法或使用 LLM 评判（成本高、继承被研究系统的缺陷），或依赖手工特征（限制了通用性）。需要一种可学习的跨任务、跨领域表示，保留决定结果的关键信号。

Method: 1. 动作-观测空间（AOS）：使用冻结的文本编码器将每个动作和环境观测嵌入为向量，形成轨迹在该语义空间中的路径表示。
2. 任务级判别分析：使用最近质心、RBF-SVM 和 fastText 等每任务基线，验证同任务的成功和失败轨迹在该空间中的可分性。
3. Precog-RM 模型：受 Prototypical Networks 启发，通过情景式元学习训练一个轻量双向 Transformer 编码器，将轨迹映射到表征空间，使新任务只需少量标记轨迹即可通过类原型距离预测结果。
4. 前缀预测与早停：训练支持前缀输入的变体，并集成到 GRPO 循环中作为滚动/永久支持集的早停控制器。
5. 评估协议：在三个基准（τ²-Bench、BFCLv3、AgentClinic）和三个策略（DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3-Next-80B-Thinking、GPT-5-mini）上测试跨任务、跨模型和跨基准的泛化能力。

Result: 1. 跨三个基准、三个策略的每任务 AUROC 最高达 0.95，证明动作-观测序列中的结果信号是可分离的。
2. Precog-RM 在 9 个 (基准, 模型) 条件中，8 个匹配或超过最佳每任务基线，7 个达到最佳分数。
3. 少样本场景下（k=1 时差距 +0.06–+0.12 AUROC；k=2 时可匹配 k=8 的基线）显著优于每任务判别器。
4. 跨策略泛化：训练池中加入其他模型的 rollout 可提升未见策略上的 OOD 性能（单模型池 0.795 → 双模型池 0.835）。
5. 跨基准泛化：OOD 性能下降明显，低于未经训练的编码器，表明所学表示是领域绑定的。
6. 在 τ²-Bench retail GRPO 训练中部署早停控制器：保守配置（rolling, θ=0.8, mc=4）保持测试 pass@1（35.6 vs 35.0）同时减少 10.1% FLOPs；激进的永久支持配置（θ=0.8, mc=0）节省 47.3% FLOPs 而性能在基线一个标准差内（pass@1 31.9 vs 35.0）。

Conclusion: 智能体轨迹的结果从其嵌入的动作和观测中是可恢复的，且这种信号具有跨任务、跨策略的普遍性。Precog-RM 通过元学习将这一信号扩展到单任务之外，作为少样本结果预测器在多个基准上优于每任务判别器。作为 GRPO 早停控制器，它能大幅减少训练计算成本而不损害学习到的策略性能。建议将结果可预测的轨迹表示视为智能体轨迹分析的可重用基础模块。

Abstract: In this work, we reframe agentic trajectories as paths through a shared embedding space of actions and environmental observations. We show that successful and failed rollouts of the same task separate in this space, with simple per-task discriminators predicting held-out rollout outcomes at up to 0.95 AUROC across three agent benchmarks and three policy models. To exploit this signal across tasks, we introduce Precog-RM, a transformer-based model that meta-learns a representation in which outcome prediction can be performed in a few-shot setting. We show that Precog-RM generalizes to unseen tasks and models, and gives confident predictions of trajectory success long before termination. Deployed as an early stopping controller for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on Tau2-Bench, Precog-RM cuts training FLOPs by up to 47.3\% while maintaining performance comparable to baseline GRPO.

</details>


### [329] [Beyond Static Positional Encoding: Bayesian Time-aware Attention for Non-Stationary Long-term Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19603)
*Xinjie Lan,Yunbo Mei,Leheng Zhou,Hao Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳长期时间序列预测（LTSF）中Transformer静态位置编码的局限性，提出了一种贝叶斯时间感知注意力机制（BTA）。核心思想是将位置感知自注意力重新解释为关于被关注位置的贝叶斯后验推断，并推导出种群级ELBO以证明静态PE在非平稳场景下的次优性。BTA通过MoE路由器自适应组合多种时间核（局部RBF与周期核），生成输入条件、头特异的相对位置偏置。在八个标准LTSF基准测试中，BTA作为即插即用模块显著提升多种Transformer骨干网络的预测性能，且计算开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. Transformer在LTSF中表现优异，但建模非平稳时序依赖仍是难题；现实时间序列常呈现趋势演变、季节性变化和分布漂移。2. 现有方法（归一化类如RevIN、架构改造类如Non-stationary Transformer）存在局限：归一化不足以处理分布漂移；架构改造引入额外复杂性、难以泛化到不同骨干网络。3. 核心科学问题：位置编码（PE）如何与自注意力交互以支持非平稳时序依赖建模？静态PE使用固定的时序偏置，在依赖结构异变的不同输入窗口间被迫妥协，可能严格次优。

Method: 理论框架：将位置感知自注意力解释为贝叶斯后验 p(S=j|Z) ∝ p(S=j)·p(Z|S=j)，其中缩放点积相似度定义内容先验，PE提供时序证据似然。推导出弱平稳时序下的种群级ELBO（定理2），并通过regime-conditioned设定证明静态PE当regime-specific最优PE不相容时严格次优（推论3）。方法：BTA由两部分组成——(A) 时序核的概率混合（5个RBF局部核+6个周期核），(B) MoE路由器。路由器从内容注意力分数聚合出按lag的1D时序证据剖面，并拼接其傅里叶频谱，经MLP和Top-k稀疏化后生成输入和头特异的核权重，自适应地构建位置偏置 b_{ij} ∝ log[Σ_c ω_c exp(ψ^(c)(τ_{ij};θ^(c)))]，叠加到原始注意力logits上。

Result: 1. 跨骨干网络泛化：在Informer、PatchTST、Timer-XL三个骨干网络上，BTA在四个数据集（ETTh1、ETTm1、Weather、Solar）上一致降低MSE/MAE，平均降幅分别达9.70%、10.35%、5.70%，95/96设置下均优于vanilla注意力。2. SOTA比较：将BTA集成到TimeBridge，在8个数据集上与10种基线（含PULSE、DTAF、DUET、Non-stationary Transformer等）对比，在7/8数据集上取得最佳MSE、5/8上取得最佳MAE，平均MSE和MAE较TimeBridge再降2.39%和1.89%。3. 案例研究：ETTm1上对两个不同输入窗口，BTA分别将权重75%分配给周期核（含7天周期核权重0.24）和66%分配给RBF局部核（最大权重0.41在0.7天核上），MSE均下降约37%。4. 消融实验：核库丰富化、MoE路由、傅里叶频谱均带来增益，完整BTA在Solar上较vanilla自注意力降MSE 5.65%、MAE 6.55%。5. 效率：相对TimeBridge，FLOPs仅增加约0.10%–1.00%，参数量增加约1.1%–6.0%。

Conclusion: 本文通过贝叶斯视角重新阐释了位置编码在Transformer时序预测中的作用，理论证明了静态PE在非平稳场景下可能严格次优，并据此提出即插即用的BTA模块。实验证明BTA可一致提升多种Transformer架构（含TimeBridge等非平稳专用模型及Time-XL等时序基础模型）的预测精度，且计算开销极小。该工作为非平稳时序预测中的自适应位置机制提供了原则性、可解释且有效的设计替代方案。

Abstract: Transformers have demonstrated strong performance in long-term time series forecasting (LTSF), yet modeling non-stationary temporal dependencies remains challenging. In this paper, we interpret self-attention as a Bayesian posterior over attended positions, combining a content-based prior induced by scaled dot-product similarity with a temporal-evidence likelihood induced by positional encoding. This formulation provides a probabilistic interpretation of how positional encoding shapes the temporal dependencies captured by self-attention. Building on this perspective, we derive a population-level evidence lower bound (ELBO) that characterizes the role of positional encoding in forecasting weakly stationary time series. Our analysis further highlights a limitation of static positional encoding: when temporal dependence structures vary across input windows, a fixed temporal bias must accommodate heterogeneous dynamics and can therefore be suboptimal for non-stationary forecasting. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Bayesian Time-aware Attention (BTA), which employs a mixture-of-experts (MoE) router to adaptively combine temporal kernels and generate input-conditioned, head-specific positional biases. Extensive experiments on standard LTSF benchmarks demonstrate that BTA consistently improves forecasting performance across multiple Transformer backbones and achieves competitive overall performance with modest computational overhead and stable training.

</details>


### [330] [Learning Across Temporal Graph Representation Silos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19576)
*Minwoo Yu,Young-guk Ha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究不同时间图表示（CTDG与TKG）之间学习到的关系动力学（Relational Dynamics）能否跨表示边界被复用，提出表示身份不能完全界定可迁移知识的边界，并通过推荐和安全检测两个PoC验证其实际价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间图预训练与迁移研究通常局限于单一表示（CTDG或TKG），但学习到的预测结构是否能够跨越表示边界被复用尚不清楚。这对构建时间图基础模型的核心问题——"什么可以被复用"提出了根本性质疑。

Method: 1) 保留各表示独立的输入接口与预测头，仅迁移共享的历史编码器；2) 通过冻结跨表示迁移实验验证复用存在性；3) 设计受控的源历史重组织算子（合作伙伴、事件序列、时间放置、关系方向），分析可复用结构的功能性特征；4) 构建30个有向迁移对的完整转移矩阵；5) 在分数层面融合独立预训练的TKG与CTDG学习器；6) 在推荐（ICEWS14→LastFM）和安全检测（DFIR Report→LANL）两个实际场景中验证无对齐迁移的实用性。

Result: 1) CTDG↔TKG双向冻结迁移均取得显著增益（如ICEWS14→Wiki AP从0.8463提升至0.9822），且适用于DyGFormer、GraphMixer、TGAT等多种骨架；2) 源关系组织（如合作伙伴组织）的扰动会显著影响跨表示效用，部分条件原始组织更重要，部分条件下重组织后反而更优；3) 18/21的跨表示对在三种训练比例（5%/20%/100%）下均获得正向冻结增益；4) 在完整迁移矩阵中，跨表示源常优于同表示源（如Wikipedia目标下三个TKG源均优于两个CTDG源）；5) ICEWS05-15+LastFM融合至Wikipedia在所有三种seed下均超过任一单源；6) ICEWS14预训练使LastFM推荐Recall@10在20%数据下提升19.53个百分点；7) 外部威胁情报预训练使LANL检测在20%训练数据下主机覆盖率从6.67提升至8.67。

Conclusion: 关系动力学的可学习性与可复用性超越了时间图的表示边界。学习到的关系动力学与可复用关系动力学是不同概念——后者取决于源-目标-查询三元组。表示身份不足以作为组织预训练来源的原则；时间图基础模型应将"可跨表示复用"作为独立学习目标，保留表示特定接口，从异构源积累关系动力学并按目标条件选择性使用。

Abstract: Temporal graph data are recorded in different representations, but whether these differences also determine the scope of learned knowledge reuse remains unclear. This study investigates whether predictive structure learned from relational histories can be reused between continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) and temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs). Bidirectional reuse emerges while retaining distinct input and prediction interfaces and independent vocabularies, and sources with the same representation are not always more useful. Controlled reorganizations of source histories show that the organization contributing to reuse varies across source-target conditions. We show that learned aspects of Relational Dynamics, the predictive structure present in relational histories, can be reused across conventional representation boundaries. Independently pretrained TKG and CTDG learners can also be fused at the score level to improve prediction on a third dataset without entity or relation-semantic alignment. Two proofs of concept in recommendation and security detection illustrate that external temporal sources without direct alignment can also become useful pretraining resources.

</details>


### [331] [TEX-MEX: Similarity-Guided Temporal Contrastive Learning for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19557)
*Aditya Radhakrishnan,Maxwell A. Xu,Wanting Mao,Santosh Kumar,Harish Haresamudram,James M. Rehg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TEX-MEX提出了一种统一的结构性与时间性相似度的时序对比学习目标，将"形态相似"与"时间邻近"融入单一框架，在五个生理信号模态上达到SOTA，并训练了一个56万参数的轻量PPG基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序对比学习依赖"如何定义相似对"，但时序信号缺乏可靠的增广手段，现有方法只能在结构相似（形态一致）和时间相似（时间邻近）之间二选一，无法兼顾。

Method: 从数据集全局随机采样一批窗口；先用编码器自身的表示空间余弦相似度对窗口分级（softmax得到正/负权重w+、w−），然后对整批窗口施加同一随机时间偏移δ；对每个锚点，将其拉向"相似窗口的时间偏移版本"、推离"不相似窗口的时间偏移版本"（P、N项），并用H项防止时间帧坍缩。整体损失为 −log(P/(P+N+H))，属于软对比学习。

Result: 在PPG、EEG、ECG、加速度计、CGM五种模态上广泛取得SOTA，超越对比、重建、JEPA及模态专用方法；GPU显存峰值降65.4%、预训练墙钟时间降49.6%（vs PULSE）；CGM代谢分型11/12指标最佳，静脉→家用迁移最大提升8.6 AUROC；560K参数PPG基础模型在11项下游任务中7项最佳，超越所有单模态预训练PPG基础模型，体积约为第二小的~1/50。

Conclusion: TEX-MEX是一种高效、可扩展的通用时序自监督目标，能以极小模型实现SOTA，为生理信号基础模型提供了"小而强"的新范式。

Abstract: Contrastive learning for time series depends on deciding which pairs of inputs should be treated as similar and dissimilar. Because few augmentations reliably preserve meaning in time series, prior methods have relied on two disjoint notions of similarity between windows: structural similarity, which relates windows with similar morphology, and temporal similarity, which relates windows that occur close together in time. We introduce TEX-MEX, to our knowledge the first approach to unify the two into a single relationship. Given a random batch of windows drawn across the dataset, TEX-MEX uses the encoder to identify which windows are structurally similar or dissimilar to each other. It then pulls each window toward the temporally shifted versions of similar windows and pushes it away from those of dissimilar ones, learning what typically accompanies similar windows in time. Across PPG, EEG, ECG, accelerometry, and continuous glucose monitoring, TEX-MEX broadly achieves state-of-the-art performance against contrastive, reconstructive, JEPA-based, and modality-specific approaches, establishing it as a strong general SSL objective. We further train a 560K-parameter PPG foundation model that achieves state-of-the-art performance across a broad range of downstream benchmarks while being roughly 50x smaller than the next-best unimodally pretrained PPG foundation model in our evaluation. We will release this foundation model open-source and open-weight to the community to support future work and practical applications.

</details>


### [332] [MIPS: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Reinforcement Learning for Large Outcome Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19457)
*Armaan Sandhu,Abhijeet Sinha,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MIPS（边际逆概率缩放）以解决强化学习在大型结果空间中的模式崩溃问题，通过学习轨迹条件模型来估计结果的边际概率，从而在GRPO框架内实现奖励对齐的多样性采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于策略梯度的RL方法（如GRPO）在大型结果空间中会出现模式崩溃，即概率质量集中在少数高奖励结果上。Inverse Probability Scaling (IPS) 通过将奖励除以结果概率来缓解此问题，但现有基于组内频率的IPS估计在结果空间远大于rollout组大小时变得不可靠，导致在LLM后训练、分子发现等需要多样化高质量解决方案的任务中失效。

Method: 方法：MIPS（边际逆概率缩放），核心思想是利用学习到的轨迹条件模型 c_ϕ(τ|o) 估计结果的边际概率 P_θ(o)。根据概率恒等式 P_θ(τ) = P_θ(o)·P_θ(τ|o)，可得 P_θ(o) = P_θ(τ)/P_θ(τ|o)。条件模型通过最大化轨迹对数似然训练，因式分解为前置转移的乘积。缩放后的奖励 ~R = R(o)·c_ϕ(τ|o)/P_θ(τ) 进入标准GRPO目标函数。算法可保证在条件模型精确时恢复真实IPS，并将GRPO替换为联合训练的条件模型更新。MIPS与GFlowNet共享轨迹条件分解思路，但差异在于：MIPS估计当前策略的边际概率用于IPS，而GFlowNet将轨迹平衡作为训练目标。

Result: 在可枚举的Hypergrid实验中（边长H∈{4,...,512}，组大小G∈{16,...,2048}），MIPS在所有192种配置下的JSD和TV距离均显著低于GRPO和IPS-GRPO，即使组大小较小也能保持与奖励分布目标的高度对齐，而频率式IPS在大结果空间下退化。在分子合成（sEH任务）中，MIPS生成45,794个独特分子（91.8%有效样本率）、70个高奖励模式和149个高奖励Murcko骨架，均优于RGFN（34,744个分子/18个模式/25个骨架）、IPS-GRPO（17个分子/0个模式）和GRPO（1个分子/0个模式）。在系统发育树构建（10个分类群）中，MIPS实现全1,000,000独特树签名覆盖，采样相关性r=0.967（PhyloGFN为0.836，IPS-GRPO为0.140）。消融实验证实：移除条件模型 c_ϕ(τ|o) 会导致JSD从0.003-0.008急剧上升至0.56-0.64，证明边际概率估计的关键作用。边际概率估计误差在训练初期瞬变后迅速收敛至低值并保持稳定。

Conclusion: MIPS通过引入学习的轨迹条件模型解决了大型结果空间中边际结果概率估计的核心难题，使GRPO风格的策略梯度能够在大结果空间下保持奖励对齐的多样性，无需依赖组内重复观察。MIPS在分子合成和系统发育推断中的表现优于现有的RL（GRPO、IPS-GRPO）和专用方法（RGFN、PhyloGFN），证明了该方法在不同领域的通用性以及将RL拓展到搜索和采样任务（而非纯粹的奖励最大化）的潜力。当前方法的局限性在于：假设过程是有限、无环、确定性的构造过程且奖励为正；未来工作可将其扩展到连续结果空间或基于相似度的局部结构。

Abstract: Expected-reward maximization in reinforcement learning concentrates probability mass on a few outcomes, even in tasks that require many distinct, high-quality solutions, a failure known as mode collapse. Inverse Probability Scaling (IPS) counters this in group-based policy gradients such as GRPO by dividing each reward by the outcome's probability, estimated from its frequency within the sampled group. When the outcome space is large relative to the group, outcomes rarely repeat and these estimates become uninformative. Since an outcome can be constructed along many trajectories, its probability is a sum over all of them, and computing it directly is intractable. We propose Marginal IPS (MIPS), which performs marginal evaluation by combining the sampled trajectory with a learned model of the trajectories that lead to each outcome. On Hypergrids, where the exact sampling distribution is computable, MIPS stays near the reward-distribution target as the outcome space grows relative to the rollout group, while frequency-based IPS degrades. In molecular synthesis and phylogenetic inference, MIPS sustains diverse, high-quality sampling where GRPO and frequency-based IPS collapse, showing that MIPS serves as a reliable solution to mode collapse in RL.

</details>


### [333] [Policy-Verified Self-Training: Learning Agent Compliance from Verifiable Policy Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19372)
*Min-Young Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Policy-Verified Self-Training（PVST），将运行时的可执行策略验证器（gate）的判决转化为可验证奖励，用于代理自身的偏好训练，无需更强的教师模型、人工偏好标签或攻击标签。在 AgentDojo 提示注入任务上，Qwen3-8B 的违规轨迹从 37.2% 降至 10.3%，成功攻击率从 12.4% 降至 0.5%，且在未见过的攻击模板和未见过的 suite 上均能泛化，部署时 gate 干预率从 39.2% 降至 8.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运行时策略验证器虽能阻止违规动作，但其判决通常只用于执法后即被丢弃；同时小型开放权重模型的工具调用代理在提示注入下违规率高。文章旨在让 gate 的判决成为训练信号，将合规行为内化到模型中，使 gate 退化为稀有触发的安全后盾。

Method: PVST 是一种后训练范式：代理在受攻击环境中采样自身轨迹，由从策略文本编译而来的确定性 gate 对每一步动作判定合规。合规且任务成功的轨迹作为正样本，违规轨迹在首个被拒调用处截断作为负样本，用于 rejection-sampling fine-tuning（RFT-gate）和 DPO（DPO-gate）。奖励形式为 r(τ)=u(τ)−λv(τ)，其二元化形式直接给出接受关系与偏好关系。设计了多组对照（无违规负样本、无关失败负样本、攻击 oracle 负样本、随机截断、写入处截断）以分离偏好优化、负样本选择与负样本定位各自的贡献。

Result: Qwen3-8B 在 AgentDojo 留出任务（受 important_instructions 攻击）：DPO-gate 三种子平均违规轨迹 10.3±0.9%，ASR 0.5±0.2%，效用 39.9±1.9%；基线分别为 37.2%、12.4%、35.5%。DPO-ctrl-clean（无违规负样本）只降到 31.9%，DPO-oracle（攻击标签负样本）22.0%。未训练过的 tool_knowledge 攻击模板上：37.7%→11.0%。完全未训练过的 workspace 套件上：34.8%→16.7%。部署时 gate 干预率 39.2%→8.8%。Qwen3-4B 复现：37.3%→10.2%。在 τ²-bench airline 上，DPO 导致代理停止所有 write 调用，暴露出该域中成功信号已高度蕴含合规，因此裁定信息有限——作为边界案例说明 PVST 需满足两个条件：成功不应已蕴含合规、守卫动作需在允许与禁止上下文中均出现。

Conclusion: 从文本编译的策略检查器可以免费且确定性地为代理自身轨迹评分。作为过滤器时收益有限，作为负样本选择依据时能显著将合规移入模型；其增益在未见攻击模板与未见套件上部分保持，并将运行时干预削减 78%。训练用 gate 同时也是审计器，部署时仍应保留作为确定性安全后盾。轨迹级反馈也带来部分回避行为并丢弃了裁定中更细粒度的信息（哪个调用、哪条规则、哪个谓词、如何改动状态即可合规），如何在学习目标中纳入这些信息以及如何以同一标量奖励驱动在线策略优化，是本文开启的问题。

Abstract: Runtime policy verifiers can prevent agents from executing disallowed actions, but their decisions are typically used only for enforcement and discarded afterward. We ask whether these decisions can instead become verifiable policy rewards for training the agents they guard. We introduce Policy-Verified Self-Training (PVST), a post-training paradigm in which an agent generates its own interaction trajectories and an executable policy verifier, here a deterministic gate compiled from a written policy, evaluates whether each action complies. Compliant trajectories are reinforced, and violations become negatives for preference optimization; beyond the gate and the benchmark's task-success signal, PVST needs no stronger teacher model, no human preference labels and no attack-specific supervision, although rollouts are collected in the benchmark's attacked environment. On held-out AgentDojo tasks under prompt injection, policy-verified preference training of Qwen3-8B reduces violating trajectories from 37.2% to 10.3 $\pm$ 0.9% (three seeds) and successful attacks from 12.4% to 0.5% at equal or higher pooled task utility, although utility falls on travel, compared with 22.0% when negatives are selected by an attack oracle and 31.9 $\pm$ 0.9% with negatives that contain no violation. The learned behavior holds under an attack template never used in training (37.7% to 11.0%) and on a suite excluded from training (34.8% to 16.7%), and the retained verifier's intervention rate falls from 39.2% to 8.8% (seed 0). Our analysis identifies two conditions under which the verdict is most informative: success must not already imply compliance, and guarded actions must appear in both permitted and forbidden contexts.

</details>


### [334] [Asymptotic Behavior of Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19358)
*Katy Blumer,Da-Cheng Juan,Jon Kleinberg,Ravi Kumar,Cyrus Rashtchian,Andrew Tomkins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究自回归Transformer在极长生成过程中的渐近行为，证明其经验缓存分布可由对数时间尺度上的确定性ODE刻画，并证明每个固定模型在足够高的softmax温度下必收敛至唯一不动点，但不存在对所有模型统一的有限温度阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大语言模型有时会"锁定"于某种状态并长时间影响其后续输出，这一现象促使作者从数学上严格地问：当自回归Transformer无限生成时，其经验历史是否总会收敛到唯一极限。已有理论多固定序列长度分析，而本文转而固定模型、研究生成过程在t→∞时的行为。

Method: 采用随机逼近（stochastic approximation）框架（Benaïm, 1999）。对单层Transformer，将状态空间约简为经验token分布P_t，得到ODE dP/dt = π*(P)−P；对多层含RoPE和局部注意力层，则将历史表示为对全局KV cache向量的经验分布η_t，并在对数时间尺度s_t = log t上建立measure-valued ODE dη/ds = Γ(η)−η。通过分析M_P对P的Jacobian证明在τ足够大时π*为压缩映射；通过分层加权距离d_{1,δ}和Γ的利普希茨性证明多层情形下Γ_τ的压缩性，并给出三层token显式反例证明任意温度都存在不收敛的单层Transformer。

Result: 1. 即使是三层token的单层NoPE attention-only Transformer在特定权重下也会几乎必然不收敛（其ODE对应循环rock-paper-scissors logit动态，唯一不动点线性不稳定）。2. 对固定单层Transformer，经验token分布几乎必然追踪ODE dP/dt = π*(P)−P；存在有限的临界温度τ_c使得τ>τ_c时π*为压缩，唯一不动点P*全局吸引。3. 对固定深度、含layer normalization、MLP、RoPE以及全局/局部注意力混合的多层Transformer，经验cache分布η_t几乎必然追踪measure-valued ODE dη/ds = Γ(η)−η；存在依赖于架构的τ_c使τ>τ_c时Γ_τ为压缩，唯一不动点η*_τ全局指数吸引。4. 对任意有限温度τ_0，都能构造一个在τ_0下不收敛的单层Transformer（通过按τ_0缩放输出嵌入），故不存在全局统一的有限温度阈值。

Conclusion: 长生成Transformer的行为可被简化为固定维状态空间上的确定性ODE，每个固定模型在高温度下必唯一收敛，但模型间的温度阈值不一致——量词顺序至关重要：∀模型∃τ_c vs. ∀τ∃模型使OD不收敛。这一二分结果建立了随机生成过程与确定性动力系统在长时极限下的等价性，并为理解和控制大模型的"状态锁定"现象提供了理论框架。

Abstract: In this paper we study the behavior of transformer networks generating text over long periods of time. We show that even a three-token, single-layer attention-only transformer can fail to converge. We then study a rich class of transformers with arbitrary finite depth, layer normalization, MLPs, RoPE encodings, and an arbitrary mix of local and global layers. Every transformer in this class has a softmax temperature threshold above which its empirical cache distribution converges to a unique limit, independent of initial conditions. We show further that, while each transformer has a temperature threshold, the supremum of this set is infinite, so there is no global minimal temperature that forces all transformers to converge.

</details>


### [335] [DTDD: Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation for Reliable On-Policy Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19302)
*Qijia He,Zequn Li,Spencer Luo,Tianle Chen,Pradyumna Narayana,Zixian Ma,Ranjay Krishna,Lan Nie,Sugato Basu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DTDD（Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation），一种基于段级师生分歧度触发教师接管的自适应在线策略蒸馏（OPD）框架。在学生生成长序列过程中按段计算师生分歧度，当某段分歧度超过阈值时回退到该段边界，由冻结教师从保留的学生前缀继续生成恢复后缀。学生前缀继续接受标准OPD监督，教师生成的后缀通过行为克隆（交叉熵）训练。该方法在长程推理、基础模型蒸馏（无需离线SFT）以及多轮智能体（ALFWorld、代码生成）三类场景中均取得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准On-Policy Distillation（OPD）通过沿学生采样轨迹提供token级密集监督来缓解分布失配，但在两种场景下变得不可靠：(1) 师生初始策略差距过大（如从base初始化蒸馏），早期监督信息量不足；(2) 长程推理或多轮工具调用中的误差累积导致轨迹偏离教师过远，使得局部reverse-KL反馈失效。需要一种自适应机制，仅在师生分歧显著时引入教师生成的连贯恢复信号，同时保留on-policy训练的大部分特性。

Method: DTDD将学生rollout划分为固定长度的token段（如64/128/256 tokens），在每段内计算基于top-K的师生log概率差的非负token级分歧度，再对段内取平均得到段分歧度。设定阈值τ，若某段（从j_min起）的平均分歧度首次超过τ，则回退到该段起始边界，由冻结教师从保留的学生前缀继续生成后缀。训练目标采用角色分离：学生前缀使用OPD（top-K reverse-KL surrogate），教师后缀使用行为克隆（one-hot交叉熵），损失权重λ_BC=1。若无触发则等价于标准OPD。阈值可固定或按目标干预率动态调整（rate-controlled）。在多轮交互任务中，触发发生在动作边界——教师替换触发动作，交互从环境新观察继续。段平均触发器优于token级尖峰触发器，BC优于统一KD作为后缀损失。

Result: (1) 长程稳定性：在15K/18K token预算下，DTDD将warmup后的峰值梯度范数降低8.6×和7.0×，保持相同精度。(2) 基础模型在线蒸馏（Qwen3-1.7B-Base ← Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO，DAPO-Math-17K）：DTDD以约70步达到21.3%精度（OPD需180步），约2.6×更少的优化器更新；最终两者均收敛至约22%。相比离线SFT+OPD，DTDD使用22.0小时vs 42.8小时串行时间，43M vs 95M教师生成token，效率提升1.9×。(3) ALFWorld：LoRA训练最佳观测成功率提升+4.8pp（全参数微调+0.4pp）。(4) 智能体代码（Qwen3-1.7B-SFT ← DemyAgent-GRPO-4B）：2.8%稀疏剂量下平均精度提升+4.1pp（40.59% vs 36.49%），但50%高剂量反而下降至28.13%。(5) 23组实验的综合分析表明，当教师显著优于OPD学生、且能恢复学生访问到的状态、学生能学习这些恢复、且干预率适中时，接管策略带来收益（headroom分析）。失败案例包括：教师本身弱于OPD（WebShop重制环境）、学生过小无法学习（0.5B ALFWorld）、剂量过大（代码任务~50%）。

Conclusion: DTDD通过段级师生分歧度将标准OPD与教师生成的恢复监督有机结合，在长程推理优化稳定性、基础模型在线warm-up、以及多轮智能体任务中均能有效提升性能。段平均触发器优于单token尖峰触发器，行为克隆优于统一KD用于教师后缀。主要限制是阈值/目标干预率需手动设置，且分歧触发器本身不能判断教师恢复对学生是否有用。未来方向包括自动剂量校准和恢复质量评估。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision on student rollouts, but this supervision can become unreliable when the student and teacher diverge, either because of a large initial policy gap or compounding errors in long-horizon reasoning and tool use. We introduce Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation (DTDD), an adaptive OPD framework that uses segment-level student-teacher divergence to trigger teacher takeover during training. When divergence triggers an intervention during reasoning, the student prefix continues to receive standard OPD supervision. The teacher then generates a recovery suffix, which the student learns through behavior cloning, using cross-entropy on the teacher-generated tokens. We evaluate DTDD in three regimes: long-horizon reasoning, distillation from a base initialization without offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and multi-turn agents. We also compare alternative trigger designs and teacher-intervention rates. DTDD reduces the post-warmup peak gradient norm by $8.6\times$ and, from a base initialization, reaches $21.3\%$ held-out math accuracy in $2.6\times$ fewer optimizer updates than OPD; both methods finish near $22\%$. It improves best-observed performance by $4.8$ and $4.1$ percentage points on ALFWorld with LoRA and agentic code, respectively. Ablations show that segment-averaged triggers outperform token-spike triggers. Behavior cloning is also more effective than the tested OPD surrogate for training teacher-generated recoveries. Across 23 experimental arms, takeover tends to help when the teacher substantially outperforms the OPD-trained student, provided that the teacher can recover from student-visited states, the student can learn those recoveries, and teacher intervention is neither excessive nor insufficient.

</details>


### [336] [Dimension-Free Scaling Laws for Size Generalization: An Exponential Separation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19279)
*Behrooz Tahmasebi,Melanie Weber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发展了关于集合与图上"尺寸泛化"（size generalization）的维度无关极小极大统计学习理论，揭示了同域内学习与跨尺寸学习之间样本复杂度的指数级分离：多项式源衰减条件下同域误差为 $n^{-\Theta(1)}$，但跨尺寸误差仅为 $(\log n)^{-\Theta(1)}$；只有指数源衰减才能恢复多项式样本复杂度。所有结果与匹配的下界一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习常需处理变尺寸结构数据（集合、图），但经典学习理论的保证通常随输入维度恶化。现有研究虽已刻画模型何时可跨尺寸迁移，却未量化其统计代价——跨尺寸泛化的样本复杂度及其与同域学习的关系长期未被严格刻画。本文旨在弥补这一空白，建立一个维度无关、与尺寸无关的极小极大理论，精确刻画尺寸泛化何时高效以及代价几何。

Method: 方法核心包括三要素：(1) 精确等距迁移算子 $T_{d\to D}$——保证同一不变规则在不同尺寸间无失真地传递；(2) 表示稳定性（representation stability）——不变多项式特征空间维度 $\dim\mathcal{V}_{d,k}$ 在尺寸 $d$ 增大后稳定，因此可用 $\sup_d \dim\mathcal{V}_{d,k}$ 统一控制，对集合有 $q_{\mathrm{set}}(k)=\exp(C_r k^{r/(r+1)}+o(\cdot))$，对图有 $q_{\mathrm{graph}}(k)=\exp(k\log k+O(k\log\log k))$；(3) 源衰减条件——多项式 $B(k)\lesssim k^{-\tau}$ 或指数 $B(k)\lesssim e^{-ak^\nu}$，控制目标函数的高阶能量。将三者结合可得一个"oracle 不等式"，平衡近似误差 $B(k)$ 与统计误差 $q_\mathsf{X}(k)/n$，再对交互阶 $k$ 优化即可得到跨尺寸误差率。下界使用局部 Assouad 引理在源类中构造超立方体扰动，证明分离是内蕴的。

Result: 主要结果如下：(1) 多项式源衰减下，集合的尺寸泛化误差为 $(\log n)^{-\tau(r+1)/r}$，图为 $(\log n/\log\log n)^{-\tau}$；同域误差为 $n^{-\tau/(\tau+rd)}$（集合）或 $n^{-\tau/(\tau+rd^2)}$（图）。因此达到精度 $\varepsilon$ 在同域仅需 $n_{\mathrm{in}}(\varepsilon)=\varepsilon^{-(\tau+rd)/\tau}$ 样本（多项式），而跨尺寸需要 $n_{\mathrm{size}}(\varepsilon)=\exp(\Theta(\varepsilon^{-r/[\tau(r+1)]}))$（集合）或 $\exp(\Theta(\varepsilon^{-1/\tau}\log(1/\varepsilon)))$（图），呈指数级分离。(2) 指数源衰减下，若 $\nu>\beta$（集合）或 $\nu>1$（图），可恢复近参数率 $n^{-1+o(1)}$；否则落入临界或亚临界过渡区间。(3) 极小极大下界（定理 4.2）证明所有上述率在常数与低阶因子意义下最优，分离并非算法或正则化的人为产物。(4) 实验部分用 Erdős–Rényi 子图计数与加权图谱场估计两个例子验证理论机制：不变量化的低阶统计可直接迁移，而非不变特征需经子图平均才可比拟；快速系数衰减使低阶逼近跨尺寸保持高精度，缓慢衰减则留下持续误差。
