Conclusion: 精确迁移是尺寸泛化的必要前提，但目标规则性（即源衰减速度）才是决定其统计效率的决定性因素。多项式衰减——足以保证同域多项式样本复杂度——仅能产生极小极大最优的对数级跨尺寸率，导致指数级样本复杂度分离；足够快的指数衰减则能克服不变特征增长，重新获得近参数率。这一相位转换由不变表示的稳定增长与目标高阶结构的衰减之间的竞争所驱动，是统计内禀性质而非算法或架构缺陷。本文建立了首个维度无关、尺寸无关的极小极大尺寸泛化理论，为深度集合、图神经网络等架构的跨尺寸迁移提供了严格的统计基础。

Abstract: Modern machine learning models increasingly operate on variable-size structured data, such as sets and graphs. A central requirement is \emph{size generalization}: the ability of a model trained on inputs of one size to generalize to inputs of a different, potentially much larger, size. Classical statistical learning theory, however, primarily considers fixed input domains, and its guarantees often deteriorate with input dimension. Although extensive work has established when models on sets and graphs can be transferred across input sizes, such results do not characterize the statistical cost of doing so: the sample complexity of size generalization, and its relationship to classical in-domain learning, remain largely unknown. We develop a statistical learning theory of size generalization and establish a sharp exponential separation in sample complexity. Letting $n$ denote the number of training samples, we show that polynomial source decay is insufficient for efficient size generalization: while it yields error $n^{-\Theta(1)}$ and hence polynomial sample complexity for in-domain learning, size-generalization error decays only as $(\log n)^{-\Theta(1)}$, yielding an exponential separation. Thus, polynomial in-domain sample complexity can become exponential across sizes. We then identify an exponential source condition under which size generalization achieves error $n^{-\Theta(1)}$, recovering polynomial sample complexity. These guarantees are independent of input dimension and depend only on the number of training samples, yielding dimension-free scaling laws. We also provide matching minimax lower bounds, establishing optimality. To our knowledge, this work provides the first dimension-free minimax theory of size generalization and a rigorous characterization of when, and at what statistical cost, learning can transfer across input sizes.

</details>


### [337] [Exploring Interpretability in Deep Learning-Based Forest Classification - Separating Similar Forest Classes using Sentinel-2 Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19270)
*Maximilian Kirsch,Christine Preisach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合循环神经网络（RNN）与集成梯度（IG）归因方法的框架，基于Sentinel-2年度时间序列对德国主要森林类型（包括纯挪威云杉与混交挪威云杉的区分）进行分类与解释分析。最佳模型GRU-MHA-128的Macro-F1达到0.851，仅略优于XGBoost（0.839）。研究发现，纯云杉与混交云杉的混淆是主要错误来源（约20%），且通过类间对比归因揭示了B11等关键波段在DOY 125后对区分两类的关键作用，为森林组成精细制图提供了物候学可解释的洞察。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着中欧干旱与热应力加剧，混交林因其生态韧性而日益受到重视。然而，纯林与混交林在中等分辨率遥感影像（如Sentinel-2）中具有高度重叠的光谱-时间特征，使得像素级分类极具挑战性。此外，深度学习模型在森林分类中的决策过程（即哪些光谱波段和物候期驱动了类别区分）理解不足，限制了对模型预测的信任与进一步应用。

Method: 研究采用德国国家森林清查数据集（2015–2022），选取挪威云杉（含纯林、混交林与受干扰林）、欧洲山毛榉、橡树、欧洲赤松及裸土共7类。将Sentinel-2年度时间序列（10个波段）作为输入，比较了双向LSTM与GRU（带或不带多头注意力池化，瓶颈维度32/64/128）与随机森林（RF）和XGBoost的性能。采用加权交叉熵与Macro-F1损失组合训练，并使用集成梯度（IG）进行特征归因分析，包括零基线归因与类间对比归因。

Result: 最佳模型GRU-MHA-128（瓶颈维度128）的Macro-F1为0.851，准确率0.854，平衡准确率0.933，优于XGBoost（0.839）和RF（0.748）。主要混淆来自纯挪威云杉与混交挪威云杉（互分错误率约20%），其他类别分类精度较高（如赤松F1=0.968）。归因分析显示，对纯/混云杉区分而言，B6、B7、B8、B8A在DOY 125后贡献增加，而B11在光谱差异最大的时期贡献最强；B2与B12贡献最低。年度观测数量越多，分类性能越好，且极端年份（2018、2022）未显著增加误分类。

Conclusion: 循环深度学习模型结合类间对比归因为分析森林分类中的光谱-时间决策过程提供了有效框架，尤其适用于光谱与物候高度相似的类别。归因结果与已知物候过程（如阔叶植被展叶期）一致，提供了物理可信的模型解释。虽然模型对纯林与混交林的区分性能受限，但IG分析揭示了最具区分力的波段与季节窗口，为未来轻量化模型设计（特征/时间步缩减）与混交林比例亚像素估算提供了方向。Sentinel-2C增加的观测密度有望进一步提升该方法的性能。

Abstract: The ecological insurance theory posits that diverse forests are more resilient and better able to adapt to changing environmental conditions. Increasing drought and heat stress in Central Europe promotes mixed forests for maintaining ecosystem services. However, a diverse species distribution complicates remote sensing-based species mapping, as distinguishing pure from mixed species compositions at the pixel level remains challenging. We evaluated the potential of recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for tree-species classification from Sentinel-2 time series and investigated the spectral-temporal features underlying class discrimination, with particular emphasis on separating pure from mixed Norway spruce pixels. We compared RNN classification models with Random Forest (RF) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and used Integrated Gradients (IG) to quantify feature attributions across spectral bands and time. The best-performing RNN achieved a Macro-F1 score of 0.851 on the test data, outperforming XGBoost by 0.012 and Random Forest by 0.103. Beyond classification performance, the attribution analysis revealed distinct spectral-temporal patterns associated with the separation of pure and mixed Norway spruce pixels. Attribution values increased particularly after approximately day of year (DOY) 125, while B11 showed the strongest contribution during periods of increasing spectral divergence between the two classes. These findings show that recurrent models can provide competitive classification performance while also revealing the phenological periods and spectral regions that are most relevant for distinguishing closely related forest compositions. Combining time-series classification with explainability therefore provides additional insight into the spectral-temporal mechanisms underlying tree-species discrimination and may support more detailed mapping of mixed forest structures.

</details>


### [338] [Refined Topology-Pass Scheduling: Damped Trust-Region Compensation for Dynamic k-NN Graphs in SE(3)-Equivariant Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19246)
*Jiankai Huang,Hanwen Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"拓扑遍调度"的精化方法，通过阻尼固定点迭代和信任域投影，在SE(3)等变蛋白质结构预测中以低成本两遍设计补偿动态kNN图重建开销。核心思想是：第一遍(拓扑遍)使用冻结图快速前向传播并记录测量位移；第二遍(补偿遍)基于阻尼信任域策略选择性修复局部邻接关系。理论贡献包括：(1)PB(逐块重建)为阻尼耦合的唯一不动点；(2)精确非翻转证书(双端常数m_i/4、单端m_i/2)；(3)BLUE最优回放增益γ*及可行性交叉点ρ*≈0.25；(4)ℓ∞盒投影的firmly non-expansive性质及收敛保持；(5)解析近邻间距律E[m]≈r_k/(3k)与实测吻合至1%。在RFAA管道上以C++实现三级补偿(L1冻结集活几何、L2裕度门控局部修复、L3阻尼投影基)，匹配条件协议验证：L2精确复现PB边集(D=0.0000)、L1偏差<0.6%、L3单调内插。实测Pass-1加速1.5×、整epoch加速1.76×，且无可测损失差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SE(3)等变结构预测(如AlphaFold2/3、RFAA)每个block边界需重建kNN图，其代价高昂(约1.8s/block，占epoch时间的34.1s vs 19.4s的1.76×开销)。直接冻结图(F)虽快但存在拓扑差距；逐块重建(PB)精确但昂贵。核心问题：(Q1)能否以低成本保持冻结拓扑并保持有用混合策略？(Q2)能否在记录少量状态后通过保守补偿缩小与PB的拓扑差距？

Method: 方法学采用两遍设计+阻尼固定点迭代理论：(1)Pass-1以冻结图(B≡x⁰)前向传播，记录测量位移Δ^t、裕度m_i、kNN半径ρ_i及步骤饱和标志；(2)离线规划阶段按B^t=Π_κ(x⁰+Σγ_sΔ^s)生成补偿基；(3)Pass-2按三级策略消费——L1仅刷新冻结边几何、L2基于裕度门控做局部kNN重选、L3通过阻尼投影基改变拓扑。三级共享O(|Ω|)风险集成本，闭合于冻结邻居。数学工具包括反函数定理证明翻转面测度零性、Kac–Rice公式量化翻转速率、Bauer–Fike定理分析单翻转谱扰动、Picard–Banach证明投影下收缩保持。

Result: 主要结果：理论方面——(i)阻尼耦合在λ>0下唯一不动点恰为PB(命题1)；(ii)在假设A1–A3下局部收缩率q=(1−λ)+λL_Φ<1(命题2)；(iii)双端4Δ<m_i充分保证kNN集不变(定理1)，单端2Δ_i<m_i同理(定理2)；(iv)γ*=Σ_d(Σ_d+Σ_p)⁻¹为BLUE最优回放增益，残差方差σ_d²σ_p²/(σ_d²+σ_p²)，可行性交叉ρ*≈0.25对应σ_p=σ_d；(v)盒投影Π_κ为firmly non-expansive(命题4)；(vi)近邻间距律E[m]≈r_k/(3k)与实测裕度中位数0.0787Å吻合至1%。实验方面——(a)匹配条件协议验证L2精确复现PB(D=0.0000)，L1偏差0.57–0.68%，L3(σ=4,γ=0.5)D=0.0044/0.0059单调内插；(b)家族重建审计通过18/18边界(Jaccard=1.0000)；(c)墙钟时间epoch从34.1s降到19.4s(1.76×)，Pass-1阶段加速1.5×；(d)损失无差距(15.49 vs 15.91,±1.3)；(e)离线oracle回放显示σ=8时D_w减少41–61%，但σ=1/2默认过紧仅减9–11%；(f)综合预测器研究证实ρ<0.25时回放有害，ρ≥0.5时改善15–27%。

Conclusion: 本文建立一个由理论指导、实验验证的拓扑遍调度家族。具体支持结论：(1)PB是阻尼耦合的唯一不动点；(2)4Δ<m_i和2Δ_i<m_i为精确非翻转证书；(3)BLUE回放规则及σ_p=σ_d边界成立；(4)近邻间距律量化了edge翻转不可避免性。L2精确复现PB边集、L3在L1与PB间单调内插、整体两级加速1.76×无损失差距。局限/后续：(1)F对PB的同种子损失/FAPE/chi角比较尚未测定，因种子散布(±1.3)大于效应；(2)需研究小漂移训练阶段风险集收缩规律；(3)边权代理w_e=1/(1+‖d_e‖)应替换为损失敏感度|L(G∪e)−L(G)|；(4)本文未证明任意离散切换全局收敛，也未证有限遍补偿必复现PB，亦未证缩小D_w必然降低预测损失——即恢复剩余0.6%拓扑边对训练目标的价值仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Equivariant structure-prediction pipelines alternate coordinate updates with the construction of a k-nearest-neighbour (kNN) graph whose membership is a discrete, piecewise-constant function of the coordinates. Rebuilding that graph at every block boundary (PB) is the expensive part of an epoch, whereas reusing one frozen graph (F) is fast but leaves a topology gap. We study a two-pass design in which the cheap pass records a small amount of state (margins, kNN radii, measured per-boundary displacements) and a second pass compensates conservatively. We formulate the choice of the graph-construction basis as a damped fixed-point iteration whose unique fixed point is exactly PB, and derive (i) exact non-flip certificates with the two-sided constant $m_i/4$ and one-sided constant $m_i/2$, (ii) the minimum-variance (BLUE) replay gain $\gamma^*$ and the resulting feasibility crossover, (iii) an $\ell_\infty$ trust-region projection that preserves convergence, and (iv) an analytic near-tie spacing law $E[m] \approx r_k/(3k)$ that matches measurements to 1\%. Three compensation levels are implemented in C++ (L1: frozen set with live geometry; L2: margin-gated local repair; L3: damped, projected basis) and validated under a matched-conditions protocol (identical seed, MSA depth and trajectory family, only the topology mode differs). L2 reproduces the PB edge set exactly ($D = 0.0000$ at every boundary), L1 stays within 0.6% and L3 interpolates monotonically: L2 reproduces the PB edge set exactly when the trust region is removed, and L3 interpolates between the frozen and the PB topology. The recorded trajectory itself yields a measured $1.5\times$ Pass-1 and $1.76\times$ epoch speed-up with no measurable loss gap. An open-source implementation of the runtime and of all the experiments reported here is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [339] [Diagnosing Low-Confidence Patient Profiles via Localized Harmful Covariate Shift Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19178)
*Olivier Lefebvre,Hakima Laribi,Dan Poenaru,Martin Vallières*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的诊断流水线，将MED3pa（用于发现低置信度患者画像）与Detectron（用于检测有害协变量偏移）相结合，在可解释的患者子群内部进行偏移检测，以揭示那些在总体层面无法被发现的局部有害偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的临床预测模型事后诊断方法通常仅在总体层面评估可靠性，无法揭示模型在特定患者子群上的异质性表现，难以识别受分布偏移影响最严重的患者群体。

Method: 基于MIMIC-IV数据，针对30天再入院、48小时活体出院和48小时死亡率三项任务，分别训练MLP作为基础模型。通过从训练集中移除特定子群（年龄<50岁、女性、非白人）人为注入协变量偏移。使用MED3pa将患者按置信度划分为可解释的画像，再在各画像内应用Detectron训练约束分歧分类器（CDC），比较其在画像内测试子集与参考子集上的分歧差异，以统计检验（α=0.05）判断是否存在有害协变量偏移（HCS）。

Result: 在三个临床预测任务上：(1)年龄偏移在总体层面未被检出，但在特定低置信度画像（如GCS-Motor≤5且年龄≤66的患者，涵盖8.76%人群）中检出HCS并伴随显著性能下降；(2)性别和种族偏移在几乎所有画像中均被检出，呈全局性影响，难以定位最受影响的子群；(3)部分画像存在性能下降但未检出HCS，反之亦然，表明HCS检测与性能退化并非完全对应。

Conclusion: 将MED3pa与Detectron相结合可从"识别模型不可靠的位置"延伸至"探究其在特定患者画像中不可靠的原因"。局部偏移检测能够揭示总体层面无法发现的局部有害偏移，但检测结果属探索性信号，需进一步验证。该方法为临床预测模型的可靠性诊断与针对性模型适配提供了新途径。

Abstract: Before deploying clinical prediction models, their reliability must be assessed to ensure safe use. Errors may arise from distribution shifts between training and deployment or from heterogeneous performance where the model systematically underperforms for certain patient subgroups. Yet most post-hoc diagnostic methods evaluate reliability only at the population level, checking whether the deployment data resemble the training data and whether the model performs well on average, without accounting for heterogeneity that may cause some patients to be disproportionately affected. We propose a unified diagnostic pipeline that combines both perspectives. MED3pa first discovers interpretable low-confidence patient profiles, and Detectron is then applied within each profile to test whether its degradation is associated with a detectable harmful covariate shift. Across three clinical prediction tasks and three injected subgroup shifts in MIMIC-IV, we find that shift detectability itself is informative. An injected age shift, undetectable at the population level, was nonetheless localized to specific degraded profiles, whereas sex- and race-related shifts were detected broadly and therefore offered little guidance for identifying the most affected patients.

</details>


### [340] [MA-Bench: Measuring Operational Planning in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19138)
*Rodney Lafuente-Mercado,Robert Sincero,Phil Sage,Yuan Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MA-Bench 是一个用于评估大语言模型在军事作战规划任务中"任务分析"能力的基准测试，涵盖 10 个专家构建的场景和 1,257 个原子化评分项，发现最佳模型仅能正确完成 62% 的评分项，且主要失败模式为遗漏而非错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大多数智能体基准测试衡量的是具有外部可验证结果的任务（如解决软件问题、导航网站），而作战规划没有这样的结果——一份计划可能流畅、合理且内部连贯，但会遗漏关键的判断、忽视冲突证据或将不确定评估固化。尽管医学等领域已开始使用专家评分标准评估开放式工作，但尚无基准覆盖作战规划。MA-Bench 旨在填补这一空白。

Method: MA-Bench 基于联合规划过程的"任务分析"步骤构建，包含 10 个专家构建的综合场景（每个场景含 10-12 份文档，约 36k-243k 字符），配以 1,257 个专家撰写的二元通过/失败评分项（按原子化、二元、可观察、基于教条或证据、自包含、非重复六项标准设计）。评分项分为三层（Tier 1：直接从单文档提取；Tier 2：跨文档综合；Tier 3：需推理的规划判断），并带有严重度权重（CI/I/SI 为正权，D/CD 为负权）。采用推理模型作为评分员（与四位持证规划师的协议 κ=0.54，接近专家间一致性），评分员不看数据包。评估了 20 个前沿和开源权重模型。

Result: 最佳模型 Muse Spark 1.3 仅获得 62% 的评分项正确率（加权分数 0.574），模型间得分跨度 0.30-0.57。模型在文档直接陈述的事实（Tier 1，58.1%）上表现最强，在需要推理的判断（Tier 3，33.4%）上表现最弱。按规划步骤看，"指挥官的关伓信息需求"得分最低（30.7%），而"约束与限制"得分最高（71.9%）。60.2% 的失败是直接遗漏，仅约 4% 是不正确或不支持的内容。推理努力从低到高最多仅改变分数 0.08；移除字数上限可使分数提高 0.08-0.123。三个来自不同提供商的评分员之间协议度（κ 0.61-0.70）高于人类专家两两之间的协议度，模型排名 Spearman 相关性 0.89-0.94 稳定，自我偏好偏差不超过 0.03。

Conclusion: MA-Bench 评估的是一种现有可验证结果基准无法触及的规划能力：将大量、不完整且部分矛盾的证据转化为参谋人员在规划前所需的关键判断。最佳当前模型仅能完成 62% 的评分项；缺失部分集中在推理层级和从态势向前展望到所需决策的步骤中，失败形式为遗漏而非错误——这是任何检查简报"说了什么"而非"应该说什么"的指标都无法捕捉的。三个评分员和四位人类专家得出一致结论，表明评分标准的应用是一致的，结果不依赖于单一评分员。数据包、评分标准、提示词、简报和评分结果全部发布，以便后续模型可按同一标准衡量。

Abstract: How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists? We introduce Mission Analysis (MA)-Bench, built on mission analysis, the first step of military operational planning, in which a staff reads the full situation and states the problem before anyone proposes a solution. Its 10 expert-built scenarios pair synthetic packets of ten to twelve documents with 1,257 expert-written pass/fail requirements, each containing information on their source, question type, and importance level. A reasoning-model judge grades each brief against the requirements without seeing the documents; it grades like a fifth credentialed planner, leaving a four-planner panel's agreement unchanged (Fleiss $\kappa$ 0.42 to 0.41), and a judge from a second provider reproduces the model ranking (Spearman 0.94). Across twenty frontier and open-weights models the best gets 62% of the rubric items right. Models are strongest on facts stated in the documents (58%) and weakest on judgments that must be inferred (33%), and six failures in ten are omissions rather than errors. MA-Bench grades the determinations, not the prose. We release the packets, rubrics, prompts, scorer and every graded brief with item-level verdicts.

</details>


### [341] [Imagining Goals with Geometric Horizon Models for Policy Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19129)
*Daniel Lawson,Dhruv Sreenivas,Adriana Hugessen,Khimya Khetarpal,Glen Berseth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TD-Aug方法，利用几何水平模型（GHM）通过TD-Flow生成可组合的新颖目标，以增强离线目标条件行为克隆（BC）策略的零样本组合泛化能力。该方法在OGBench的stitching任务中显著提升了泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线训练的目标条件BC策略在组合泛化（即拼接不同轨迹完成新任务）方面表现较差。现有世界模型生成长视野样本困难，且现有数据增强技术（如聚类拼接）仅能处理单步拼接。

Method: 1) 提出TD-Aug方法：训练一个基于流的GHM来近似行为混合策略的后继测度，然后将其生成的目标用于目标条件BC策略的训练作为数据增强；2) 提出新的MCHC-β目标函数，结合蒙特卡洛监督和TD自举来改善长视野生成质量；3) 在理论上证明该方法等价于基于行为策略的值加权回归。

Result: 在OGBench基准的stitching任务中：低维导航任务平均成功率从31%提升至79%；基于图像的任务从29%提升至56%；机械操作任务从13%提升至52%。TD-Aug优于GCIQL、QRL、CRL、HIQL等多种离线GCRL基线方法，并能改善CRL的价值学习。

Conclusion: 基于TD的几何水平模型能够通过目标增强显著提升行为克隆的组合泛化能力。MCHC-β目标在生成长视野、具备拼接能力的样本方面优于纯TD或纯MC方法。该方法为离线目标条件RL中的组合泛化提供了一个有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Training from offline data has allowed for substantial progress in domains such as robotics, leading to general-purpose policies that can be easily applied zero-shot or efficiently finetuned for downstream tasks. However, these policies can still have poor generalization, both due to the choice of modeling objective and from learning from a static dataset. In this work, we focus on the challenging task of zero-shot goal generalization, where a policy is evaluated on unseen tasks that require combining its existing knowledge (compositional generalization). An avenue for improving a policy's generalization is by generating new experience with world models; however, such generation has proven difficult for longer horizons. Thus, to alleviate this issue, we propose TD-Aug, which samples from a geometric horizon model and allows for directly imagining novel outcomes that can be achieved by composing existing knowledge. We demonstrate that training on these future outcomes as goals for goal-conditioned BC policies significantly improves generalization in stitching-based OGBench tasks.

</details>


### [342] [PairIT: Autoregressive Transformers for Low-Data Molecule Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19123)
*Hannah Lawrence,Bodhi P. Vani,Ji Won Park,Natasa Tagasovska,Samuel Don Stanton,Andrew Martin Watkins,Michael Maser,Ewa M. Nowara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PairIT是一个面向低数据种子分子优化的紧凑型（68M参数）自回归Transformer框架，通过匹配分子对（MMP）训练学习局部化学编辑，并引入结构化提示令牌支持单/多属性可控生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物发现早期阶段常面临标注数据稀缺（仅数百到数千个分子）的"种子分子优化"问题：需在保留种子结构的同时改进目标属性。现有方法多在de novo生成或大数据场景下评估，低数据种子优化这一现实场景未被充分研究。

Method: 1) 使用68M参数解码器-only自回归Transformer（Llama风格）在SMILES上训练；2) 构造结构相似的有向分子对（MMP或Tanimoto近邻）作为监督信号；3) 引入结构化提示令牌编码属性身份、方向与变化幅度，支持推理时多属性组合；4) 提供三个变体：PairIT（基线）、PairIT-Beam（迭代重播种）、PairIT-RL（GRPO后训练+相似度正则化）；5) 在ZINC-250K上预训练后在MoleculeNet（BACE/BBBP/HIV）小数据集上微调（仅88–662对）。

Result: 在MoleculeNet低数据设置下，68M的PairIT在BACE和BBBP上与大幅更大或更复杂的基线（如7B GeLLM4O-C、NF-BO、DDSBM、HierG2G）具有竞争力或更优（BBBP VIN达87.27%，PairIT-Beam达90.91%）；HIV上PairIT-RL将VIN从33.94%提升至82.6%；hERG毒性数据集上PairIT-Beam达79.76% VIN。提示令牌实现QED/logP粗粒度幅度控制及多属性联合优化（如BBBP QED+logP联合VIN达30%）；预训练分析显示匹配对预训练优于单分子预训练，但收益在不到一个epoch时即饱和，增大预训练数据呈现边际递减。

Conclusion: PairIT证明在低数据种子分子优化场景下，精心构造的匹配对数据配合紧凑Transformer即可达到强大基线水平，无需依赖大型通用LLM；提示令牌为多属性优化提供了无需重训的灵活控制；领域知识体现在配对距离、构造策略、提示设计与奖励函数中；强化学习可作为可选扩展，但需相似度正则化以避免奖励欺骗；预训练存在早期饱和现象，激进早停是关键。

Abstract: Generating novel molecules with desired properties is a central challenge in drug discovery. Although foundational work focused on de novo generation, practical use cases require a more complex setting: conditioning on an initial seed molecule, optimizing multiple properties, and operating in data-sparse regimes. We introduce PairIT, a flexible training framework for autoregressive transformers over SMILES sequences that enables seeded generation by learning from pairs of structurally similar molecules. By leveraging matched pairs, the model learns to generate local, chemically meaningful edits that improve a property of the seed molecule. Prompt tokens extend this framework by specifying the target property, desired direction, and approximate magnitude of change. Multiple prompt tokens can be concatenated to enable multi-property optimization at inference time. For properties where pair supervision alone is insufficient, reinforcement learning post-training can further improve optimization, providing a tunable trade-off between proximity to the seed and the optimization objective. PairIT naturally supports pretraining on a large dataset and fine-tuning on a smaller dataset, which is critical for performance in data-sparse regimes. Surprisingly, we observe diminishing returns to the scale of the pretraining dataset. We demonstrate empirically on MoleculeNet and Therapeutics Data Commons datasets that, with appropriate paired-data curation, a standard transformer model of modest size (68M parameters) can achieve robust seeded molecular optimization in low-data regimes.

</details>


### [343] [Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19121)
*Woosang Lim,Haneul Yoo,Vincent-Daniel Yun,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LayerTrim是一种无需训练的结构化剪枝方法，通过保留注意力机制和解码器深度、选择性修剪冗余层的MLP特征，在不进行梯度更新或恢复训练的情况下，首次将训练自由的结构化剪枝应用于保留长链思维推理能力的任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的结构化剪枝方法在面向推理语言模型（RLMs）处理长链思维推理任务（如AIME）时，会导致推理性能的崩溃。其根本原因在于这些方法是为非推理大语言模型设计的，未考虑长形式推理的内在结构。LayerTrim旨在解决这一痛点，在压缩模型的同时保留推理能力。

Method: LayerTrim方法包含三个核心设计原则：(1) 保留注意力机制：通过诊断分析发现，仅修剪MLP宽度比修剪注意力或移除整个模块产生的表示误差更小。(2) 选择性MLP特征修剪：利用特征重要性分数（基于中间激活的期望平方范数与下行投影向量范数的乘积）筛选并保留关键特征，丢弃冗余特征。(3) 基于Block Influence (BI) 的预算分配：利用Block Influence指标识别冗余的解码器层，将剪枝预算集中分配给这些低影响力的层，并均匀修剪（默认每层选择K=2N个MLP，每层保留m个特征）。该方法是无需梯度的，仅通过密集模型的推理轨迹进行teacher-forced前向传播来收集统计数据。

Result: 在三个推理语言模型（Qwen3-14B、Phi-4-reasoning-plus、Magistral-Small-2506）和五个基准测试（AIME25/26、GPQA-Diamond、HumanEval、MBPP+）上，LayerTrim在大多数评估设置下优于现有结构化剪枝方法。在N=9层等价预算下，平均准确率分别比最强基线高出6.8、14.3和21.4个百分点（相比RESP最多提升21.4个百分点）。在Qwen3-14B上，LayerTrim实现了1.24倍prefill加速和19.7%的峰值GPU内存降低，且在评估的剪枝模型中平均生成长度最短，同时保留了最高的平均准确率。其剪枝准备时间比RESP快94至140倍。消融实验验证了MLP修剪目标、特征重要性评分和基于块影响的层选择策略的有效性。

Conclusion: LayerTrim通过选择性修剪MLP特征同时保留注意力机制和解码器深度，有效降低了推理语言模型的推理成本。它利用密集模型的推理轨迹来识别冗余层并保留高重要性特征，无需梯度或恢复训练。实验证明，LayerTrim在两个剪枝预算下均取得了比评估的结构化剪枝基线更高的平均准确率，并实现了相当的推理加速，为通过无需训练的结构化剪枝实现推理语言模型的高效部署迈出了重要一步。局限性在于评估集中在三个模型和五个基准上，未来工作可探索更多架构、规模及自适应预算分配。

Abstract: Structured pruning reduces LLM inference costs by removing model components to produce smaller dense models. However, existing methods can cause reasoning performance to collapse on long-form reasoning tasks such as AIME. We propose \textit{LayerTrim}, a training-free structured pruning method that identifies redundant decoder layers and selectively trims their MLP features while preserving attention and decoder depth. LayerTrim is the first training-free structured pruning method designed to preserve long-form reasoning without gradients or recovery training. Across three reasoning language models and five benchmarks, LayerTrim outperforms existing structured pruning methods in most evaluated settings, improving average accuracy by up to 21.4 percentage points over RESP. On \texttt{Qwen3-14B}, LayerTrim achieves 1.24$\times$ faster prefill and 19.7\% lower peak GPU memory than the dense model, while better preserving reasoning ability. It also achieves the shortest average generation length among evaluated pruned models, while retaining the highest average accuracy. These results demonstrate that LayerTrim improves reasoning efficiency through both structural compression and reduced token generation.

</details>


### [344] [Genesis Steering: Better Activation Steering Through Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19114)
*Tora Bodin,Eric Aubinais,Ilaria Torre,Chih-Hong Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"genesis steering"（创世引导），主张用模型自身微调数据中的对比样本来构建激活引导方向；当原始微调数据不可访问时，借助成员推断攻击（membership inference）从候选池中筛选代理创世数据集，从而提升大语言模型推理时行为控制的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）是一种无需修改模型参数即可在推理时控制LLM行为的有效手段（如控制拒绝行为），但其效果高度依赖用于构建引导方向的对比样本选择。当前方法（如CAA、difference-of-means）常因提示变化或反引导现象导致效果不稳定，却鲜有研究系统探讨"应使用哪些对比样本来定义引导方向"这一根本问题。此外，模型自身的安全微调数据通常并不公开，进一步限制了引导方向选择的可操作性。

Method: 1) **Genesis Steering框架**：将差分均值（difference-of-means）引导向量构建于模型自身微调数据中的对比对（拒绝/顺从响应）之上，称为genesis向量。2) **理论保证**：提出两个命题——在椭圆表示密度与主轴可分性假设下，genesis方向最小化到达决策边界的欧氏位移（命题1）；在均值保留选择的混合模型下，成员推断代理构建当真阳性率高于假阳性率时严格减少类均值估计偏差（命题2）。3) **基于成员推断的代理构建**：当原始微调数据不可用时，对候选数据集按10种成员推断分数（Loss、zlib、Min-K%、Min-K%++、Gap、Min-K gap、Top-1、ReCaLL、s_base、s_twin）排序，取Top-K构建代理genesis数据集。4) **实验评估**：在Tülu-3-8B（公开SFT数据）和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（未公开数据，作为负对照）上，使用七组安全数据集（含三组来自Tülu训练混合），在第16层输入处进行引导，在HarmBench、StrongREJECT、XSTest、OR-Bench、Alpaca五个基准上以gemma-2-27b-it为评判测量翻转范围和可引导性。

Result: 1) **Genesis数据来源优势显著**：Tülu-3-8B训练混合中的安全数据（WildGuardMix、WildJailbreak、CoCoNot）构建的引导向量在两个模型上均优于外部数据集——Tülu-3-8B上可引导性0.924–0.990 vs 外部0.730–0.977；Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct同样观察到该模式，表明该优势具有跨模型泛化性。2) **成员推断代理效果依赖候选池**：在Tülu-3-8B上，各成员分数在识别训练样本上高度一致（前四分位共识达到0.954/0.991的refusal/compliance pole训练数据占比），Top-128代理向量与同等规模随机子集具有竞争力且优于Bottom-128。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上（候选数据均非其训练数据），Top-128选择反而比随机子集更差（可引导性下降0.454–0.058），Min-K%++选择甚至因分布偏移严重导致40.9%的提示退化。3) **选择偏差违反理论假设**：经验分析发现成员分数选择对两极的处理不对称（如Min-K%++在Llama上将refusal极沿池轴移动-1.531个标准差），违背了命题2中"保留每个混合分量均值"的假设，解释了理论与实证的差距。

Conclusion: 本文证明模型自身微调数据是构建激活引导向量的优选参考源；成员推断可在原始数据不可访问时作为有效的代理构建工具，但仅当候选池包含模型的真实训练样本时才能带来增益。该研究凸显了参考数据选择对激活引导效果的决定性影响，并为微调数据组成与可控性的关系提供了新视角，同时为设计兼顾行为学习与推理时可干预性的微调混合开辟了方向。

Abstract: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time, but its effectiveness depends on the choice of reference data. We introduce genesis steering, which derives a genesis vector from contrastive examples in the model's own fine-tuning data. When these data are unavailable, we draw on the membership inference literature to identify likely training examples and construct a proxy dataset. We establish two theoretical results on optimal displacement to the decision boundary and reduced proxy-estimation bias. We evaluate genesis steering and membership-based proxy construction on Tülu-3-8B, whose fine-tuning data are publicly available, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as a control. We find that safety data from Tülu-3-8B's training mixture yield stronger steering than external datasets on both models. On Tülu-3-8B, membership scores largely agree in identifying training examples, and vectors built from top-ranked examples achieve competitive performance against random subsets of the same size. In contrast, the results on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct hint that a MIA method will only have a positive effect if the mean direction shift with MIA-filtered in-distribution data is much less severe than the direction shift with OoD data.

</details>


### [345] [Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19084)
*Chinmoy Mitra,Tarek Mahmud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Reflective Feedback-Driven Prompt Optimization（RFDPO），一种自动提示优化工具，通过追踪每条样本的恢复、回归和变动（churn），揭示聚合准确率所掩盖的逐项行为变化。实验在五个基准（法律、知识、指令遵循、数学、隐私）上表明：单条净变化可隐藏多达17个变动结果，校验集提升仅为测试集的约61%，而物品级反馈可将churn降低约40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动提示优化（APO）方法主要以聚合准确率评估效果，无法揭示哪些样本从错误变为正确、哪些从正确变为错误，也无法反映优化增益是否迁移到未见样本。这种评估盲区可能导致优化引入隐性失败。

Method: 提出RFDPO工具：在每次提示修订后，对Mining集（M）和Validation集（V）进行评估，对比修订前后逐例正确性，定义恢复集R（错→对）、回归集G（对→错）、净变化N=|R|-|G|和变动量C=|R|+|G|。从第2轮起，将逐项效果报告反馈给优化器，引导后续修订。Test集T仅在初始与最终提示上评估，不参与反馈。提示采用五段式结构（System Role/Context/Task Details/Constraints/Output Format）以便追踪修改。

Result: 在5个基准×2个求解器的9个主要配置中，5个配置的churn至少为绝对净变化的5倍；LegalBench-Hearsay上单条净变化掩盖了13–17个变动结果（约27–35%的测试集）。17个编辑返回中，平均校验提升+7.9pp，测试提升+5.2pp（测试约为校验的66%）；3个校验提升但测试下降。GPT-5作优化器、GPT-4o-mini和GPT-4.1 Mini作求解器。在LegalBench-Hearsay上的探索性消融显示，提供物品级反馈使每轮Mining churn从5.2降至3.1（p=0.024），但测试准确率未改善。资源消耗差异显著（AIME需约498K优化器输入token，Hearsay仅约14K）。

Conclusion: 聚合准确率不足以评估提示优化；推荐报告恢复、回归、churn以及校验-测试迁移指标。RFDPO无需额外推理开销即可记录这些信息，支持更透明的APO分析，但反馈对泛化的提升仍待验证。

Abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) uses feedback from model responses to improve prompts automatically. However, its effectiveness is usually measured through overall scores, which do not reveal which questions become correct, which previously correct answers become wrong, or whether improvements extend to unseen questions. We introduce Reflective Feedback-Driven Prompt Optimization (RFDPO), a tool that tracks recoveries (incorrect to correct), regressions (correct to incorrect), and churn (all changed outcomes). RFDPO uses this feedback to guide subsequent revisions and records prompt changes throughout optimization. We evaluate RFDPO across five benchmarks covering law, knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, and privacy, using GPT-5 as the optimizer and GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1 Mini as solvers. Our results show that overall accuracy can hide substantial changes: in five of nine configurations, churn was at least five times the absolute net change, and a single-item net change concealed up to 17 changed outcomes. Average validation gains were 7.9 percentage points, compared with 5.2 points on held-out tests. In a controlled ablation on LegalBench-Hearsay, item-level feedback reduced churn by 40% ($p=0.024$) while maintaining similar net gains. These findings motivate reporting recovery, regression, churn, and performance on unseen data alongside overall accuracy.

</details>


### [346] [How Inner Optimizers Shape Replica Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19064)
*Eugene Belilovsky,Stefan Horoi,Edouard Oyallon,Benjamin Thérien*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在 DiLoCo 等分布式本地优化框架中,内部优化器的选择如何影响模型副本(replica)扩展时的性能退化问题。作者识别出两个影响副本扩展性的关键因素:伪梯度的协方差结构和批量大小对伪梯度噪声尺度的影响,并通过理论和实验证明白化(whitening)预处理是一个有效的内部优化器设计准则。实证表明基于白化的内部优化器(如 SPlus、SOAP)在 8-96 副本范围内表现出优异的副本扩展性,相对 DP 基线的性能损失最小可控制在 3% 以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练大语言模型需要跨地理分布的弱互联计算集群,这推动了 DiLoCo 等本地优化方法的研究。然而,固定总训练预算下增加副本数会导致性能单调下降,这是制约本地优化方法广泛应用的核心难题。现有工作虽然经验性地表明内部优化器的选择(如 Muon vs AdamW)能显著改善这一趋势,但缺乏理论解释。

Method: 方法包含三个层面:(1) 理论分析:将本地优化相对 DP 的误差分解为均值偏差(mean mismatch)和随机误差(stochastic error)两项,证明白化预处理可控制最大方向方差并促进副本间协方差匹配;(2) 单步分析:在高斯提案模型下推导 SPlus 的均值和协方差表达式,以及基于高斯方差微分法对 Adam/SOAP 的均值偏差界,并据此提出 β₂ 的 token half-life 缩放规则;(3) 实验验证:在 178M 和 512M 规模 LLaMA 模型上系统对比 SOAP、SPlus、Muon、AdamW、Shampoo 等内部优化器,采用各向异性指标、均值/噪声比、损失 Hessian 曲率等度量进行分析。

Result: 主要结果包括:(1) SPlus 在 96 副本时相对自身 DP 基线的损失增加仅为 2.1%(512M),显著优于 SOAP(+4.4%)、Muon(+7.7%)和 AdamW(+12%);(2) 各向异性指标 a₁ 排序为 SPlus(0.43) < SOAP(2.3) < Muon(3.8) < AdamW(35),与副本扩展性表现一致;(3) 沿高噪声方向,均值偏差仅为随机误差的 7.5%-19%,验证了控制随机误差的重要性;(4) Hessian 曲率分析显示 SOAP 和 SPlus 将噪声均匀分散到各方向,而 AdamW 沿高曲率方向集中噪声(460-730 倍平均曲率);(5) 应用 β₂ 缩放规则后,IsoLoCo 甚至能超越 MuLoCo,512M 模型 R=64 时 DiLoCo 损失从 2.884 降至 2.849;(6) 单步实验(H=1)证实即使无多步参数漂移,优化器选择仍主导副本扩展性。

Conclusion: 白化预处理是本地优化中内部优化器选择的关键准则。白化类优化器(SPlus、SOAP)在副本扩展时损失最小,且其优势源于将伪梯度噪声均匀分散到各参数方向,避免了对高曲率方向的过度损伤。这两类优化器可实现 50+ 副本仅 3% 以内的性能退化,其中 SPlus 在高副本数下表现最佳,而 SOAP 在 DP 性能上最强且在大规模下有望成为最优选择。此外,通过 token half-life 规则缩放 β₂ 可使基于 Adam 的方法(如 IsoLoCo)在不增加谱分解开销的情况下达到接近白化方法的效果,为资源受限场景提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) across geographically distributed and poorly interconnected compute pools or data centers has become a topic of significant interest. This has led to increased study of local optimization methods such as DiLoco for LLMs, especially those that use local (or inner) adaptive or preconditioned optimizers, which are critical for high-performance LLM training. However, a central challenge remains: it is well known that increasing the number of model replicas (replica scaling) while fixing the total training budget leads to monotonically decreasing performance. Existing work has empirically demonstrated that the choice of inner optimizer (Muon v.s. AdamW) can significantly improve this trend, but offers only limited explanation of the performance difference. In this work, we consider a range of inner-optimizers and identify two important factors that impact replica scaling: (1) the covariance structure of the pseudo-gradients and (2) the impact of batch size on the pseudogradient's noise scale. Based on these insights, we theoretically and empirically demonstrate that whitening-based pre-conditioning is a powerful inner-optimizer desideratum. Our empirical evaluation extends the results to reveal that whitening-based inner-optimizers achieve strong replica scaling (for 8-96 replicas), with performance relative to DP improving as parameters and data are scaled.

</details>


### [347] [Graph Coarsening Enables Escaping Local Optima in Compute-Constrained Nonconvex MAX-CUT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19043)
*M. Harper Langston,Pierre-David Letourneau,Dalton Jones,Harris Teague,Peter Scott,Mingu Lee,Richard Lethin,Chris Lott,Roland Memisevic,Fatih Porikli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CMG+PPR流水线，将粒子多项式松弛（PPR）与组合多重网格（CMG）粗化初始化相结合，用于计算受限场景下的MAX-CUT非凸优化。该方法在稀疏加权图上表现优异，在t2g20上达到97.5%平均/98.4%最优种子的最优解比例，在Biq Mac全部60个实例上匹配已发布最优解，并通过CSR稀疏表示扩展到20,000顶点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MAX-CUT的二元解空间包含指数级局部最优，传统单bit局部搜索高度依赖初始化质量；经典Goemans-Williamson 0.878最坏情形保证未能反映结构化实例上非凸求解器在良好初始化下能达到的性能。需要一种无需训练数据、能提供结构感知初始解、并在计算受限时可扩展到大规模图的方法。

Method: 提出三级流水线：(1) Spielman-Srivastava有效电阻谱稀疏化（仅用于|E|>3n的密集图）；(2) CMG谱粗化构建coarsen-solve-uncoarsen层次结构，生成结构感知的二进制热启动（O(|E|log n)复杂度，无需训练）；(3) PPR（基于矩的连续非凸重构，L层、R粒子的乘积测度表示），通过L-BFGS求解并采用penalty-continuation调度，最优二元解在多pass间链式传递，最后单次2-opt扫描收尾。理论分析证明：在混合权重β自由移动时，每个非最优点具有零逃逸屏障（escape barrier）；β固定为均匀平均时，屏障上界为C/L。算法采用稀疏CSR存储实现O(LnR)线性扩展。

Result: 在t2g20（n=400）上，CMG→5-pass PPR→单次2-opt达到0.975平均/0.984最佳种子的最优解比例（GW保证0.878）；完整流水线（含KL→3-opt→200重启→memetic GA离散尾部）在所有60个Biq Mac实例上匹配已发布最优解（8.5-130.5秒/实例，对比神经分支定界4509秒）；G-set实例n=5000-20000通过CSR稀疏存储实现833-3333×内存节省，连续松弛路径保持Δ2opt=1.19-1.21×增益，加入离散尾部后Δfinal=1.32-1.33×，G77和G81达到98.7%/99.0%外部验证最优解。方法在稀疏加权结构化图上增益最大，在密集均匀图或Erdős-Rényi图上增益有限（CMG粗化失败）。离散尾部消融显示：在约半数硬实例上，纯随机种子的GA在相同预算下可匹配或超过CMG种子流水线。

Conclusion: 结构感知CMG热启动与基于粒子的连续松弛相结合，可在广泛问题规模上获得接近最优的MAX-CUT解，且无需训练数据或推理硬件。在计算受限场景下具有鲁棒优势；但当大预算离散搜索可用时，最终解质量越来越多由尾部抛光阶段决定，而非热启动。该方法适合具有可利用权重异质性的稀疏加权结构化图，对密集或均匀权重图效果有限。

Abstract: Because its binary optimization landscape contains exponentially many local optima, MAX-CUT is highly sensitive to initialization. We study Particle Polynomial Relaxation (PPR), a moment-based nonconvex continuous reformulation possessing an advantageous optimization landscape. We warm-start PPR with Combinatorial Multigrid (CMG), a spectral graph-coarsening method that produces structure-aware initial solutions in near-linear time without training data. On \texttt{t2g20} ($n=400$), benchmark instance with known exact optimum, the combined CMG+PPR pipeline reaches $97.5\%$ of optimum on average and $98.4\%$ on the best run. An extended variant with discrete local-search refinement reaches the published optimum on all sixty Biq Mac instances evaluated by a recent neural branch-and-bound method. Using a sparse CSR representation, the same approach scales to G-set instances with up to $20{,}000$ vertices reducing memory requirements by up to $3333\times$ while maintaining a consistent improvement over the CMG warm start. Gains are largest on sparse weighted graphs; on dense graphs we complement the pipeline with spectral sparsification.

</details>


### [348] [Loss Curvature as a Sampling-Free Proxy for Memorization in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19042)
*Shashank Sule,Xinyue Yu,Boonam Shin,Yuxuan Liu,Abolfazl Hashemi,Hayden Schaeffer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需采样的扩散模型记忆化度量——输入损失曲率（Frobenius范数的Hessian矩阵），用于同时从模型层面和样本层面量化训练数据记忆化现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在训练中会出现记忆化（memorization）现象，导致隐私和版权风险。现有研究在模型层面需要昂贵的采样操作，而在样本层面则依赖昂贵的留一法重训练。因此，需要一种无需生成样本即可在训练过程中实时监测记忆化程度的代理指标。

Method: （1）定义输入损失曲率为去噪损失对输入的二阶Hessian矩阵的Frobenius范数的期望；（2）将该指标用于模型层面，追踪训练过程中训练集与验证集曲率的演化；（3）引入反事实记忆化（counterfactual memorization）定义，度量单个样本在训练集与留一集之间的对数似然差；（4）基于Lipschitz Hessian、PL不等式、一阶优化器收敛性等假设，建立反事实记忆化与留一模型输入曲率之间的理论界。

Result: （1）训练集平均曲率随训练上升并跟踪记忆化率f_mem；（3）验证集曲率与训练集曲率的分离点对应记忆化起点，相对曲率差ΔCurv(τ)可作为早停准则；（3）单个样本的曲率不能预测其被复制的频率；（4）理论上证明留一模型的输入曲率以领近邻距离的多项式形式控制反事实记忆化的上界；（6）在ImageNet 64×64和CelebA 32×32上的DDPM与流匹配实验验证了上述结论。

Conclusion: 输入损失曲率是扩散模型记忆化的有效、无需采样的代理指标。在模型层面，训练集与验证集曲率的相对差可作为早期停止准则；在样本层面，反事实记忆化在理论上受留一模型曲率控制。虽然样本级曲率无法预测复制频率，但整体方法为理解和监测扩散模型记忆化提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Understanding the mechanism behind why diffusion models memorize their training data remains an open question in generative modeling. In this paper, we examine this question from two perspectives: (a) the model-level perspective concerning the onset of memorization in a model during training, and (b) the sample-level perspective concerning the proclivity of an individual sample to be memorized by a given model. We show that the so-called input loss curvature, or the Frobenius norm of the Hessian of the diffusion model's training loss, is an effective metric for quantifying both perspectives on memorization. In particular, we empirically demonstrate that input curvatures averaged across training and validation samples can identify when a model is likely to start regurgitating its training data when tracked over training time. However, this metric is not sufficient for measuring an individual sample's likelihood of being memorized. To address this perspective, we introduce a counterfactual definition of memorization in diffusion models, extending the analogous notion from supervised learning proposed by [Feldman, 2019]. We prove that this counterfactual memorization is controlled by the input curvature of the leave-one-out model, thus establishing a direct theoretical link between a sample's local loss landscape and its generation likelihood. We validate our derived bounds through several empirical experiments and show that input-dependent curvature provides a proxy for memorization.

</details>


### [349] [Who Should We Listen to More? Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition for Pluralistic Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19035)
*Ruomeng Ding,Tianwei Gao,Lianrui Geng,Mohit Bansal,Zhun Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WAPA（Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition），一种面向多元对齐的福利感知偏好采集方法，通过社会福利目标在有限人工标注预算下分配反馈，以同时兼顾代表性不足的个体和应用指定的优先群体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多元对齐中，AI模拟器标注偏好对节省成本，但不同个体的模拟精度差异导致部分人偏好被低估；现有主动采集方法未明确反馈增益在群体间应如何分配，需要一种可控制、显式的分配机制。

Method: 定义基于个体监督效用的社会福利目标，包含两类优先级（当前监督劣势和应用指定权重）；使用参考模型估计每个查询的边际福利增益并贪心选择，证明贪心规则在固定预算和模型预测下精确最大化估计的福利目标；采集到的标签用于DPO策略训练。

Result: 在六个Roleplay数据集和四个OpinionQA区域上，20%标注预算下WAPA在均值、尾部和目标群体效用上均优于随机、熵、参考分歧、APL和BAL-PM等基线；策略训练在20%标注下恢复了全伪标签与全真实标签策略间75–86%的预测效用差距；参数γ和ρ可控制子群体优先级与公平性之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 福利感知偏好采集将监督增益在人群间的分布作为训练数据构建的显式选择项，连接了反馈分配决策与对齐政策对多元偏好的预测能力，为多元对齐中的预算分配提供了理论和实证基础。

Abstract: Pluralistic alignment needs to accommodate diverse preferences under limited human feedback. Using AI simulators to label preference comparisons reduces annotation costs, but variation in simulation accuracy across individuals can leave some people's preferences poorly represented in training. We study how to allocate human feedback across people to construct training data for pluralistic alignment, and how this allocation affects the trained policy. To make this allocation explicit and controllable, we define a social welfare objective over individual supervision utilities that measure label quality. Each query's marginal welfare gain depends on its expected supervision improvement, the recipient's current utility, and application-designated priority. Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition (WAPA) uses auxiliary reference models to estimate query gains and individual utilities, then selects queries by estimated marginal welfare gain while updating recipient utilities. We prove exact optimality of the acquisition algorithm for the estimated welfare objective under a fixed query budget and model predictions. Experiments on six Roleplay collections and four OpinionQA regions demonstrate improved supervision and controllable allocation tradeoffs. Policy training on four Roleplay collections improves preference prediction for both seen and unseen individuals. When prioritizing a designated group and poorly represented individuals, acquiring human labels for 20% of comparisons recovers 75-86% of the average predictive utility gap between policies trained entirely on AI-generated labels and entirely on ground-truth labels.

</details>


### [350] [Scaling Cheap Synthetic Pretraining Improves Indoor Radio-Map Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19015)
*Khoren Petrosyan,Artashes Mkrtchyan,Rafayel Mkrtchyan,Hrant Khachatrian,Theofanis P. Raptis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套可扩展的合成预训练流程，通过程序化生成多样化室内布局并结合快速开源近似射线追踪器，构建了1.28亿样本的合成语料库，在ResNet-101和Swin-T上预训练后在五个ICASSP/MLSP室内无线电地图预测基准上平均减少15%相对误差，并展示了可预测的数据缩放趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内路径损耗预测面临两个数据瓶颈：真实测量数据稀缺昂贵，且高精度射线追踪模拟器缓慢、专有、难以大规模生成训练数据。现有深度学习方法依赖任务特定的工程化特征或架构，无法受益于大规模预训练范式。

Method: 1）构建可配置的输入-标签生成管道：程序化平面图栅格化器生成多样化布局，Numba加速的2D射线追踪器（46080条射线，最多5次反射和10次穿透）生成路径损耗标签；2）生成1.28亿独特合成样本（约6TB），含11通道输入表示（反射率、透射率、距离、天线增益、对数频率傅里叶通道等）；3）在固定FLOP预算（6×10^18）下搜索10种编码器-UNet架构，选择ResNet101和Swin-T；4）使用WSD学习率策略在2M-256M样本规模上预训练，并对五个下游任务（3个ICASSP + 2个MLSP稀疏采样）进行微调。

Result: ResNet-101在五个任务公共排行榜上较最佳已知方法平均减少15%相对误差（ICASSP T1: -12.17%, T2: -27.86%, T3: -19.27%, MLSP 0.02: -8.23%, MLSP 0.5: -14.16%）；基于2M-16M数据拟合的幂律可外推预测32M-128M归一化RMSE（ResNet101的MAPE为3.33%，Swin-T为7.10%）；真实RSSI测量冻结特征迁移实验显示8M时RMSE从5.878降至5.117 dB（p=0.0082）；物理探测显示模型学会自由空间频率缩放（0.45% MAPE）、距离缩放（1.10% MAPE）、单墙损耗校准（MAE 0.41 dB）和D4场景等变性一致性等。

Conclusion: 廉价的近似模拟预训练可使稀缺的高质量室内无线电地图数据更具价值。ResNet101在所有五个公共排行榜任务上均有改进，扩展呈可预测趋势（但非单调）。模拟器保真度和材料信息仍然重要，特别是在目标监督稀缺时。冻结预测为真实RSSI校准回归增添信息；受控探测显示出物理上有意义的结构。高保真模拟和真实测量仍然是适应和验证的必要条件。

Abstract: Real measurements are too limited to train an accurate indoor pathloss predictor that works across a wide range of buildings. Large-scale synthetic pretraining offers a way forward, but real building layouts are also scarce, and accurate ray-tracing simulators are slow, expensive, and often proprietary. We address both problems by introducing a generator that automatically creates diverse indoor layouts and a fast, open-source approximate ray tracer that computes radio maps for them. Using this pipeline, we generate 128M synthetic samples, pretrain ResNet-101 and Swin-T encoder-decoders, and fine-tune them on high-quality benchmark data. Despite simulator mismatch, our ResNet-101 model reduces error by 15% on average relative to the best known methods across five indoor radio-map prediction tasks and improves transfer on a small real-measurement dataset. Both architectures show predictable data-scaling trends: power laws fitted on 2M-16M samples predict the mean normalized downstream RMSE at 32M-128M with 3.33% mean absolute percentage error for ResNet-101 and 7.10% for Swin-T. These results show that pretraining on large amounts of cheap simulated data can improve indoor radio-map prediction, even when real measurements and high-quality simulations are limited.

</details>


### [351] [Token Utility for On-Policy Distillation via Local Trust-Region Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18883)
*Narayanan Sadagopan,Yilan Chen,Vijay Lingam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW)，一种基于优化目标本身推导的 token 重要性度量方法。该方法通过求解每个 token 位置在相同 KL 预算下的局部信任域优化问题，得到闭式效用 $s_t = g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$，对 reverse-KL 退化为对数比方差，对 forward-KL 退化为 Pearson $\chi^2$ 散度。在 Qwen3 系列三个学生-教师对和七个数学推理基准上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中的 token 选择方法（基于熵、师生分歧、不匹配方向等启发式信号）缺乏统一的优化理论基础。作者希望从蒸馏目标本身出发，定义 token 重要性，以替代主观设计的启发式准则。

Method: 为每个学生访问的预测分布建立局部信任域优化问题：在对预测分布施加相同 KL 预算 $\varepsilon$ 的约束下，最大化 token 级蒸馏损失的一阶减少量。通过 Fisher 几何求解，得到自然梯度方向的闭式解，效用为 $s_t = g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$。具体地，对 reverse-KL，效用等于学生加权的对数概率比方差；对 forward-KL，效用等于 Pearson $\chi^2$ 散度。将其实例化为 Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW)：在候选集上计算受限的对数比方差，做均值归一化后得到连续 token 权重。

Result: 在三个 Qwen3 学生-教师对（1.7B←8B、1.7B←14B、4B←30B-A3B）和七个数学推理基准（AIME24/25、AMC23、BRUMO25、MATH-500、Minerva、OlympiadBench，共 1620 题）上，FUW 在 reverse-KL 下提升 1.35–4.0 宏平均百分点，在 forward-KL 下提升 1.08–2.71 宏平均百分点。分析表明，学生熵、KL 分歧、TIP 等多个独立准则在 50% 选择比例下与 FUW 共享相似的高重要性支持区域，但在更严格的选择比例和方向特定准则（如 TIDE-excess）下出现分歧。消融实验证实位置特定的效用信息和 Fisher 归一化（避免训练后期权重过度集中）均对性能有贡献。

Conclusion: 论文提供了一个从蒸馏目标本身推导 token 效用的优化框架，得到 $g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$ 这一 Fisher 归一化量，其对 reverse-KL 和 forward-KL 分别退化为对数比方差和 $\chi^2$ 散度。FUW 是一种从单一闭式分数得出的连续加权方案，实验证明其优于匹配的均匀 OPD 且与现有选择性方法具有竞争力。该分析是局部的、一阶的，刻画的是局部优化机会而非全局最优共享参数加权规则。局限在于仅在 Qwen3 模型和数学推理任务上验证。

Abstract: Token-selection methods for on-policy distillation (OPD) prioritize student-visited positions using diverse signals, including uncertainty, teacher-student disagreement, and mismatch direction. We instead derive token importance from the distillation objective itself: how much can each position's loss decrease under an equal local KL budget on the student's predictive distribution? The answer is the utility $s_t=g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$, where $g_t$ is the logit gradient and $F_t$ is the categorical Fisher matrix. For reverse-KL it equals the student-weighted variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio, and for forward-KL it equals the Pearson $\chi^2$ divergence, so the appropriate utility follows from the choice of objective. On shared training checkpoints, several independently motivated criteria, including student entropy, KL disagreement, and TIP, concentrate their importance on nearly the same positions as the derived utility at a 50\% selection fraction, while diverging at stricter fractions and for direction-specific criteria. We instantiate the utility as Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW), a continuous, mean-normalized token weighting. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 student-teacher pairs, FUW improves over matched uniform OPD under both reverse-KL (1.35-4.0 macro points) and forward-KL (1.08-2.71 macro points), and is competitive with existing selective methods using a single closed-form score derived from the training objective.

</details>


### [352] [Do Perturbation Predictors Learn Gene Interactions? Diagnosing Extrapolation in Agentic Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18880)
*Ziyuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对Perturb-seq基因组合扰动预测中的"组合性OOD"问题，提出了一种名为"加性分歧（AD）"的可靠性信号。通过将模型预测与简单的单基因效应加和基线进行比较，量化模型对未见组合引入的交互修正幅度。在八个预测方法和三个数据集上的实验表明：专门的神经预测器并不一致优于加性基线；AD比传统的嵌入/输出类OOD信号更一致地预测预测误差；且AD可用于指导智能体筛选工作流中的保守回退决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高 throughput 扰动筛选越来越多地使用机器学习模型预测未测量的基因组合效应。当测试对中两个基因在训练中均单独出现过，但其组合未出现时，构成"组合性OOD"。此时标准OOD方法（如kNN、Mahalanobis距离）失效，因为单个输入并不陌生，新颖性在于交互作用本身。不可靠的预测若用于指导昂贵的后续实验，会浪费资源并误导生物学解读。论文旨在诊断此类外推失败。

Method: 核心方法是将模型预测分解为观测加性参考与模型隐含交互修正两部分：f_θ(A,B) = (δ_A + δ_B) + Î_θ(A,B)，并定义加性分歧 AD(A,B) = (1/G)‖f_θ(A,B) − (δ_A + δ_B)‖_1。评估了八种预测方法（Ridge、MLP、Transformer、CPA、scGPT、GEARS+scGPT、GEARS、加性基线）和八种可靠性信号（AD、预测幅度、基因方差、集成方差、kNN距离、Mahalanobis距离、NN误差代理、余弦相似度），使用失败检测AUROC、误差秩相关和选择性弃预测下的MAE改善等指标，在Norman、Joung-Zhang和Adamson三个Perturb-seq数据集上评估。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 在Norman数据集上，专门的神经预测器并不一致优于简单加性基线；Ridge取得最低MAE并在75次评估中60次优于加性基线；GEARS和GEARS+scGPT表现最差，从未优于加性基线（0/75）。在Joung-Zhang上，CPA以29/44获胜最多。(2) AD在所有模型和两个组合性数据集上均与预测误差正相关（ρ=0.528–0.982），在GEARS上失败检测AUROC达0.996（Top10%）。(3) 传统OOD信号（kNN、Mahalanobis距离、集成方差）跨数据集和模型一致性较差。(4) GEARS的共表达图是其外推失败的主要来源：去除共表达图将MAE从0.0336降至0.0228。(5) 在保守回退分析中，对高风险预测替换为加性参考可大幅降低GEARS的误差。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：当前扰动预测模型并未一致地学习可迁移到未见组合的基因交互效应。模型隐含的交互修正是预测失败的关键驱动因素，其幅度可通过加性分歧可靠地检测。AD是一种跨组合性数据集和模型架构均一致的可靠性信号，特别适用于基于智能体的扰动筛选工作流。论文同时指出了若干局限：AD需要观测单基因效应，不适用于单基因OOD；AD在Top20评估指标下可靠性下降；扩展至高阶组合需要更丰富的参考先验。

Abstract: High-throughput perturbation screens increasingly use machine-learning models to predict the effects of gene combinations that were never measured. A difficult case arises when both genes in a test pair were seen individually during training, but their combination was not. In this setting, standard OOD methods often fail because neither gene appears unfamiliar on its own. We therefore compare each model prediction with a simple additive prediction obtained by summing the two observed single-gene effects. The difference between them, which we call additive disagreement (AD), measures how much extra interaction effect the model introduces for an unseen combination. Across eight prediction methods and three Perturb-seq datasets, specialised neural predictors do not consistently outperform this simple additive baseline. More importantly, predictions with larger deviations from the additive baseline tend to have larger errors. Conventional output-based and embedding-based confidence signals are inconsistent across datasets and models, whereas AD remains informative across all evaluated compositional settings. We further study how this signal can guide decisions in an agentic perturbation-screening workflow. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [353] [Do Vision CIL Methods Transfer to Protein? A Diagnostic Benchmark of Frozen Protein Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18879)
*Ziyuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了首个针对冻结蛋白质编码器的类增量学习(CIL)系统基准，评估了9种视觉领域主流CIL方法在5种蛋白质编码器和2个酶功能数据集上的迁移表现，发现现有方法均无法可靠跨编码器迁移，并诊断出三个根本原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质功能注释的标签空间持续扩展（如EC数量从2018年约4700增至2024年超5000），需要类增量学习(CIL)框架来吸收新发现的酶类别而无需完全重训。当前蛋白质表示学习主要使用冻结的预训练编码器，但CIL方法几乎全在计算机视觉领域开发且未经系统性评估其在冻结蛋白质表征上的迁移性。核心问题：视觉CIL方法能否迁移到冻结蛋白质表示？

Method: 采用控制变量基准测试方法：(1)固定5个冻结蛋白质编码器（ESM2-650M/150M、ProtBert序列PLM；GearNet-Edge结构GNN；SaProt序列-结构融合）；(2)9个代表性CIL方法（EWC正则化；Replay/iCaRL/DER++/RER回放；FeTrIL伪特征；RanPAC随机投影；EASE子空间；FeCAM共享协方差Mahalanobis原型）+ Naive下界与Joint上界；(3)2个酶功能数据集（Enzyme Reaction 348类、EC Number 4788类）；(4)4种phase构建协议（EC-first、Random、Finer-EC、Mixed）；(5)所有方法使用同一组超参数零调优嵌入跨编码器；(6)评估指标为AvgAcc、Forgetting、Plasticity；(7)诊断分析包括梯度冲突余弦与Fisher集中度、嵌入几何统计（内在秩、协方差条件数、类可分性）、协方差粒度对照实验。

Result: (1)主要结果：无方法在所有编码器和数据集上可靠胜出，方法排名随编码器剧烈变化。(2)EWC正则化在梯度信号微弱时几乎退化为Naive，RER退化为普通Replay。(3)回放方法保持高塑性但遗忘严重。(4)FeTrIL与FeCAM呈相反失败模式：前者高塑性但严重遗忘，后者保留旧类能力强但在大规模EC Number上塑性崩溃。(5)RanPAC在大多数序列编码器上强但在GearNet-Edge上骤降。(6)四种phase协议下整体格局稳健，结论表征依赖而非phase依赖。(7)诊断：相位间梯度冲突余弦接近零（-0.01至-0.05）、Fisher信息高度集中于少数头部参数；嵌入几何差异显著，类内协方差条件数跨编码器跨度达5个数量级。(8)共享协方差失效呈结构化：错误集中于转移酶和水解酶两种EC大家族，最优协方差粒度随数据集规模与编码器联合变化。(9)GearNet-Edge始终偏好全共享协方差，其他编码器在更大规模EC Number上优选逐类协方差。

Conclusion: 冻结蛋白质CIL的核心难点不在于灾难性遗忘，而在于现有CIL方法内置假设与底层表征之间的不匹配。研究提出"编码器感知型持续学习"(encoder-aware continual learning)作为新的设计原则：协方差粒度、投影维度、距离度量、正则化强度、内存分配等统计容量应适应表征几何，而非预先固定。EC层次可作为生物先验，但分组与否应由表征几何决定。本研究确立了表征应被视为持续学习设计的核心组件而非被动特征提取器的观点，并提供了未来蛋白CIL方法的设计准则。局限：仅评估冻结编码器与酶功能分类，固定超参数评估plug-and-play迁移而非编码器特定调优的最佳性能。

Abstract: Protein function annotation operates over an expanding label space, making class-incremental learning (CIL) a natural framework for incorporating newly discovered functions without full retraining. Yet existing CIL methods have been developed largely in vision and have not been systematically evaluated over frozen protein representations. We conduct a controlled benchmark of nine representative CIL methods across five sequence-, structure-, and sequence--structure-based protein encoders and two enzyme function datasets at different scales, while keeping the encoders frozen and evaluation settings consistent across representations. We find that no method transfers reliably across encoders, and that these failures persist across alternative phase constructions. Diagnostic analyses reveal that this instability arises from weak gradient-based stability signals, substantial heterogeneity in embedding geometry, and covariance assumptions whose appropriate capacity changes with both dataset scale and encoder. These findings suggest that the representation itself should be treated as a central component of continual-learning design rather than a passive feature extractor. More generally, reliable protein CIL will require encoder-aware methods that adapt their statistical assumptions and capacity to the geometry of the representation on which they operate. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [354] [Inverse Reasoning Models for Efficient Post-Training and Verification from Answer-Only Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18878)
*Eric O. Korman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"逆向推理模型"(Inverse Reasoning Model)的方法，用于在仅有问答对(无CoT推理链)的数据上进行大语言模型的后训练和验证。该方法通过训练一个独立的逆向LLM，根据提示和答案生成CoT推理链，将CoT视为潜变量并采用变分推断方法。在Countdown和GSM8K任务上，逆向模型蒸馏可将困难提示的pass@1翻倍，并在测试时作为验证器将选择准确率从0.753提升到0.969。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理LLM后训练方法在数据成本和计算效率间存在权衡：监督微调需要昂贵的CoT推理链(数据低效)，而强化学习(如GRPO)虽无需CoT但每步需多次自回归采样(计算低效)。本文旨在探索一种中间路径，仅使用answer-only数据实现高效的有监督微调，同时避免GRPO的每步采样开销，特别适用于持续学习场景。

Method: 方法核心是训练一个独立的逆向推理LLM q_φ(C|P,A)，用于从提示和答案重构正向模型p_θ的CoT推理链。采用变分推断近似后验p_θ(C|P,A)。训练目标结合NLL损失和对比边际损失(用包含正确和错误答案的补全组训练)。应用包含两个方向：(1)自蒸馏——用q_φ生成forward-consistent的CoT对p_θ进行SFT，可混入拒绝采样数据(由混合比率μ控制)；(2)测试时验证——用q_φ(C|P,A)的长度归一化对数似然作为验证器分数进行best-of-n选择。所有采样一次完成、前置执行，适合离线持续训练。

Result: 在Qwen3-0.6B上的实验显示：(1)在Countdown和GSM8K的困难提示(p_θ正确率≤25%)上，逆向模型可显著扩展可解集，Countdown上FCR@1从0.09提升至0.45；(2)经过GRPO饱和后，单轮蒸馏使困难pass@1从0.08翻倍至0.19，在pass@8和pass@32上全面优于拒绝采样和GRPO；(3)在新鲜数据上同样有效，混合比率μ≥0.5在所有pass@8/32指标上最优；(4)作为验证器时，Countdown选择准确率从多数投票的0.753跃升至0.969，自适应best-of-n在仅约2次采样时即超越所有基线。

Conclusion: 逆向推理模型为仅有answer-only数据的场景提供了一种高效、可扩展的后训练方案。它在RL饱和后能进一步提升性能(尤其在困难提示的尾部)，适合离线持续学习且避免了GRPO的在线采样开销。逆向模型还可作为准确验证器发挥作用。该方法通用性较强，可应用于任何具备潜变量序列模型的场景。未来方向包括迭代交替更新q_φ和p_θ(EM/wake-sleep框架)、自归一化重要性加权、以及用q_φ合成的轨迹重新引导RL训练。

Abstract: Post-training reasoning LLMs often requires making a tradeoff between costly supervision and compute inefficiency: supervised finetuning typically requires reasoning traces, which is data inefficient since in many applications one only has prompt-answer tuples and lacks the groundtruth chain-of-thought (CoT) sequence. On the other hand, reinforcement learning (with verifiable rewards, for example) can operate without CoT data but it is much more compute-inefficient since it requires multiple autoregressive completions per optimization step, none of which are guaranteed to give a non-zero policy gradient. In this work we explore a middleground, a self-distillation technique that uses answer-only data, treating CoT as latent variables. This relies on training a partner ``inverse reasoning LLM" that generates the original's reasoning traces conditioned on the answer. The inverse model is trained once and reused across incoming batches of answer-only data, with all generation happening offline and up front, making the approach particularly suited to continual post-training. Using Qwen3-0.6B on the Countdown and GSM8K tasks, we show that after GRPO training has saturated, a single offline distillation round from the inverse model roughly doubles pass@1 on hard prompts and, on Countdown, outperforms rejection-sampling self-distillation on every hard-tail metric at every mix ratio (with smaller gains on GSM8K); rejection sampling by construction has no signal on problems the model never solves on its own. Continued GRPO on the fresh data retains an edge at hard pass@1 but trails distillation at pass@8 and pass@32 while regenerating rollouts at every step. As an added bonus we see that the inverse model has a second application as an accurate verifier of correctness. When used for best-of-$n$ selection at test time, it raises selection accuracy on Countdown from 0.753 (majority voting) to 0.969.

</details>


### [355] [Lotus: Learning to Understand Time-series by Learning to Forecast](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18877)
*Van Dai Do,Huu Hiep Nguyen,Minh Hoang Nguyen,Manh Nguyen,Hung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LOTUS是一种时间序列语言模型，提出"预测接地"(forecast grounding)预训练原则和时频双视图patch表示，通过在LLM隐藏状态上预测下一patch，迫使语言对齐的时间序列表示保留未来演化的时序信息。在三个LLM主干和六个下游任务上以极少可训练参数取得最佳平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列语言模型主要通过标签、字幕、问答对等语言监督来对齐数值信号与语言表示，但这种监督并未明确要求表示保留时间序列的演化信息。同一语言目标可能对应具有不同未来行为的时序状态，仅靠语言监督无法区分它们。因此需要一个能保留未来相关时序信息的预训练目标。

Method: 1) 提出"预测接地"(forecast grounding)预训练原则：在预训练阶段，要求语言对齐的时间序列表示在下游任务适应前仍能预测其源信号的未来演化。2) 提出时频双视图patch表示：将每个时间序列patch的原始时域表示与其FFT频谱表示拼接后再映射到LLM嵌入空间，捕获局部时序变化和周期模式。3) 架构上，将每个通道分割为非重叠patch，经编码器和投影器映射为LLM软token，预训练时从LLM对时间序列token的隐藏状态预测下一patch，通过预测损失的梯度反传塑造LLM所使用的表示。4) 下游适应阶段移除下一patch解码器，使用纯语言目标微调。

Result: 在Gemma3-270M、Gemma3-1B和Qwen3-0.6B三种LLM主干上，在HAR、Sleep-EDF、ECG-QA、PAMAP2、TimeMQA-MCQ和TimeMQA-T/F六个下游数据集上，LOTUS在每个匹配主干组中均取得最佳平均准确率。最佳结果为Qwen3-0.6B上的59.91%平均准确率，超过最强匹配基线3.36%。LOTUS-270M仅用1.9M可训练参数即接近全微调的TS-Reasoner-7B(55.19% vs 55.33%)。在TSRBench零样本评估中，LOTUS-270M以38.5%总体准确率超过13个基线，超越了比其大25-50倍的模型。消融实验表明移除预测接地使平均准确率从55.2%降至43.5%，移除频谱分支在两个阶段同时移除时降低4.7%。

Conclusion: 预测接地作为一种预训练原则是有效的，它使紧凑的时间序列语言模型能够在TSRBench上超越比其大25-50倍的模型。预测性监督有助于保持时间序列表示中的时序结构。频谱分支对捕获频率内容（尤其是低频delta波段）具有重要作用。这些发现支持将预测作为时间序列语言模型的预训练目标，即使下游任务仅需要语言输出。

Abstract: Time-series language models typically align numerical signals with language using labels, captions, or question-answer pairs. Although such supervision encourages linguistic representations, it does not explicitly require them to preserve information about how the underlying time-series signal evolves. We introduce forecast grounding, a pretraining principle that requires language-aligned time-series representations to remain predictive of the future evolution before they are adapted to downstream tasks. We instantiate this principle in LOTUS, which divides each time-series channel into non-overlapping patches and maps them into the LLM embedding space. It then predicts the next patch from the LLM hidden states of the time-series tokens, encouraging the learned representation to retain temporal information. To capture both temporal changes and periodic patterns, we also propose a temporal-spectral patch representation that combines each raw time-series patch with its spectral representation before mapping it into the LLM embedding space. Across three language model backbones and six downstream evaluation datasets, LOTUS achieves the best average performance with minimal trainable parameters, reaching 59.91% accuracy and outperforming the strongest matched baseline by 3.36%. Our representation analyses further show that LOTUS uses the numerical input and preserves temporal structure in its learned patch representations. These results establish forecast grounding as a promising pretraining principle, enabling compact time-series language models to outperform models 25 to 50 times their size on TSRBench.

</details>


### [356] [Learnable Hodge-Laplacian Driven Mixture of Experts for Steady-PDE Surrogates on Coarse Unstructured Meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20585)
*Stavros Nousias,Akis Nousias,Konstantinos Gkrispanis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种Hodge-Laplacian驱动的Transformer专家混合架构(Hodge-routed MoE),用于非结构网格上的稳态PDE代理建模。该方法将求解分配给多个专注于不同频谱尺度的vanilla Transformer专家,并使用离散Hodge Laplacian作为门控机制(路由权重)而非预测算子。在AirFRANS翼型RANS基准测试上,相比Transolver基线,相对L2误差降低31%,内部MSE降低47%,且参数量仅为其一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稳态PDE非结构网格代理模型在整个解上使用单一混合机制,难以捕捉多尺度特征。本文旨在通过频谱尺度专家化和网格结构感知的路由机制,解决多尺度PDE问题中不同频谱成分需要不同处理方法的挑战,同时避免Hodge算子在预测路径上引入的平滑效应。

Method: 方法包含三大核心组件:(1)高斯星构造的Hodge控制器:使用对称正半定的Gaussian核学习离散Hodge星,通过2层Gaussian-Hodge模块计算顶点路由权重;(2)8个频谱专家MoE:每个专家结合共享顶点嵌入与不同尺度的固定Fourier位置特征(σ从1.0到38.0),通过2块vanilla Transformer块处理;(3)频谱带监督:使用对角星Hodge Laplacian的平滑梯子(8级,m=[2,4,6,8,12,16,24,32])生成9个原子,通过softmax分配为各专家的辅助监督目标。训练目标包括体/面场重建损失、频谱带损失(λ=0.5)、路由平衡损失(λ=0.01)和能量下限惩罚(λ=1.0)。

Result: 在AirFRANS官方800/200划分上(重网格化至约4.9K顶点),Hodge-routed MoE(3.02M参数)取得相对L2误差0.0300(优于Transolver 6.00M的0.0436,降低31%)、R²=0.9983、体积MSE=0.00140(降低47%)。湍流黏度ν_t改善最大(46%)。但表面Surf误差(0.00164)和升力系数误差C_L(0.0225)高于Transolver(分别为0.00143和0.0103)。频谱分解显示压力场81%能量在最粗原子,14%在最细残差中。

Conclusion: 本文提出的Hodge路由MoE架构通过将网格结构感知与频谱尺度专家化结合,在非结构网格稳态PDE代理建模上取得显著性能提升,验证了频谱带分解与网格感知路由的有效性。然而,该方法仍存在以下局限:(1)注意力复杂度为二次,所有专家均被评估;(2)当前实现未强制执行控制器所需的互惠邻域条件;(3)表面和升力误差高于Transolver;(4)仅在单一网格分辨率与PDE族下验证。未来工作需强制结构条件、引入高效专家架构,并扩展至多尺度多PDE验证。

Abstract: Current approaches for steady partial differential equations surrogate models on unstructured meshes apply a single mixing mechanism to the whole solution. This paper proposes an architecture that partitions the solution among vanilla transformer experts, each focused on a different spectral scale. The partition is built from a discrete Hodge Laplacian $L_0=\star_0^{-1} d_0^{\top}\star_1 d_0$, that serves as a fitting layer measuring high-frequency content. A gating mechanism takes the mesh as input and produces the per-vertex weights that recombine the expert outputs. AirFRANS is a steady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) airfoil benchmark. We evaluate our approach in a reduced remeshed version of the benchmark with each unstructured mesh counting 9.6K faces and 4.9K vertices. We compare our approach with the Transolver on the same dataset and dataset slit. Our approach reduces relative $L_2$ error by 31\% and interior mean squared error by 47\%.

</details>


### [357] [Revisiting Simple Baselines for Relational Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20534)
*Viet The Nguyen,Vijay Prakash Dwivedi,Gunther Gust*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了关系深度学习（RDL）中的简单基线方法，提出了一种无需学习关系聚合的轻量级流水线：通过固定低通特征传播增强MLP输入，再结合Correct-and-Smooth（C&S）标签传播利用历史标签。该方法在RelBench基准测试上仅使用少量可训练参数即接近异构GNN的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关系深度学习方法主要依赖复杂的GNN或Transformer架构，但其相对简单基线（如MLP）的有效性缺乏系统评估，难以判断架构复杂度的必要性。此外，RDL中的图是异构且时序的，简单的同态图传播方法无法直接应用。

Method: 1. 特征传播：将异构关系数据库折叠为同态图，按时间快照进行固定低通滤波（K步传播），保留各表属性特征。2. MLP预测：在传播后的特征上训练单隐藏层MLP。3. 标签传播：构建任务特定的元图（meta-graph）连接目标实体的历史标签及相关实体标签，应用Correct-and-Smooth后处理。

Result: 在RelBench-v1和RelBench-v2的21个任务上：特征传播在20/21任务上优于仅用目标属性的MLP，将平均分类AUROC与HeteroGNN的差距缩小至1.6-1.8点；可训练参数相比HeteroGNN减少58.7%-95.5%；但在历史标签利用方面，元图构建方式缺乏统一最优方案，不同任务需要不同的图构造策略。

Conclusion: 固定特征传播可在无需学习关系聚合的情况下恢复大部分关系预测信号，是评估复杂RDL模型必要性的有力基线。然而，关系数据库模式本身并不规定哪些连接支持有效的标签传播，因此规范化的元图构建方法是从历史标签中获益的关键挑战。

Abstract: Relational deep learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning end-to-end predictive models over relational databases by representing them as temporal heterogeneous graphs. Recent advances based on graph neural networks and Transformers have achieved strong performance across diverse domains. However, the effectiveness of simpler relational baselines remains underexplored, making it difficult to assess how much architectural complexity is needed to achieve strong predictive performance. Motivated by the observation that predictive signals arise from target attributes, relational attributes, and historical labels, we revisit how effectively these signals can be exploited using simple propagation methods. We adapt fixed low-pass feature propagation to relational entity graphs and train an MLP for prediction. The resulting predictions are further refined using Correct-and-Smooth, a graph-based label propagation algorithm that incorporates historical labels over task-specific meta-graphs connecting target entities. Across classification and regression tasks on RelBench, an MLP trained on neighborhood-filtered features outperforms one using only target-entity features on most tasks and recovers a substantial portion of the performance of heterogeneous GNNs. Correct-and-Smooth provides further gains from historical labels, although applying it requires a separately constructed meta-graph because connections among target entities are not directly specified by the relational entity graph. Together, our studies revisit the effectiveness of established propagation methods as simple RDL baselines while identifying canonical meta-graph construction as a key challenge for effective label propagation.

</details>


### [358] [Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20533)
*Alan Baade,Kyle Sargent,Vincent Sitzmann,Eric Ryan Chan,Justin Johnson,Li Fei-Fei,Gordon Wetzstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为RePR（Relative Prediction Representations）的自监督表示学习方法，专门为生成模型设计作为分词器（tokenizer）。该方法通过分解数据的点互信息（PMI）来监督表示学习，利用生成模型的条件预测来估计PMI，从理论上和实验上避免了DINO和LeJEPA等方法中常见的维度崩溃和特征抑制问题，并展现出良好的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于表示学习的分词器（如DINOv2、RAE）使用为判别性任务设计的编码器，其训练目标并非为生成服务，且需要比生成模型多得多的数据和计算资源来训练。传统对比学习方法存在特征抑制问题，会丢弃对生成至关重要但对判别无用的潜在变量。因此需要探索专门为生成优化的可扩展表示学习方法。

Method: 1. 提出RePR（Relative Prediction Representations）：通过条件生成模型估计两个数据视图间的加权PMI，直接监督表示编码器输出的特征点积等于PMI；2. 使用扩散模型的ELBO作为似然估计工具；3. 引入时间步加权（timestep weighting）控制不同SNR尺度信息的贡献；4. 使用自举式PMI估计（bootstrapped PMI estimation）将全视图PMI分解为局部增量；5. 架构上结合MAR（Masked Autoencoder with diffusion head）作为预测模型；6. 通过迭代特征预测（iterative feature prediction）逐步替换像素目标为特征目标以提升性能。

Result: 1. RePR在特征抑制压力测试（带水印的ImageNet）下保持稳定，而LeJEPA和DINOv3崩溃；2. 在ImageNet和GPIC数据集上展示了清晰的编码器幂律扩展规律；3. 推断可达到DINOv2级别性能但FLOPs仅为其1/7，WebSSL级别性能但FLOPs仅为其1/8；4. 首次证明表示学习+生成在联合FLOPs上比直接像素扩散更优；5. 使用JiT-L获得ImageNet FID-50K=2.18（PSNR 21.72dB，超过DINOv2的18.09dB），对比JiT-L直接像素扩散FID-50K=2.36。

Conclusion: RePR是一个理论上动机明确的表示学习方法，可作为生成模型的可扩展分词器。它继承了对比学习的理论保证（PMI分解），无需负样本，并在现有方法失效时对特征抑制保持鲁棒。RePR建立在扩散可扩展性的基础上，展示了清晰的扩展规律，证明表示学习可以作为额外的扩展轴，与生成建模结合后在匹配训练FLOPs下优于直接扩散。这表明具有扎实理论基础的表示学习可以与生成建模的扩展共生并改进之。

Abstract: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 8x fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC.

</details>


### [359] [The Physics Is the Network: Fast, Training-Free Neural Emulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20525)
*Luka Todorovic,Kaushal Gianchandani,Sai Ravela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Neural emulation need not require learning a substitute for known physics. We investigate PolyNets that couple a continuous-time neural representation of polynomial dynamics with a simple recurrent network for discrete-time integration. When the governing coefficients are known, the resulting tensor graph requires no training and preserves the prescribed numerical scheme while enabling efficient hardware execution and parallel simulation. Using the one-dimensional Korteweg-de Vries equation, we compare PolyNet with CPU and GPU finite-difference Runge-Kutta solvers and three trained neural models: a state-map emulator, a physics-informed predictor, and a learned-tendency integrator. Analytical soliton solutions provide a reference for amplitude and phase errors across grid resolutions, 10^6 dispersively scaled time steps, ensembles of up to 10^4 trajectories, and varying initial amplitudes. PolyNet achieves accuracy comparable to the numerical solvers, including at amplitudes outside the learned models' training conditions. It combines this fidelity with high GPU throughput, approximately constant over the tested resolution range, and favorable ensemble scaling.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (incomplete_output). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (incomplete_output). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: Neural emulation need not require learning a substitute for known physics. We investigate PolyNets that couple a continuous-time neural representation of polynomial dynamics with a simple recurrent network for discrete-time integration. When the governing coefficients are known, the resulting tensor graph requires no training and preserves the prescribed numerical scheme while enabling efficient hardware execution and parallel simulation. Using the one-dimensional Korteweg-de Vries equation, we compare PolyNet with CPU and GPU finite-difference Runge-Kutta solvers and three trained neural models: a state-map emulator, a physics-informed predictor, and a learned-tendency integrator. Analytical soliton solutions provide a reference for amplitude and phase errors across grid resolutions, 10^6 dispersively scaled time steps, ensembles of up to 10^4 trajectories, and varying initial amplitudes. PolyNet achieves accuracy comparable to the numerical solvers, including at amplitudes outside the learned models' training conditions. It combines this fidelity with high GPU throughput, approximately constant over the tested resolution range, and favorable ensemble scaling.

</details>


### [360] [Bayesian Learning to Select Fair Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20514)
*Saatvik Kher,Hyungrok Do,Judy Zhong,Padhraic Smyth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯多臂老虎机（Thompson采样）的在线公平分类器选择方法，用于在动态数据流中自适应地选择最能平衡预测准确性与敏感属性子群体公平性的分类器，同时支持延迟反馈与查询成本权衡。该研究在多个真实数据集（含表格分类器、LLM、人类标注者）上证明了其方法相比UCB、ε-贪心、轮询等基线具有显著更低的遗憾，并给出了显式包含敏感子群体比例与公平性权重的理论遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的批量评估所有分类器在测试集上的表现在现实场景中代价过高甚至不可行；而现有的在线模型选择工作未充分考虑公平性维度。因此需要一种在线、自适应的策略，能够在平衡预测准确性的同时兼顾敏感属性的子群体公平性，并允许标签延迟观测。

Method: 将该问题建模为贝叶斯多臂老虎机问题，每条臂代表一个预训练分类器或人类专家。定义权衡准确性、公平性差距与查询成本的效用函数 U_a(λ) = ρ_a − λg_a − c_a。采用Thompson采样：维护每臂每子群体的Beta后验以及边际准确性的Beta后验，决策时从后验中采样并选择最大化采样效用值的臂。同时支持延迟反馈下的精度后验更新，以及通过Dirichlet后验扩展到多类别、多子群体及实值奖励场景。

Result: 在7个真实数据集（涵盖ML分类器、LLM、人类专家；包括Bank、Adult、Credit、ACSIncome、Toxicity、Bios、Twitter）上的10,000次运行结果显示，TS在14个端点案例中的12个实现了最低遗憾，其余仅差0.1；同时在所有λ值的比较中TS在4个数据集上100%最优。在双类别、二元敏感属性的标准设置下推导了与差距相关和无差距的遗憾界，界限显式包含子群体最小占比π_min与公平权重λ的影响，并扩展到延迟反馈情形。

Conclusion: 该方法为在线公平模型选择提供了兼具理论与实证支撑的解决方案，能够在多种分类器类型和公平约束下显著降低遗憾。理论上揭示了敏感子群体占比与公平性权衡如何影响收敛速率，验证了Thompson采样在含公平约束的多臂老虎机场景中的优越性。局限性包括：理论分析限于二元分类、非上下文老虎机及基于差的公平度量；未来工作将探索上下文老虎机、时间-事件模型、多子群体探索算法等方向。

Abstract: Evaluations of classifiers (AI or human or agents) often assume a batch setting in which every agent produces labels on every example in a test set, which can be expensive or impractical in many contexts. This motivates online policies that adaptively select agents to query as examples arrive and update policies as outcomes are observed. We study the problem of selecting, in an online stream, the agent that best balances (i) predictive performance and (ii) subgroup fairness of a sensitive attribute, and that allows for delayed observations of true class labels. We formulate this as a Bayesian multi-armed bandit problem using Thompson Sampling, explicitly balancing accuracy and fairness. We conduct empirical evaluations on real-world datasets spanning problems involving tabular classifiers, large language models, and human labelers, demonstrating substantial reductions in regret relative to baselines. Our theoretical contributions include guarantees on the performance of the selected agent that incorporate both the accuracy and fairness aspects of the problem.

</details>


### [361] [A Two-Level Clinical Novelty Prioritization Framework for Disease Trajectories Discovered from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20512)
*Jin-Jia Zheng,Vincent S. Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两层次框架，用于在已通过图学习方法从MIMIC-IV电子健康记录中挖掘出的99,527个分叉轨迹（branching motifs）的基础上进行语义层面的优先级排序。框架结合了基于PubMed文献的语义稀缺度（路径级与节点-终点级）与可靠性调整的临床优先级，并通过多维度鲁棒性分析与语义剂量分析验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于图的电子健康记录（EHR）分析方法能够挖掘疾病轨迹（disease-trajectory catalogs），但仅凭图结构的支持并不足以证明其语义新颖性。因此，亟需一种在已发现轨迹基础上进行语义优先级排序的框架，以区分真正具有临床与科研价值的轨迹与结构性伪发现。

Method: 本文采用两层次框架对冻结的轨迹目录进行优先级排序。具体包括：(1) 对每个分叉轨迹及其节点-终点对生成三种确定性文本化表示；(2) 使用 BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 进行嵌入，并以166,972篇2023年前的PubMed文献作为参考集，计算平均top-20余弦距离以衡量语义稀缺度；(3) 引入正重组率（8.63%）与特异性、支持度/GNN可靠性等临床优先级指标；(4) 通过改变邻居数量、模板、编码器、通用标签分类法、评分设置、PrimeKG替代数据库以及修正的基于密度的RND指标进行鲁棒性分析；(5) 在高语义子组（catalog-q90）中进行语义剂量分析与分支增强预测评估。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 正重组对全局排名影响可忽略；(2) 特异性与支持度/GNN可靠性显著改变临床优先级排序；(3) 整体排名稳定性优于硬性top-k归属；(4) 语义剂量与预测收益之间在终点与token数调整后不存在单调关系（每标准差1.96天；95% CI: -0.75至4.68）；(5) 在高语义子组中，分支增强预测将条件事件时间MAE降低20.1天（95% CI: 13.3-27.0），sMAPE降低2.37个百分点（95% CI: 1.81-2.93），但判别能力与终点排名差异不具结论性；(6) 修正RND与主评分在尾部一致性较低（Spearman ρ=0.430；q90 Jaccard=0.125）。

Conclusion: 本文结论支持对已发现轨迹进行"表征感知、不确定性感知、文献相对"的优先级排序，而非依赖因果发现或临床医生裁定的新颖性判断。该框架为从大规模EHR数据中筛选具有真正临床与科研价值的疾病轨迹提供了一种可解释且稳健的方法论路径。

Abstract: Graph-based analysis of electronic health records (EHRs) yields disease-trajectory catalogs, but structural support does not establish semantic novelty. We present a two-level framework to prioritize 99,527 branching motifs previously discovered by an upstream patient-disjoint, train-only MIMIC-IV v3.1 pipeline and frozen after validation-based catalog selection. The framework separates path-level and node-to-endpoint semantic sparsity from reliability-adjusted clinical priority. Three deterministic textualizations per motif or node-target pair were embedded with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 and calibrated against 166,972 pre-2023 PubMed references using mean top-20 cosine distance. Positive recombination occurred in 8.63% of motifs and had negligible effect on global ranking, whereas specificity and support/GNN reliability terms changed clinical-priority ordering. Robustness analyses across neighbor counts, templates, encoders, generic-label taxonomies, score settings, PrimeKG, and corrected density-based RND showed that broad ordering was more stable than hard top-k membership. A semantic-dose analysis did not support a monotonic relation between score and forecasting benefit after endpoint and token-count adjustment (1.96 days per SD; 95% CI, -0.75 to 4.68). In the frozen catalog-q90 high-semantic subgroup, branch-enhanced forecasting reduced conditional event-time MAE by 20.1 days (95% CI, 13.3-27.0) and sMAPE by 2.37 percentage points (95% CI, 1.81-2.93), while discrimination and endpoint-ranking differences were inconclusive. Corrected RND showed low tail agreement with the primary score (Spearman rho = 0.430; q90 Jaccard = 0.125) despite a similar aggregate timing association. These findings support representation-aware, uncertainty-aware literature-relative prioritization of discovered trajectories rather than causal discovery or clinician-adjudicated novelty.

</details>


### [362] [Graph-Enhanced Disease Trajectory Discovery and Temporal Endpoint Forecasting from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20502)
*Jin-Jia Zheng,Vincent S. Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于图增强框架的方法，用于从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）中预测疾病进展，重点在于无信息泄露的轨迹发现、检查性证据和审查感知的结果处理，核心价值在于长程时间预测支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向EHR数据蕴含疾病进展结构信息，但疾病进展预测面临三大挑战：信息泄露控制、审查感知结局处理以及可检查的轨迹证据需求。现有方法缺乏结构化、无泄露、可解释的轨迹建模框架。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV v3.1上构建图增强框架：1）在图构建前分割患者，确保训练零泄露；2）仅从训练数据中学习连续入院的转移关系；3）冻结端点特定的"分支 motif（branching-motif）"策略，这些策略在验证集上选择；4）最终目录包含99,527个motif；5）使用时间感知Transformer通过端点特定交叉注意力机制为每个端点检索最多24个患者兼容motif；6）引入有向、度匹配的GNN修复机制以改善未见边的发现；7）在生存预测评估中使用偏差校正。

Result: 五个训练种子下：micro-AUPRC从0.9330提升到0.9357；事件时间MAE从676.9天降至657.7天（减少19.2天；95%配对患者簇bootstrap CI为13.8-24.8天）；时间效应异质：730天内事件MAE变差，但730天后事件MAE改善58.9天；内部时间分割中，分支条件化使条件事件时间MAE降低26.9天（95% CI 23.0-30.8），但未显示micro-AUPRC改善；校正后的生存评估在0-2,555天支持区间内，宏C-index和综合Brier得分并未优于匹配的历史仅离散危险模型；GNN修复虽大幅改善未见边发现，但替换固定motif身份内的GNN得分未带来下游预测改进。

Conclusion: 分支 motif 应被定位为结构化轨迹上下文，其核心价值在于支持长程事件时间预测，而非均匀地提升端点判别能力、生存预测或因果解释。研究强调在医学时序建模中严谨的无泄露评估、时间异质性分析以及生存评估偏差校正的重要性。

Abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can reveal disease-progression structure, while useful forecasting requires leakage-controlled discovery, censor-aware outcomes, and inspectable trajectory evidence. We developed a graph-enhanced framework in MIMIC-IV v3.1 that splits patients before graph construction, learns train-only consecutive-admission transitions, and freezes endpoint-specific branching-motif policies selected on validation data. The final catalog contained 99,527 motifs, and a time-aware Transformer retrieved at most 24 patient-compatible motifs per endpoint through endpoint-specific cross-attention. Across five training seeds, micro-AUPRC increased from 0.9330 to 0.9357, while event-time MAE decreased from 676.9 to 657.7 days (reduction 19.2 days; 95% paired patient-cluster bootstrap CI, 13.8-24.8). Timing effects were heterogeneous: MAE worsened for events within 730 days but improved by 58.9 days for events occurring after 730 days. In an exploratory internal temporal split, branch conditioning reduced conditional event-time MAE by 26.9 days (95% CI, 23.0-30.8) without evidence of better micro-AUPRC. Corrected survival evaluation over the supported 0-2,555-day interval did not establish macro C-index or integrated Brier score superiority over a matched history-only discrete-hazard model. A directed, degree-matched GNN repair substantially improved unseen-edge discovery, yet replacing GNN-derived scores within fixed motif identities did not improve downstream forecasting. These results position branching motifs as structured trajectory context whose main value is long-range timing support rather than uniformly stronger endpoint discrimination, survival prediction, or causal explanation.

</details>


### [363] [Average-Reward Policy Identification from a Single Continuing Trajectory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20486)
*Tongxi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了平均奖励强化学习中从单一连续轨迹进行策略识别的问题。作者开发了一种算法，能够同时学习数据采集的位置并保证所需样本能被高效收集，建立了识别近似最优策略所需交互次数的上界，并证明了匹配的信息论下界，表明在广泛的环境类别和足够高的精度下，从单一轨迹学习在最坏情况下并不比具有无限制访问状态-动作样本的学习更难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在强化学习中，智能体必须探索未知环境以学习如何做出好的决策。与可以自由采样任何状态-动作对的方法不同，从单一轨迹学习的智能体必须花费额外的时间在状态之间导航。因此，自然会预期从单一轨迹学习需要更多的经验。本文旨在证明这种额外成本并非总是必要的，特别是在平均奖励强化学习的设定下。

Method: 本文提出了两个关键的数学联系：首先，逆计数探索产生具有统计覆盖的实证分配，时间均匀的轨迹流界表明相同的访问计数可以被大致相同质量、加上加性成本平衡的流所覆盖；其次，非均匀估计将这些请求转换为全状态策略保证，其中值截断的负项抵消了由于瞬态流不平衡导致的误差。统计误差因此按 M^{-1/2} 缩放，瞬态校正按 M^{-1} 缩放。算法使用逆计数奖励进行试点探索，然后使用未完成配额指示器进行样本收集，并使用分位数规划和折扣网格进行统计停止。

Result: 主要结果包括：定理1建立了交互次数的上界为 Õ(D∑ᵢmin{dᵢ,D} + SA(B*+1)/ε² + SAD/ε)；推论2表明在适当条件下，继续访问和生成式访问的类复杂度均为 Θ̃(SAD̄/ε²)；定理D.1建立了匹配的下界 Ω̃(SAD̄/ε²log(1/δ))。匹配范围包括最多两个后继者的类的整个 0<ε≤1/32 区间，以及无限制支持在 ε²min{S,D̄}≤1 条件下。

Conclusion: 本文证明导航约束可以在统计预算内被吸收，用于推论2中规定的模型类和精度范围。学习者发现环境能够供应哪些请求，付出获取它们的代价，并使用观察到的数据证明它们的充分性。匹配结果表明，在这些范围内，受控收集可以适应该不可避免的统计预算。对粗精度下无限制支持的匹配仍然开放，需要更敏锐地理解学习有用分配所需的交互次数。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning, an agent must explore an unknown environment to learn how to make good decisions. Unlike methods that can freely sample any state--action pair, an agent learning from a single trajectory must spend additional time navigating between states. It is therefore natural to expect that learning from a single trajectory requires more experience. In this paper, we show that this additional cost is not always necessary. For average-reward reinforcement learning, we develop an algorithm that learns where to collect information while ensuring that the required samples can be obtained efficiently. We establish an upper bound on the number of interactions needed to identify a near-optimal policy. Furthermore, we prove a matching information theoretic lower bound, showing that, for a broad class of environments and at sufficiently high accuracy, learning from a single trajectory is no harder in the worst case than learning with unrestricted access to state action samples. Our results reveal that the additional complexity cost of navigation can be avoided by adapting information gathering requirements to how the environment provides information.

</details>


### [364] [Decoupled Marginal Sharpening for Training-Free Inference-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20483)
*Weixin Wang,Wei Deng,Anderson Schneider,Yuriy Nevmyvaka,Pan Xu,Andrew Bennett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出解耦边际锐化(DMS),一种无需训练的推理时扩展方法,通过在推理路径和最终答案两个阶段使用独立的锐化指数,并结合全适配退火SMC(FAA-SMC)采样器,缓解了序列级幂采样中目标层和采样层两方面的挑战,在四个基准上均取得最佳pass@1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练免费的推理时扩展方法(如序列级幂采样)存在两个层面的问题:在目标层面,完整的序列锐化会过度集中在少数高似然推理-答案轨迹上,抑制支持同一答案的替代路径;在采样器层面,有限粒子的SMC可能因反复复制少数高权重前缀而发生路径坍缩。这些问题限制了LLM推理性能的进一步提升。

Method: 提出解耦边际锐化(DMS)框架:(1)目标层面,将生成分解为推理路径Z和答案A,先以锐化指数α_Z对推理分布进行锐化,再对由加权推理路径聚合得到的答案边际分布以独立指数α_A进行锐化;(2)采样器层面,设计全适配退火SMC(FAA-SMC),结合退火中间幂目标、预测性祖先重采样和局部全适配提议,并引入Island-DMS变体将粒子分成多个独立岛屿以缓解路径坍缩。最终通过采样-重要性-重采样从锐化答案边际中选取答案。

Result: 在MATH500、GPQA-Diamond、HumanEval和AIME24/25四个基准上,使用Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B三个模型,DMS在全部12个模型-基准设置中均取得最高平均pass@1,比最强基线提升0.34–10.07个百分点;同时在所有设置下推理延迟均低于Marginal Sharpening基线。消融实验验证了答案锐化和岛屿采样的有效性,并表明两个锐化指数应独立选择。

Conclusion: DMS通过在推理和答案两个阶段独立控制锐化强度,有效保留了支持同一答案的多种推理路径,同时通过FAA-SMC缓解了SMC采样中的路径坍缩问题。实验结果证明解耦的边际锐化设计在多个推理任务上一致优于现有训练免费的推理时扩展方法,且具有更高的计算效率,代表了一种有效的LLM推理增强框架。

Abstract: We study how to improve LLM reasoning at inference time without updating model weights or using external reward models.
